originalDescription.text:
About us
We’re a growing women’s fashion brand dedicated to mature women aged 50+. We sell online through Shopify and grow through paid social and organic content, and we need a steady flow of high-performing video to keep up.

The role
You’ll own the production of our video content from script to final edit. That means generating the footage with AI as well as editing it. You’ll receive a brief with a script and sometimes a reference video. From there, you decide which clips the script needs, generate them, and edit them into scroll-stopping videos for Meta, TikTok, Instagram and our other channels.

Hyperrealism is non-negotiable. Every video must look like it was shot with a real camera, with real women in real places. Viewers should never be able to tell it’s AI: no plastic skin, warped hands, morphing faces, unnatural movement or glossy “AI look.”

The other two parts of the job that matter most are creative judgement (knowing which shot goes where and which style suits the message) and garment accuracy (our real products must look exactly as they are on screen).

Reference videos
Examples of the styles, formats and quality we’re after are in this Google Drive folder. Please review them before applying:

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/11Wyg5Sa6C-GYYdNi2V1YoBQce16FAj1t?usp=sharing

How the work runs

You receive a brief in ClickUp with a script, and sometimes a reference video to replicate
You break the script into scenes and choose the right shots, hooks and pacing for each line
When given a reference, you replicate its structure, pacing and editing style using our products and models
You generate hyperrealistic clips with AI tools, keeping models, garments and settings consistent across the video
You edit the final video with captions, text overlays, transitions, music and sound design, then deliver in the required formats and aspect ratios

What you’ll create

Paid ads: UGC-style testimonials, try-ons, problem/solution ads, product demos, hook variations and static-to-motion ads for Meta and TikTok
Organic content: trend-led Reels and TikToks, styling videos, “get ready with me” content, outfit transitions and lookbooks
Multiple styles from one script: the same message produced as UGC, polished brand content, voiceover-led and text-led versions for creative testing
Hook and variant testing: multiple openings and cut-downs of each video so we can find winners fast
Authentic representation: hyperrealistic, natural-looking women aged 50+ across a range of body types and skin tones, with real skin texture, natural movement and believable expressions (not over-smoothed or artificially youthful)

Requirements

A portfolio is mandatory. Applications without one will not be considered. It must include hyperrealistic AI-generated video and edited short-form content, ideally fashion, beauty or e-commerce ads.
A proven ability to produce AI video that passes as real footage, with natural motion, lighting, skin and fabric movement
Strong ability to turn a script into a shot list and know which visuals best support each line
Ability to replicate a reference video’s structure, pacing and editing style closely
Hands-on experience generating video with current AI tools (e.g. Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Runway, Sora, Hailuo, Seedance or similar), plus AI image tools for start frames. Tell us your stack.
Proven ability to keep AI models, garments and settings consistent across clips
Strong editing skills in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar, including captions, text animation, sound design and music selection
A deep, current understanding of what’s working in paid media (hooks, ad formats, UGC styles, creative testing) and organic (trending formats, audio and editing styles on TikTok and Reels)
Familiarity with AI voiceover and lip-sync tools (e.g. ElevenLabs or similar), with natural-sounding, believable results
Fast turnaround and the ability to work from a brief with little hand-holding
Comfortable working in ClickUp (taking briefs, updating task status, uploading deliverables)

Nice to have

Experience producing ads for Meta / TikTok that you can share results from
Fashion styling sense (accessories, hair, makeup and complete outfits for mature women)
Motion graphics skills (After Effects or similar)
Experience writing or improving hooks and scripts

How to apply

Send your portfolio link (required). Point us to your most realistic piece.
List the AI and editing tools you use, and describe your workflow from script to final video, including how you keep results hyperrealistic
Pick one video from our reference folder and tell us how you’d recreate it for a women’s fashion product
Tell us one AI or short-form trend you think is working right now in paid ads, and one in organic
Tell us roughly how many finished videos you can deliver per week
Briefly mention your experience using ClickUp with a remote team
Start your application with the word “[keyword]” so we know you read the whole post

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short paid trial: producing a hyperrealistic video from one of our scripts.

originalDescription.text:
TRACS Air Purifiers | Premium Cinematic Homepage Video

We are TRACS Air Purifiers (www.tracspurifiers.com), an established American manufacturer of residential and commercial air purification systems.

We are currently redesigning our Shopify website and looking for a highly skilled AI video creator / 3D motion graphics specialist to produce an impressive, cinematic homepage hero video that immediately communicates our brand's quality, engineering, and advanced air purification technology.

We do not want a typical product advertisement or social media video.

Our goal is to create a premium, visually captivating brand experience similar in production quality and sophistication to the video presentations used by Dyson.

Creative inspiration:

https://www.dyson.com/air-treatment/air-purifiers

We are not looking to copy Dyson's footage, branding, or creative assets. We want an original video that achieves a comparable level of visual impact while showcasing TRACS products and technology.

Creative Vision

We envision a cinematic video incorporating:

Dramatic, premium product reveals with sophisticated lighting.

Smooth camera movements and detailed close-ups of our actual air purification equipment.

Beautiful visualization of airflow and advanced filtration technology.

Potential 3D cutaway animations showing how air moves through our filtration system.

Accurate representation of HEPA filtration, activated carbon, and UV-C technology.

Seamless transitions between residential and commercial applications.

A premium, modern aesthetic that conveys American manufacturing, engineering, quality, and reliability.

We want viewers to immediately feel they are looking at a serious, technologically advanced air purification company.

Critical Requirement: Product Accuracy

Our products must look exactly like the real equipment we manufacture.

This includes accurate:

Product proportions and dimensions

Ventilation openings and airflow paths

Digital control panels and displays

Colors, materials, and finishes

TRACS logos and branding

Internal filtration components, where shown

We do not want generic AI-generated air purifiers or inaccurate representations of our products.

We can provide high-resolution product photographs, technical specifications, branding materials, and reference images.

The ideal candidate should know how to combine AI video generation with traditional editing, compositing, and 3D animation to achieve accurate results.

Technical Deliverables

Main website hero video:

Approximately 12–15 seconds

Seamless looping animation

Premium cinematic quality

Desktop widescreen version (16:9 or wider)

Separate mobile-friendly version (9:16 or appropriately composed vertical format)

Silent playback, suitable for autoplay on a Shopify homepage

Optimized MP4/WebM exports for web performance

High-quality static poster/fallback image

Final high-resolution master file

Editable project/source files, with third-party assets and licensing clearly identified

The video must allow sufficient visual space for our website designer to overlay a headline and shopping buttons.

Please do not permanently embed website headlines or buttons into the video.

Preferred Skills

We are interested in professionals experienced with some combination of:

Runway, Kling, Veo, Higgsfield, or similar AI video tools

Blender, Cinema 4D, or other 3D software

Adobe After Effects

Cinematic product animation

CGI product commercials

Photorealistic rendering

Motion graphics and compositing

AI-assisted product visualization

Website hero video production

We are open to your preferred production workflow if you can deliver exceptional visual quality and product accuracy.

Project Process

We would like to begin with a short, paid 3–5-second concept test before committing to the complete video.

Our preferred process:

Review our TRACS product assets and creative references.

Present a brief storyboard or visual concept.

Produce a paid 3–5-second sample.

Develop the complete hero video after concept approval.

Deliver desktop and mobile versions.

Complete revisions and provide final optimized files.

Please include at least two revision rounds in your full-project quote.

To Apply

Please provide:

Portfolio: Links to your three best cinematic product commercials or AI-assisted product videos.

Relevant experience: Have you worked with physical products where exact product appearance was essential?

Production approach: How would you ensure our actual TRACS air purifiers remain visually accurate throughout the animation?

Pricing: Your fixed-price quote for a 12–15-second hero video, including desktop/mobile versions and revisions.

Timeline: Estimated time required to complete the project.

Paid sample: Your price for an initial 3–5-second concept test.

Please begin your proposal with the words "TRACS CINEMATIC" so we know you have read the project requirements.

We are looking for someone who can bring creative ideas to the table, not simply follow a template.

Our goal is a truly impressive homepage video that differentiates TRACS from competitors and makes a memorable first impression.

originalDescription.text:
# AI Cinematic Filmmaker Needed — Corporate Training Film Series

**Project Type:** Fixed-price contract
**Location:** Worldwide — Remote
**Opportunity:** Initial four-film commission with potential for an ongoing production partnership

## About Us

*tell me. The Institute of Spoken Communication* is an innovative international training organization dedicated to transforming human connection through communication, emotional intelligence, conflict resolution and relationship skills.

We are developing a distinctive library of cinematic educational films for corporate training programs in the United Kingdom, United States and Canada.

We are seeking an experienced, imaginative **AI filmmaker and video producer** who can bring psychologically nuanced workplace scenarios to life through sophisticated, photorealistic storytelling.

## The Project

Our initial commission comprises four short films, approximately 18–23 minutes of finished content in total.

**1. Can't You Take a Compliment? (4–5 minutes)**

A senior executive makes increasingly inappropriate comments to a younger colleague at a corporate Christmas party. The film explores workplace power dynamics, sexual harassment and bystander intervention through two alternative endings and a final moment of reflection.

**2. He's Our Biggest Client (3–4 minutes)**

An employee experiences inappropriate sexual attention from an important client. Her manager must navigate the conflict between commercial interests and professional responsibility.

**3. Just One More Drink (3–4 minutes)**

A workplace celebration reveals the complexities of alcohol, professional hierarchy, social pressure and personal boundaries.

**4. When Attention Becomes Harassment (8–10 minutes)**

A comprehensive, scenario-driven educational film examining sexual harassment, professional boundaries, bystander responsibility, reporting and workplace prevention.

The films will initially be produced for British corporate audiences, with subsequent American and Canadian adaptations anticipated.

## What We Already Have

We have developed:

- A completed screenplay and detailed storyboard for the first film.
- Three approved photorealistic AI character portraits.
- An initial AI-generated video clip.
- Established creative direction, character descriptions and educational objectives.

We will provide the scripts, instructional content, creative oversight and feedback. Additional scripts will be supplied in coordination with the production schedule.

## What We're Looking For

We are seeking a filmmaker with demonstrated expertise in:

- **Cinematic AI video production:** Realistic human characters, natural movement and professional visual storytelling.
- **Character consistency:** Maintaining recognizable faces, wardrobe and appearances across multiple scenes.
- **Dialogue and performance:** Natural British-accented speech, accurate lip synchronization and convincing emotional expression.
- **Visual direction:** Sophisticated lighting, camera movement, composition and continuity.
- **Post-production:** Editing, sound design, appropriately licensed music, subtitles and professional finishing.
- **Creative collaboration:** Interpreting scripts thoughtfully and incorporating feedback.

Experience with Kling, Google Veo, Runway or comparable AI filmmaking technologies is desirable.

We are not seeking animated cartoons, generic avatar presentations, stock-footage compilations or slideshow-style videos.

## Deliverables

The successful freelancer will provide:

- Four completed cinematic films, including the two alternative endings specified for Film 1.
- High-quality 16:9 MP4 exports, preferably 1080p or higher.
- Accurate English subtitles and separate caption files.
- Professionally edited dialogue, music and sound.
- Agreed editable project files and production assets.
- Appropriate commercial-use licences and contractual rights for worldwide educational and promotional distribution.
- Revisions at agreed production milestones.

## Application Requirements

Please include the following in your proposal:

1. Links to two or three examples of your **existing completed AI-generated films**, preferably featuring realistic human characters speaking naturally.
2. Your proposed **fixed price for the complete four-film commission**, including AI-generation costs, editing, audio and revisions.
3. Your estimated production timeline and availability.
4. The AI generation and editing tools you use.
5. Your approach to maintaining character consistency and realistic dialogue across scenes.
6. Your revision policy and the source files you can provide.

**No custom samples, auditions or unpaid test clips are required.** We will evaluate candidates using existing portfolios, relevant experience, client reviews and the quality of their proposals.

## Potential for Ongoing Work

We anticipate expanding our film library to include workplace communication, conflict resolution, leadership, emotional intelligence, relationships and professional conduct.

Our intention is to establish a long-term creative relationship with a talented producer who shares our commitment to intelligent storytelling, psychological realism and high production standards.

We welcome applications from skilled filmmakers worldwide.

**tell me. The Institute of Spoken Communication**
*The Art of Being Heard.*
tellmeinstitute.com

If you can turn a script into a compelling, realistic, movie-style advertisement, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

- Produce high-quality AI drama and cinematic advertisements for e-commerce brands.
- Generate realistic AI characters, environments, and cinematic scenes.
- Transform scripts into emotionally engaging, story-driven video ads.
- Maintain consistent characters, appearances, outfits, and environments throughout each production.
- Handle the complete production process, from AI image/video generation to final editing.
- Incorporate realistic voiceovers, dialogue, sound effects, music, and cinematic transitions.
- Deliver high-quality concepts and initial drafts within 1–2 days.
- Work closely with our creative team to execute concepts, revisions, and new creative directions.

Required Qualifications

- Proven experience creating AI drama ads, movie-style advertisements, or cinematic AI storytelling videos.
- A portfolio demonstrating actual AI-generated drama/movie advertisements.
- Strong understanding of AI character generation and consistency.
- Ability to create realistic characters, cinematic environments, and emotionally compelling scenes.
- Experience with AI video generation and professional video editing.
- Extremely fast execution without compromising quality.
- Strong storytelling, creative judgment, and attention to detail.
- Full-time availability and ability to handle ongoing projects.
- Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines.

Preferred AI Tools

Experience with tools such as:

- Kling AI
- Veo
- Runway
- Higgsfield
- Midjourney
- Flux
- ElevenLabs
- CapCut / Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects
- Other advanced AI video generation and editing tools.

You do not need to use every tool listed. We are interested in your actual production capabilities and the quality of your work.

Compensation & Benefits

- Above-market compensation for highly qualified editors.
- Performance-based bonuses for outstanding work.
- Consistent, long-term projects.
- Opportunity to work with a growing e-commerce brand.
- Full-time engagement with room for growth.

We are willing to pay exceptionally well for editors who can consistently deliver outstanding results.**

MANDATORY APPLICATION QUESTIONS

IMPORTANT: All questions below require answers. Applications with incomplete answers or missing portfolio samples will be disqualified.

1. Which AI tools have you used for client or brand work?

List the specific tools you have used and briefly explain how you use them.

**AI Video Creator & Editor for Social Ads and UGC | Long-Term Opportunity**

We’re looking for an AI video creator and editor to help us make realistic social videos, UGC-style content, and product ads.

We will provide the concepts, scripts, visual references, and scene-by-scene instructions. We also welcome your ideas.

JOB DESCRIPTION
- Create **30–40 short videos per month**, usually **15 seconds each**.
- Generate realistic people, settings, products, and actions using AI.

You will focus on visuals and editing ONLY. Our team will handle text overlays, voiceover, music, and sound.

Animation and motion graphics skills are a bonus.

BUDGET & COLLABORATION
- Budget: monthly retainer
- Long-term collaboration can be discussed after delivery review of first project.
- Deliverable production deadlines TBD by weekly review of creative concepts & complexity
- Please tell us whether AI tools and generation credits are included in your price or cost extra.

HOW TO APPLY
1. Include 3 AI video examples you created: UGC-style videos and product ads are preferred. Animation examples are welcome too.

We’re looking for a reliable creative partner who can deliver realistic visuals and consistent quality. We look forward to working together!

originalDescription.text:
I’m looking for an AI filmmaker to develop and produce a 30–40-second vision film for BrainHome, a startup exploring how homes can support health and independence as we age.

The film will be shared with senior living operators, real estate facility owners, and senior housing REITs. Its purpose is to communicate our vision, create an emotional connection, and spark conversations about pilot partnerships.

This is an end-to-end creative assignment. I have rough story ideas, visual references, and exploratory AI assets. I want someone to own the storytelling, art direction, and production through final delivery.

The story

Emma is an active, independent 65-year-old woman living in a thoughtfully designed residence. She enjoys her life, while her adult daughter sometimes worries about how she’s doing.

As Emma learns about potential future health concerns, she can subscribe to different intelligences within her home. For example, a family history of Alzheimer’s might lead her to choose cognitive wellbeing support. As her needs evolve, she can add other intelligences.

This ability to choose and add intelligence over time is central to the product story. Please show one clear example, with a simple glimpse of the broader possibilities.

Emma also controls what information is shared and who receives it. She chooses to send morning updates to her daughter. Her daughter receives a reassuring notification, visibly relaxes, and returns to her day. Emma continues enjoying her life.

Core message: A home that grows with you—with intelligence you choose as your needs evolve.

This is a future-vision film. It should communicate personalized support without implying that the home diagnoses conditions, predicts disease with certainty, or guarantees safety.

Suggested narrative
- Establish Emma’s personality, home, and independence.
- Show her learning about a potential health concern and subscribing to a relevant intelligence.
- Show Emma choosing to share updates, followed by her daughter receiving reassurance.
- Close with Emma enjoying life, BrainHome branding, and a pilot invitation.
This is a starting point. I want your creative recommendations on how to make the story clear and emotionally compelling within 30–40 seconds. No founder introduction is needed.

Your scope

Own the complete production process:
- Creative treatment, script development, and storyboard.
- AI character and environment creation.
- AI video generation with consistent characters and settings.
- App-screen design and compositing, including subscribing to an intelligence and selecting sharing preferences.
- Voiceover, music, sound design, editing, and color.
- Titles, captions, and final exports.
I’ll provide product context, references, and feedback. You should be comfortable driving the creative process without requiring me to direct every shot.

Visual direction

Cinematic, warm, contemporary, and believable. Thoughtfully designed interiors, natural light, understated performances, and technology that blends into the home.

Avoid generic healthcare advertising, stereotypical depictions of older adults, cluttered interiors, and flashy futuristic effects. Emma should feel capable and engaged in life.

I’m an interior designer and founder, so art direction and environmental detail matter.

Existing materials and tools

I have early OpenArt experiments, character and interior references, and an interactive app concept. These are optional starting points, not finished assets you must preserve.

You may recommend the AI tools and workflow best suited to the project.

Deliverables
- Finished 30–40-second film in 16:9, minimum 1080p.
- Versions with and without captions.
- Editable project files and organized source assets.
- Commercial-use licensing details for music, voices, and other assets.
- Agreed milestones and revision rounds.
Please include in your proposal
1. Two or three relevant AI films, specifying what you personally created.
2. Examples demonstrating realistic people, character consistency, and strong interior art direction.
3. Your initial creative approach to this story.
4. Your proposed timeline and fixed-price quote, including generation and licensing costs.
5. What you would need from me to begin.
I’m looking for a creative partner who can turn an early concept into a cohesive film and own the process through delivery.

originalDescription.text:
We are a growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) brand looking for an experienced AI Video Creator / AI UGC Specialist to produce a realistic, high-converting UGC-style product ad using AI video generation tools.

The goal is a video that looks and feels like authentic user-generated content — a real customer filming on their phone, talking about our product naturally — not a polished studio commercial. It should stop the scroll, build trust, and drive conversions on paid social.

You will own the full process: creative concept, scriptwriting, AI generation, voice delivery, and final editing.

Scope of Work

1. Creative Concept & Script

Research our product, target audience, and competitor ads
Develop a UGC ad concept with a strong 3-second hook
Write a direct-response script (hook → problem → solution → product demo → benefits → social proof → CTA)
Provide 2–3 hook variations for A/B testing

2. AI Avatar / AI Actor Generation

Create hyper-realistic AI UGC creators/AI influencers that look like real people
Natural skin texture, realistic lighting, authentic settings (home, bathroom, kitchen, car, gym, etc.)
Casual handheld, selfie-style, phone-shot framing
Consistent character appearance across all shots

3. Product Integration

Our product must stay accurate: correct packaging, label, color, and shape
Realistic product interaction: holding, unboxing, applying, using, before/after moments
Image-to-video, compositing, or product placement techniques as needed

4. AI Voice Delivery & Lip-Sync

Natural, conversational AI voiceover (not robotic)
Accurate lip-sync and talking-head animation
Human touches: pauses, emphasis, emotion, casual tone
Option for different accents/voices

5. Final Editing

Fast-paced UGC-style editing with jump cuts, zoom punches, and B-roll
Trending animated captions/subtitles
Product close-ups, text overlays, sound design, and background music
Color correction, upscaling, and final polish
Export in 9:16 vertical (plus 1:1 and 16:9 versions if needed)

Deliverables

1 realistic UGC-style video ad (15–20 seconds)
2–3 alternate hook versions
Captioned version + clean version (no captions)
Final files optimized for TikTok Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram Reels), and YouTube Shorts
Revisions included until approved

Preferred Tools / Experience
Experience with some or all of the following is a big plus:

AI video generation: Google Veo 3, Kling AI, Runway Gen-4, Sora, Hailuo/MiniMax, Seedance, Higgsfield, Luma Dream Machine, Pika
AI avatars & UGC platforms: HeyGen, Arcads, Creatify, Captions AI, Synthesia, Hedra
AI image generation: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Stable Diffusion
AI voice: ElevenLabs or similar voice cloning/voice design tools
Editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut
Upscaling/enhancement: Topaz Video AI

Who We’re Looking For

Proven portfolio of realistic AI UGC ads or AI-generated video ads (please share links)
Understanding of direct-response marketing, hooks, and what converts on paid social
Strong eye for realism — avoiding the “uncanny valley” AI look
Experience with DTC/e-commerce niches (skincare, beauty, supplements, wellness, fitness, fashion, home gadgets, etc.)
Good communication and ability to meet deadlines

Potential for Long-Term Work
If this ad performs well, we plan to scale into ongoing AI ad creative production — multiple ad variations, new hooks, and different AI creators for continuous ad testing.

To Apply, Please Include:

Links to 2–3 AI UGC or AI-generated ads you’ve created
Which AI tools you’d use for this project and why
Your estimated timeline and price
A short hook idea for a DTC product ad (bonus points)

Proposals without relevant AI UGC samples will not be considered.

We’re already a multi-six-figure brand, currently spending $200,000 per month on ads, and we’re looking for talented editors to help us scale.

Why This Seat Exists

Winning ads drive our growth. We need more editors who can turn strong concepts into creative that grabs attention, holds it, and sells.

Now we’re expanding the team and giving more talented editors the opportunity to earn.

- You aren’t willing to learn new tools, apply feedback, and improve.

originalDescription.text:
About us
We’re a growing women’s fashion brand dedicated to mature women aged 50+. We sell online through Shopify and paid social, and we need a lot of high-quality imagery to keep up.

The role
You’ll own all AI-generated imagery across the brand. That covers our website, paid ads, email and social. The most important part of this job is garment accuracy: every image has to show our real products exactly as they are (cut, fit, fabric texture, colour, stitching and details). Beautiful images of a garment that isn’t ours are no use to us.

You’ll also act as the stylist for every shoot. Each piece should be styled the way a real woman in our demographic would wear it, so our customer sees herself in the image and can picture the full outfit.

Reference images
Examples of the style and quality we’re after for e-commerce, lifestyle and UGC are in this Google Drive folder. Please review them before applying:
(link removed)

What you’ll create

E-commerce images: clean product-page shots on models (front, back, side, detail), consistent lighting and backgrounds across a collection, plus colour-variant versions
Lifestyle images: our pieces styled in real-world settings our customer relates to, such as lunches with friends, family events, weddings, travel and everyday outings
UGC-style images: authentic phone-shot content (mirror selfies, getting-ready shots, outfit posts) that reads as a real customer, for Meta ads and social
Full styling: choosing shoes, bags, jewellery, hair, makeup and complementary pieces that suit the garment, the occasion and the season
Model consistency: recurring AI models who look the same across shoots and campaigns
Authentic representation: realistic, natural-looking women aged 50+ across a range of body types and skin tones (not over-smoothed or artificially youthful)

Requirements

A portfolio is mandatory. Applications without one will not be considered. Fashion or apparel work is strongly preferred, especially examples where a real garment was placed on an AI model.
Proven ability to keep garments accurate and models consistent across many images
Strong women’s styling skills: a confident eye for accessories, footwear, hair, makeup and complete outfits, with an understanding of how to style mature women in a way that feels modern, elegant and age-appropriate
Ability to generate realistic older models with natural skin texture, hair and features
Strong command of current tools (e.g. Higgsfield, Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Kling, ComfyUI or similar). Tell us your stack.
Retouching skills in Photoshop or similar to fix hands, fabric, logos and artefacts
A good eye for fashion, lighting and what makes ad creative convert
Fast turnaround and the ability to work from a brief with little hand-holding
Comfortable working in ClickUp (taking briefs, updating task status, uploading deliverables) and Slack (daily communication and quick feedback loops)

Nice to have

Background in fashion styling, fashion photography or fashion design
AI video experience (UGC-style clips, product motion)
Experience producing ad creative for Meta / TikTok
Familiarity with Shopify image specs

How to apply

Send your portfolio link (required)
List the tools you use and describe your workflow for keeping a real garment accurate
Tell us how you approach styling a look, for example how you’d accessorise a navy dress on a 60-year-old woman for a wedding versus a lunch out
Tell us roughly how many finished images you can deliver per day
Briefly mention your experience using ClickUp and Slack with a remote team
Start your application with the word “[keyword]” so we know you read the whole post

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short paid trial: generating a few styled images of one of our real products.

originalDescription.text:
Estime Enterprises, Inc. is a commercial construction company in the Washington, DC metropolitan area. We are looking for an experienced AI image-generation specialist to create a collection of highly realistic corporate photographs for our company website, marketing brochures, capability statements, and business development materials.

We want to create realistic images of our company's employees working in our actual office environment.

We will provide photographs of our conference room, reception/front desk, and individual offices. The selected consultant will first create realistic AI-generated employee avatars and then professionally composite those individuals into our actual office photographs.

The finished images must look like genuine professional corporate photographs—not cartoons, illustrations, obvious AI images, or computer-generated characters.

Phase 1 – Create Seven Realistic Employee Avatars

The consultant will create seven distinct, photorealistic professional employee avatars representing the following positions:

Project Manager: White male, approximately 60–65 years old. Professional business appearance, wearing business attire.

Assistant Project Manager: Black male, approximately 20–25 years old. Professional, modern business appearance.

Superintendent #1: Black male, approximately 50–55 years old. Experienced construction professional.

Superintendent #2: Hispanic male, approximately 50–55 years old. Experienced construction professional.

Superintendent #3: White male, approximately 40–45 years old. Experienced construction professional.

Administrative Assistant: Black female, approximately 25–30 years old. Professional office appearance.

Controller: Male or female, approximately 55–60 years old. Professional executive/business appearance.

The avatars must have realistic facial features, natural skin textures, appropriate clothing, realistic body proportions, and professional expressions.

Each individual must have a consistent appearance across all photographs. The same person must look identical in the conference room, office desk, and individual portrait photographs.

Phase 2 – Conference Room Corporate Photography

We will provide photographs of our actual conference room.

Create professional corporate photographs showing all seven employees seated around the conference room table participating in a business meeting.

The images should include:

The project manager leading or participating in the meeting.

The assistant project manager reviewing documents or taking notes.

The three superintendents participating in the discussion.

The administrative assistant and controller participating in the meeting.

Natural facial expressions and realistic body positioning.

Professional business attire and appropriate construction management documents on the table.

Create several different compositions, including a wide-angle photograph showing the entire team and closer photographs showing team members interacting.

Phase 3 – Individual Office Photography

We will provide photographs of our actual offices.

Create realistic photographs showing:

Project Manager seated at his desk, working on project documents or reviewing construction plans.

Assistant Project Manager seated at his desk working on a computer and reviewing project information.

Controller seated at her/his desk reviewing financial reports, invoices, and accounting documents.

The individuals must be professionally integrated into our actual office photographs.

Phase 4 – Superintendent Portraits

Create individual professional photographs of the three superintendents.

Each superintendent should be photographed standing naturally against a wall inside our actual office.

The images should look like professional corporate employee portraits, with appropriate business-casual or construction-management attire.

Deliverables

The selected consultant will provide:

Seven original, high-resolution employee avatars.

Conference room team photographs showing all seven employees.

Three individual office/desk photographs.

Three individual superintendent portraits.

Additional close-up or alternative compositions as agreed.

High-resolution JPG and PNG files suitable for printing and digital marketing.

Layered Photoshop PSD files for the final composite photographs.

Commercial usage rights for all final images and confirmation that the assets used are appropriately licensed.

All images must be high resolution and suitable for professional brochures, website graphics, and company capability statements.

Required Qualifications

Applicants must have demonstrated experience with:

Photorealistic AI-generated human characters.

Consistent AI characters across multiple photographs and scenes.

Adobe Photoshop and advanced photo compositing.

Generative AI image editing and background integration.

Matching lighting, shadows, perspective, and color between people and actual office photographs.

Creating professional corporate and business photography.

Please include samples of previous work involving realistic AI-generated people integrated into real office environments.

Important Project Requirements

This project will be completed in stages.

Stage 1: Create the seven employee avatars and submit them for approval.

Stage 2: Once approved, we will provide our actual office photographs for integration.

Stage 3: Submit preliminary composite images for review and corrections.

Stage 4: Deliver final high-resolution images and editable source files.

We want to approve the appearance of each individual before proceeding with the office photographs.

When Applying, Please Answer These Questions

What AI software and image-editing programs would you use for this project?

How would you maintain the same facial appearance and identity of each individual across multiple photographs?

Have you previously placed AI-generated people into real office photographs?

Can you provide examples of similar projects?

How long would you need to complete all phases?

What is your fixed-price proposal for the complete project?

We are looking for someone with excellent attention to detail who can produce professional, convincing corporate photography.

originalDescription.text:
We’re Bulletproof Fitness Equipment, an innovative fitness equipment company specializing in unique, multifunctional strength-training products designed to replace traditional gym machines while saving space.

We’re looking for an exceptional direct-response creative strategist and video editor who knows how to create Facebook and Instagram ads that don’t just look great—they convert into sales.

We admire the advertising styles of brands like Freak Athlete and The Nordstick. Their ads are engaging, authentic, creative, sometimes humorous, and extremely effective at demonstrating why customers need their products.

We’re looking for someone who understands what makes ads like these successful and can help us create our own unique, high-performing campaigns.

What We’re Looking For

We need someone who can do more than simply edit footage.

Our founder is comfortable filming product demonstrations, talking directly to the camera, creating scripted scenes, and shooting additional content based on your direction.

Your role is to help turn that content into high-converting ads.

Ideally, you’ll be able to:

* Develop creative concepts: Research winning ads, identify compelling angles, and suggest original concepts that make our products stand out.
* Provide filming direction: Tell us exactly what footage to shoot, including scripts, hooks, demonstrations, camera angles, and B-roll.
* Produce exceptional video ads: Edit attention-grabbing, high-quality direct-response ads with strong storytelling, pacing, captions, graphics, and sound design.
* Create multiple variations: Test different hooks, opening scenes, messaging, lengths, and calls to action.
* Understand performance marketing: Know how to evaluate ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rates, and other important metrics to improve future creative.
* Continuously innovate: Bring fresh ideas to the table instead of waiting for us to tell you what to create.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re especially interested in someone who has:

* A proven track record creating profitable Meta ads for e-commerce or direct-to-consumer brands.
* Experience with fitness equipment, home gym products, or other physical products that benefit from demonstrations.
* Strong creative strategy skills—not just technical editing abilities.
* An understanding of direct-response marketing, consumer psychology, and effective storytelling.
* Experience developing founder-led, UGC-style, comparison, and problem/solution ads.
* The ability to take raw footage and turn it into professional, engaging advertisements.
* A proactive approach to recommending new creative directions based on performance.

We’re not looking for someone who simply adds captions, transitions, and music to videos. We’re looking for someone who understands how to sell products through creative advertising.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique

Bulletproof has a growing lineup of innovative products with unique features and compelling demonstrations.

Our equipment offers opportunities for creative advertising, including:

* Showing how one product can replace multiple traditional gym machines.
* Humorous comparisons between bulky gym equipment and compact multifunctional solutions.
* Founder-led product stories and demonstrations.
* Side-by-side comparisons, transformations, and educational content.
* Unique product features that create immediate curiosity.

We have plenty of opportunities to develop original creative concepts, and we’re willing to put in the effort to film the content you need.

We’re looking for someone who can help us build a repeatable system for producing winning ads.

How to Apply

Please include the following in your proposal:

1. Links to 3–5 of your best-performing video ads, preferably for physical products.

Location: Remote. 
Type: Full-time. 
Hours: 40 per week, with some overlap with US Eastern business hours. 
Language: English.

APE BORN is an 8-figure direct-to-consumer fitness brand. We sell muscle stimulation technology, and our growth runs on video ads on Facebook and Instagram.

We are growing our in-house creative team and hiring a full-time Video Editor who makes direct-response ads that sell. This is not a job of cutting clips together. You take a script and a voiceover and turn them into a finished ad that stops the scroll, holds attention and gets people to buy. If you think like a creative strategist and you already use AI to make visuals, read on.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Edit Meta video ads: direct-response ads for Facebook and Instagram, built to convert.
- Turn scripts into stories: take a script and voiceover and build the full ad yourself.
- Make hook variations: several different openings for every ad, for testing.
- Create AI visuals: realistic AI video, scenes and animations.
- Mix all footage: AI footage, stock, product demos and motion graphics in one clean edit.
- Finish with polish: animated captions, sound effects, transitions and music.
- Learn from winners: study winning ads and use what works in new ones.
- Work with strategists: follow creative briefs and help improve ad results.
- Ship every week: several polished versions each week, on time.

OUR STACK
You do not need deep expertise in every tool, but familiarity is preferred.
- Editing: CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro or Adobe After Effects (at least one, well)
- AI video and voice: Higgsfield, Google Flow (Veo), ElevenLabs
- Ads: Facebook and Instagram
- Communication: Slack

WHO THIS IS FOR
- You have 2+ years of professional video editing, including direct-response ads for DTC eCommerce brands.
- You have made AI animations and AI-powered ads yourself.
- You know hooks, pacing, storytelling and retention, and you can explain why an ad works.
- You can find or make the right visuals for a script on your own.
- You follow a brief closely and catch small details.
- You take feedback and use it on the next version the same day.
- You hit deadlines week after week.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
- Your ads arrive finished, on brief and ready to launch, with few rounds of changes.
- Every ad comes with strong hook variations ready to test.
- Your AI visuals look real and professional, never cheap or strange.
- Your ads become winners we scale.

NOT A FIT IF
- You have only edited YouTube videos, vlogs or events, never ads made to sell.
- You have never made AI video yourself.
- You need a shot list for every second and cannot build an ad from a script.
- You want part-time or project work only.

WHAT WE OFFER
- Full-time, long-term remote work with an established 8-figure DTC brand.
- Modern AI video tools and creative software.
- A steady flow of ads, with winners tested and scaled.
- An experienced performance marketing and creative team.
- Room to grow into Senior Video Editor or Creative Strategist.

HOW WE HIRE
1. Apply: we review your application and portfolio.
2. Short questions: we message you three quick questions.
3. Recorded interview: a short video interview on Zoom.
4. Editing trial: we send a script, a voiceover and an inspiration ad. You make one full ad with three different hooks.
5. Final interview: we go over your trial, your process, your tools and long-term fit.

HOW TO APPLY
Please send us:
- Your resume and portfolio link.
- Links to your 3 best direct-response video ads.
- Links to AI animations or AI-powered ads you made.
- The editing and AI tools you use now.
- Your expected monthly salary in USD.
- Your timezone, your working hours, and confirmation that you can work full-time.

Please also answer:

2. Have you edited direct-response video ads for a DTC eCommerce brand?
3. Have you made AI video yourself with tools like Higgsfield, Google Flow (Veo) or ElevenLabs?
4. Can you work full-time, 40 hours a week, with some overlap with US Eastern hours?

Applications without direct-response ad work or hands-on AI video work will not be considered. We want editors who make ads perform, not only look good.

originalDescription.text:
# Creative Brief – Evie & Skye Storefront & Website Animation

We are looking for an experienced AI creative expert to partner with us in developing a beautiful, photorealistic virtual storefront for Evie & Skye, beginning with our Christmas collection.

Our vision is to create a distinctive digital shopfront that welcomes visitors to our website and evolves throughout the year to reflect our collections, seasons and special occasions.

We are looking for **an ongoing creative partner**, rather than someone to complete a single project.

### 1. Creative Direction

Our aesthetic is **fresh yet timeless**, combining the elegance of a London townhouse with the warmth, colour and personality of a beautifully curated interiors boutique.

We want the storefront to feel welcoming, sophisticated and full of character, without becoming overly traditional or twee.

Above all, the imagery must feel like genuine photography rather than something obviously AI-generated.

### 2. Initial Project – Christmas Storefront

We have already developed a base image of our Evie & Skye storefront, which we will provide.

We would like to transform this into a beautifully styled Christmas shopfront.

**Exterior**
- Retain the existing off-white façade, architecture and Evie & Skye branding.
- Add tasteful Christmas greenery, warm white fairy lights and seasonal winter planters.
- Feature one of our **extra-large Christmas fabric bows prominently on the front door**, using our actual product design.
- Create a welcoming, festive London atmosphere.

**Christmas Window Display**

We would like the windows to showcase our actual Christmas collection, including:

- Christmas stockings in our signature prints.
- Santa sacks in our different fabrics and colourways.
- Our Mistral Drape tablecloth, styled on a beautiful Christmas dining table.
- A beautifully decorated Christmas tree.
- Carefully selected festive accessories and seasonal greenery.

We will provide photographs of our products. It is essential that their colours, patterns, shapes and fabric details are reproduced accurately.

### 3. Website Video Animation

Once the Christmas storefront image has been approved, we would like to bring it to life through a short cinematic video.

**The concept is simple: customers virtually walk into our store.**

We imagine the following sequence:

1. The video opens with a full view of our beautifully decorated Christmas storefront.
2. The camera slowly approaches the entrance, as though the customer is walking towards the shop.
3. The shop door gently opens, with our oversized Christmas bow attached.
4. We hear the charming sound of an old-fashioned shop doorbell ringing.
5. The camera moves through the doorway, transitioning seamlessly into our actual website homepage.

The animation should feel natural, realistic and beautifully executed, with no exaggerated AI effects.

**Ideal duration:** Approximately 5–7 seconds.

The final video will be used on our Shopify website, so we will require desktop and mobile-friendly versions, along with a separate audio file for the shop bell.

We would also welcome your recommendations on how best to achieve the transition from the animation into our live website.

### 4. An Ongoing Creative Partnership

Our longer-term vision is to make the Evie & Skye storefront a recognisable and evolving part of our brand identity.

Rather than creating an entirely new storefront each time, we want to retain the same beautiful architecture and overall character, while changing the window displays, products, decorations and atmosphere throughout the year.

For example:

- **Spring/Summer:** Fresh, colourful displays featuring our table linens, cushions and seasonal homewares, with beautiful flowers and greenery outside.
- **Children's Collection:** A playful but sophisticated window showcasing our children's bedding, blankets, cushions and prints.
- **Autumn/Winter:** Richer colours, layered textiles, cosy interiors and seasonal styling.
- **Christmas:** Our festive collections, Christmas decorations and beautifully dressed windows.
- **Special Occasions:** Smaller seasonal updates for key dates such as Easter, Mother's Day and other relevant gifting occasions.

We see this as creating a **living digital storefront** that changes with the seasons, just as a beautiful physical interiors shop would.

Ideally, we would work together to establish a consistent visual style and develop a process that allows us to refresh the storefront efficiently, without rebuilding everything from scratch.

We would also like to explore how the animations could evolve alongside the storefront, while retaining the same recognisable experience of entering the Evie & Skye shop.

### 5. Deliverables & Working Together

For the initial Christmas project, we would like:

- One high-resolution, photorealistic Christmas storefront image.
- One short cinematic entrance animation.
- Desktop and mobile-optimised versions.
- A separate traditional shop bell audio file.
- A consistent base storefront that can be reused and adapted for future collections.

We will provide our existing storefront image, brand assets, product photography and creative references.

We would like to work collaboratively, refining the visual direction together and developing a shared understanding of the Evie & Skye aesthetic.

### 6. Next Steps

We would love to hear how you would approach this project, which AI tools you would recommend and whether you have experience creating realistic product imagery and cinematic animations.

Please also provide an estimated cost for the initial Christmas storefront and animation, together with an indication of how you would structure and price ongoing seasonal updates.

**Our goal is to find someone who can become a long-term creative partner, helping us bring the Evie & Skye world to life throughout the year.**

You’ll work with our team and media buyer to turn product materials, scripts and creative ideas into finished advertising content.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Create ad videos and images using ElevenLabs’ creative tools.
• Produce natural, expressive voiceovers with the right tone and pacing.
• Adapt existing ads into different language versions.
• Combine visuals, voiceovers, music and sound effects into finished ad videos.
• Create variations of visuals, voices and opening scenes for our team to test.
• Apply corrections and improvements provided by our language reviewers.
• Keep our product images, book covers and branding accurate and consistent.
• Deliver finished assets in the required advertising formats.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• Strong hands-on experience with ElevenLabs, including its video, image and voice tools.
• A portfolio showing relevant work you have personally created.
• A good eye for visuals and an ear for natural speech.
• Experience creating short ads for consumer products.
• An efficient workflow that balances quality, turnaround time and generation costs.
• Experience producing multilingual content is a strong advantage.

PLEASE INCLUDE IN YOUR APPLICATION

• Two or three relevant examples, explaining which parts you created using ElevenLabs.
• A brief explanation of your workflow for creating an ad and adapting it into multiple languages.
• Your hourly rate or price per finished creative, including whether generation costs are included.
• Your current availability and typical turnaround time for a 30–60-second ad.

There is potential for ongoing work creating and adapting advertising content across our markets.

originalDescription.text:
COMPLETE CINEMATIC VIDEO PRODUCTION BRIEF

Evolution Travel × Archer Travel

Project: Two premium cinematic marketing videos
Total Budget: $500 maximum
Production Style: Fuze Marketing-inspired cinematic storytelling
Brand Voice: RRZ — Raw Truth. Radical Compassion. Zero Bullshit.

1. PROJECT OVERVIEW

I am hiring an experienced AI cinematic video producer to create two professional marketing videos for my independent travel business.

Video 1: 90-second cinematic commercial
Video 2: 10-minute business opportunity overview

Both videos must look and feel like they belong to the same premium brand.

The 90-second commercial should emotionally connect with viewers, build curiosity, and inspire them to watch the full overview.

The 10-minute overview should educate viewers about the travel business opportunity, Archer Travel, Evolution Travel, compensation, training, enrollment packages, and the next steps.

This is not a traditional network-marketing presentation.

I do not want a slideshow, AI spokesperson, generic stock-footage montage, or typical MLM recruitment video.

I want a sophisticated cinematic campaign that combines powerful storytelling, beautiful visuals, compelling narration, and a credible business message.

The desired quality is comparable to premium Fuze Marketing-style productions, without copying their proprietary work.

2. CREATIVE DIRECTION

Visual Identity

Think premium cinematic advertising, luxury travel brand film, and sophisticated documentary storytelling.

The aesthetic should include:

Rich blacks, charcoal, warm gold, and natural tones

Dramatic but realistic cinematic lighting

Beautiful modern resorts, villas, and luxury cruises

Elegant urban architecture and professional environments

Authentic, diverse adults

Intentional camera movement

Strong depth, composition, and contrast

Sophisticated, minimal on-screen typography

Seamless visual storytelling

The videos must look expensive, even though the production budget is limited.

AI-generated footage must be realistic, cohesive, and polished.

Emotional Direction

The videos should take viewers through a deliberate emotional progression:

Recognition → Reflection → Possibility → Credibility → Understanding → Decision

Start intimate and thought-provoking.

Gradually transition into optimism, beautiful travel imagery, and business possibilities.

Finish with confidence, clarity, and an invitation to make an informed decision.

Avoid exaggerated wealth imagery, mansions, luxury cars, cash, and unrealistic lifestyle promises.

Voiceover

Use one consistent, mature, warm, confident female voice throughout both videos.

The delivery should be conversational, emotionally intelligent, and commanding without sounding aggressive.

No artificial enthusiasm, shouting, exaggerated promotional delivery, or robotic pacing.

No AI talking-head presenter or avatar. The narration runs over cinematic footage.

Music and Sound Design

Use licensed cinematic instrumental music with an intentional emotional progression.

The commercial should begin quietly, build with emotion, become expansive during the travel opportunity section, pull back during the business reality section, and finish powerfully.

The overview should use more restrained cinematic music, supporting clear educational narration.

Music must never overpower the voice.

Use subtle ambient effects and sound design when appropriate.

Editing Standards

Smooth, purposeful cuts

Controlled pacing with emotional pauses

Elegant transitions

Cinematic color grading

Minimal, strategically placed on-screen text

Consistent typography

No cheesy animations

No unnecessary effects

No excessive zooming or rapid cuts

No fake company footage or fabricated testimonials

3. VIDEO ONE — 90-SECOND CINEMATIC COMMERCIAL

Title: YOUR NEXT CHAPTER
Length: Approximately 90 seconds
Purpose: Create emotional recognition and invite viewers to watch the 10-minute business overview.

SCENE 1 — THE WAKE-UP CALL

Target Time: 0:00–0:15

Narration:

You ever look at your life and wonder...

How did I get so busy taking care of everything...

that I stopped making time for what I wanted?

You work.

You handle business.

You show up.

And tomorrow?

You do it all over again.

Visual Direction:

Begin with a quiet, intimate cinematic shot.

A professional woman sits near the floor-to-ceiling window of an elegant modern apartment overlooking a city at night.

The environment is beautiful but the moment is reflective.

Slow camera movement toward her face.

Show genuine human emotion without exaggerated sadness.

Transition briefly to realistic scenes of daily responsibilities, professional routines, and quiet reflection.

Sound: Start with atmospheric room tone. Minimal or no music for the opening seconds.

Editing: Slow, thoughtful pacing. Allow the opening question to land.

SCENE 2 — THE SHIFT

Target Time: 0:15–0:30

Narration:

But here's the thing.

You can be grateful for your life...

and still want more from it.

More choices.

More ownership.

Something that belongs to you.

And no, you don't have to blow up your entire life to start exploring something different.

Visual Direction:

Transition from darkness into beautiful natural morning light.

Show the same sense of real life, but with a change in emotional energy.

A professional confidently walks through a beautifully designed modern city.

Another person works in a sophisticated home office.

Warm sunlight enters the frame.

The visual message is possibility, not unrealistic luxury.

Sound: Introduce a subtle piano melody and cinematic pulse.

Editing: Gradually introduce movement and a more hopeful visual rhythm.

SCENE 3 — THE OPPORTUNITY

Target Time: 0:30–0:48

Narration:

What if you could build a business in an industry built around experiences people already value?

Travel.

Not just taking trips.

Helping people plan them.

Creating experiences.

Building relationships.

And developing a business of your own.

Visual Direction:

This is the first major visual expansion.

Reveal a stunning modern oceanfront resort.

Use a cinematic aerial shot of turquoise water and distinctive architecture.

Transition to a luxury cruise sailing at golden hour.

Show a sleek contemporary villa and an elegant resort interior.

Balance the destination imagery with realistic scenes of a travel advisor assisting clients and researching travel arrangements.

The footage must be visually impressive, modern, and sophisticated.

Sound: Music becomes expansive and emotionally uplifting.

Editing: Elegant cinematic transitions aligned with the narration.

SCENE 4 — THE FOUNDATION

Target Time: 0:48–1:03

Narration:

Through Archer Travel, a company with roots dating back to 1952, and Evolution Travel, you can explore becoming an independent travel advisor.

With training.

Travel resources.

And an optional path into leadership and team development.

Visual Direction:

Show a sophisticated modern travel-business environment.

Professionals collaborating around laptops.

A travel advisor attending training.

An advisor discussing a vacation with clients.

Introduce clean, premium graphics identifying Archer Travel and Evolution Travel.

Use authentic, approved company logos only.

On-Screen Text:

ARCHER TRAVEL
ESTABLISHED 1952

EVOLUTION TRAVEL

INDEPENDENT TRAVEL BUSINESS OPPORTUNITY

Sound: Confident, steady cinematic music.

SCENE 5 — THE REALITY

Target Time: 1:03–1:17

Narration:

Now, let's be clear.

This is a business.

Not a shortcut.

Not a guaranteed paycheck.

It takes learning, consistency, and actual work.

And it's not for everybody.

Visual Direction:

Bring the energy back down.

Show a professional working at a laptop, reviewing travel details, communicating with customers, and developing business skills.

Use an intimate, grounded aesthetic.

On-Screen Text:

REAL BUSINESS.
REAL WORK.

Sound: Pull the music back so the narration feels direct and powerful.

SCENE 6 — THE INVITATION

Target Time: 1:17–1:30

Narration:

But if you've been thinking about building something of your own...

Maybe it's time to stop wondering what the opportunity looks like.

And actually understand it.

Your next chapter starts with a decision.

WATCH THE 10-MINUTE OVERVIEW.

Visual Direction:

Finish with a breathtaking cinematic sunrise over the ocean.

Use an elegant, slow aerial shot.

Gradually transition to a black background with minimal white and warm-gold typography.

Final Screen:

YOUR NEXT CHAPTER.

STARTS WITH A DECISION.

WATCH THE 10-MINUTE OVERVIEW

Evolution Travel × Archer Travel

Independent business opportunity. Results vary.

Sound: Powerful but tasteful musical finish.

Important: The commercial's final spoken duration must be checked before editing. Preserve the natural emotional pauses; adjust visual holds and pacing rather than rushing the narration.

4. VIDEO TWO — 10-MINUTE BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Title: YOUR NEXT CHAPTER — THE OPPORTUNITY
Target Length: 10 minutes
Purpose: Explain the travel business opportunity clearly and professionally.

The overview should have the polish of a premium business documentary, not a corporate slideshow.

Use elegant graphics where necessary to communicate financial examples and enrollment packages.

The same cinematic visual identity and female narration should continue throughout.

SCENE 1 — THE TRUTH

Target: 0:00–1:00

Narration:

You did what you were supposed to do.

You worked hard. You showed up. You handled your responsibilities.

And somewhere along the way, you started asking yourself a question.

What am I actually building for myself?

Because here's something nobody talks about enough.

You can be successful at taking care of everybody else's needs and still feel like you've put your own dreams on hold.

Maybe you're not looking to walk away from your career. Maybe you love what you do.

You just want more options. More choices. An opportunity to build something that belongs to you.

Not another promise. Not another motivational speech.

Something real.

So let's talk about an industry that connects people, experiences, and opportunity.

Travel.

Visual Direction:

Begin with intimate, beautifully composed human moments.

Move from reflective professional scenes to bright, sophisticated travel imagery.

Open with cinematic pacing before moving into the educational sections.

SCENE 2 — ARCHER TRAVEL HISTORY

Target: 1:00–2:15

Narration:

Before you consider a business opportunity, you should know who's behind it.

Because a beautiful presentation means nothing if there's no substance behind the company.

Archer Travel was founded in 1952 by Cliff and Lola Archer.

More than seven decades ago.

What started as a family-owned travel agency developed into an established travel business with relationships throughout the travel industry.

In 2016, Archer Travel partnered with Evolution Travel to create an opportunity for independent entrepreneurs to enter the travel industry.

Here's what that means for you.

You don't have to open a storefront.

You don't have to establish your own relationships with every travel supplier.

And you don't need years of experience to begin learning the business.

Archer provides the infrastructure.

The training.

The booking resources.

And access to participating travel suppliers.

You bring the willingness to learn and the commitment to build your business.

Visual Direction:

Transition from tasteful historical-inspired imagery into modern travel-business environments.

Use genuine company archival materials only if authorized.

Show travel professionals, sophisticated office environments, training, and modern travel technology.

On-Screen Text:

ARCHER TRAVEL
FOUNDED 1952

PARTNERSHIP WITH EVOLUTION TRAVEL — 2016

SCENE 3 — THE TRAVEL BUSINESS

Target: 2:15–3:25

Narration:

Let's talk about how travel advisors get paid.

When people book eligible cruises, hotels, resorts, and vacation packages, travel suppliers may pay commissions.

As an independent travel advisor, you can earn a portion of those commissions.

Here's a simple example.

Let's say a travel supplier pays Archer a $500 commission on a completed booking.

If your membership provides an 80 percent commission share, your portion would be $400 before applicable taxes and expenses.

That's 80 percent of the commission.

Not 80 percent of the vacation price.

Now, let's be clear.

You don't get paid simply because you have a travel website.

You need customers.

You need bookings.

You need to provide excellent service.

And you need to give people a reason to trust you with their travel plans.

That's how you begin building a real travel business.

Visual Direction:

Show breathtaking luxury cruises, modern boutique resorts, and beautifully designed hotels.

Integrate genuine travel-advisor business activities.

Use an elegant, animated financial example.

On-Screen Example:

Supplier Commission: $500
Agent Share: 80%
Illustrative Agent Commission: $400

Hypothetical example before taxes and expenses. Actual results vary.

The commission example must be clearly identified as illustrative, not typical income.

SCENE 4 — EVO PLUS

Target: 3:25–4:40

Narration:

Now, there's another feature worth understanding.

It's called EVO Plus.

EVO Plus gives participating agents access to wholesale pricing on hotels, resorts, and villas.

And this creates another potential way to earn money.

Let me show you how.

Imagine you find a resort stay through EVO Plus with a wholesale cost of $1,500.

You offer that same stay to your customer for $1,800.

The customer agrees to the price.

The difference is $300.

If the booking allows that markup and the full amount is payable to you, that represents $300 in gross earnings before applicable fees and taxes.

Under qualifying EVO Plus arrangements, agents may be able to receive their markup as instant cash, subject to the program's payment rules.

Now, that's just an example.

Not every property will have the same pricing.

Not every booking will qualify.

And actual earnings depend on the transaction.

But here's the opportunity.

You have access to another travel pricing platform that may allow you to serve your customers and earn through eligible bookings.

Visual Direction:

Show beautiful modern villas, resorts, elegant suites, and sophisticated vacation environments.

Use premium animated graphics to explain the example.

On-Screen Example:

Wholesale Resort Price: $1,500
Customer Selling Price: $1,800
Potential Gross Markup: $300

Illustrative example only. Subject to booking eligibility, pricing rules, fees, and payment terms.

Avoid showing fake EVO Plus website interfaces.

SCENE 5 — EVOLUTION TRAVEL & LEADERSHIP

Target: 4:40–6:05

Narration:

Now, let's talk about Evolution Travel.

Because there's another side to this business.

Evolution Travel operates through a network-marketing model, also known as multilevel marketing.

That means you can focus on selling travel, and you can also choose to build and lead a team.

Evolution's compensation plan includes qualifying leadership ranks, bonuses, and residual compensation opportunities.

But here's what people need to understand.

Building a team and building a productive organization are two different things.

Anybody can invite someone to look at an opportunity.

Leadership is what happens after that.

It's helping people understand the business.

Teaching them how to find customers.

Helping them develop confidence.

Holding them accountable.

And creating an environment where people have the opportunity to grow.

That's leadership.

And here's something else.

You don't have to build a team if that's not what you want.

You can focus on serving travel clients.

Or you can pursue travel sales and leadership development together.

Additional compensation depends on qualifying activity and the official plan.

There's no automatic paycheck.

And no guaranteed income.

Visual Direction:

Show sophisticated, diverse professionals collaborating, training, mentoring, and working together.

The scenes should feel like real entrepreneurial business development.

Do not show exaggerated celebrations, cash, awards, or unrealistic success imagery.

On-Screen Text:

TRAVEL SALES

OPTIONAL TEAM DEVELOPMENT

LEADERSHIP OPPORTUNITIES

SCENE 6 — LEGACY PROGRAM

Target: 6:05–6:55

Narration:

Now, let's talk about something that matters when you're thinking beyond today.

Legacy.

Evolution Travel has a Legacy Program with specific participation and eligibility requirements.

If you're interested in building a long-term organization, this is a program you'll want to understand.

Because there is a difference between earning money today and planning for what happens to a business in the future.

The important details are found in the written program rules.

Who qualifies?

What benefits are available?

And what conditions must be met?

Those are questions worth asking.

Because building a business is one decision.

Understanding its long-term structure is another.

Visual Direction:

Show thoughtful scenes of long-term planning, mentorship, and professional continuity.

Use a warm, elegant cinematic treatment.

Do not promise inheritance or transferable income without specific written program terms.

SCENE 7 — ENROLLMENT PACKAGES

Target: 6:55–8:05

Narration:

Now let's talk about what it costs to get started.

Because nobody should have to guess what they're paying to join a business.

Evolution Travel currently offers three enrollment packages.

Let's start with EVO Basics.

The enrollment price is $68.99, followed by a $69 monthly administration fee.

EVO Basics includes EVO Plus membership, a 50 percent travel commission share, team-building access, a personal replicated website, a back office, and training and support.

The next option is EVO Essentials.

Enrollment is $89.98, followed by $89.99 per month.

EVO Essentials includes EVO Plus, an 80 percent travel commission share, team-building access, access to over 100 travel vendors, your personal website, back-office tools, and training.

There's also the EVO Bundle.

Enrollment is $299, followed by $89.99 per month.

The Bundle includes EVO Essentials and additional promotional travel benefits, including cruise, hotel, flight, and dining credits or an applicable resort voucher, along with a convention ticket and promotional incentives subject to their terms.

All three packages operate with recurring monthly administration fees.

You pay your enrollment cost, and then you pay month to month.

The important thing is to choose the package that fits what you want to do and understand the included benefits and terms before enrolling.

Visual Direction:

This section should shift to elegant premium motion graphics.

Use clean typography and a sophisticated three-column comparison.

Maintain the black, charcoal, white, and warm-gold aesthetic.

Do not use a generic PowerPoint slide, spinning cards, or flashy animations.

SCENE 8 — TRAINING & SUPPORT

Target: 8:05–9:10

Narration:

Now, you might be wondering.

Could I actually do this?

Maybe you've never sold travel.

Maybe you've never owned a business.

Maybe you've spent most of your life working for somebody else.

That's okay.

You don't have to know everything when you start.

Archer provides training and travel education.

Evolution offers a structure for business development and leadership support.

But none of those resources replace your effort.

You have to learn.

You have to communicate.

You have to follow through.

And you have to be willing to develop skills you may not have today.

You don't need to be the loudest person in the room.

You don't need thousands of social media followers.

And you don't have to pretend to be somebody you're not.

But you do need to be teachable.

Consistent.

Accountable.

And willing to do the work.

Because a business doesn't grow simply because you want it to.

It grows through what you consistently do.

Visual Direction:

Show realistic scenes of agents learning, attending virtual training, researching destinations, discussing travel with clients, and developing professional skills.

Use warm, polished imagery that communicates confidence and personal development.

No exaggerated lifestyle scenes.

SCENE 9 — YOUR DECISION

Target: 9:10–10:00

Narration:

So here's what you know.

Archer Travel provides the foundation for an independent travel business.

You can earn commissions from qualifying travel bookings.

EVO Plus offers wholesale access to hotels, resorts, and villas, with additional earning opportunities on eligible transactions.

Evolution Travel offers an optional path into leadership and team development.

There are training resources.

There are business costs.

There are responsibilities.

And there are no guarantees of income.

Now here's the question.

Is this something you want to explore?

Not because somebody pressured you.

Not because somebody promised you a different life.

But because you see an opportunity that might align with what you want to build.

If you're ready to explore enrollment, choose:

I'M READY TO GET STARTED.

If you have questions, choose:

I HAVE QUESTIONS.

Because the next chapter of your life deserves more than a sales pitch.

It deserves an informed decision.

YOUR NEXT CHAPTER STARTS WITH YOU.

Visual Direction:

Return to the most visually beautiful imagery from the film.

A modern oceanfront property.

An elegant cruise passing through open water.

A sophisticated professional preparing for a new business opportunity.

Finish with a cinematic sunrise over the ocean.

The two options will be connected to separate paths in the business funnel. The editor only needs to produce the visual closing screen; the interactive actions will be configured through the funnel system.

5. GOOGLE FLOW / AI VIDEO GENERATION

AI scenes may be created using Google Flow/Veo, Runway, Kling, or other professional AI video-generation tools.

Use these general prompt standards when generating scenes:

Base Cinematic Prompt:

"Premium cinematic documentary-style brand commercial, ultra-realistic human subjects, beautiful natural lighting, high-end architectural environments, rich cinematic contrast, elegant composition, smooth intentional camera movement, authentic emotion, sophisticated modern luxury aesthetic, natural skin textures, realistic movement, shallow depth of field where appropriate, professional cinematic color grading, 16:9 widescreen, no text, no artificial logos, no unrealistic facial movements, no distorted hands, no exaggerated expressions."

Adapt the subject, activity, setting, and emotional tone to each scene.

Generated scenes must maintain consistent quality, realistic human appearance, and a coherent visual identity.

Use genuine licensed travel footage when it provides better authenticity and production value.

Do not present AI-generated buildings, hotels, cruise ships, or company offices as authentic representations of specific real properties or company facilities.

6. PRODUCTION WORKFLOW

Step 1 — Establish the Visual Look

Review both scripts and the creative direction.

Select consistent typography, color treatment, lighting, cinematic pacing, and voiceover style.

Step 2 — Produce a Short Sample

Create a 15–20-second cinematic preview, using a portion of the approved commercial.

The sample should demonstrate:

Cinematic quality

AI footage realism

Narration delivery

Music and editing

Premium branding

Obtain client approval before full production.

This preview must be included in the agreed total project price.

Step 3 — Record or Generate Narration

Create the voiceover using the approved scripts.

Check spoken timing before building the final scenes.

Keep natural pacing and emotional emphasis.

The overview target is 10 minutes. Use purposeful visual holds where appropriate, but do not slow the narration unnaturally or pad the presentation with filler. Report any script-duration mismatch before editing.

Step 4 — Generate and Collect Visuals

Produce the required AI footage and gather properly licensed supporting visuals.

Ensure consistency in quality, color, lighting, and style.

Step 5 — Edit Both Videos

Build each video around the narration, emotional progression, and approved storyboard.

Apply cinematic music, sound design, minimal titles, graphics, and professional color grading.

Step 6 — Client Review

Provide both videos for review and include one consolidated revision round for each video.

Step 7 — Final Delivery

Export approved videos and deliver all agreed files.

7. FINAL DELIVERABLES

Commercial

16:9 widescreen

Minimum 1080p

MP4

Business Overview
