originalDescription.text:
Title: Cinematic AI Promo Video for Premium Trading Card Break Brand (72hr Turnaround)

About us
Ziggazee is a new UK trading card break brand launching on TikTok and Whatnot. We run seasonal breaks across three formats:

	•	Multisport and TCG repacks (football, NFL, NBA, Pokémon, One Piece, Marvel) in three escalating tiers: Flamethrower, Napalm and Nuclear Fallout (the case hit)
	•	Rare wax breaks, including ultra high-end product such as Topps Dynasty and Panini National Treasures, plus vintage and low-numbered releases
	•	Big giveaways: sealed Pokémon, AirPods, Nintendo Switch, PS5

We are not a filler-repack operation. The brand is premium, high-stakes and built around the moment of the big pull.

What we need
A slick, professional, extremely dramatic AI-generated promo to build hype before launch. It should feel like a blockbuster trailer, not a social ad. The video has two jobs:

	1.	Get people to follow our TikTok and Whatnot accounts
	2.	Get people to Ziggazee.com to join the mailing list before Season 1 drops

Creative direction

	•	Cold open: darkness, tension, low rumble, a countdown or vault sequence
	•	Escalation through the tiers: Flamethrower (fire), Napalm (bigger, hotter), Nuclear Fallout (full detonation, shockwave, slow-motion card reveal)
	•	A "vault" beat for the high-end wax: luxury, gold light, sealed boxes, serial-numbered cards catching the light
	•	Giveaway beat: prizes revealed in quick, punchy cuts
	•	Finish: Ziggazee logo slam, "Season 1" and launch date, then a clear CTA: "Follow @[handle]" and "Join the list at Ziggazee.com"
	•	Tone: cinematic, bass-heavy sound design, fast cuts, premium colour grade

Deliverables

	•	1 x hero video, 30 seconds, 9:16 vertical (1080x1920) for TikTok
	•	1 x 15-second cutdown (9:16)
	•	2 x 6 to 8 second teaser clips, cut from the hero footage
	•	Burned-in captions and on-screen text that can be read with the sound off
	•	Sound design and commercially licensed music (please confirm the licence)
	•	All final generated clips used in the edit

Assets we will provide
Logo and brand files, tier names, real product photos and footage of our boxes and cards, and our handles and launch date.

Rules (please read)

	•	No AI-generated likenesses of real athletes or celebrities
	•	No generated Pokémon, Marvel or other copyrighted characters
	•	No generated manufacturer, league or electronics brand logos. Where real products appear, we will supply the footage.
	•	No claims about card values or guaranteed returns in on-screen text
	•	The video must be suitable for TikTok's AI-generated content label

Timeline: 72 hours from hire

	•	Milestone 1, within 24 hours: short script, storyboard, 3 style frames, and one 5-second test shot of the Nuclear Fallout reveal
	•	Milestone 2, within 72 hours: all final deliverables, with one round of revisions included

We will only release Milestone 2 if Milestone 1 shows the quality we need.

To apply, please include:

	1.	Links to AI video work you have produced (trailer-style or cinematic work especially)
	2.	The tools you use (e.g. Runway, Kling, Veo, Sora, CapCut, After Effects) and how you keep visuals consistent between shots
	3.	Confirmation that you can deliver within 72 hours
	4.	A one or two line idea for how you would open the video

Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.

We are a DTC brand selling Orthopedic products, to the Australian market via Meta ads. We are looking for a long term AI video creator who turns our scripts into high quality AI UGC and VSL ads.

Every video is fully AI generated. There is no filmed UGC to edit. You create the AI creators, the AI spokesperson, voices, scenes and visuals yourself. If you only edit filmed footage, this job is not a fit.

We own the creative side. Angles, scripts, hooks, shot lists, brand kit and compliance rules are fully written and handed to you. Your job is clean, polished execution. You don't need to come up with concepts, but good ideas inside the script are always welcome.

originalDescription.text:
DESCRIPTION We're a direct-response ad agency running Meta ads for coaching and fitness brands. 

We want to turn our ads into short AI dramas: 60 to 120 second vertical stories with real-looking characters, real dialogue and a hook that stops the scroll. Think of the AI micro-dramas going viral on TikTok and Reels right now, made to sell a product.

Our first project is for a mobility brand. It's a short drama about foot and ankle problems that ends on the founder's free training. If it works, we'll want a steady flow of these across several clients.

We'll give you the script, the story beats and the brand notes. You turn it into a finished, ready-to-run ad.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

-Create the cast: face references, outfit references and character sheets that keep every character's face the same from shot to shot
-Build a location plate so the set looks the same in every scene
-Write the shot prompts and generate each scene in Higgsfield (Soul, Seedance 2.0/2.5) or similar tools like Kling, Veo or Runway
-Get the lip sync and dialogue to look natural, with the same voice for each character in every clip
Fix bad takes (warped hands, face drift, characters jumping around the room) by redoing only the broken moment
-Edit it all together with sound design, music, captions and pacing that holds attention
Deliver 9:16 exports that keep text and faces inside Meta's safe zones


WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

-A portfolio with at least one AI narrative piece where the same characters stay consistent across several shots. Single-shot clips and music videos don't count for this role.
-Hands-on experience with Higgsfield, Seedance or Kling. Tell us which you've used.
Strong editing skills in Premiere, DaVinci, CapCut or After Effects
-A feel for story and pacing. You know a hook from a cliffhanger.
-Comfort with health ad rules on Meta. No before/after shots and no medical claims, and you'll flag anything that looks risky.
-Good English and fast replies during US hours (Arizona time)

NICE TO HAVE

You've made AI ads that ran on paid social
ElevenLabs or other voice tools
Experience with direct-response or UGC-style ads
HOW WE'LL START A paid test: one 20 to 30 second scene from our script, using our characters and location brief. If it's good, we move to the full episode and then ongoing work.

TO APPLY Start your proposal with the word "jumbo" so we know you read this. Then send:

Links to 2 or 3 AI narrative videos you made, with a note on what you did on each

The tools you used for character consistency and lip sync

Your rate for a 60 to 90 second finished drama, and how many days one takes you

Who covers the AI generation credits in your quote: you or us

originalDescription.text:
Unika Health is looking for a freelance video creator to produce a two-minute brand video around our theme, **“Care Beyond the Clinic.”** The video will introduce Unika to primary care practices and healthcare partners and show how we help their teams stay connected with patients between visits.

**The story we want to tell**

Follow one patient from the clinic to home. At the clinic, a physician and a Unika Care Coordinator meet with the patient and explain the care plan. At home, the patient checks their blood pressure or blood sugar and reconnects with the same Care Coordinator by video. Show how the coordinator helps the patient follow the plan and keeps the clinic informed when follow-up is needed.

We want viewers to see what this means for both sides. Patients know who to turn to between visits, and providers have a care team that helps carry their plan forward.

**Creative direction**

Use AI-assisted visuals, animation, and motion graphics to bring the story to life. We’re open to a fully animated approach or a blend of realistic AI-generated scenes and simple motion graphics. The video should feel warm, polished, and credible, with natural expressions and a consistent look for the patient and Care Coordinator across scenes. Keep on-screen text brief and close with the Unika Health logo and **“Care Beyond the Clinic.”**

**Scope and deliverables**

- Help refine the concept and script, then develop a storyboard for review before production.
- Produce a finished English-language video of approximately two minutes, with voiceover, captions, and background music cleared for commercial use.
- Deliver a high-resolution 16:9 MP4 for our website, LinkedIn, and presentations. Please indicate whether editable project files and an optional 30-second social cut are included or quoted separately.

**To apply**

Please share two or three relevant samples, ideally healthcare, character-led animation, or brand storytelling. Include a brief note on how you would show the transition from clinic to home, along with your estimated timeline, fixed-price quote, and the number of revision rounds included.

originalDescription.text:
We're a fast-growing DTC e-commerce team looking for a talented **AI Video Editor who specializes in AI-generated drama videos and cinematic storytelling.**

We're looking for someone who can turn creative briefs and scripts into compelling, emotionally engaging videos using AI video generation tools. You should understand how to create believable characters, natural dialogue, cinematic scenes, and dramatic moments that keep viewers watching.

This isn't just about generating random AI clips and stitching them together. We need someone who understands storytelling, knows how to get the best out of AI video models, and can turn generated footage into polished, engaging videos.

If we find the right person, this will become a long-term collaboration with consistent work. We want someone who can start immediately.

### What You'll Do

- Turn creative briefs and scripts into compelling AI-generated drama videos.
- Generate cinematic, realistic scenes using AI video models such as Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Higgsfield, Hailuo, or similar tools.
- Create believable characters with consistent appearances across multiple scenes and shots.
- Generate natural-looking character movements, facial expressions, reactions, dialogue, and interactions.
- Create emotionally engaging scenes with strong hooks, tension, conflict, suspense, humor, or other dramatic elements depending on the brief.
- Maintain visual continuity between shots, including characters, clothing, locations, lighting, and camera angles.
- Use AI voice generation tools such as ElevenLabs for natural-sounding dialogue, narration, and character voices.
- Edit generated footage into cohesive videos with strong pacing, sound design, music, captions, transitions, and other elements where appropriate.
- Follow creative briefs while contributing your own ideas to improve the storytelling and final output.
- Work through feedback efficiently and refine videos without wasting unnecessary AI generation credits.

### What We're Looking For

- **Strong experience creating AI-generated drama videos.** You understand how to create scenes that feel like a real story rather than a collection of disconnected AI clips.
- **Strong AI video generation skills.** You know which models work best for different shots, how to prompt effectively, and how to achieve consistent, high-quality results.
- **Character consistency.** You know how to maintain the same character's appearance across multiple scenes, expressions, and camera angles.
- **Storytelling instincts.** You understand pacing, emotional beats, scene transitions, reactions, and how to keep viewers engaged.
- **Strong editing skills.** You're proficient in Premiere Pro, CapCut, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or similar tools.
- **Voice and dialogue skills.** You can produce believable dialogue and voiceovers using ElevenLabs or equivalent tools.
- **Resourcefulness.** You can work around AI generation limitations, troubleshoot bad outputs, and find practical ways to achieve the desired result.
- **Reliability.** You communicate clearly, meet deadlines, take feedback well, and can work with us through fast iteration cycles.

### What to Include in Your Application

1. **Portfolio:** Send 3–5 examples of AI-generated drama videos you've personally created. Prioritize videos with multiple scenes, recurring characters, dialogue, and storytelling.
2. **Rate and availability:** Share your rate and how many hours per week you can commit.
3. **Attention check:** Start your proposal with the exact words: **"I confirm the AI credit policy."**

Applications that do not include this line will not be reviewed.

### NON-NEGOTIABLE: AI Credit Usage Policy

We provide access to paid AI generation tools. **Every generation must have a clear purpose.**

Unplanned experimentation, careless prompting, repeated low-quality generations without a clear improvement strategy, or excessive credit usage will not be tolerated. Violating this policy may result in immediate termination.

We expect you to think before generating, plan your shots, use efficient workflows, and make sensible decisions about when another generation is actually necessary.

We're not looking for someone to burn through credits until something works. We're looking for someone who can consistently produce excellent results while respecting the tools and budget.

### Long-Term Opportunity

We're not looking for a one-off freelancer. We want to build a long-term working relationship with someone talented, reliable, creative, and efficient.

If you can consistently turn our briefs into compelling AI drama videos and work efficiently within our generation budget, there is plenty of potential for ongoing work.

We treat the right talent with respect and care, and we're looking forward to finding someone we can grow with.

**If this sounds like you, we'd love to see your work.**

originalDescription.text:
Hi, I'm Allie Bjerk. I run a personal brand where I teach coaches, experts and creators how to sell digital products with Meta ads. I've generated $7M+ in revenue and spent $2M+ on ads, and we're scaling our ad spend fast right now, so I need an editor who can help us launch fresh ads every single week.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Edit talking-head video ads for Facebook and Instagram from raw takes I record twice a week
- Cut each take into several ads by swapping the hook, the opening line and the length (15 to 60 seconds)
- Add clean captions and export 9:16 and 4:5 versions
- Work from an AI-generated cut list that comes with each batch
- Name files using our naming system and deliver to Google Drive within 24 to 48 hours
- Use our weekly notes on which hooks won to shape the next batch

MUST HAVE
- A portfolio of talking-head or direct-response ads (not vlogs, weddings or music edits)
- Daily use of AI editing tools like Descript, Claude, CapCut AI or Submagic
- A strong ear for American English, so you catch flubbed words, filler and dead air
- CapCut, Claude or Premiere Pro
- Comfortable with 15+ ads a week now, growing to 30 to 50 a week

NICE TO HAVE
- Ad experience with coaches, courses or digital products
- Motion text and simple graphics

HOW WE WORK
We start with a paid test and then move to weekly fixed-price milestones, one per batch. We're budgeting $15 to $30 per finished ad depending on experience, and we'll move to a monthly rate once you're at full-time volume.

THE PAID TEST
Shortlisted editors get 2 raw takes and a cut list and turn them into 8 finished ads within 24 hours, paid at $160 (the budget on this post).

OWNERSHIP
All footage and finished ads belong to Prosperity Lab. Please ask before using any of it in your portfolio, since my face is my brand.

TO APPLY
Answer the screening questions, and start your proposal with the word "HOOK" so I know you read this far.

originalDescription.text:
About MANILAI
MANILAI is a pre-launch, premium mental performance system: a connected smart pen and app that turn a person’s own writing (or typing, or voice) into insight and one clear direction, measured against the future self they deliberately chose, their Northstar.

We’re not a gadget brand and not a wellness brand. We hold ourselves to the craft level you’d expect from Apple or Aesop: restrained, precise, intentional.

Ahead of our launch in early 2027 we’re building a small creative bench of specialists. We’re not looking for volume or the lowest rate. We’re looking for a few people whose work makes us stop scrolling.

What you’ll create
- High-end visuals and short video sequences using AI tools, combined with real product renders and brand assets
- Concept visuals, mood and scene development, backgrounds and environments for ads and the website
- Consistent output across a campaign: same look, same world, same product accuracy

What we’re looking for
- A portfolio where people can’t tell what was AI and what wasn’t. We are explicitly not looking for the typical “AI look”.
- Fluency in current tools (e.g. Midjourney, Flux, Runway, Kling, Veo, Magnific, ComfyUI) plus compositing and retouching in Photoshop/After Effects
- Product accuracy: you can integrate a real product into AI-generated scenes without distorting it
- Full transparency about which tools you used per asset, and no use of real people’s likenesses or copyrighted material
- A background in photography, art direction or design is a strong plus

Nice to have: video editing, workflow building (ComfyUI pipelines), experience with brand-safe/commercial use of AI.
How to apply (please read, proposals without this won’t be reviewed)
- Portfolio is required. Share a link plus your 3 most relevant pieces, and state your exact role on each (concept, design, edit, animation, tools used).
- Start your proposal with the word “Northstar” so we know you’ve read this.
- Tell us your rate and availability (hours per week) for the coming months.

Our process
- We review all portfolios.
- We invite 2–3 candidates for a video call.
- Possibly a short, paid test brief.
- Ongoing collaboration for the right person.

Good to know
- Freelance, ongoing, remote. Working language is English, with some overlap with CET for check-ins.
- Before receiving briefs or brand assets, you sign an NDA and an IP assignment. All work created for MANILAI is owned by MANILAI.

originalDescription.text:
ABOUT US

EaseNordic is a fast-growing Nordic DTC e-commerce brand in the health and self-care space (muscle recovery and body maintenance tools). We sell in 30+ markets and we run paid social at scale, which means we need a constant flow of high-performing video ads.

We are looking for an all-round video editor on a long-term basis. This starts as a freelance role with steady weekly work. If it works out, we want to bring you in-house (full-time). We produce a lot and we will keep producing, so this is a real long-term seat, not a one-off project.

WHAT YOU WILL EDIT

We make everything between heaven and earth, so you need to be comfortable with a very wide range of formats:

- UGC-style ads and creator content (talking head, product demos, testimonials)
- Short-form ads for Meta, TikTok and YouTube (15s to 90s), hooks, variations and iterations of winners
- Longer-form VSLs and PSLs (up to 6+ minutes), including fully AI-generated VSLs
- AI video content: AI avatars, AI podcast-style ads, AI animation and motion pieces, combining AI-generated footage with real footage
- Mashups, remixes, re-cuts of existing winners, A/B hook swaps
- B-roll heavy edits, product-focused edits, unboxing, how-to content
- Occasionally organic social content and website videos

WHAT WE EXPECT

- Flawless, clean edits with excellent pacing. You understand retention, you cut tight, you know when to speed up and when to let a beat land
- Great captions: correctly timed, well styled, readable, consistent. Captions and on-screen text always stay inside platform safe zones (you know where the Instagram / TikTok / Reels UI sits and you never put text under it)
- Strong understanding of direct response ads: hook in the first 1-3 seconds, clear structure, CTA, text overlays that support the message
- Sound design and music that fits (SFX, transitions, voiceover levelling, music ducking)
- Comfortable with AI video tools (Veo, Kling, Runway, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, HeyGen or similar) and able to stitch AI and real footage into one seamless piece
- Proficient in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut (we are flexible on tool), After Effects a big plus
- Organized project files, consistent exports in all needed aspect ratios (9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9)
- Fast turnaround, reliable communication, able to take feedback and iterate without drama
- Fluent English

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with DTC / e-commerce / health brands
- Motion graphics skills (animated text, product callouts, simple animated explainers)
- Experience editing in Finnish or other Nordic languages (not required)

HOW WE WORK

Ongoing weekly work with clear briefs (storyboards, scripts, footage, references) via ClickUp. Async communication plus occasional calls. We move fast and ship a lot. If you deliver quality, there is as much work as you can handle.

HOW TO APPLY

Please include:
1. A portfolio / reel link with your best paid social ad edits (UGC, VSL, short-form). Links to actual ads are better than a showreel
2. 1-2 examples of work where you combined AI-generated content with real footage, if you have any
3. Which editing software you use
4. Your hourly rate and weekly availability
5. Start your proposal with the word "PACING" so we know you read this

Project Type: Long-Form Educational Video Production
Payment Structure: Milestone-Based
Project Status: Strictly Confidential
NDA Required: Yes — Before Project Disclosure

Project Overview

I am seeking a highly experienced, detail-oriented AI video producer to create a premium-quality educational masterclass featuring an ultra-photorealistic female digital instructor.

The instructor must look, speak, and move convincingly like a real human being. I am not interested in cartoon-style avatars, robotic voices, unnatural facial expressions, or generic AI-generated talking heads.

The completed production must resemble a professionally filmed educational course featuring a real female instructor.

The complete production script and creative direction have already been developed. I am seeking a producer who can execute the entire project from beginning to end.

STRICT CONFIDENTIALITY: A signed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) is mandatory before any information regarding the course subject, business, website, script, or proprietary materials will be disclosed.

Mandatory Digital Instructor Specifications

The producer must create a consistent, photorealistic female instructor with the following characteristics:

Age: Appears approximately 30–35 years old.
Appearance: Sophisticated, polished, and styled as an American corporate executive.
Hair: Dark brown, elegantly styled UP in a sleek professional chignon, French twist, or comparable formal updo. Hair must not be worn down.
Clothing: Luxurious, tailored, high-end designer-style NAVY BLUE business suit. The navy blue color is mandatory.
Voice: Fluent American English with a natural, neutral American accent.
Speech: Warm, articulate, confident, professional, and engaging.
Facial Expressions: Extremely realistic, including natural blinking, eye contact, and subtle expressions.
Lip Synchronization: Highly accurate and natural.
Body Language: Realistic posture, subtle head movements, and believable hand gestures.
Character Consistency: The same face, hairstyle, clothing, and voice must be maintained throughout the entire course.
The instructor must look convincingly human and maintain a credible, professional teaching presence.

Video Production Responsibilities

The producer must be capable of:

Creating and maintaining the approved digital instructor.
Producing professional educational videos from an existing script.
Recording step-by-step demonstrations of electronic forms and documents using fictional information.
Integrating the instructor with screen recordings, educational graphics, and visual presentations.
Creating smooth transitions, professional titles, captions, and engaging instructional visuals.
Producing clear, professional audio and narration.
Maintaining consistent visual quality throughout a long-form educational presentation.
Combining all instructional segments into one seamless, high-resolution MP4 video.
Delivering editable production files and all agreed commercial usage rights.
Mandatory Communication and Availability Requirements

Clear, consistent, and accessible communication is an essential requirement for this position.

I am located in California, USA, in the Pacific Time Zone. International applicants are welcome, but they must be available to communicate during reasonable U.S. Pacific Time business hours.

The following requirements are mandatory:

Fluent written and spoken English.
Availability for scheduled video or voice calls during mutually agreed Pacific Time daytime hours.
Sufficient overlapping working hours with the U.S. Pacific Time Zone.
Responses to routine project messages within one business day.
Regular production updates without repeated follow-ups.
Availability for questions, feedback, revisions, and milestone reviews.
Proactive communication regarding delays, technical difficulties, or production concerns.
Direct communication with the client.
I will not schedule meetings at 2:00 AM, 3:00 AM, or other unreasonable overnight hours to accommodate international time-zone differences.

Applicants who cannot reliably accommodate this communication schedule should not apply.

Mandatory Demonstration of Capabilities — Hiring Process

Applicants must demonstrate their AI video production capabilities as part of the hiring and selection process, at no cost to the client.

Applicants must provide examples of realistic AI-generated human presenters speaking naturally in actual videos.

Existing portfolio samples are acceptable, provided they demonstrate the required production quality.

Applicants may also voluntarily provide a short demonstration using their own generic, nonconfidential material.

Demonstrations should show:

At least two minutes of continuous, natural AI presenter speech, where available.
Realistic facial expressions, blinking, and lip synchronization.
Natural American English narration.
Professional appearance and believable body movements.
Experience combining an AI presenter with instructional screen recordings.
Static images, screenshots, and promotional stills alone will not satisfy this requirement.

The applicant must demonstrate sufficient technical capability before being selected.

No confidential course materials will be provided for the hiring demonstration.

Payment Structure — Milestones

The selected producer will be compensated through clearly defined production milestones.

Each milestone must include:

Specific deliverables.
An agreed completion deadline.
Submission of work for review.
Reasonable revisions based on agreed specifications.
Approval before payment release, subject to the platform’s payment procedures.
The producer must provide regular progress updates and private video previews throughout production.

Applicants should submit their proposed pricing and production approach. No project budget is disclosed in this posting.

Confidentiality and Intellectual Property

A signed NDA is required before any confidential project details are disclosed.

The selected producer must agree to appropriate intellectual property ownership, commercial licensing, confidentiality, and restrictions on unauthorized use or distribution of project materials.

The producer may not publish, display, or use the project in a portfolio without prior written authorization.

Qualifications

Applicants must have demonstrated experience with professional AI video production, preferably using HeyGen, Synthesia, Adobe Premiere Pro, Camtasia, or comparable platforms.

Experience producing long-form educational masterclasses is strongly preferred.

How to Apply

Please provide:

Two or three examples of your most realistic AI-generated human presenters in actual speaking videos.
Examples of educational or instructional videos you have produced.
The AI video and editing software you use.
Your experience maintaining consistent AI characters in long-form productions.

Your proposed pricing structure.

Confirmation that you can attend scheduled calls during normal California daytime hours and respond to messages within one business day.
Only experienced producers who can demonstrate exceptional AI video quality, dependable communication, and reliable project management should apply.

I am seeking a highly skilled professional who values communication, respects deadlines, welcomes feedback, and can complete this project from beginning to end.

AI Video Creator Needed – Realistic AI Commercial for AI Translation Platform

About the Project

I'm looking for a talented AI video creator to produce a realistic, high-quality promotional video for TrueTranslate (https://truetranslate-ai.com), an AI-powered real-time voice translation platform.

The goal is to create a professional commercial that demonstrates how TrueTranslate breaks language barriers and makes conversations between people speaking different languages feel natural.

We want the video to look and sound like a professionally produced commercial, NOT like a typical AI-generated video with artificial-looking characters or robotic voices.

Video Concepts / Scenarios

I have several scenarios in mind, and I'm open to your creative suggestions.

Scenario 1: International Business Meeting

- An American businessperson is having a video call with a Spanish (or any other language than English) business partner.
- They speak their native languages naturally.
- TrueTranslate translates their speech in real time, allowing both parties to communicate without language barriers.
- The conversation feels natural, with each person hearing the translated speech.

Scenario 2: International Travel

- An American tourist is visiting Vietnam (or any other country).
- The tourist wants to communicate with a local Vietnamese person who doesn't speak English.
- They use TrueTranslate to have a natural conversation in their respective languages.
- Demonstrate how easy it is to communicate across languages.

Scenario 3: Long-Distance Personal Conversation

- Two people (working in a multinational company) from different countries are having a video call.
- One speaks English, while the other speaks Spanish or another language.
- Despite speaking different languages, they can communicate naturally using TrueTranslate.

I'm also open to completely different creative concepts if you have better ideas for showcasing the product.

What I Need

1. Realistic AI-generated human characters with natural facial expressions and body movements.
2. Natural-sounding AI voices with appropriate accents and emotions.
3. Accurate lip-sync matching the spoken dialogue.
4. Professional video editing, transitions, background music, and sound effects.
5. Realistic environments, lighting, and cinematography.
6. Product integration: incorporate TrueTranslate's actual UI or screen recordings where appropriate.
7. Engaging storytelling that communicates the product's value within the first few seconds.

Deliverables

- One primary promotional video (approximately 30–60 seconds).
- Video in 16:9 format for website and YouTube.
- Ideally, additional 9:16 versions for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
- Voice, background music, and sound effects included.
- Final exported videos in high quality.
- Commercial usage rights for all generated assets, voices, and music.

Required Skills

- Proven experience creating realistic AI-generated videos.
- Experience with tools such as Google Veo, Seedance, Kling, Runway, or similar.
- AI voice generation and voice synchronization.
- Lip-sync and character consistency across multiple scenes.
- Professional video editing and storytelling.
- Understanding of advertising and promotional video production.

When Applying

2. Which AI video generation tools you typically use.

4. Estimated production timeline.
5. Your pricing for the project.

I'm looking for someone who can take a concept and turn it into a compelling commercial, not just someone who can generate AI clips. Creativity, storytelling, and production quality are extremely important.

originalDescription.text:
# AI Video Creator – Google Veo & HeyGen | 128 Training Videos Per Month

**Job Type:** Ongoing Freelance Contract  
**Workload:** Approximately 128 videos per month  
**Video Length:** Approximately 2 minutes each  
**Location:** Remote  
**Experience:** Advanced Google Veo & HeyGen experience essential

## About Us

We are an established UK vocational training provider delivering online training across Adult Care, Children's Homes, Fostering, Early Years, Education, Social Work and other specialist sectors.

We are looking for an **experienced AI Video Creator** to produce high-quality, realistic training videos using **Google Veo and HeyGen**.

This is a long-term opportunity with a consistent requirement for approximately **128 videos every month**.

## What We Need

Each video will be approximately 2 minutes long and form part of a professional online training course.

The videos will combine:

1. **AI Presenter:** A realistic professional presenter created using HeyGen, introducing and explaining the subject.
2. **Scenario-Based Video:** Realistic situations generated using Google Veo, demonstrating how the training subject applies in the workplace.
3. **Presenter Transitions:** Smooth transitions between the presenter explaining key learning points and the scenario playing out.
4. **Sector-Specific Environments:** Authentic workplaces, clothing, characters and situations relevant to the training sector.
5. **Professional Editing:** Natural dialogue, accurate lip-syncing, appropriate facial expressions, clear audio and seamless video transitions.

### Example – Adult Care Training

**Course Subject:** Safeguarding Adults

The video opens with an AI presenter introducing the importance of recognising potential safeguarding concerns.

It then transitions into a realistic scenario showing a care worker noticing concerning behaviour during an interaction with an adult receiving care.

The presenter returns to explain the key learning points, followed by a further scenario demonstrating the appropriate professional response.

The video concludes with a short summary reinforcing good practice.

**The objective is to create engaging, believable training videos that help learners understand how to apply their knowledge in real-life situations.**

## Your Responsibilities

- Produce approximately 32 completed videos per week.
- Use HeyGen to create natural, professional AI presenters.
- Use Google Veo to generate realistic workplace scenarios.
- Maintain consistent character appearance, clothing and environments throughout each scenario.
- Ensure all characters, situations and settings are appropriate to the UK sector being represented.
- Edit and combine presenter footage and scenarios into professional 2-minute videos.
- Ensure natural movement, realistic facial expressions, accurate dialogue and high-quality sound.
- Follow supplied course scripts, scenarios, sector guidelines and brand requirements.
- Deliver videos in MP4 format, suitable for integration into our online learning platform.
- Make reasonable revisions where videos do not meet the agreed standards.

## What We Will Provide

We will provide:

- Course subjects and learning objectives.
- Written scripts and scenario guidance.
- Sector-specific visual requirements.
- Presenter appearance and positioning guidelines.
- Clear examples of our expected quality.
- A structured monthly production schedule.

You will be responsible for producing the finished videos from the material provided.

## Essential Experience

**Please only apply if you have proven experience producing professional AI-generated videos using Google Veo and HeyGen.**

We require someone who:

- Has strong experience with both Google Veo and HeyGen.
- Can demonstrate realistic AI-generated scenarios involving multiple characters.
- Understands video editing, pacing

originalDescription.text:
AI Video Editor for DTC Performance Ads (Higgsfield, 20-30 hrs/week, Ongoing)

Who We Are
We run 3 direct-response e-commerce stores in NL, DE, and FR with Spain coming in 2027. Every week we test new products and scale the winners on Meta and Google. Video drives all of it. We already have one video editor and we need a second to increase output and allow us to test more angles, hooks, and variations.

This is Not a Brand Film Job
We make ads that sell. A beautiful video and an ad that converts are two different things. If your portfolio is music videos, brand films, or cinematic reels, this is not the right fit. We need someone who understands that the first 3 seconds decide everything.

What You'll Do
Turn scripts and briefs from our Head of Growth into performance ads: hooks, pacing, structure, captions, sound design
Create realistic AI footage using Higgsfield and similar tools (product shots, UGC-style scenes, b-roll)
Build hook and angle variations of winning ads so we can test fast
Edit with voiceovers in Dutch, German, and French. You don't need to speak them, but you need to feel the rhythm.
Review ad performance data with Rick and use it to plan the next round of edits

What We Need From You
Strong editing fundamentals: pacing, storytelling, scroll-stopping hooks, sound design, clean visuals
Hands-on AI video experience: you know how to get realistic, engaging footage out of AI tools, not just generic eye candy. Higgsfield experience is a big plus.
You understand creative strategy: awareness levels, desires, pain points, angles. We write the strategy and scripts, but you should understand why an ad is built the way it is.
Basic DTC knowledge: hook rate, hold rate, and "the first 3 seconds decide everything" should make sense to you
Can work 20-30 hours per week on an ongoing basis
Strong written English for team communication

You don't need to know everything. We'll teach you our systems and processes. What matters is a solid foundation, a hunger to get better, and the ability to take direct feedback.

What We Offer
Long-term, fully remote, 20-30 hrs/week
Premium AI tools, paid by us
Access to our library of winning ads and the data behind them across three markets. You'll learn what actually converts.
Short feedback loop: you work directly with our Head of Growth who runs the ad accounts
Your pay grows with your output: editors who consistently deliver winning ads earn more

You report to Rick, our Head of Growth and Creative Team Lead. He writes the scripts and strategy, you bring them to life.

This is a freelance/contractor position. You invoice us directly.

Answer These Questions in Your Proposal
1. Show us 2-3 performance ads you edited (not brand films or music videos). If you have results (hook rate, CTR, ROAS), include them.
2. Show us one AI-generated clip you're proud of. What tools did you use and what made it work?
3. Pick one of the ads you shared. In 2-3 sentences: why did you choose that hook, and what would you test next?
4. Have you worked with Higgsfield? If not, which AI video tools do you use and how do you get realistic output from them?
5. How many hours per week are you available, and how quickly can you start?
6. What is your hourly rate?

AI-generated or generic applications will be ignored.
Start your proposal with the keyword EDIT26 or it will be ignored.

Top 3 Shortlisted candidates get a paid test assignment.

originalDescription.text:
DeepAR is hiring three QA Specialists to review AI-generated fashion imagery.

We generate photorealistic fashion shots: a garment on an AI-generated model, built from real stock reference photography. You decide whether each shot faithfully represents the reference — and catch it when it doesn't.

All work happens in our in-house QA dashboard. No Photoshop, no editing, no external tools.

---

The work
- Compare generated shots against reference images using a structured checklist
- Flag defects: garment inaccuracies, anatomy errors, colour drift, lighting and texture issues, face inconsistencies, AI artifacts etc…
- Write a short note per flag and attach screenshots in the dashboard
- Point out when a case is ambiguous
- Use internal AI Tooling to fix issues on AI Generated Images

You need
- A sharp eye for detail, sustained across many similar images
- Experience in product or fashion retouching, image QC, or studio/print checking — comparing output against a reference and rejecting what doesn't match
- Ability to follow a written protocol precisely rather than your own aesthetic judgement
- Working English: conversation with our team, English checklists, clear written defect notes
- Consistent availability overlapping 10:00–18:00 CET
- Based no further east than the Philippines
- 1440p display or higher; colour-calibrated strongly preferred

A plus: fashion knowledge, professional or hobby. Familiarity with how AI images typically fail.

---

Hours, rate and duration
- 20–30 hours per week, 4–6 hours daily, flexible within the 10:00–18:00 CET window
- $8-12/hour depending on experience, tracked through Upwork's work diary
- 3–6 months to start.

NDA required before access — this is unreleased product imagery. No downloading, sharing, or portfolio use.

Human-only
This QA exists to catch what AI gets wrong, so AI-assisted review is unusable. We monitor for it, and it ends the contract. 

The person we hire must be the person working — no subcontracting or shared accounts.

No Agencies.

---

Process
Screening questions → questionnaire → NDA → paid trial task → video call → contract.

---

To apply
This role suits people who've made a living looking closely at images: product and e-commerce retouchers, fashion or beauty retouchers, image QC reviewers, photo studio or print production checkers. Worth knowing upfront that the work is methodical rather than creative — the same checklist, many images, close attention throughout. Some people find that genuinely satisfying; if you're looking for creative input, this may not be the right fit.

Answer the screening questions, and in your proposal tell us:
- The closest work you've done to this, and for what kind of client or product
- The defects you caught most often, and how you spotted them
- Whether you follow fashion at all, professionally or otherwise

At Balance is Possible, we share ancient Daoist wisdom through beautiful films, inspiring stories, Tai Chi, Qigong and philosophy. Our mission is to help people cultivate peace, energy and purpose, and find balance within themselves, with each other and with our living planet. Our films have reached millions worldwide. We are a small, passionate, mission-driven team that believes media can change lives.

See the channel: https://www.youtube.com/@George-Thompson

THE OPPORTUNITY
We're looking for an exceptional Video Editor & AI Content Producer with a great eye for visual storytelling and genuine excitement about our mission. You'll primarily edit our weekly YouTube films, contribute to daily short-form content, and occasionally help with ambitious documentaries exploring Daoism, consciousness, personal transformation and nature.

We also want to pioneer an AI-powered content production system — not by sacrificing creativity, quality, heart, integrity or our distinctive visual identity, but by automating repetitive work and freeing more time for meaningful creative decisions. You don't need to have built AI workflows before, but you must be excited to experiment, learn and develop them.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
• Edit approximately one polished, emotionally compelling YouTube video each week, working from clear, vetted briefs. Long-form quality takes priority.
• Bring excellent narrative structure, pacing, visuals, music and sound design, while maintaining and elevating our visual identity. Creative suggestions welcome.
• Help produce engaging daily short-form content for YouTube Shorts, Instagram and other platforms, using efficient repurposing workflows.
• Experiment with AI-assisted footage review, transcription, rough cuts, moment selection and repetitive production tasks. Progress from AI-assisted workflows towards a scalable, human-directed content system.
• Occasionally contribute to more ambitious documentary films.

WHAT WE VALUE
ESSENTIAL:
• Exceptional storytelling instincts: narrative, pacing, emotion and audience engagement.
• Excellent visual taste: composition, music, sound design and distinctive aesthetics.
• Strong professional video editing experience and ability to deliver polished films.
• Enthusiasm for AI experimentation and building efficient creative workflows.
• Genuine alignment with our mission and desire to make a positive impact.
• Fluent English and strong remote communication.

HIGHLY DESIRABLE:
• Understanding of YouTube hooks, retention and audience psychology.
• Adobe Premiere Pro experience (other professional editing platforms welcome).

DESIRABLE:
• Existing AI editing experience; documentary filmmaking experience; interest in Daoism, Tai Chi, Qigong, philosophy or consciousness.

We value creative judgement, portfolio and potential over formal qualifications or years of experience. We want a talented storyteller who's hungry to master AI, not an automation expert who compromises on craft.

WHY JOIN?
Your work can reach hundreds of thousands or millions of people and share teachings that genuinely change lives. You'll help shape the future of creative production, develop valuable AI filmmaking skills, work on meaningful projects and collaborate with a kind, curious, international team that values creativity, ownership and integrity.

PRACTICAL DETAILS
• Fully remote, worldwide; fluent English required.
• Full-time commitment, approximately 40 hours/week.
• Monthly contractor retainer: $2,600 USD (equivalent to $15/hour at 40 hours/week).
• Primary focus: one high-quality YouTube film per week.
• Secondary focus: support daily short-form output and develop AI workflows.
• We judge success by compelling finished films that match the brief and visual identity, dependable weekly delivery, constructive collaboration and documented progress towards efficient AI-assisted production. Long-form quality comes before short-form volume.

HOW TO APPLY
We are looking for thoughtful, personalised applications. Generic responses will not be accepted.

1. Your best work: Share 2–3 examples of your best editing work. Tell us which you're most proud of and why.
2. Our mission: Watch some of our videos and explain why our mission resonates with you.
3. AI innovation: Tell us how you're currently using AI in video editing, or how you'd like to use it.
4. Practical details: Share your availability and expected monthly rate.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid editing exercise.

We believe the world needs more wisdom, compassion and beautiful storytelling. If you want your creative work to make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

☯ Balance is Possible.

We're a DTC brand selling washable incontinence underwear in several European markets. We want to build an always-on library of product videos we can use for years: in ads (Meta, TikTok, YouTube), on our product pages, marketplaces, email and social. Not for one campaign, and not tied to one language.

Our audience
Men and women 50+, mostly men after prostate treatment, living with light to moderate bladder leaks. Many still use pads and feel embarrassed by them. They want something discreet that feels like normal underwear. Some buyers are partners or family members shopping for them.

The tone must be respectful, calm and real. No jokes about the condition, no shocking visuals, nothing that makes people feel bad about themselves.

What we need
Short product videos created with AI video tools, for example:
• How the product works (absorbent layer, absorption demo)
• Product vs pads comparison
• Everyday life moments (walking, working, travelling, at home)
• Product details: fabric, fit, waistband, washing and reuse
• Close-ups and product shots

Requirements
• Realistic AI people aged 55 to 75, natural everyday settings, not glossy or fake looking
• No one talking to camera, no lip sync
• Language neutral: no burned-in text, so we can add voiceover and captions in any language
• Nothing time-bound: no prices, offers, seasons or holidays
• Modular: separate scenes we can recombine into new ads, plus 3 different hooks (first 3 seconds) per video
• Lengths: 6s, 15s and 30s versions
• Formats: 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9
• Delivered as clean master files plus the project file with separate tracks (video, music, sound, text)
• Follow Meta's health ad rules (we'll guide you)

We provide
• Briefs and scripts for each video
• Product photos and brand assets
• Reference videos showing the style we want

How we'll work
• 1 paid test video first
• If it works, ongoing work in batches of 5 videos
• Up to 2 rounds of revisions per video
• Full commercial rights to everything you deliver, and AI tools used must allow commercial use

To apply, send:
1. AI video ads or product videos you made for fashion brands, ideally underwear or apparel
2. The AI tools you use
3. Your price for the test video, and your price per batch of 5 (3 hooks, all lengths and formats)
4. Your turnaround time per batch

originalDescription.text:
I’m producing an AI-assisted narrative short film and looking for an experienced AI video artist to generate individual cinematic shots for an awards-show red-carpet scene.

I’ll edit the shots into the film myself. Your role is to create believable, visually compelling footage with consistent characters, wardrobe, props and environments.

The goal is a high-end feature-film look: cinematic lighting, intentional compositions, natural performances and motivated camera movement. I want to avoid a flat TV-show look or footage that feels obviously AI-generated.

What I’ll Provide

* Scene script
* Character reference sheets
* Location references and a rough location sheet
* Prop and branding sheets
* Creative direction and feedback

Scope and Deliverables

* Review the script and recommend shot coverage and an estimated shot count.
* Generate individual shots with lengths appropriate to the scene.
* Maintain continuity across characters, wardrobe, geography, lighting and branding.
* Refine selected shots based on feedback.
* Deliver approved shots in 1080p.

This scene is primarily about atmosphere, performances and cinematic coverage. It does not involve elaborate action choreography.

Initial Paid Trial

I’d like to begin with one or two paid shots to establish the visual approach and confirm we’re a good fit before moving forward with the full scene.

Ideal Experience

* AI-generated narrative filmmaking
* Character and location consistency across multiple shots
* Realistic human movement and performances
* Cinematography, visual storytelling and shot design
* Experience with tools such as Higgsfield, Seedance, Kling or comparable platforms

Strong visual judgment matters more than a particular tool.

Please Include in Your Proposal

1. Two or three relevant examples of your cinematic AI video work. Please identify your contribution.
2. The tools and workflow you would use.
3. Whether your pricing includes generation credits or those are billed separately.
4. Your pricing for a one- or two-shot paid trial.
5. Whether you prefer hourly or fixed per-shot pricing, and how you handle revisions.
6. Your availability and estimated turnaround.

The full scope and budget will be determined after reviewing the script and agreeing on coverage.

originalDescription.text:
We're a small Scandinavian creative studio making ads for premium brands in the UK and the Nordics. The ads run on Meta and have to sell, so pretty isn't enough (but they do have to be beautiful).

We're looking for one person who is really great at this and wants to own it. You take a brief, think about who the ad is for, and turn it into images and short films with tools like Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Nano Banana, GPT Image and Claude. The tools matter less than your eye, though. We want work that looks like a real photo or a real shoot, with labels that are sharp and correct, hands that hold things the way a person would, and copy that is clear rather than clever.

The pace is high, with several product ad batches every day for clients and for new brands we pitch, so speed matters a lot, but we're honestly just as interested in how you think. We want someone who studies what's new in AI creative every week, tries it before anyone asks, and comes to us with ideas for better ways of working (and new things we could offer clients). If you like working fast and clean and being trusted with that, you'll probably like it here.

Above all, we want someone who solves things. If a tool only gives you 3:4 and the ad needs 4:5, you extend it, crop it or fix it by hand instead of telling us it can't be done. AI gets you most of the way, and it would be a big plus if you also have real Photoshop skills for the part it can't handle (a warped label, a hand that looks off, a background that needs to grow).

We pay USD 875 per month for 40 hours a week, and all AI tool subscriptions are on us. On some clients you also earn a percentage of the sales your own ads bring in. It's fully remote, and we work the same hours as a team, roughly 9 to 18 Central European Time, so you need to live within 3 hours of CET (most of Africa and Europe fit).

How to apply (about 15 minutes, and we read every reply)
1. Start your reply with the word BUBBLES, so we know you read this far.
2. Send 3-5 links to work you made. For each one, tell us the tools you used and which part was yours.
3. In 2-3 sentences, name one ad you think is brilliant (anyone's) and tell us why it works.
4. Tell us about a time a client wasn't happy with your work, and what you did next.
5. Tell us one new AI tool or technique you tried in the last month, and what you learned.
6. Show us one image where AI got stuck and you fixed it yourself, and tell us how.
7. Tell us your timezone and the hours you can work.

originalDescription.text:
**Job title: Direct-Response Video Ad Editor | Beauty & Skincare UGC | Meta Ads**

We’re a beauty and skincare ecommerce brand looking for an experienced video ad editor to turn creator footage into compelling paid ads for Facebook and Instagram.

Our products include face masks, lip care and serums. Our style is confident, playful and polished, with clear product demonstrations and authentic creator reactions.

We want someone who understands how to earn attention, communicate a product’s appeal and build a persuasive story that encourages a purchase.

**The work**

We’re commissioning creators to supply application footage, texture close-ups, reveals, testimonials, alternative hooks and still photography.

You’ll work with these assets to:

- Identify the strongest moments and build clear, engaging ad concepts.
- Edit UGC into ads with effective openings, purposeful pacing and convincing product demonstrations.
- Create genuinely different hooks and creative angles from the same footage.
- Combine footage from multiple creators where it strengthens the story.
- Add readable captions, relevant graphics, clean sound and consistent colour.
- Adapt edits for agreed Meta placements, including 9:16 and 4:5, with appropriate safe zones.
- Refine creative using performance feedback and recommend what to test next.
- Flag missing footage and suggest useful shots for future creator briefs.

Ad length will depend on the concept and available material. You should be comfortable recommending what the story needs.

**Who we’re looking for**

You should have:

- A strong portfolio of direct-response ecommerce video ads.
- Experience editing UGC for paid Facebook and Instagram campaigns.
- Relevant beauty, skincare or cosmetics examples.
- Strong judgement around hooks, storytelling, product benefits, customer objections and calls to action.
- Excellent English and an ear for natural, believable dialogue.
- The ability to preserve authentic skin texture and creator reactions.
- An organised workflow, clear communication and reliable delivery.
- The confidence to contribute ideas and explain your editing decisions.

You should understand how viewing behaviour, clicks and purchase results can inform creative decisions. You won’t be responsible for media buying, but you should be comfortable collaborating with whoever manages the campaigns.

Motion graphics skills are welcome where they improve clarity. The priority is persuasive storytelling and strong editing judgement.

**What good work looks like**

For a face mask ad, you might recognise that the removal is the strongest opening, use earlier application footage to build curiosity and select an honest reaction to support the reveal.

Another version might open with texture or a different customer motivation. We want meaningful creative variations that help us learn which approaches resonate.

All edits must preserve the meaning of creator statements and use approved product claims. Music, fonts and other added assets must be licensed for paid advertising.

**How we’ll start**

We’ll begin with a small **paid trial** for shortlisted candidates, using supplied footage:

- One complete ad.
- Two alternative opening hooks that work with the same main edit.
- A brief explanation of your creative choices.

**Deliverables**

For agreed projects, provide:

- Final exports in the requested formats.
- A clean version without added captions, graphics or music.
- Clearly labelled creative variations.
- Editable project files with linked assets organised for handover.

**Please include in your application**

1. **Three relevant ads you personally edited**, ideally beauty or skincare UGC. Individual ad examples are more useful than a general showreel.
2. Your exact contribution to each: editing, concept, scripting or a combination.
3. A short explanation of why one example’s opening works and what alternative you would test.
4. Any performance feedback you’re permitted to share, with context about the campaign and your contribution. Results are helpful but not essential; please don’t promise a particular ROAS.
5. Your availability, typical turnaround and whether you work independently or as part of a team.
6. Your proposed price for the paid trial above, plus your usual pricing structure for ongoing work.

Please keep applications focused on relevant examples and your approach. We value thoughtful creative decisions, attention to detail and work that makes the product easy to understand.

**We’re looking for a long-term creative partner, with substantial ongoing work planned across future campaigns and product launches. For the right candidate, this could develop into a full-time role if that’s something you’re interested in. We’d love to find someone who wants to grow with the brand.**

originalDescription.text:
We're an Amazon agency running brands on Amazon EU and US: sleep, supplements, food, beauty and more. We need a designer who is excellent with AI image tools and has the eye and retouching skills to turn AI output into finished, accurate, premium listing images. This is ongoing work across several brands, starting now.

First project: main image, gallery and A+ content for a German mattress brand, about 10 product lines in many sizes. The client has approved the design direction. We create the first AI drafts in-house. You make them better and take them to final.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Generate and improve product scenes with AI (GPT Image, Nano Banana, Flux, Midjourney, Higgsfield or similar). Use real product photos and our guide renders as references, so the product stays true to the real thing.
- Catch and fix what AI gets wrong: skewed or warped print on labels, wrong foam profiles and seams, melted edges, fake fabric texture, wrong shadows, pixelation.
- Know when to re-prompt, when to inpaint, when to composite a real photo and when to rebuild a detail by hand.
- Set all text yourself in Photoshop or Figma; text is never AI-generated. We supply the German copy. It must be big, short and readable on a phone.
- Design inside a brand system: two calm colours plus one accent, and real depth (background, product, foreground). None of the generic "AI look": no glass cards, glows or random icons.
- Roll one design across many variants and sizes with templates, instead of redoing everything.
- Work in Figma with a clean version history and deliver layered source files (PSD or Figma). Everything you make is ours to keep and edit.

WHO YOU ARE
- Your portfolio shows Amazon or e-commerce images and, ideally, the raw AI output next to your final.
- You retouch at a professional level: perspective, light, shadow, and print that sits straight on angled or curved surfaces.
- You know Amazon's image rules: pure white main image, 2000 px, A+ module sizes, mobile first.

I got big dreams and a micro budget. But this is a ONCE IN A LIFETIME PROJECT and may lead to a feature film deal.

Looking for an experienced AI filmmaker and storyteller to turn my book, real interviews, and historical footage into a compelling five-minute film.

The story follows the rise of a new rave drug, entrepreneurial ambition, underground culture, money, conflict, and the personal stakes behind building an unconventional business.

The finished film will serve as a premium marketing asset, a source of short social clips, and a proof of concept to help attract producers and studios interested in a larger adaptation.

The goal is to use this as a sales tool to raise financing for which we may hire you to make a larger film.

Creative direction

We want a powerful opening within the first 5–10 seconds, a clear story arc, escalating tension, and an ending that leaves viewers wanting the full film.

Quality reference:  Gossip.Goblin

We admire the cinematic ambition, visual impact, and immersive storytelling. Our film is grounded in a real story and historical settings, rather than science fiction.

The visual approach should combine:

• Live interview footage of me, which I will provide.
• Real historical footage, photographs, and other materials I will provide.
• Carefully directed AI recreations and atmospheric sequences that bring key moments to life.

The result should feel cohesive, emotionally engaging, and cinematic, with strong sound design and purposeful pacing.

Your responsibilities

• Review the book and supplied materials, then identify the strongest five-minute story.
• Use AI to develop the script, narration, storyboard, and shot list, with your own editorial judgment and my approval.
• Build the film around authentic interview moments and historical materials.
• Create selected AI sequences using Higgsfield and other appropriate tools.
• Maintain consistent characters, period details, lighting, and visual style.
• Complete editing, dialogue cleanup, music, sound design, color grading, and titles.
• Identify moments that can stand alone as promotional clips.

Historical claims and quotations must remain grounded in the source material. AI recreations should be distinguishable from genuine archival footage. Any new narration will be recorded by me unless we agree on another approach.

Deliverables

• One approximately five-minute film in 16:9.
• High-quality 1080p master at minimum; please quote a 4K delivery option and explain any source-resolution limitations or upscaling.
• A clean master without burned-in captions, plus an English SRT caption file.
• Editable project files and an organized handoff of transferable assets.
• A list of music, stock, and AI tools used, including commercial-use permissions and any restrictions.
• Please separately quote three vertical promotional clips of approximately 20–45 seconds each.

Timeline and budget

Target delivery: 14 calendar days after receiving the materials and confirming the scope.

Preferred schedule:
• Days 1–3: Story treatment, script, and shot plan.
• Days 4–5: Short visual sample to approve the direction.
• Days 6–10: AI production and first full cut.
• Days 11–14: Revisions and final delivery.

Initial fixed-price budget: $500. ( I know its nothing but it will be a selling tool for a larger film) . We have budjeted an extra $300-$500 for the hard costs of Higsfield credits etc.

Please explain exactly what you can deliver within that budget, including the amount of AI footage, revision rounds, and tool or generation costs. If the complete scope requires more, provide a separate all-inclusive quote. Any additional costs must be agreed in advance.

To apply, please include:

1. Two or three relevant completed films, ideally combining real footage with AI sequences.
2. Your specific role in each example.
3. Your experience with Higgsfield and your preferred production workflow.
4. A brief idea for the opening of this film.
5. Your proposed scope, total price, included revisions, and confirmation of availability.

I’m looking for someone with strong filmmaking instincts who can turn an extraordinary real story into a film people want to keep watching.

Reach out on DM If you want a copy of the Best Selling Book this will be based on and some more direction.

🎬 We're a DTC supplement brand looking for a Video Editor & AI Creative Producer to build and cut our paid social ads.

We test a high volume of creative every month, and a growing share of it is AI-generated. We need an editor who understands that a direct-response ad is not a brand film: pacing, retention, and clarity beat polish every time. Equally important, you need to be fluent in the current AI video stack and know how to turn AI output into ads that actually convert.

🤖 AI is a core part of this role, not a bonus

A big part of your work will be producing ads in AI-driven styles, including:

Pixar-style / 3D animated ads: character-driven stories, animated mascots, explainer-style scenes
Suno-powered music ads: custom jingles, songs, and soundtracks built around the product and hook
AI UGC & AI avatars: realistic AI presenters, talking heads, and testimonial-style content
AI b-roll & product shots: generated scenes, ingredient visuals, before/after concepts, lifestyle footage
AI voiceover: natural-sounding VO in multiple voices and languages

You should have hands-on experience with:

Google Veo (Veo 3): prompting, scene consistency, generating usable clips with native audio
Higgsfield: camera motion presets, character consistency, cinematic AI shots
Suno: generating and editing music and jingles for ads
Bonus: Kling, Runway, Sora, Midjourney, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, or similar tools

You know how to keep characters and products consistent across shots, fix the typical AI artifacts (hands, faces, warped labels and text), and blend AI footage with real footage so it doesn't feel cheap.

🔥 What you'll do

Edit UGC, VSL, advertorial, testimonial, and problem/solution ads from written briefs
Produce fully or partially AI-generated ads (Pixar-style, AI UGC, music-led Suno ads) from concept to final export
Cut multiple hook variations of the same concept so we can test them properly, including AI-generated hook alternatives
Source, generate, and sync b-roll, stock, AI clips, screen recordings, and images to fit each video
Add captions, sound design, music, and on-screen text that support retention instead of decorating the frame
Handle basic motion graphics: text reveals, callouts, ingredient and benefit animations
Deliver in the aspect ratios and specs we need for Meta placements
Turn around revisions quickly and apply feedback across the batch, not just the one clip flagged

✅ What we're looking for

Proven experience editing direct-response ads for DTC/e-commerce brands
Demonstrable experience creating AI video ads, especially with Veo, Higgsfield, and Suno
A portfolio that includes AI-generated ads (Pixar-style, AI UGC, AI music ads, etc.)
Supplements, health, beauty, or another compliance-sensitive category is a strong plus
Strong command of Premiere Pro or After Effects (or CapCut, if your work holds up)
An eye for pacing: you know where a viewer drops off and how to stop it
You stay on top of new AI tools and actually test them, not just read about them
Ability to work from a written brief (briefs will be provided)
Consistency and speed

🚫 Not a fit

This isn't a wedding, YouTube, or brand-film editing role. Beautiful edits that don't convert aren't what we're hiring for. Same goes for AI: impressive-looking AI clips that don't sell aren't the goal.

📩 To apply

Include:

DTC brands you've edited for
Some of your ads for Meta advertising
At least 2–3 AI-generated ads you've made, and which tools you used for each (Veo, Higgsfield, Suno, etc.)
What was the biggest spend on one of your ads?
Any results you know of: spend, CTR, hold rate, ROAS, anything you have

🎥 Then send a short Loom (5 min, no editing needed) walking us through one direct-response ad and one AI-generated ad you've made: why you made the editing choices you did, how you built the AI parts, and how the ad performed.

originalDescription.text:
# Cinematic AI Creative Director — Contract/Freelance
**K3 Group | Remote | Contract/Freelance**

---

## About K3 Group

K3 Group is a full-service digital marketing firm managing brand, creative, and growth for clients across multiple industries. We are building out a high-caliber AI creative function — not a content farm, not a prompt-and-export operation — a genuine cinematic production capability that produces branded content and original IP at a studio level. We are looking for the rare individual who can lead that from the front.

---

## The Role

This is not a job for someone who opens Runway, types a prompt, and exports whatever comes out. We are looking for a Cinematic AI Creative Director who approaches AI-generated content the way a film director approaches a production — with intention, craft, and a point of view that carries through every frame.

You will work on a contract/freelance basis to direct and produce end-to-end cinematic AI content for K3 Group's client portfolio. This includes branded commercial content, original IP development, character-driven narrative films, animated world-building, and high-end social content that does not look like it came from a tool — it looks like it came from a studio.

The benchmark we are building toward: the kind of output you see from operations like The Blue Horizon. Cinematic. Consistent. Emotionally grounded. Built from a real creative process, not a template.

**If your work looks like an AI demo reel, this is not the role for you. If your work looks like a film that happens to be made with AI — keep reading.**

---

## What You'll Do

**Cinematic AI Direction & Production**
- Direct and produce end-to-end AI-generated video content at a cinematic quality standard — from creative brief to final delivery
- Develop and maintain frame-by-frame visual consistency across characters, locations, environments, and brand aesthetics throughout a production
- Apply genuine filmmaking craft to AI production — shot composition, pacing, lighting direction, scene structure, and emotional storytelling
- Oversee the full production pipeline from concept and storyboard through generation, editing, sound design, and final export
- Produce content across formats — short-form social, long-form brand films, commercials, and episodic original content

**Original IP & Branded Content Development**
- Concept and develop original IP projects for clients — character-driven narratives, animated brand worlds, and cinematic brand stories
- Build branded content at a commercial production level — hero spots, campaign films, and platform-specific cutdowns that all live within the same cohesive visual universe
- Develop brand characters, visual languages, and narrative frameworks that can sustain an ongoing content strategy
- Translate client briefs into cinematic creative directions that go beyond what the client imagined when they sent the brief

**Creative Direction & Storytelling**
- Write or supervise scripts, shot lists, and storyboards that guide AI production with precision
- Bring a clear directorial point of view to every project — visual style, narrative tone, pacing, and emotional arc
- Collaborate closely with K3 Group leadership and the AI Creatives team to ensure creative direction is aligned before production begins
- Push creative ideas beyond the obvious angle and bring references, concepts, and directions that the team would not have found on their own

**Tool Mastery & Production Innovation**
- Operate at an advanced level across the leading AI video and image generation platforms — Runway, Kling, Sora, Pika, Midjourney, Leonardo AI, and equivalent tools
- Stay at the absolute frontier of AI creative technology — new model releases, emerging techniques, and production methods that most people are not using yet
- Find and implement solutions for the hardest production challenges — character consistency, scene coherence, realistic motion, and cinematic lighting — across tools and workflows
- Continuously raise the quality ceiling on what AI-generated content can look and feel like

---

## What You Bring

- A portfolio or reel that demonstrates **cinematic AI production at a studio level** — not tool demos, not highlight reels of generated clips. Actual produced pieces with narrative structure, visual consistency, and creative direction throughout
- Deep, hands-on experience with AI video and image generation tools: **Runway, Kling, Sora, Pika, Midjourney, Leonardo AI**, and comparable platforms
- A genuine filmmaking background or equivalent — you understand shot language, scene construction, pacing, color, sound, and how all of it works together to create something that lands emotionally
- Proven ability to maintain character and environmental consistency across multi-scene, multi-shot AI productions
- Strong creative writing and concepting skills — you can develop an original IP concept, a brand narrative, or a commercial script from scratch
- Experience producing branded commercial content and original creative IP — not just social content
- Ability to take a client brief and translate it into a full creative direction with references, visual language, and a production plan
- Self-directed and highly professional — you manage your own creative process, communicate proactively, and deliver at the level you promised
- Experience working across multiple brands or clients in a creative leadership capacity

---

## What We're Really Looking For

There is a version of AI video that anyone can make. We are not interested in that version.

We are building toward a creative capability that sits at the intersection of filmmaking craft and generative technology — where the AI is a production tool in the hands of a real director, not a replacement for one. The output should make people ask how it was made, not immediately recognize it as AI.

The right person for this role has seen what is possible at the frontier of this medium and has been building toward it. They have a reel that proves it. They have a creative instinct that drives it. And they are ready to do it consistently, across multiple brands, at a standard that raises the bar for everyone on the team.

---

## Engagement Details

- **Type:** Contract / Freelance
- **Commitment:** Project-based and ongoing (scope defined per project and client)
- **Location:** Fully Remote
- **Rate:** Competitive — commensurate with portfolio quality and production capability

---

## How to Apply

**⚠️ Please apply directly through this Upwork posting only. Applications submitted outside of Upwork will not be reviewed.**

Send the following through your Upwork application:

1. **Your reel or portfolio — non-negotiable.** We need to see cinematic AI productions with clear creative direction, visual consistency, and narrative structure. Clip collections and tool demos will not be considered.
2. A brief overview of your production background — filmmaking, direction, AI creative, or a combination
3. Two or three specific projects you are most proud of and what your role was in each — be precise about what you directed, built, and delivered
4. The tools you operate at the highest level and how you use them to solve the hardest production challenges
5. Your availability and rate

We are not in a rush to fill this role with the wrong person. We will wait for the right one.

---

*K3 Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse perspectives and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all collaborators.*

Ball markers and clips

1. Background Removal & Cleaning

Remove the existing background and replace it with pure white (#FFFFFF).

Remove any visible studio equipment, supports or unwanted objects.

Ensure clean, precise edges, particularly around fabric and detailed products.

Maintain natural, subtle shadows where appropriate to avoid a flat, artificial appearance.

2. Product Retouching

Remove dust, lint, dirt, unwanted marks and visible imperfections.

Reduce distracting wrinkles and creases in fabrics while maintaining realistic texture and shape.

Correct any minor distortions or uneven shapes where necessary.

Ensure products look polished and professionally presented without appearing artificially manipulated.

3. Colour & Lighting

Ensure colours remain accurate and true to the physical products.

Correct exposure, white balance and colour inconsistencies.

Maintain consistent brightness, contrast and overall appearance across the entire collection.

Preserve realistic material textures and fine details.

4. Product Alignment & Consistency

Centre and straighten all products.

Ensure consistent positioning, scale and spacing between similar products.

Maintain consistent presentation across different angles of the same item.

Ensure products are visually balanced within the frame.

Final Deliverables

High-resolution JPEG files with pure white backgrounds.

Consistent 1:1 square framing suitable for Shopify.

Products centred with appropriate and consistent margins.

Maintain maximum image quality and sharpness.

Organised final files with clear filenames.

Important

The final images should look like they belong on a premium retail e-commerce website, not simply basic background-removal edits.

We want professional, natural-looking results with careful attention to detail, accurate colours, realistic fabric textures and excellent consistency.
