originalDescription.text:
We are building an exclusive, virtual "Quiet Luxury" lifestyle influencer brand ("Amara") and are looking for a top-tier AI Content Creator & ComfyUI Specialist to produce high-end visual assets.

PLEASE NOTE: This is a pure content production role. You will NOT need to manage social media accounts, engage with followers, or post anything. Your only responsibility is generating and delivering flawless, ready-to-use visual assets to a shared drive.

What We Provide:

Fully trained custom LoRA character model (consistent face, hazel/amber eyes, signature beauty mark).

Multi-stage ComfyUI workflows and brand style guidelines.

Your Responsibilities (Content Production Pipeline):

Image Production: Generate 20–25 photorealistic images per month (luxury travel, high fashion, fine dining, aesthetic lifestyle) using our ComfyUI setup and custom LoRA.

Short Video / Reels Creation: Generate 4–6 short AI video clips (Reels) per month (e.g., using Luma, Kling, or Wan2.1 for subtle movements like sipping coffee, enjoying a scenic view, walking in luxury locations).

Post-Processing & Quality Assurance: Perform face consistency checks, skin detail retention, and Photoshop touch-ups to guarantee 100% realistic quality (no floating fingers, distorted hands, or uncanny AI flaws).

Google Drive Delivery: Upload all final, organized assets (High-Res Images + Video Reels + matching aesthetic captions) to our shared Google Drive folder on a strict weekly schedule.

CRITICAL REQUIREMENT – QUALIFICATION CHECK:
Please ONLY apply if you are 100% confident in your technical setup, ComfyUI mastery, and ability to deliver consistent, photorealistic face/LoRA quality on day one. We are looking for an absolute expert who can hit the ground running with our provided workflows without hand-holding. If you cannot produce flaw-free, hyper-realistic visuals independently, please do not apply.

Intellectual Property (IP) & Confidentiality (STRICT):

All outputs, character LoRAs, ComfyUI workflows, images, and videos created or used under this contract are 100% sole property of the client.

Signing a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and full transfer of all IP rights is strictly required prior to project start.

How to Apply:

Share 3–5 examples of your best photorealistic AI character portraits and short AI video clips.

Confirm your availability to produce 25+ visual assets per month.

Include the word "AMARA GROWTH" at the very top of your proposal so we know you read this description thoroughly.

originalDescription.text:
Body Balance System makes premium red-light therapy beds. We just rebranded and changed our brand colors and want our site to reflect the new changes and new brand identity. We need 16 lifestyle images for our website 8 of the OvationULT and 8 of the PremierRLT.

Our current site images (bodybalancesystemonline.com) have the mood we want: the settings, color palette, lighting atmosphere and overall feel. But they were made with AI, and it shows, and that needs to get fixed immediately. 

We want to replace the AI generated images with ones that include real imagery of the beds and models, but have the various types of luxury backgrounds across the new site (which you can reference from the images currently live)
This is a remote compositing and retouching job. We supply all product and model photography.

What we need:
-Editor is to go through the current site and assess which backgrounds would be needed for the project deliverables
-16 finished images: 8 OvationULT and 8 PremierRLT
Composites built from our real photos of the beds and models. The beds and people must not be AI-generated or AI-altered in any way that changes their shape, proportions or details.
-Backgrounds can be built digitally, as long as they look realistic and on-brand.
-Logo and nameplate swap: replace the existing blue logo and nameplate on each bed in Photoshop using our PNG files with the gold branding, so they look physically part of the bed. That means correct perspective, curvature, surface texture, lighting and reflections. No flat overlays.
Realistic lighting is critical:
The red-light glow coming from the bed has to spill naturally onto the models, the floor, walls and nearby surfaces.
Contact shadows, cast shadows and reflections must match the scene's light sources.
Color temperature, perspective and grain have to match between the bed, the models and the background.
What we provide (at contract start)
Existing photos of the OvationULT and PremierRLT beds, with and without models
PNG files of the new logo and nameplate
Our current site images as mood and setting references

Deliverables:
16 high-resolution final images as JPG that match our requirements of the project
Layered PSD files for every image
Two rounds of revisions per image if needed

Requirements
Advanced Photoshop skills and a strong portfolio in product compositing or commercial retouching
Proven experience matching light, shadows and reflections. Emitted-light or glowing-product work is a big plus.
Experience replacing logos or labels on 3D surfaces realistically
You must confirm in writing that the beds and models in the final images come only from our supplied photos, not from AI generation
Our supplied photos and brand files are confidential and may only be used for this project
You transfer full commercial usage rights to Body Balance System on delivery
Timeline: 1 week
Budget: $500-$640 per project (BOE)

originalDescription.text:
ADV is an AI visual production studio for beauty and personal care brands. We produce full campaigns for top multi-million dollar brands stocked in Sephora, Walmart and Target, without a single photoshoot.

A campaign at ADV means everything a brand needs to launch and sell: model images, product images, video ads, UGC and brand films. Every piece starts with research into the brand and its customer, which is a big part of why our work performs.

We’re hiring a senior brand producer to take a creative brief and build the campaign from start to finish. By senior we mean taste and judgment, not years on a CV. If your work looks premium and you know why, we want to see it.

Why join us

You’ll work directly with people who have helped generate over $100M for DTC brands over the years, and you’ll learn how creative actually drives sales
Your work goes out for beauty brands you’ll recognise on the shelf
We train you on our workflow, tools and creative process
We’re a fully remote team with a culture we’re proud of. We care about results and sustainability, which means realistic deadlines and no working until you burn out
Game night every Friday

What you’ll do

Turn briefs into finished campaigns, from model and product images to video ads, UGC and brand films
Generate scenes with AI image and video tools, then finish them in Photoshop and Premiere or CapCut
Keep products and models accurate and consistent across every asset in a campaign
Bring your own ideas when a brief needs more than execution

Requirements

A portfolio that shows taste. This matters more than anything else on this list
Professional-level Photoshop: retouching, compositing and cleaning up AI output so it looks real
Video editing in Premiere or CapCut, with an eye for pacing
Hands-on experience generating images and video with AI tools (Midjourney, GPT Image, Higgsfield or similar). You understand how the models behave and how to fix what they get wrong
Attention to detail. Product labels, packaging and skin have to be exactly right
Clear written English and able to work full-time with some overlap with US Eastern hours

Nice to have

Experience at a creative agency or on an in-house brand team
Work for beauty, skincare or personal care brands
Experience making ads or UGC for paid social

Compensation and benefits

$2,500 per month
Bonuses for great work and showing initiative
Paid test project ($50) for shortlisted candidates
Weekends off
Fully remote
Room to grow as ADV grows
Game night every Friday


To apply, send:

Your portfolio, with a note on which pieces used AI and what you did on each
The tools you use for AI generation, design and editing
The one piece you’re proudest of and your exact role on it

We are a beauty brand launching a honey lip balm, and we are looking for a creative AI video specialist to produce a short cinematic ad for Instagram Reels and TikTok.

The idea
We want a playful, slightly provocative story built around honey: rich golden textures, a luxurious historical setting and an unexpected twist that leads to our product. We will share a rough concept, but it is a starting point, not a strict script. You are free to develop the structure, scenes, pacing and transitions your own way. We value your creative ideas as much as your technical skills.

The work includes:
- Developing the video structure and shot sequence based on our rough concept
- Realistic AI-generated scenes with one consistent main character
- Close-up and macro shots where the honey looks rich, glossy and almost tangible
- A final product shot with our real packaging (product photos will be provided; the label and logo must look accurate)
- Music, sound design, editing and transitions
- Vertical 9:16 format, 10–15 seconds

We would like to begin with this one paid video. If we are happy with the result, this may become ongoing work for our product line.

Please provide:
- Examples of your best AI videos (beauty, product or cinematic ads are a plus)
- A short idea of how you would hook the viewer in the first 1–2 seconds
- The AI tools you use
- Your turnaround time
- The number of revisions included

The final video must include commercial usage rights and be delivered without watermarks.

originalDescription.text:
AI Content Creator – Furniture Product Photography, Interior Styling & Video

About Dimehouse

Dimehouse (www.dimehouse.nl) is an international furniture e-commerce brand operating in multiple European countries. We offer a wide range of furniture, including sofas, dining chairs, tables, cabinets and other home interior products.

We are looking for a creative and experienced AI Content Creator who can help us significantly improve our visual product presentation across our international webshops.

What are we looking for?

Our goal is to create a consistent, recognizable and high-quality visual identity that appeals to our European target audience.

We already have an extensive collection of product images, but there is room for improvement:

Product photography: Improve existing product images by creating modern, realistic and attractive interior settings using AI.

Visual consistency: Some of our current images have outdated backgrounds, while others are AI-generated by suppliers and do not meet our quality standards. We want to establish a consistent visual style across our webshop.

Complete interior settings: Create realistic lifestyle images combining multiple products from our collection. For example, a dining table with matching chairs, lighting and accessories, presented as a complete interior.

Campaign content: Develop creative AI-generated images and videos for marketing campaigns, advertisements and social media.

Product accuracy: It is essential that the actual furniture remains true to the original product. AI should improve the presentation, not change the product's design, proportions, materials or colors.

Our vision

We are not simply looking for someone who can generate attractive AI images.

We want someone who understands furniture, interior styling, e-commerce and visual branding.

Our main objective is to make Dimehouse look more professional, visually consistent and recognizable, while ensuring that our product presentation matches the expectations and preferences of our European customers.

About our company

Besides Dimehouse, we also own Livin24 (www.livin24.com), another furniture brand for which we currently handle content creation internally.

For Dimehouse, we would like to explore an AI-focused approach to content production and potentially build a long-term partnership with a talented external specialist.

Who are we looking for?

Ideally, you have:

Proven experience with AI-generated furniture or interior photography.

Strong skills in AI image generation, image editing and realistic product integration.

A good understanding of European interior design trends and e-commerce presentation.

Experience creating AI-generated marketing videos would be a strong advantage.

The ability to maintain a consistent visual style across a large product catalogue.

How would we like to start?

We would like to begin with a small paid test project involving several different furniture products.

Based on the results, we can discuss a larger collaboration covering product photography, lifestyle settings and campaign content.

When applying, please share:

Examples of AI-generated furniture or interior images you have created.

Examples showing original product photos transformed into realistic interior settings.

Any AI-generated campaign videos you have produced.

Your preferred pricing structure for ongoing content production. (We prefer a no cure no pay method, a price per picture or product)

We are looking for someone who can combine creativity, technical AI expertise and commercial understanding to help us take Dimehouse's visual presentation to the next level.

originalDescription.text:
We sell iron stair balusters, newel posts and railing parts online. One of our lifestyle images is performing very well on Pinterest, and we want more images like it for Pinterest, Meta and Google ads.

We are looking for someone who combines AI image generation with real Photoshop compositing (or 3D rendering). Pure AI output is not good enough for us: AI tends to distort thin repeating parts like balusters. The product must stay accurate, and the room around it can be AI-generated.

PAID TEST (this job)
Create 3 lifestyle image variations based on a reference image we provide.
- We supply: the reference image, product photos, real installation photos and a short list of product rules.
- You create: 3 new photorealistic staircase scenes showing our balusters, each with a different look (for example different wall colour, flooring, decor, lighting or season).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. 3 final images, 1000 x 1500 px (2:3 vertical) or larger, JPG or PNG.
2. Baluster shape, pattern, finish and spacing match our product photos. No warped, merged, missing or extra bars.
3. Construction is realistic: balusters meet the handrail and the treads or floor correctly, and the wood handrail sits on top of the metal newel post.
4. Lighting, shadows and perspective of the product match the scene. The image should pass as a real photo at full size.
5. No AI artifacts: no distorted steps, garbled textures or impossible geometry.
6. Layered source file (PSD or equivalent) delivered for each image so future variations are quick.
7. One round of revisions included.
8. We receive full commercial usage rights, including paid advertising.

ONGOING WORK
If the test goes well, we want regular monthly batches of new variations across our product range.

TO APPLY
Please show 2-3 examples where you placed a real product into an AI-generated or composited scene, ideally interiors, furniture, architecture or home improvement.

originalDescription.text:
# Professional High-End Photo Retoucher & Instagram Grid Designer

I’m looking for an experienced professional photo retoucher and color grading specialist to transform my personal photographs into premium, cinematic, high-end editorial images for my Instagram profile.

**The goal is to achieve the quality of a luxury professional photoshoot while preserving 100% of the original photographs.**

### What I Need

- **Ultra-High-Resolution Enhancement:** Professional image upscaling, improved sharpness, clarity, and fine details without generating artificial textures.
- **High-End Photo Retouching:** Natural, professional retouching while preserving authentic skin texture, facial features, body proportions, clothing, and all original details.
- **Cinematic Color Grading:** Beautiful cinematic tones, sophisticated lighting, balanced contrast, realistic colors, and a premium editorial photography aesthetic.
- **Professional Light Correction:** Improve exposure, shadows, highlights, and overall visual depth.
- **Instagram Grid Design:** Create a visually consistent, premium-looking Instagram profile with harmonious colors, carefully selected photographs, and an attractive overall grid.
- **Photo Selection & Creative Direction:** Help select the strongest photographs, recommend their posting order, and develop a cohesive visual style.

### Strict Requirements — No AI Image Generation

**I do not want AI-generated or AI-reconstructed photographs.**

- Do not regenerate, reconstruct, or alter faces.
- Do not modify tattoos, vehicles, clothing, backgrounds, or original objects.
- Do not invent missing details or artificially reconstruct textures.
- Do not change my appearance, identity, facial expression, or body proportions.
- Avoid artificial skin smoothing, unrealistic sharpening, and visible AI artifacts.

Traditional professional photo editing techniques are preferred, including Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom, Camera Raw, and professional non-generative enhancement tools.

**The final images must look like authentic photographs taken and retouched by a world-class professional photographer — never AI-generated.**

### Final Deliverables

- Professionally retouched, high-resolution photographs.
- Instagram-ready images with optimized dimensions and quality.
- Consistent cinematic color grading across the photo collection.
- A proposed Instagram grid layout and posting sequence.
- Full-resolution final files and editable source files.

### Who I'm Looking For

An experienced professional with a strong portfolio in high-end portrait retouching, lifestyle photography, automotive photography, cinematic color grading, and Instagram visual design.

Please share relevant before-and-after examples of your previous work.

**Quality, natural realism, attention to detail, and preservation of the original photographs are my highest priorities.**

originalDescription.text:
I’m Cristian, founder of NORDMOND. We’re looking for a production partner to create a premium, 40–45-second product video for our product:

Our product — NORDMOND: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0F3XQ3JPT

These two videos are our references for the production quality and creative direction we’re aiming for:

* HOTO reference: https://www.amazon.com/HOTO-Adjustable-Extendable-Waterproof-Replaceable/dp/B0FL1YZZ19
* Dyson reference: https://www.amazon.com/Dyson-V15-Detect-Cordless-Vacuum/dp/B0GXX8KQY7/

We’d be interested in a direction inspired by either reference, or a combination of the two, adapted to our product and brand. We’re looking for the same level of production quality, attention to detail, and overall polish as these examples. Please use them as the benchmark when preparing your proposal.

Our initial idea is to film primarily in a warm, modern apartment, combining lifestyle scenes with beautifully lit product close-ups and demonstrations. We’re also considering:

* One or two actors, depending on the script.
* A lifestyle scene featuring a pet.
* A brief scene involving a car.
* A high-quality 3D product shot or short CGI sequence, potentially integrated seamlessly with the live-action footage.

These are starting points, and we’re open to your creative recommendations. We’d like to develop the concept, script, and storyboard together so that each scene contributes to a clear and engaging story within the 40–45-second runtime.

Quality and professionalism are our main priorities across the entire production: art direction, location, casting, lighting, cinematography, editing, color grading, and sound design.

Could you please share:

* Relevant examples from your portfolio demonstrating a comparable level of quality.
* Your estimated budget and what it includes, from concept development through final delivery.
* Your expected production timeline and included revision rounds.
* Separate estimates for optional elements such as CGI, a second actor, and the pet/car scenes.

We’d love to hear how you would approach this project and bring the creative direction to life.

Best regards,
Cristian
NORDMOND

originalDescription.text:
Hi there , 

Life's beautifully elegant - let's animate it! :-)

We're building a French-market brand studio for high-end medical aesthetics clinics, dental cosmetics, and MediSpa — think French luxury perfume and fashion-house commercials as a quality bar, not Instagram filler. We already have the strategy, the compliance framework, and the three concepts fully written. What we need is a director's eye to turn them into three short, beautiful proof-of-concept films that we'll put on our own site to win our first client.

If you've ever watched a French perfume or fashion-house commercial and thought "I could build that shot," this is your job. Note: the specific visual grammar (palette, pacing, whether it's opulent-and-still or energetic-and-social) changes per concept and per target client — a MediSpa film aimed at a younger, more active clientele calls for a different register than a couture-editorial piece for an older luxury clientele. We're not hiring for one fixed look. We're hiring for the taste and range to find the right look per brief.

What "good" and "not good" look like:

The quality bar: think French perfume and fashion-house commercials — cinematic light, deliberate pacing, one coherent color story from first frame to last. We're not sending a specific look to replicate here, because the right palette and pacing will vary by concept and by target client. What has to be constant is the production values and coherence of that world.

One reference worth studying — for content, not craft: crpce.com, one of the most successful aesthetic-medicine clinics in Paris, and their homepage video is genuinely haute-couture-level execution — lighting, styling, and production value are all excellent. But it mixes editorial fashion footage with real treatment-room and equipment-in-use shots featuring a visible patient. In our regulatory market, that specific combination (a person coded as a patient, shown alongside equipment actively in use) is a legal exposure regardless of how beautifully it's shot (more on that below). So: study their execution quality, not their content structure. We need your craft at that level, applied to content that stays inside what we're legally allowed to show.

The three films

We've already named, defined, and legally scoped three distinct visual concepts. Your job is to direct each one — shot list, pacing, palette — not to invent the strategy from scratch.

1. Brand Lifestyle She steps out of the clinic's reception — a warm goodbye from the staff, the name on the wall behind her, nothing else of the space in view — and walks straight into her actual life: a café table, a morning run, the city going by. The clinic is a place she visits, not a place she's defined by. Depending on who we're building this for, that "real life" can read as unhurried and elegant for a mature luxury clientele, or active and social for a younger, MediSpa-style audience — same structure, different energy.

2. Fashion Show (Défilé Haute Couture) This one announces itself as a shoot, not a visit: full styling, hair and makeup treated as high fashion, the unmistakable energy of a photographer's set — whether that reads through visible production gear in frame or through styling so heightened it can only be read as performance. It can be staged in or around the clinic's own space, but she's never coded as a patient there; she's coded as talent, on location, being photographed.

3. Clinical Showcase (Plateau Technique) No one is in the room. This is the equipment and the space itself, shot the way a watchmaker or a car brand shoots a hero object — macro detail, considered light, a sense of precision and quiet confidence. A practitioner's voice may guide us through what we're looking at, but the chair stays empty throughout.

For this first proof-of-concept round, we'll brief you on the specific target/tone per film — you don't need to guess. Each film: 30–60 seconds, delivered in 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1.

Why the compliance detail matters (read this before you bid)

This isn't creative-freedom theater — there's a real legal framework behind why these three concepts look the way they do (French medical advertising law is strict about what can and can't be shown). We'll hand you a short, clear brief per concept with the non-negotiables spelled out. You won't need to become a lawyer. You will need to actually follow the brief instead of improvising around it — one wrong shot (a treatment being performed on camera, for instance) isn't a style note, it's a legal problem for our client. If "creative direction within firm constraints" sounds like a cage rather than a canvas, this isn't your project.

What you'll have to work with
Full access to our Higgsfield team account (video, image, sound — 6,000 credits/month)
Storyflow.so for storyboarding, if useful to you
Our live site in progress, dondedieu.webflow.io, for context on brand tone
Three fully written creative briefs — you're not starting from a blank page
What we need from you
A portfolio that shows cinematic sensibility — command of light, color, and pacing — in whatever register you've worked in. We're not gatekeeping on niche: if your reel is gaming, product, or tech and it still has the eye for mood and restraint we're describing, tell us why in your application. What we're actually screening for is range and taste — the ability to find the right look for a given brief, not reproduce one fixed aesthetic.
Proof you can hold one consistent look across an entire cut — light, grain, pacing, color — not just three gorgeous unrelated frames. If you have a full sequence (not just the highlight reel) from a past project, send it.
Real hands-on fluency with Higgsfield (or something directly comparable — Kling, Runway, Luma) — you'll be driving our account, not learning a new tool on our clock.
Comfort taking a written concept and legal constraints and turning them into your own shot list — we're not looking for an order-taker, we're looking for a director.
Ability to deliver clean 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 cuts, not just one ratio cropped badly into the others.
Nice to have, not required

Experience in medical aesthetics marketing. We'd rather hire your taste from fragrance, fashion, or luxury product work and point it at a new subject — most execution we've seen in this specific niche either matches the content-structure problem described above or falls well short of the CRPCE quality bar entirely.

The honest pitch on budget

$50/video is a concept-proof rate, not a production rate — we're upfront about that. This is us testing a market before we have a paying client, and we're asking you to bet a little of your time on where this goes. In return: if/when we land our first client off the strength of these films, whoever directed them gets a bonus per video and the right of first refusal on that client's full production — meaning this small, weird gig is the audition for becoming part of an ongoing production team, not a one-and-done task.

We can't promise the first client. We can promise that if it happens, you're the first call.

To apply

Send:

* Your reel — whatever best shows your eye for light, color, and pacing, regardless of niche
* One or two sentences on how your own work relates to the quality bar described above, and how you'd think differently about tone for, say, a mature luxury clientele vs. a younger, more active one
* Your day rate or availability for a fast 1–2 week turnaround

We read reels before cover letters. Show, don't tell.

One more thing: start your application's subject line with "Paris is chic!" — it's how we'll know you actually read this brief end to end, rather than mass-applying. Applications without it won't be considered.

Yay! :-)
Stef

### Hiring: AI Video Creative Editor — Meta Ads (Remote)

We are looking for a fast, creative, and technically skilled **AI Video Editor** to join our performance marketing team.

Our primary goal is to produce a high volume of video ad variations for Facebook and Instagram campaigns.

**What you'll do:**
- Take existing video creatives and produce multiple variations with minimal changes.
- Modify hooks, scenes, subtitles, overlays, transitions, and visual elements.
- Use AI tools to generate or modify footage when needed.
- Replicate the structure of reference videos while introducing meaningful creative differences.
- Work with news-style, interview-style, and social-media video formats.
- Deliver organized batches of ready-to-test creatives every working day.
- Develop reusable templates to accelerate production.

**Requirements:**
- Strong skills in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects.
- Experience with AI video generation and editing tools.
- Experience producing direct-response or performance marketing ads.
- Ability to work quickly without sacrificing quality.
- Understanding of Meta advertising formats.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow creative references.

**Expected output:**

Initially, 10–15 simple variations and 2–4 more advanced edits per day, depending on complexity.

**To apply:**

Please send your portfolio, tools you use, expected monthly compensation, and an example of how you would create five variations from one existing video.

A paid practical test will be required.

About us
We are a DTC oral care brand: gum care, enamel repair, breath care. We sell through Meta ads and organic Instagram reels. Almost all of our creative production already runs on Claude: research, scripts, AI video, posting queue and daily ad checks are built as Claude Projects and Skills. The founder currently runs all of it alone. We need one person to take over the daily operation of this system.

What you will do
- Run our Claude workflow every day: ad research, scripts, AI video production (Kling, Seedance, Omni, ElevenLabs), captions, posting queue
- Check Meta Ads Manager twice a day, apply the daily recommendations (pause, scale, launch new tests) and keep the change log
- Launch a new creative concept every 3 to 4 days with several hook variations, and move winners into scaling campaigns
- Write short daily and weekly reports: what worked, what didn't, what's next
- Improve our skills and prompts when you see a better way

Must have
- You use Claude (or similar) daily for real work, not just chat: Projects, long workflows, ideally Skills or MCP connectors
- At least 1 year of hands-on Meta Ads for ecommerce/DTC with your own spend, and you can explain your testing structure
- A good eye for short-form video: hooks, pacing, captions. You can tell why a reel holds attention
- Fluent English. Spanish is a plus (we test Spanish reels)
- Reliable, organized, and you speak up when something looks off

Nice to have
- Shopify, Omnisend, subscription funnels
- Direct response copywriting

How we work
- Remote, async, 25 to 40 hours a week, with at least 3 hours of overlap with Central European Time (CET)
- Paid test task first (fixed price), then a 2 to 3 week paid trial, then a long-term monthly contract with a performance bonus

To apply
Start your proposal with the word "MOONLIGHT" so we know you read this. Then answer briefly:
1. What is the most complex workflow you have built or run with Claude or another AI tool? What did it produce?
2. Describe one Meta ad account you managed: monthly spend, your testing structure, one winner and why it won.
3. Link 2 or 3 short-form videos or ads you made or directed.

The first chapter is the website. The colors and art direction are already defined, and the first pages are built. originalDescription.text:
# Performance Creative Team for DTC Brand — High-Volume Meta Ads (AI Video + Static)

## ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Southern Fry Kings is a growing DTC food brand specializing in New Orleans-inspired Creole fry batters for fried chicken and seafood.

We are looking for a **performance creative team** to significantly increase the volume and quality of our Meta advertising creative.

This is NOT simply a video-editing or AI-generation position.

We are looking for a team that understands:

- Meta/Facebook direct-response advertising
- DTC/e-commerce creative strategy
- Creative testing and iteration
- Hooks and consumer psychology
- AI video generation
- AI UGC
- Static ad design
- Analyzing winning ads and developing new concepts from them

Our goal is to build a long-term relationship with a team capable of producing approximately **20–30 Meta ad creatives per week.**

Before committing to an ongoing engagement, we are starting with a **$500 paid trial.**

---

# PAID TRIAL — $500

The initial project is for:

## 10 Finished Meta Ad Creatives

The 10 deliverables should include a strategic combination of:

- AI-generated video ads
- AI UGC/native-style ads
- Food-focused video ads
- Static ads
- New hooks
- Variations of proven concepts
- New concepts based on insights from existing winners

We are intentionally NOT prescribing an exact video/static split.

After reviewing our existing creatives and performance, we want **you to recommend how the 10 deliverables should be allocated.**

We will provide:

- Brand information
- Product photography
- Logos and brand assets
- Existing advertisements
- Winning creatives
- Relevant performance information
- Existing messaging and advertising angles

---

# THIS IS NOT 10 COMPLETELY DIFFERENT PRODUCTIONS

We believe in intelligent creative iteration.

We are not expecting every deliverable to be an entirely new concept produced from scratch.

For example, one strong concept could generate:

- Original video
- New opening/hook
- Alternate visual hook
- Shorter cut
- Different voiceover
- Different CTA

Those can represent multiple legitimate creative tests.

However, we also do NOT want 10 creatives where the only difference is one sentence of text.

There should be a meaningful testing hypothesis behind each variation.

---

# STEP 1 — ANALYZE WHAT IS ALREADY WORKING

Before producing all 10 creatives, review the winning advertisements we provide.

Tell us:

1. Why you believe the creative is working.
2. What the primary hook is.
3. What consumer insight or pain point it taps into.
4. Which elements you would preserve.
5. Which elements you would test or change.
6. What additional creative directions can be developed from the winner.

We want to approve the strategic direction before full production begins.

---

# STEP 2 — DEVELOP THE TESTING PLAN

Based on your analysis, propose the 10 creatives you would produce.

For each creative, briefly identify:

**Concept → Hook → Format → What We're Testing**

We specifically want to see whether you can **iterate on a winner without simply cloning it.**

For example, suppose an advertisement about the high cost of buying fried chicken is performing well.

We do NOT want:

"I stopped buying fried chicken."

"I don't buy fried chicken anymore."

"I'll never buy fried chicken again."

Those are essentially the same ad.

Instead, the same consumer insight could become:

**Concept 1:** Someone sees a $70 food-delivery total and closes the app.

**Concept 2:** Family dinner showing what the same amount of money produces at home.

**Concept 3:** Disappointing takeout order compared with homemade fried chicken.

**Concept 4:** "Things I refuse to pay for anymore..."

**Concept 5:** Receipt-style static comparing takeout with cooking at home.

Same underlying insight.

Different executions.

That's the type of thinking we're looking for.

---

# STEP 3 — PRODUCE THE CREATIVE

Once the concepts are approved, produce the 10 finished Meta-ready assets.

We want advertising that feels:

- Native to social media
- Food-first
- Direct response
- Immediately attention-grabbing
- Realistic
- Highly appetizing
- Professional without looking like a traditional TV commercial

The first **1–3 seconds** of video creative are especially important.

---

# ABOUT SOUTHERN FRY KINGS

Southern Fry Kings makes premium Creole fry batters designed to make highly seasoned, crispy fried chicken and seafood easier to prepare at home.

One of the major product benefits is **simplicity**.

Customers should not need a cabinet full of seasonings or a complicated flour mixture to make great fried food.

Our strongest advertising generally makes the:

## FOOD THE HERO.

Think:

- Crispy chicken close-ups
- Audible crunch
- Steam
- Juicy chicken
- Golden breading
- Fryer reveals
- Chicken being pulled apart
- Large platters
- Fried seafood
- Family gatherings
- Sunday dinner
- Game day
- Cookouts
- People reaching for another piece

The viewer should almost be able to **hear the crunch through the screen.**

---

# PROVEN / PROMISING CREATIVE TERRITORIES

Some messaging territories that have worked or that we are actively exploring include:

### "I stopped buying fried chicken."

Homemade fried chicken replaces expensive or disappointing takeout.

### "$68 for fried chicken? I'm done."

Price frustration creates the problem. SFK becomes the solution.

### "When 40 people are showing up..."

Making great food for parties, holidays, cookouts and large family gatherings.

### "Everybody thought I bought this."

The emotional payoff of making restaurant-quality food yourself.

### "One Bag. No Extra Seasoning."

Simplicity.

These are **consumer insights and creative territories—not scripts we want copied repeatedly.**

We want you to find additional ways to express these ideas and uncover new angles we haven't considered.

---

# AI IS ENCOURAGED

We are comfortable with extensive use of AI.

Your workflow may include tools such as:

- Higgsfield
- Veo
- Kling
- Midjourney
- Flux
- ElevenLabs
- Photoshop
- Premiere
- CapCut
- Other AI or editing tools

We care more about the **final creative** than which platform was used to create it.

However:

## AI SHOULD NOT LOOK LIKE BAD AI.

Avoid:

- Strange hands
- Morphing food
- Impossible utensils
- Fake-looking chicken
- Unnatural movement
- Overly cinematic AI scenes that don't feel native to social media
- Misspelled packaging
- Altered logos
- Invented product packaging

Actual Southern Fry Kings product photography should be composited into AI-generated scenes when necessary to maintain product accuracy.

---

# WHAT WE ARE EVALUATING

This trial is testing six things:

### Creative Strategy
Can you understand WHY an advertisement is working?

### Concept Development
Can you turn one insight into multiple meaningful tests?

### Hooks
Can you earn attention immediately?

### Execution
Can you make excellent-looking ads?

### Direct-Response Thinking
Does the creative make someone want to purchase the product?

### Efficiency
Can you produce quality creative at the volume required for continuous Meta testing?

---

# LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY

If the trial is successful, we are interested in establishing an ongoing relationship.

Our target production volume is approximately:

## 20–30 finished creative deliverables per week.

The weekly mix may include:

- New video concepts
- Winning-ad iterations
- New hooks
- AI UGC
- Food-focused videos
- Static concepts
- Static variations
- Offer creative
- New-angle testing

The exact mix should evolve based on performance.

We operate multiple DTC brands, so there is also an opportunity for the relationship to expand beyond Southern Fry Kings.

For an ongoing engagement, we would prefer a **fixed weekly or monthly creative-production arrangement rather than hourly billing.**

---

# HOW TO APPLY

**Please do not send us a generic proposal.**

Start your application with the word:

## CRUNCH

Then answer the following:

### 1. Show us 3–5 direct-response ads you've personally created.

Preference will be given to DTC/e-commerce Meta ads.

Tell us what **you or your team specifically did** for each project.

### 2. Show us examples of AI-generated advertisements you've produced for paid social.

We care about finished ads—not AI demo reels.

### 3. What AI and editing tools are currently part of your workflow?

### 4. Who will actually work on our account?

Are you an individual, small team or agency?

Who handles:

- Creative strategy
- Hooks/copy
- AI generation
- Video editing
- Static design

### 5. If we give you ONE winning Meta advertisement, how would you turn that winner into 10 additional creative tests without simply making 10 copies?

Keep your answer concise, but be specific.

### 6. Can your team consistently support 20–30 finished creative deliverables per week?

### 7. What would your typical turnaround time be for 20–30 creatives?

### 8. What would you charge for an ongoing engagement producing approximately 20–30 creatives per week?

Please provide your preferred:

- Weekly rate, and/or
- Monthly rate

Also explain what would be included in that price.

---

# IMPORTANT

The budget for this initial paid trial is:

## $500 for 10 finished creative deliverables.

Please apply only if you are comfortable completing the trial within this budget.

The trial is designed to determine whether we are a good fit for a much larger, ongoing creative relationship.

We are not looking for someone who simply waits for us to provide a prompt and then generates a video.

We want a team that can eventually look at our performance data and say:

**"Here's what worked. Here's what we learned. Here's what we're testing next."**

Our goal is to build a repeatable performance creative system:

## Find winners. Expand winners. Kill losers. Repeat.

originalDescription.text:
We are a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand that sells our own products (home cafe gadgets, comfort and wellness products) mainly through Meta ads. We are climbing toward $500K a month in revenue, and creative is what gets us there. We are hiring a full-time Creative Strategist to lead our ad creative: write the briefs, run our team of video and image editors, and get the finished ads live.

THE ROLE
You will own our creative pipeline from idea to live ad. You will write the briefs our editors work from, review their work, give clear revision notes, and get the final ads uploaded and tracked. You will lead a remote team of 2 to 6 video and image editors (most of our videos are made with AI tools like Veo, Kling and Seedance).

WHAT YOU WILL DO EACH WEEK
- Write 5 to 10 short, clear creative briefs a week. Each brief has the customer avatar, problem, unique mechanism and angle, plus 5 videos in 5 different proven ad formats, each with its script and an example video. Our editors own the visuals, so briefs stay focused on the idea and the words.
- Find proven formats and examples to model (long-running ads, our own winners).
- Send briefs every Sunday night (US Eastern time), review the first versions on Thursday, send clear revision notes the same day, and approve the finals on Friday.
- Upload the finished ads and keep every ad tagged and tracked in our in-house system (we will train you on it).
- Read the results (spend, ROAS, cost per brief) and turn what is winning into the next round of briefs.
- Keep the editors on time and on brief, and be their go-to person for questions.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
- You have written creative briefs or ad scripts for paid social (Meta or TikTok) for DTC brands, and you can show examples.
- You understand why ads work: hooks, formats, avatars, angles and offers.
- You are organized, reply fast, and give direct, friendly feedback.
- You have managed freelancers or a small creative team.
- Hands-on experience with AI video or image tools is a big plus.
- Clear written English.
- Available for calls and meetings during US Eastern business hours.

PAY
- $50 per brief, guaranteed (5 to 10 briefs a week to start).
- PLUS 1% of the ad spend on the ads made from your briefs. This is where the real earning power is: great briefs make great ads, great ads get more spend, and your bonus grows with it. We are scaling toward $500K a month in revenue, and it is very reachable from where we are today.
- Full-time and long-term.

HOW WE HIRE (FAST)
We are growing quickly and want this seat filled soon, so our process moves fast:
1. Apply with a short note about your experience and 1 or 2 examples of ad briefs or scripts you have written.
2. A paid test: 2 briefs at $50 each ($100 total). One uses a product, avatar and angle we give you. The other is fully your own idea for a second product.
3. A short call.
4. Onboarding: a few days learning our process and tools, then you run the weekly cycle.

Please start your proposal with the word BRIEF so we know you read this post. We look forward to meeting you.

originalDescription.text:
AI Food Photography & Creative Director – Photorealistic Commercial Images, Video Ads & UGC

Long-Term Opportunity | 5 Established Singapore Food Brands

We are looking for an exceptionally talented AI visual artist, commercial food photography specialist and creative director to produce stunning, photorealistic food advertising content for five established Singapore food brands.

Our brands:
1. Ding Bakery – Our highest priority
2. 8 Crabs
3. Turkey Delivery
4. Tacos
5. Jeffrey's Smokehouse

WHAT WE WANT

We want food photography and advertising creatives that look as though they were produced by a world-class commercial photography studio or advertising agency.

The finished work must be exceptionally realistic, visually striking, appetising and original.

We do not want generic AI-generated food images, obvious AI aesthetics, unnatural textures or repetitive templates.

Our standard is simple: A customer should not be able to distinguish the final image from professionally photographed commercial food advertising.

THE MOST IMPORTANT CHALLENGE: PRODUCT ACCURACY

Our food products are unique to our brands.

We have an extensive library of professionally photographed, high-resolution studio images of our actual food products, packaging and gift sets.

You will receive these original photographs.

Your responsibility is to use them to develop entirely new visual concepts, scenes, compositions and advertising campaigns while maintaining the exact appearance of our real products.

For example:

- Take an existing studio photograph of our pineapple tarts and create a completely new premium Chinese New Year campaign.
- Transform our actual seafood dishes into dramatic restaurant-quality advertising imagery.
- Place our real products into beautiful, realistic lifestyle environments.
- Create premium festive dining scenes featuring our actual food.
- Develop advertising visuals with creative compositions, cinematic lighting, believable shadows and professional food styling.

Product accuracy is non-negotiable.

Do not change the appearance, shape, ingredients, proportions, colours, textures or packaging of our actual products.

You must know how to combine AI generation with professional Photoshop compositing, retouching, lighting and colour grading to achieve this.

DELIVERABLES

1. PREMIUM COMMERCIAL FOOD PHOTOGRAPHY – ESSENTIAL

Create exceptional, photorealistic images for:

- Website banners and homepage hero images
- Product and category pages
- Meta, Google and other digital advertising
- Promotional campaigns
- Social media
- Festive and seasonal campaigns

2. STATIC ADVERTISING CREATIVES – ESSENTIAL

Develop original, scroll-stopping advertising concepts designed to generate clicks, interest and purchases.

We want creative thinking, not simply beautiful pictures.

You should understand visual hierarchy, advertising hooks, product positioning, composition and conversion-focused design.

We want fresh concepts that stand out from competitors, not variations of the same generic layouts.

3. AI VIDEO ADVERTISING – STRONGLY PREFERRED

We are especially interested in someone who can turn our product photography and newly created visuals into realistic, compelling videos.

Examples include cinematic product reveals, food close-ups, realistic camera movement, lifestyle scenes and short-form video ads.

Experience with professional AI video generation and post-production is highly desirable.

We want videos that feel naturally filmed, not obviously AI-generated.

4. REALISTIC UGC-STYLE CONTENT – BONUS

We would also love to explore realistic, natural-looking UGC-style videos, including people interacting with our actual products.

These must look believable, with natural movements, realistic hands, accurate food interactions, convincing lighting and appropriate Singaporean cultural context.

We are open to hybrid production methods using real footage, AI and professional editing.

Any synthetic actors or AI-assisted endorsements must be used responsibly and must not misrepresent genuine customer experiences.

WHAT MAKES YOU THE RIGHT CANDIDATE

You should have:

- An outstanding portfolio of photorealistic commercial product or food imagery
- Advanced Photoshop compositing and photo manipulation skills
- Strong commercial photography knowledge, including lighting, shadows, perspective and food styling
- Experience preserving exact product identity using reference photographs
- Excellent creative direction and advertising design instincts
- Experience with professional AI image-generation workflows
- Ideally, experience with AI video generation, animation and short-form advertising
- Meticulous attention to detail and the ability to eliminate obvious AI artefacts
- The ability to independently propose original concepts rather than waiting for detailed creative instructions
- A strong understanding of what makes an advertisement visually compelling and commercially effective

We are interested in results, not which particular AI software you use.

WHAT WE DO NOT WANT

- Generic AI images produced from simple prompts
- Food that looks different from our actual products
- Fake-looking textures, unrealistic ingredients or plastic-looking food
- Distorted packaging, inaccurate logos or invented product details
- Obvious AI-generated people, hands or movements
- Recycled templates or repetitive compositions
- Designers who depend entirely on AI without professional finishing
- Beautiful images that have no clear advertising purpose
- Candidates who cannot demonstrate genuine product preservation and professional compositing skills

HOW WE WORK

We will provide high-resolution studio photography, product references, brand information and campaign objectives.

You will be expected to propose creative directions, develop original concepts, produce finished advertising assets and refine them based on our feedback.

Final work should be delivered in appropriate high-resolution formats for website and advertising use, together with editable source files where applicable.

We require commercial usage rights for approved deliverables.

This is a long-term opportunity. We have multiple brands and ongoing advertising needs throughout the year.

Our immediate priority is Ding Bakery's upcoming Chinese New Year campaign, but successful candidates will have opportunities to work across all five brands.

HOW TO APPLY

Please answer all five questions:

1. Show us your three best examples of photorealistic commercial food or product advertising. Explain your involvement in creating each.

2. Show us a before-and-after example where you used an existing product photograph to create a completely new commercial image while preserving the original product.

3. Can you create photorealistic AI video advertisements? Please provide your best examples, including any realistic human or UGC-style content.

4. Explain your workflow for preserving the exact appearance of our food products and packaging while changing the background, lighting, composition and environment.

5. What would you charge for:
- One premium commercial food image
- Five unique advertising images
- One 10–15-second AI-assisted video advertisement
- An ongoing monthly creative arrangement

Please start your proposal with the words "REAL FOOD, REAL DETAILS" so we know you have read the requirements carefully.

PAID CREATIVE TEST

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid creative test using our actual high-resolution product photography.

We will assess:

- Realism and product accuracy
- Originality and creative direction
- Professional commercial photography quality
- Advertising effectiveness
- Attention to detail
- Ability to follow feedback

The best candidate will have the opportunity to work with us on ongoing campaigns across all five brands.

We are willing to pay for exceptional quality, but we expect exceptional results.

We are looking for a long-term creative partner who can consistently produce work that looks like it belongs in a premium international food advertising campaign.

# Premium Pet Supplement Packaging Designer – Lou's Good Days

## About Our Brand

Lou's Good Days is a new premium dog wellness brand focused on helping dogs live healthier, happier lives.

We are developing a line of dog wellness supplements, including dental health, joint support, gut health, and other products.

We are looking for a talented packaging designer who has experience creating premium supplement packaging and understands the pet wellness industry.

## What We Need

We want to establish a consistent, professional visual identity across our product line.

The project includes:

1. **Supplement Bottle Label Design**
   - Design attractive, premium labels for dog supplement bottles.
   - Create a consistent look across multiple product categories.
   - Ensure labels are clean, modern, professional, and easy to read.
   - Prepare artwork according to our manufacturer's exact label dimensions and printing requirements.

2. **3D Product Mockups**
   - Create realistic bottle mockups showing the finished label.
   - Create professional product images suitable for our Shopify store.
   - Show how the products will look together as a brand.

3. **Brand Consistency**
   - Establish consistent typography, colors, layouts, and visual elements.
   - Create a premium look that communicates trust, quality, and wellness.
   - Make sure the designs work across our future product line.

4. **Final Deliverables**
   - Editable Adobe Illustrator files.
   - Print-ready label files.
   - High-resolution PNG/JPG product mockups.
   - Source files and fonts or font information.
   - Commercial usage rights for the completed work.

## Who We Are Looking For

You must have experience with:
- Pet supplement or human supplement packaging.
- Bottle label design.
- Consumer product branding.
- Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.
- 3D product mockups and rendering.

Experience with Shopify and direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands is a plus.

## To Apply

Please include:

1. Examples of supplement bottle labels you have designed.
2. Examples of pet wellness or consumer product packaging.
3. Examples of realistic 3D product mockups.
4. Your estimated project cost and timeline.
5. A brief explanation of how you would approach developing our product packaging.

**Important:** We are looking for someone who has actually designed supplement packaging before. Please share relevant portfolio examples rather than general graphic design work.

We want to build a long-term brand and would love to find the right creative partner.

We need someone who can shoot both authentic, UGC-style footage and polished, professional product photography for our website and ads.

Ideally, you'll be comfortable appearing on camera yourself, but also have the ability to work with or source other bearded creators/models when needed.

**Important:** There's no need to record talking-head videos or speak directly to the camera. Since we're an American brand, we're primarily looking for visual content, including product demonstrations, lifestyle footage, and creative B-roll. Any voiceovers or spoken content will be handled separately.

- **UGC-Style B-Roll:** Shooting natural, engaging footage of our products being used. Think bathroom routines, beard grooming, product close-ups, unboxings, lifestyle shots, etc.

We need a production designer to place approximately 700 images into our 1200 × 1200 px Photoshop template, centered using the grids built into the file. This is precise, repeatable production work, not creative retouching.

Scope of work
• Place each of the ~700 source images into the supplied 1200 × 1200 PSD template.
• Center each item within the image/image horizontally and vertically, aligned to the template's guides/grid.
• Scale each item proportionally to fit the grid's safe area (no stretching or distortion).
• Export one finished file per source image.

What is NOT needed
• No changes to lighting, exposure, color, contrast, or white balance. Images must look exactly as supplied.
• No retouching, cleanup, background removal, or cropping of the subject unless we approve it in writing.
• No changes to the template layers, grids, or background.
• Do not use AI to automate image production.

Specifications
• Canvas: 1200 × 1200 px (from the supplied PSD; do not resize the canvas).
• Alignment: centered on the template grid; consistent margins across all files.
• Scaling: proportional only (aspect ratio locked)
• Color: sRGB. If a source is already sRGB, keep it as is; if not, convert to sRGB so it displays correctly in browsers (no other color or tone adjustments).
• Output format: WebP,. Target file size: about 600KB. 
• File naming: keep the original source file name (e.g., source SKU1234.jpg → output SKU1234.jpg).
• Folder structure: mirror the source folder structure in the output folder.

Files we will provide
• The 1200 × 1200 PSD template with grids/guides.
• ~700 source images, delivered via a shared cloud folder.
• 2–3 approved reference examples showing correct placement.

Process and approval
1. Test batch: complete 10–20 images first and send them for review.
2. We approve the test batch or send corrections.
4. Final delivery to the shared output folder, with a count that matches the input count.
5. Spot check by us; designer fixes any flagged files at no extra cost.
Quality checklist (every file)
• Image is centered on the grid and fully inside the safe area.
• No distortion, no stray edges
• Lighting and color identical to the source.
• Correct file name, WebP format, and dimensions (1200 × 1200); file size around 600KB with no visible pixelation, banding, blockiness, or halos around edges when viewed at 100%.

Timeline
• Test batch due: 1 day
• Full delivery due: 2-3 days

originalDescription.text:
Job Description

We are looking for a talented and creative AI filmmaker, VFX artist or motion graphics specialist to produce a short, highly realistic cinematic sequence for our feature documentary, North of Impossible.

The film follows an extraordinary wind-powered expedition across Iceland's Vatnajökull Glacier.

We need to recreate a critical communication moment between the pilot of a high-speed snowsailer and the film's director, Sven, using a combination of existing cockpit footage, genuine voice recordings, AI filmmaking and professional visual effects.

This sequence will appear in the finished feature film and must be suitable for theatrical screening.

What We Need

Scene 1: Cockpit Communication

Use our existing cockpit POV footage as the visual foundation.

Incorporate the pilot's genuine voice recording, which we will supply.

As the pilot speaks, visually recreate the words appearing through the Wispr Flow voice-to-text application.

Show the completed message being transmitted to Sven.

The interface must feel authentic, realistic and cinematic.

Scene 2: Sven's Response

Show Sven receiving the message through a suitable cinematic visual treatment.

Incorporate Sven's genuine voice recording, which we will supply.

Sven responds with countdown numbers.

Synchronise the countdown visually and audibly.

Build tension and anticipation through the editing and visual presentation.

Scene 3: Final Cinematic Sequence

The entire exchange must feel like one seamless, believable communication sequence.

We want a sophisticated documentary aesthetic, not exaggerated science-fiction graphics.

The sequence must work as a standalone piece that our editor can insert directly into the film.

Materials Provided

We will supply:

Original cockpit POV footage.

Genuine pilot voice recordings.

Genuine Sven voice recordings.

Exact dialogue and countdown numbers.

Reference footage and visual direction.

Wispr Flow branding and interface references.

You will not need to generate voices or write dialogue.

Technical Deliverables

One completed 15–30-second cinematic sequence.

4K resolution preferred, 16:9 format.

Professional compositing and motion graphics.

Accurate on-screen text and audio synchronisation.

Colour matching to existing footage.

Final high-quality video master suitable for theatrical editing.

Editable project files or separate visual-effect elements.

Two rounds of revisions.

Required Skills

We are particularly interested in freelancers experienced with:

AI-assisted filmmaking.

Adobe After Effects or DaVinci Resolve Fusion.

Runway, Kling, ComfyUI or similar AI tools.

Realistic motion graphics and interface animation.

Live-action footage compositing.

Cinematic documentary storytelling.

We are open to your recommended creative and technical approach.

Budget and Timeline

Fixed budget: £250 GBP

Suggested milestones:

£50 – Initial 5-second visual proof of concept.

£125 – Completed sequence for review.

£75 – Final revisions and delivery of master and project files.

Target completion is within 3–5 working days from receiving the materials.

How to Apply

Please answer the following questions:

Have you created AI-assisted cinematic sequences using existing live-action footage? Please provide examples.

How would you approach creating the Wispr Flow message animation and Sven's countdown response?

Which AI, editing and VFX tools would you use?

Can you deliver within 3–5 working days?

Can you provide editable project files and two revision rounds within the £250 budget?

Important: We are not looking for generic AI-generated videos or simple animated captions. We need a creative professional who understands cinematic storytelling, visual realism and seamless integration with genuine documentary footage.

There may be opportunities for further work on this feature documentary and its international promotional campaign.

We look forward to seeing your portfolio and creative approach.

You’ll join an existing creative team of five video editors and two creative strategists, working on campaigns that combine direct-response marketing with a premium fashion aesthetic.

We’re looking for someone who can own the full production process: generating realistic AI assets, animating product imagery, editing footage, and delivering polished ads ready to launch.

**What you’ll do**

- Turn scripts, storyboards, and creative briefs into finished video ads for Meta and other paid social channels.

- Animate still images with natural movement, controlled camera work, and consistent product details.

Strong practical experience with **Higgsfield** and its image and video generation ecosystem is essential. Relevant models and tools include:

- **Finishing:** upscaling, retouching, artifact removal, color correction, and footage cleanup.

You should understand how to choose the right model for each shot, work effectively with reference images, and improve results through precise prompting and iteration. We value deep practical expertise and the ability to learn new models as they become available.

You must also be proficient in a professional editing workflow using tools such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or an equivalent setup.

**The quality we expect**

Our ads need to sell while maintaining a premium brand identity.

For a leather handbag brand, product accuracy is critical. The bag’s shape, proportions, handles, stitching, hardware, leather texture, and color must remain faithful to the reference product throughout the video.

You should be able to spot and fix unnatural hands, distorted products, inconsistent faces, flickering, unrealistic movement, and other visible AI artifacts.

We’re looking for elegant styling, natural colors, believable lighting, strong composition, and thoughtful pacing.

**Who we’re looking for**

- A strong portfolio of AI-generated videos and edited ecommerce ads.
- Proven experience creating content for DTC brands, ideally in fashion, accessories, beauty, or luxury.
- Strong image-to-video and reference-based generation skills.
- An understanding of direct-response editing: hooks, retention, benefits, objections, social proof, and CTAs.
- Excellent visual judgment and attention to detail.
- Good English communication skills and the ability to follow English scripts and briefs.
- Reliable delivery, organized workflows, and a proactive approach to creative problem-solving.
- The ability to manage generation credits efficiently while maintaining quality.

Experience creating ads that have performed successfully at meaningful spend levels is a strong advantage.

**Workload and collaboration**

Our current benchmark is approximately **10 completed videos per editor per week**, combining short-form and long-form content. The exact mix and complexity will be planned with the creative strategists.

This is a remote, long-term freelance opportunity. We’re looking for consistent availability and someone who wants to grow with the team.

**Compensation: monthly retainer + performance bonuses**

We offer a fixed monthly retainer based on experience, plus **2.5% of the ad spend allocated to each creative you generate and edit that achieves a ROAS of at least 2.6**.

For example, if one of your eligible creatives receives $40,000 in ad spend while meeting the agreed ROAS requirement, your performance bonus for that creative would be **$1,000**, on top of your fixed retainer.

The reporting period, attribution method, and eligibility rules will be agreed before we start.

As your successful creatives receive more advertising spend, your earning potential grows.

**To apply, please include**

1. Three to five relevant video examples, ideally including both AI fashion/product content and direct-response ads.
2. A clear explanation of what you personally generated and edited in each example.
3. The AI models and editing tools you use regularly.
4. A brief explanation of your workflow for turning a handbag reference photo into a realistic finished video ad.
5. Any available performance results from your previous work.
6. Your weekly availability and expected monthly retainer.

We’re looking for an editor who combines technical AI skills, strong taste, and an understanding of what makes an ad convert.

originalDescription.text:
# Cinematic Video Producer / Creative Director Needed for EPIC 60-Second Medical Brand Commercial

**Project Type:** Fixed-Price  
**Experience Level:** Expert  
**Project:** One flagship 60-second commercial

## Project Overview

We are seeking an exceptionally talented **cinematic video producer, commercial editor, and creative storyteller** to create a visually stunning, high-impact 60-second brand commercial for **InvisiFoot**, an innovative approach to bunion and hammertoe surgery offered at Emerald Coast Foot and Ankle Center in Pensacola, Florida.

**We do NOT want a typical medical advertisement, basic promotional video, or slideshow.**

We want something extraordinary.

Think **Nike, Apple, or a major national healthcare technology brand**: dramatic, sophisticated, emotionally compelling, visually captivating, and unforgettable.

Our goal is to create a flagship commercial that establishes InvisiFoot as an innovative surgical brand while inspiring prospective patients to schedule consultations.

We are looking for someone with the creative vision and technical expertise to transform our existing footage and photographs into a truly exceptional commercial.

## The Creative Vision

The commercial should combine:

- Cinematic storytelling and dramatic pacing.
- Powerful, emotionally engaging music that builds throughout the video.
- Authentic patient testimonials.
- Striking before-and-after surgical photographs.
- Sophisticated motion graphics, typography, and visual effects.
- Professional voiceover narration.
- Seamless transitions and exceptional sound design.
- A memorable brand reveal and powerful closing call to action.

We want viewers to stop scrolling within the first few seconds and feel compelled to watch the entire commercial.

**This should look and feel like a national brand campaign, not a local doctor's office advertisement.**

## Key Messages

The commercial will highlight three primary differentiators of the InvisiFoot surgical approach:

**1. Immediate Walking After Surgery**

Eligible patients can begin walking immediately after surgery in a protective surgical shoe. We have actual footage of a patient walking immediately following surgery that we want featured prominently.

**2. Tiny Openings Instead of Large Incisions**

InvisiFoot uses small puncture openings rather than the larger incisions associated with many traditional surgical techniques.

**3. Faster Recovery**

InvisiFoot is designed to facilitate earlier mobility and recovery. We want to communicate this benefit in a compelling but medically accurate manner.

These messages should be incorporated creatively, rather than simply presented as a list of features. All medical claims and comparisons will require our approval.

## Materials We Will Provide

We already have valuable content available, including:

- Actual patient video testimonials.
- Before-and-after surgical photographs.
- Real footage of a patient walking immediately after surgery.
- InvisiFoot branding and logos.
- Information about the surgical technique and its advantages.
- Additional clinical photographs and practice information as needed.

We need someone who can take these materials and transform them into a cohesive, cinematic brand experience.

## Scope of Work

The selected freelancer will be responsible for:

1. **Creative Direction:** Develop a compelling concept and narrative for the commercial.
2. **Storyboard:** Present a proposed visual sequence and creative approach before editing begins.
3. **Video Production and Editing:** Create the complete 60-second commercial using our supplied assets.
4. **Motion Graphics:** Incorporate sophisticated text animations, visual effects, and branded graphics.
5. **Audio Production:** Select appropriately licensed cinematic music, incorporate professional sound design, and arrange a professional voiceover.
6. **Color Grading:** Ensure a polished, consistent, premium visual aesthetic.
7. **Brand Integration:** Incorporate the InvisiFoot logo, practice information, and a strong call to action.
8. **Final Delivery:** Provide polished versions suitable for social media and website use.

Custom medical animations or 3D graphics would be a significant plus, but are not mandatory. Any anatomical illustrations must be medically accurate and approved before inclusion.

## Deliverables

- One fully produced 60-second flagship commercial.
- Horizontal 16:9 version for YouTube and website use.
- Vertical 9:16 version optimized for Facebook Reels, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.
- Professional audio mixing, music, and voiceover.
- Burned-in captions or subtitles suitable for social media.
- At least two rounds of revisions.
- Final high-resolution files and editable project files.
- Appropriate commercial-use licenses for all third-party assets.

The scope is for one flagship commercial, not multiple separate advertising campaigns.

## Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone with demonstrated experience in:

- High-end cinematic brand commercials.
- Luxury, healthcare, technology, or lifestyle advertising.
- Advanced video editing and motion graphics.
- Creative storytelling and emotional pacing.
- Professional sound design and cinematic music integration.
- Developing advertisements designed to capture attention and drive customer action.

Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Cinema 4D, or comparable professional production software is preferred.

**We care much more about your portfolio and creative ability than the number of projects you have completed.**

## Important Requirements

Because this is a healthcare advertisement, all patient footage must be handled confidentially and used only as authorized. The final commercial must accurately represent the surgical procedure and patient experiences. No fabricated testimonials, misleading clinical imagery, or unapproved medical claims may be included.

We will retain final approval over all clinical messaging and patient-related content.

## How to Apply

Please include the following in your proposal:

1. **Your best 2–3 examples of cinematic brand commercials you personally created.** We are particularly interested in sophisticated, emotionally powerful advertisements rather than basic social media edits.
2. A brief explanation of how you would approach this InvisiFoot commercial creatively.
3. Whether you can provide professional voiceover, cinematic music, advanced motion graphics, and sound design.
4. Your estimated cost and production timeline.
5. Whether you would personally complete the project or use additional team members.

**To demonstrate that you have read this posting, please begin your proposal with the words "InvisiFoot Cinematic."**

## Our Goal

We want to create the definitive InvisiFoot brand commercial.

Something powerful. Something memorable. Something that looks like it belongs on national television.

**We are not looking for an ordinary video editor. We are looking for a creative partner who can produce something exceptional.**

If you have the talent and vision to bring this concept to life, we would love to see your work.

I need a photorealistic, emotional brand film of about 75 to 90 seconds, made with AI video tools. The script is locked, and the production bible, visual bible, and shot-by-shot prompts are already written. I’m looking for a filmmaker with strong taste and storytelling ability, not just a prompt operator. The goal is to create a cinematic commercial that feels authentic, polished, and emotionally engaging.

The story
Three fictional teachers who post what they know online:

Nadia, 32, who teaches yoga as a daily practice, in Portland, US
Rae, 33, who teaches people to make homes and wardrobes last, in Sheffield, UK
Daan, 34, who teaches people to grow food on a small closed-loop plot, in Utrecht, the Netherlands

Each has one student who has watched everything and done nothing: Mia, Ellie and Sanne. The three stories meet in one shared moment across three phones, then resolve in three quiet endings where each teacher sees, by chance, that their student did it without them. A short text message closes the film.

The quality bar
- Netflix-grade realism: real skin texture, natural light, a 35mm documentary feel. It must never look “AI.”
- Consistent faces: each character looks like the same person in every shot.
- Real emotion without melodrama: small, honest expressions, nothing overacted.
- Creative camera work: movement that’s enjoyable to watch, not static or generic.
- Joyful, energetic music: think Tristan Barton, Tom Day or Jakob Ahlbom, not sad piano.

What I’ll provide
- 5,000 Higgsfield credits on my account, set aside for this project. You’re welcome to use other tools too (Kling, Veo, Runway, Midjourney or anything else that gets the best result). For Higgsfield work, use my credits. Any other tools are on your side, so please include those costs in your quote.
- The script, character and location references, visual rules (lenses, grade, banned elements) and full prompts for every shot. These are a reference, not a cage: if you see a better shot, angle, tool or idea, suggest it. I want your creative input.

What you’ll deliver
- The final film in 16:9, plus a 9:16 version for Reels
- Edit, colour grade, sound design and licensed music

- All project files and character references
