We're developing Stock2Market, a new software platform designed to simplify vehicle marketing for independent motor trade businesses across the UK.

Our platform is intended for dealerships selling **used cars, motorcycles, vans and motorhomes**.

Our core message is:

**Photo once. Film once. Publish everywhere.**

Stock2Market allows dealerships to select a vehicle from their existing stock, capture photographs and video, and manage the publishing of that content across connected platforms, including Auto Trader, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram.

The objective is to eliminate repetitive work, save dealership staff time and make professional vehicle marketing accessible to businesses of all sizes.

## What we're looking for

We need a talented video editor and motion graphics specialist to produce a professional promotional video that will be prominently featured near the top of our website homepage.

We particularly like the approach of websites such as https://constructico.com/, where the product is introduced through strong visual presentation and engaging promotional content.

We want visitors to understand what Stock2Market does within seconds of watching the video.

The finished video should combine:

- **Genuine screen recordings of our working Stock2Market application**, including its mobile interface.
- Professional motion graphics and smooth animated transitions.
- A confident, friendly British English voiceover.
- Clear on-screen text reinforcing the key messages.
- High-quality automotive imagery featuring cars, motorcycles, vans and motorhomes.
- Professional background music and sound design.
- Strong Stock2Market branding.

**The real application must be central to the video. We do not want a generic cartoon explainer or a production made entirely from stock footage.**

We want the result to look like a polished commercial for an established technology company, while remaining friendly and understandable to independent motor dealers.

## Suggested storyline

**1. The problem**

Show how dealerships currently spend time photographing, filming and repeatedly uploading vehicle content to different platforms.

**2. Introducing Stock2Market**

Introduce the platform and our core message:

**Photo once. Film once. Publish everywhere.**

**3. Demonstrating the application**

Use genuine Stock2Market screen recordings to demonstrate selecting a vehicle, taking photographs, recording video and preparing content for publication.

**4. Publishing across platforms**

Show the connected workflow for Auto Trader, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram, using accurate application footage supported by professional animation.

**5. Suitable for the wider motor trade**

Demonstrate that Stock2Market is designed for used car dealerships, motorcycle retailers, van dealers and motorhome businesses.

**6. The benefits**

Communicate the main advantages: less repetitive work, simpler vehicle marketing and more time to focus on selling vehicles.

**7. Call to action**

Finish with Stock2Market branding, our core slogan and a clear invitation to start a free trial.

## Deliverables

We require:

- One professionally produced 75–90 second promotional video in 16:9 format for our website.
- One shorter 20–30 second promotional edit for social media.
- One vertical 9:16 version suitable for Instagram Reels, Facebook and TikTok.
- Professional British English voiceover.
- On-screen captions and subtitles.
- Licensed music and any required stock footage.
- Editable project files and final high-quality MP4 exports.
- Two rounds of revisions.

The video should also work well when viewed without sound, using on-screen text and visual storytelling.

## What we'll provide

We'll provide Stock2Market branding, product information and genuine application screen recordings.

We're happy to collaborate on the script and storyboard and welcome creative suggestions from the freelancer.

As the application is still being finalised, we'd particularly appreciate a production approach that allows individual app-screen recordings to be replaced without rebuilding the entire video.

## Who we're looking for

We're particularly interested in freelancers with experience creating promotional videos for SaaS platforms, software products and mobile applications.

Please include the following in your proposal:

1. Links to two or three relevant videos you've personally produced.
2. Your suggested creative approach for Stock2Market.
3. Your estimated turnaround time.
4. Confirmation that your quotation includes a professional British English voiceover.
5. Confirmation that you can incorporate genuine app screen recordings and provide editable project files.

We value creativity, clear communication and attention to detail.

Our aim is to build a long-term brand, so there may also be opportunities for additional promotional and social media video projects in the future.

We're looking forward to finding someone who can bring Stock2Market to life.

We are looking to hire **1–3 creators immediately**, depending on expertise and portfolio quality.

---

## 1. Scope of Work

Selected freelancers will work on one or more of the following areas.

### A. AI-Generated Product Videos

- Create premium product videos using advanced AI video-generation tools.
- Develop realistic kitchen environments, lifestyle sequences and visually engaging product scenarios.
- Maintain accurate product appearance, proportions, materials and finishes.
- Deliver smooth transitions, cinematic lighting and consistent visual quality.
- Combine AI-generated visuals with product photography, compositing and post-production where required.

### B. 3D Product Animation & CGI

- Create photorealistic 3D models and animations of cookware products.
- Develop cinematic product reveals, 360° rotations, exploded views and feature demonstrations.
- Showcase material finishes, construction details and functional features through animation.
- Create realistic reflections, textures, lighting and product interactions.
- Integrate 3D products into premium kitchen environments or minimalist studio settings.

### C. Product Storytelling & Video Editing

- Translate product features into compelling visual narratives.
- Create premium launch films, short-form social media videos and product-feature animations.
- Develop storyboards and visual concepts based on our creative briefs.
- Add suitable sound design, music, motion graphics and typography where required.

---

## 2. Creative Direction

We are looking for videos that demonstrate:

- Premium, contemporary and minimalist aesthetics.
- Cinematic lighting and sophisticated camera movements.
- Photorealistic product rendering, particularly stainless-steel surfaces.
- Strong visual storytelling with minimal dependence on text.
- Clean compositions and carefully considered backgrounds.
- High production quality suitable for a premium consumer brand.

**Visual Reference:** Mokobara's product videos and website presentation.

*This reference is intended to communicate our expectations for production quality, visual sophistication and storytelling—not to replicate another brand's creative work.*

---

## 3. Initial Deliverables

The initial assignment may include:

| Deliverable | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Product Launch Film | 1 premium video, approximately 30–60 seconds |
| Product Feature Videos | 2–3 short videos, approximately 10–20 seconds each |
| Formats | Vertical and horizontal versions for social media, website and digital advertising |
| Final Files | High-resolution exports with editable project files or agreed source assets |

Final deliverables will be allocated based on each creator's expertise and the approved brief.

---

## 4. Required Skills & Experience

- Proven experience in AI video generation, 3D product animation, CGI or photorealistic rendering.
- Strong portfolio of premium consumer-product videos.
- Experience with cookware, appliances, electronics, lifestyle products or similar categories is an advantage.
- Excellent understanding of lighting, materials, camera movements, composition and editing.
- Ability to maintain product accuracy across frames and sequences.
- Strong communication skills and ability to meet tight deadlines.

**Preferred Tools:** Blender, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, Houdini, After Effects, Runway, Kling, Veo or similar platforms.

*The quality of your work matters more than the software you use.*

---

## 5. Project Timeline

**Urgent Hiring — Immediate Availability Preferred**

Shortlisted freelancers will begin with a **paid pilot assignment** before proceeding to larger production requirements.

Please indicate your earliest available start date and expected turnaround time.

---

## 6. How to Apply

Please include the following details in your proposal:

| Requirement | Details to Share |
|---|---|
| **Portfolio** | Direct links to your three best product videos, preferably featuring photorealistic CGI, AI-generated product films or premium lifestyle products |
| **Specialisation** | AI video generation, 3D/CGI animation or both |
| **Your Contribution** | Clearly specify which aspects of the portfolio work you personally created |
| **Production Approach** | Briefly explain how you would create a premium cookware video while maintaining accurate product appearance |
| **Turnaround Time** | Estimated production time for a 30-second product film |
| **Commercials** | Estimated cost for a 30-second product film and a 15-second product-feature video |
| **Availability** | Confirm your earliest possible start date |

**Important:** Please share direct links to relevant product-video work rather than general portfolios containing unrelated projects. Applications without relevant samples will not be prioritised.

---

## 7. What We Offer

- Opportunity to work on a new premium cookware launch.
- Creative briefs, product references and technical information.
- Potential for multiple video assignments.
- Opportunity for ongoing collaboration across product launches and e-commerce campaigns.
- Clear feedback and structured approval processes.

We are looking for creators who combine **technical execution with strong creative judgment** and can deliver work that feels genuinely premium.

originalDescription.text:
Overview

We're a bridal brand with a library of high-quality in-studio product photography. We want to turn those existing studio images into scroll-stopping social content — both stills and short subtle-motion videos — by placing our gowns into beautiful, believable scenes using AI, without altering the dress itself. We do not want the results to look like AI was used.

This posting is a small test project of around 15 images. It's the first step toward a much larger ongoing engagement: a full AI-driven "photoshoot" where we drop our gowns into a range of styled scenes at scale. We're hiring the test to find the right long-term partner, so strong performance here leads directly to bigger, recurring work.

The single most important requirement:

The gown must stay identical. Beading, lace pattern, neckline, silhouette, fabric drape, and color have to be preserved exactly from our source photo. We are changing the scene, lighting, and atmosphere around the dress — never the dress. If your work tends to "reinterpret" the subject, this isn't the right fit. 

Aesthetic direction:

Refined and editorial. Clean, premium, light-driven. For video, we want subtle living-photo motion: fabric breathing, light shifting, gentle model movement — not big camera moves or anything that looks "AI-animated." Loop-friendly and elegant.

Test deliverable:

We'll provide 2 on-mannequin product photos. For each gown, deliver:

2 finished social stills — the gown placed into a styled scene, preserved exactly, with believable lighting, shadows, and ground contact. Put the model in two different spots in the scene.

1 short subtle-motion video (approx. 5–10 seconds, 9:16) in the living-photo style described above.

So the full test is 2 stills + 1 videos.


What makes a strong applicant:

A portfolio with input→output pairs showing a real product preserved while the background/scene changed (fashion, apparel, or ecommerce especially)
Fluency with a serious, repeatable pipeline — e.g. ComfyUI workflows, FLUX / Seedream or comparable models, inpainting/masking, relighting, and a current image-to-video tool
Experience producing cohesive sets (not just one-off images)
Comfort with commercial/ecommerce delivery and platform-ready formats.

originalDescription.text:
We run direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands and scale them through Meta and TikTok ads. We're building a team of video editors who turn a creative strategist's briefs into high-retention ads, fast. We're looking for an editor who is excellent at producing ads from AI-generated video and from existing or stock footage (no need to film anything), and who understands what keeps a viewer watching.

HOW WE WORK
You'll receive a clear, step-by-step brief for every ad from our Creative Strategist: the hook, the angle, the script or voiceover, reference ads, and the CTA. You execute it and bring your own ideas on pacing, visuals and variations. We provide the direction; we expect you to deeply understand retention and make the video genuinely watchable.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Build short-form ads (9:16, 4:5, 1:1; 15 to 60 seconds) for Meta and TikTok from the brief
- Create footage with AI video tools (e.g. Runway, Kling, Veo, Sora, Midjourney, Higgsfield, HeyGen, ElevenLabs) and/or source, license and edit existing footage
- Produce multiple variations per concept: different hooks, intros, pacing, captions and endings
- Apply retention techniques: strong first 3 seconds, pattern interrupts, fast cuts, dynamic captions, sound design, B-roll, motion graphics
- Add voiceover, music, subtitles and on-screen text; keep branding consistent
- Take feedback and deliver revisions quickly
- Organize and deliver files cleanly (Google Drive / Frame.io), named clearly

WHO YOU ARE
- Strong portfolio of short-form ads or social video (ecommerce / DTC experience is a big plus)
- Hands-on with AI video generation and comfortable stitching AI clips into a believable, high-quality ad
- Fast with Premiere Pro, CapCut, After Effects or DaVinci Resolve
- Understand hook rate, hold rate, pacing and what makes people keep watching
- Reliable on deadlines, communicative, and receptive to feedback
- Good written English so you can follow briefs precisely

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (how we judge the work)
1. Each ad follows the brief: the specified hook, angle, script and CTA, delivered in the requested format and ratio
2. At least 2 hook or intro variations per concept when requested
3. Clean delivery: 1080p+ MP4, correct captions with no spelling errors, balanced audio, no watermarks or unlicensed footage
4. First 3 seconds clearly built to stop the scroll, backed by a short note on your retention choices
5. First draft within the agreed turnaround (target 48 to 72 hours); revisions within 24 hours
6. Open files (project or asset links) shared on request

HOW TO APPLY
Answer the screening questions and share 3 or more ad-style videos you edited, especially AI-made or stock-footage ads.

This is a long-term working relationship with steady volume for the right editor. The listed budget is a placeholder and open to discussion based on your rate and the volume of videos.

originalDescription.text:
## About the Project

I'm looking for a creative video editor to produce a cinematic YouTube travel film documenting my trip to Rocky Mountain National Park, Colorado.

I've already organized approximately 63 minutes of preselected footage in DaVinci Resolve, arranged chronologically.

The footage primarily consists of scenic mountain drives, hiking, landscapes, and occasional conversations and personal moments. This is not an action-packed vlog. I'm looking for someone who can transform relatively simple footage into an immersive, visually engaging film through thoughtful editing and music.

I'm envisioning a finished video around 8–20 minutes long, but I'm open to a shorter or longer runtime if it produces a better result. Quality and pacing are much more important than reaching a specific length.

My YouTube channel focuses on travel, automotive experiences, outdoor adventures, and lifestyle content. I'm also interested in establishing a long-term relationship with an editor as the channel grows.

## Editing Style

I'm looking for a natural, cinematic approach that emphasizes:

- Beautiful landscapes, composition, and visual storytelling
- Thoughtful shot selection that avoids unnecessary repetition
- Strong music selection and cuts synchronized naturally with the music
- Smooth pacing that allows scenic moments to breathe
- Authentic dialogue and personal moments where appropriate
- Clean color grading and balanced audio

I prefer an immersive, understated style rather than flashy transitions, excessive effects, or unnecessarily fast-paced editing.

I'm particularly interested in an editor who can recognize which footage is worth keeping and isn't afraid to cut material that doesn't contribute to the overall experience.

## Project Requirements

- Review approximately 63 minutes of preselected footage
- Create a cohesive cinematic travel film, ideally around 8–20 minutes, with flexibility based on the material
- Handle shot selection, sequencing, music synchronization, color grading, and audio mixing
- Work in DaVinci Resolve and provide the editable project files
- Include at least one revision round
- Use properly licensed music, which we can coordinate together

I'm looking for someone who can contribute creative direction rather than simply assemble clips according to instructions.

## Budget and Paid Trial

My estimated budget for the complete project is $300, although I'm open to discussing pricing depending on your experience, portfolio, and proposed approach.

Before committing to the full project, I may request a short paid editing trial from a shortlisted candidate to evaluate creative style, shot selection, pacing, and music synchronization.

Trial scope and compensation can be discussed individually. If selected for the full project, I'd prefer to incorporate the trial into the overall project budget.

## To Apply

Please include:

1. Two or three examples of cinematic travel, outdoor, or lifestyle videos you've personally edited.
2. Your proposed fixed price for the complete Colorado project.
3. Your estimated turnaround time.
4. Confirmation that you work in DaVinci Resolve and can deliver editable project files.
5. A brief explanation of how you'd approach a mostly scenic travel video without a traditional storyline.

I have upcoming travel footage from Hawaii and Japan, along with future automotive and lifestyle projects. Ideally, I'd like to find an editor I can collaborate with consistently as my channel develops.

originalDescription.text:
We are looking for a talented AI Video Creator and Video Editor to produce a visually stunning, mouthwatering food commercial for our brand, Macro Monster, featuring our Cream of Rice product.

The video will be used for paid advertising on Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, and Facebook.

This is a remote project. No physical filming or presence in Kuwait is required. We want someone who can use advanced AI video generation tools, product images, and creative editing to produce a realistic, premium-quality food commercial.

Creative Vision

We want an irresistible “food porn” video that makes viewers crave Macro Monster Cream of Rice immediately.

The video should feature:

* Ultra-realistic, cinematic close-ups of creamy, delicious Cream of Rice.
* Slow-motion chocolate pouring, dripping, stirring, and spoon scooping.
* Rich food textures, appetizing toppings, and beautiful lighting.
* Satisfying ASMR-style food preparation sounds.
* Smooth camera movements, creative transitions, and engaging visual effects.
* A powerful visual hook within the first 2 seconds.
* Premium food advertising aesthetics combined with modern, viral social media content.

The final result should look like a professionally filmed food commercial, not an obviously AI-generated video.

AI Production Requirements

The creator should be experienced with AI video generation and editing tools such as Kling AI, Runway, Google Veo, or similar platforms.

We will provide product packaging images, branding assets, and product information.

The creator will be responsible for:

1. Developing a creative concept and short storyboard.
2. Generating realistic food visuals and animations using AI.
3. Integrating our actual Macro Monster product packaging accurately.
4. Editing the video with professional sound design and transitions.
5. Ensuring realistic food textures, movement, lighting, and consistency.
6. Producing a polished, conversion-focused social media advertisement.

Deliverables

* One 15–30-second premium AI-assisted food commercial.
* Vertical 9:16 format, minimum 1080 × 1920.
* Three alternative opening hooks for A/B testing.
* One version with advertising text overlays and one clean version.
* Professional sound design and music licensed for commercial advertising.
* Final MP4 files optimized for Instagram Reels, TikTok, Snapchat, and Facebook.
* Full commercial usage rights for all delivered assets.

Ideal Candidate

* Proven experience creating realistic AI-generated food videos or commercials.
* Strong understanding of food advertising and visual storytelling.
* Excellent AI prompting, video generation, and editing skills.
* Ability to maintain accurate product packaging, logos, and branding.
* Understanding of performance marketing and attention-grabbing social media ads.

To Apply

Please include:

1. Examples of AI-generated food commercials you have created.
2. Which AI video generation tools you use.
3. Your proposed creative approach for Macro Monster Cream of Rice.
4. Your fixed project price.
5. Your estimated delivery timeline.

Important: We are not interested in generic AI slideshows, unrealistic food animations, or basic templates. We want premium, photorealistic, cinematic content that could be mistaken for a professionally filmed food advertisement.

We are looking for a creative partner for potential ongoing projects across multiple Macro Monster products and flavors.
Happy bidding

originalDescription.text:
We are an established video production studio building a long-term pipeline of cinematic AI series, music videos and character-driven stories. We are looking for AI film directors and creative directors who work through the prompt, and we want them on our core team for the long run.

This is not UGC, talking-head ads or quick product clips. This is cinematic work. You will direct the shot, the performance and the pacing, and the model follows your vision.

If you think about camera, light, blocking and emotion before you ever type a prompt, you will feel at home here.

What you will direct:

You will turn approved storyboards into finished cinematic sequences, using Seedance as your main tool and Kling as a secondary tool. You decide how each shot is framed, how a character moves and feels, and how a scene builds from one clip to the next. The content spans music videos, dramatic narrative series and children's stories, and all of it needs strong character consistency and intentional visual storytelling.

What you get:

Approved storyboards, character sheets and scene descriptions to direct from
Seedance and Kling access, with tools and credits covered by us
A directing-focused role. No editing, no sourcing tools, no admin work
Payment through funded Upwork milestones, paid per approved video
A real long-term position on a team with a steady pipeline, and a clear path to longer, higher-paid work

How the work and pay are structured:

Everyone starts on music videos of 2 to 3 minutes, paid per approved video from USD 100. As your work meets our standard, you move up to longer episodic work with higher rates, confirmed in writing. Each milestone is funded through Upwork and you are paid for approved work.

Who this is for:

AI film directors, creative directors and filmmakers who now direct through AI. You have worked on narrative or episodic video, not just standalone clips. You understand scene continuity, can keep a character's look and feel consistent from one video to the next, and know how to get genuine cinematic output from the model.

What we are looking for:

Hands-on experience with Seedance omni model prompting
Working knowledge of Kling as a secondary tool
A director's eye for camera, lighting, performance and pacing
Experience with dramatic or character-driven content
Ability to hold visual consistency across a multi-scene project
Clear communication and reliable delivery on agreed timelines
Someone who wants a long-term role and can work independently

How we select:

We hold a short video call with every shortlisted candidate. Strong candidates then complete a short paid trial through Upwork. We do not ask for free or unpaid work.

Please note:

All work is confidential and done under an NDA. Nothing you create for us can be shown in a portfolio or shared publicly.

To apply:

Tell us how you would direct a dramatic scene with AI, including how you think about camera, performance and pacing, and how you keep characters consistent and emotionally continuous across clips. Tell us how many generations you usually need to get a finished clip you are happy with, and how many hours per week you can give us. Please share 1 to 2 examples of cinematic work you have already completed. We do not ask for new or test work as part of the application.

originalDescription.text:
I'm sending you 2 short-drama references from DramaBox, ReelShort, and similar platforms.

Please study their emotional pacing, reaction cuts, cinematic music, sound effects, dialogue mixing, and transitions.

Pay special attention to how music builds tension, suddenly stops at an action or revelation, and switches to a new emotional score.

I want you to understand the storytelling and sound design techniques behind these videos, not simply copy them.

After reviewing all 4 samples, please tell me what techniques you noticed and how you would apply them to my films..

but I'm looking for a much more detailed breakdown of the sound design in all 4 references.

Please identify the types of music, cinematic SFX, Foley, ambience, dialogue treatment, sound layering, and emotional transitions, with timestamps and explanations of how they work together.

My AI footage will already include dialogue and some natural sounds, so I need an editor who knows what to preserve, enhance, or add without duplicating sounds.

I want to understand your complete sound design approach, not just music cuts and impacts.

One of my biggest priorities is advanced cinematic music transitions: tension build-up → powerful impact → sudden music cut → strategic silence → a completely new emotional score.

Sometimes the music should stop just BEFORE a major action or revelation, like in professional action and horror trailers.

You must understand each scene's story and emotional shifts to know exactly when and how to use these techniques. This is essential for my short dramas, but effects should never be overused or added randomly.

originalDescription.text:
# AI Image Creator – Premium Coastal Lifestyle Brand

**Ongoing Opportunity | Product & Lifestyle Photography**

### About the Project

We are a premium coastal lifestyle brand looking for a talented AI image creator to help elevate our online presentation through realistic, high-quality product and lifestyle imagery.

Our aesthetic is rooted in authentic New England coastal living. Think sailing, boats, harbors, weathered teak, understated coastal clothing, and timeless maritime style.

Nothing kitschy, overly nautical, or artificially staged. We want imagery that feels natural, authentic, and photographic.

### Initial Project

Our immediate need is to create **four images for Meta advertising** to test new creative directions.

We will provide original product photography and references. The goal is to incorporate our actual products into compelling, realistic lifestyle settings.

**Product accuracy and realism are non-negotiable.**

Product details must remain true to the original, including construction, texture, colors, proportions, and hardware. We cannot sacrifice product detail for a more attractive image.

### Long-Term Opportunity

We're looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term creative partner as we expand across our product catalog.

Future opportunities may include:
- Lifestyle and product imagery across our website and catalog.
- Additional creative for Meta advertising and social media.
- Larger lifestyle and editorial-style imagery.
- AI-generated motion imagery and video.

### Who We're Looking For

- Proven experience creating photorealistic AI product and lifestyle imagery.
- A strong understanding of photography, composition, lighting, and styling.
- Experience incorporating existing physical products into AI-generated scenes while preserving their actual appearance.
- Familiarity with Nano Banana, Midjourney, Photoshop, or similar tools.
- A strong creative eye and an understanding of understated, premium coastal aesthetics.

We're looking for someone who brings creative judgment, not just prompt-writing skills.

### To Apply

Please include:
- Your portfolio, particularly examples of realistic AI product and lifestyle photography.
- Examples of work incorporating actual products into AI-generated scenes.
- The AI tools and workflows you typically use.
- Your pricing for the initial four-image project.

We will award the project based on portfolio, experience, and creative fit. No preliminary sample assignment is required.

If the initial project is successful, we'd like to develop an ongoing working relationship.

originalDescription.text:
SIGNING A SHORT WORK-FOR-HIRE AGREEMENT IS REQUIRED BEFORE HIRING.

AUDIO IS ALREADY FINISHED AND WILL BE SUPPLIED BY ME. Use each supplied track exactly as provided - do not edit, remix, shorten, extend, replace, or otherwise change the audio. Do not add other audio.

I am a New York songwriter. My song "New Year on Times Square" exists in 17+ recorded versions (swing, klezmer, Latin house, bachata, country, cabaret, hip-hop and more). I need finished music videos for ten of the versions, one video per version. You may apply to produce individual complete videos for $120 per video, or the full ten-video package for $1,000. These are paid deliverables, not unpaid samples.

These videos are made for DJs: they will play them on big screens at New Year's Eve parties while the track plays. That is why the picture must stay energetic and readable from across a dance floor, with the dancing up front and the ball-drop finale at the end of the song.

The first six versions:
1. Latin House Mix (dance, 115 BPM)
2. Klezmer Clarinet (klezmer celebration, 92 BPM)
3. Bachata Mix (bachata dance)
4. Nashville Mix (country celebration)
5. Marching Cabaret (cabaret / marching band energy)
6. Hip-Hop Mix (cinematic hip-hop)

Four additional versions will be selected for the ten-video package. I will provide their audio tracks later.

What I provide: the exact audio track for each version, the full lyrics, and reference videos of the style I like. Listen to the available versions here: https://ontimessquare.com/music/ Everything is ready on my side: finished audio, lyrics, covers and references - you can start immediately.

Please watch our three trial music videos at https://ontimessquare.com/music/ (select the versions marked "Video"), plus this fourth trial video from my channel: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qn0vHU_qmeE. These references show the creative direction: lots of dancing and New Year's Eve scenes in Times Square. You do not need to copy specific shots. Finished videos must be substantially higher quality than these trials.

What each video must be:
- Full song length, 1080p, ready for YouTube.
- Mostly DANCING: energetic dancing through most of the song, matched to the version's genre and tempo (twist, bachata steps, country line dancing, cabaret kicks, hip-hop moves - depending on the version).
- Photorealistic AI scenes of the actual Times Square: recognizable locations, big screens, New Year's Eve crowds, celebration and confetti. Documentary-realistic, NOT fantasy or sci-fi.
- The finale of every video, as the song ends: the realistic New Year's Eve ball drop over Times Square - the ball descending, the crowd counting down, confetti at the drop. This is the climax.
- Where a singer appears, she/he sings THIS song - shots cut on lyric phrases (I will mark the key lines).
- Opening title card: "New Year on Times Square" and "RIGLI".
- A discreet constant bottom line through the video: "New Year on Times Square - RIGLI".
- Larger title at each chorus.
- Closing card (about 16 seconds, within the end of the supplied track - do not extend the audio): "Written by Walter J. Kin (RIGLI)" and "OnTimesSquare.com - Sing it free - 17+ versions".
- No other added text, logos or watermarks.
- Quality bar: the finished video should look like professionally filmed New Year's Eve celebration footage, not like an obvious AI demo.

Process and payment: please propose one of these fixed-price options:
Two rounds of revisions per video are included in the price.
- Individual complete videos: $120 per finished, approved video.
- ALL TEN complete videos: $1,000, paid as 10 milestones of $100 - one per finished, approved video. The $100-per-video rate applies only to the ten-video package.

Use the full supplied track; samples do not count. For the ten-video package, deliver Latin House Mix within 5 days of contract start. After approval, make the other nine in the same style system. Propose a realistic full-package schedule, to be agreed before hiring.

Rights: the songs and recordings are mine (I am the songwriter and rights holder). You deliver the finished videos and the project/source files; I may publish and monetize the videos on my channels.

To apply, please send:
1. At least FIVE YouTube links to AI-generated videos you made yourself. Music videos are preferred; dancing and crowd scenes are a big plus. DO NOT APPLY without at least five YouTube links to your own AI video work. Applications without these links will not be considered.
2. The AI video tools you use, and why those tools fit this project (dancing, crowds, lip-sync to supplied audio).
3. Your chosen option (individual videos at $120 per video, or all ten for $1,000), and confirmation that you accept the applicable price and payment structure and will sign a short work-for-hire agreement before hiring.
4. Your estimated turnaround: the first video, and the full package if you choose it. Please do not send generic portfolios - only your own AI video work.

Seeking an Experienced Filmmaker, Story Consultant & Post-Production Partner (Long-Term Collaboration)

Type: Independent Short Film | Potential Long-Term Collaboration
Budget: Limited / Indie Filmmaking Budget

About the Project

I recently wrote, produced, and submitted a short film titled The Red Circle for the 48 Hour Film Project.

Due to the strict 48-hour deadline, the film was written, shot, and edited under significant time pressure. As a result, some scenes are missing, certain character connections need strengthening, and the overall storytelling and emotional flow could be improved.

Now that the competition submission is complete, I want to revisit the project and develop it into a stronger, more polished film for a wider audience.

Who I’m Looking For

I’m seeking an experienced filmmaker with a strong background in film direction, production, storytelling, and post-production who can serve as both a creative collaborator and mentor.

This is not simply a one-time editing assignment. I’m looking for someone who genuinely enjoys filmmaking, understands cinematic storytelling, and is interested in building a long-term professional working relationship.

* Review the existing film, screenplay, and available footage.
* Identify storytelling gaps, missing scenes, and weak character development.
* Help strengthen emotional connections, pacing, suspense, and overall narrative structure.
* Guide me in developing additional scenes, improving the screenplay, and potentially expanding the story into future projects or a sequel.
* Provide creative direction and practical filmmaking advice.

* Help plan additional scenes, shot lists, camera angles, and visual storytelling.
* Provide guidance on directing actors, scene composition, and cinematic execution.

3. Editing & Post-Production

* Support video editing, scene sequencing, and storytelling through editing.
* Provide sound design, audio enhancement, and sound engineering support.
* Assist with color grading, transitions, and overall cinematic presentation.
* Help deliver a polished final product suitable for YouTube and other platforms.

Long-Term Opportunity

My goal is to continue producing independent short films through DarVista Films. I would like to establish an relationship with someone who can support future productions, provide mentorship, and grow creatively alongside my projects.

I value professionalism, honest feedback, reliability, and commitment. I am looking for someone who takes independent filmmaking seriously, even when working with smaller budgets.

We’re looking for an experienced, reliable video editor to join our faceless history YouTube channel for long-term collaboration.

We tell dramatic WWI/WWII stories about ordinary people facing extraordinary situations. We provide the script and a detailed production guide. Your job is to turn them into engaging videos through strong visual storytelling, natural voiceover, atmosphere, and precise editing.

**Relevant experience editing faceless history or documentary channels is required.**

**Our reference**

[Arven](https://www.youtube.com/@Arven-channel) 
Study especially the highest viewed videos.

Please review several videos before applying. We use this channel as a reference for storytelling, tension, atmosphere, and narration-led scenes. Our own guide and script package define the final production requirements.

**What you’ll create**

8–13 minute videos combining:

- AI-generated still images with purposeful camera movement.
- Selective AI motion clips for important moments.
- Relevant archival photographs, documents, and footage.
- Simple maps, information cards, and tactical overlays.
- Natural AI narration and occasional character dialogue.
- Music, sound effects, and silence that support the story.

**What matters most**

We need an editor who understands how to keep viewers watching.

You should know how to:

- Build an opening that immediately establishes danger and curiosity.
- Match visual changes to the exact narration beat.
- Show actions and consequences clearly, so viewers understand what is happening.
- Vary framing, movement, and shot length without making every scene feel the same.
- Support reveals, reversals, and escalating threats through editing.
- Give emotional moments room to breathe.
- Follow the script’s final-action ending and hard cut.

Every shot should help viewers understand the scene, feel the tension, or anticipate what happens next.

**Your responsibilities**

- Follow our script, scene instructions, and production guide.
- Generate, select, and refine the visuals needed for each scene.
- Produce and edit narration using ElevenLabs or a comparable tool.
- Correct pronunciation, unnatural delivery, awkward pauses, and dialogue timing.
- Maintain consistent character appearance, clothing, equipment, and locations.
- Find suitable archival material and keep a simple source and usage-rights log.
- Create clear maps from supplied geography and references.
- Balance voiceover, music, and sound effects.
- Review the complete video before delivery and address feedback reliably.

**Visual quality is essential**

Recurring characters must remain recognizable across shots.

Uniforms, weapons, vehicles, and environments must fit the period and scene. Check hands, weapon grips, anatomy, scale, and background figures carefully.

If an AI image contains an obvious error, fix or replace it before delivery.

We want believable historical scenes with a consistent documentary look.

**You’re a good fit if you:**

- Have completed work for faceless history or documentary channels.
- Understand hooks, pacing, suspense, and visual continuity.
- Can make still-image sequences feel purposeful and engaging.
- Have experience generating and refining AI visuals.
- Have a strong ear for natural English narration.
- Follow detailed instructions while making thoughtful editing decisions.
- Communicate clearly and meet agreed deadlines.

Our workflow primarily uses AI stills, archival material, maps, and selective motion clips. Full AI video generation and 3D animation are not the core of this role.

**What we offer**

- Ongoing work with the opportunity to grow together.
- Prepared scripts and clear production guidelines.
- Direct feedback and straightforward communication.
- Reliable payment.

Don't apply if you work or present an agency or not available for long term.
Please begin your application with **“HISTORY EDITOR”** so we know you’ve read the brief.

Best,
Mar

We run two supplement brands on Shopify that sell to the UK through Meta ads. For each product we follow a competitor that already sells it at scale, and we make our own version of their winning ads.

We cannot run their ads: their product and logo are in every shot. So every winning ad has to be made again from scratch: same idea, our product, UK setting. We are looking for the person who makes those ads.

This is a video ad role, not an AI-only role. You use whatever gets the best result fastest: editing, real product footage, stock clips, motion graphics or AI.

WHAT YOU WILL MAKE
- Presenter and UGC-style videos: a person talking to camera with our product (AI presenter, or edited from real creator footage)
- Product videos: unboxing, pouring, close-ups, lifestyle shots
- Animated and explainer videos: ingredient and body animations, 3D product shots, text-led story videos
- Voice-over videos with b-roll and product shots
- Edits, cut-downs and new hooks for ads that already work
- Static image ads and carousels

HOW THE WORK COMES IN
- Our Creative Strategist picks the competitor ads and writes a clear brief for each one: reference ad, script notes, format, deadline
- You break the reference down shot by shot and rebuild it with our product
- You deliver in 9:16 and 4:5, with captions, named and uploaded, through Monday.com

YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU
- Make direct-response video ads for Meta every week and can show them
- Edit fast: pacing, captions, sound, hooks
- Know what an ad needs in the first 3 seconds
- Are comfortable with AI video and image tools, and can keep a real product and its label correct on screen
- Can do basic motion graphics
- Get natural voices, in a British accent where a voice is needed
- Know Meta's rules for health ads and work within them
- Deliver on time and say early when something will be late

TOOLS
Use the editor you are fastest in (CapCut, Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci). We have a Higgsfield account for AI video and images. Tell us your stack.

HOW WE WORK
- Small team: owner, manager, creative strategist, page builder, media buyer and you
- You get a full SOP on day one, with all products, competitor links and file rules
- Steady weekly volume, long-term role for the right person

TO APPLY
1. Send 3 video ads you made for Meta. At least one should show a real product on screen.
2. Tell us your tool stack and how long one 30-second ad takes you from brief to delivery.
3. Tell us which of your ads performed best and why you think it did.

Start your application with the word "Soursop" so we know you read this.

We are developing Momo Investigates, an original entertainment series featuring a charismatic, sophisticated detective who investigates fascinating mysteries, historical events, and surprising facts about casinos and the gaming industry.

The finished product should resemble a professionally produced animated detective series.

* Professional voiceovers, sound design, subtitles and cinematic editing.

Requirements

* Natural facial animation, lip-sync and body movements.

# AI Creative Producer – Virtual Folk-Rock Band & Music Videos

We are looking for a creative AI content producer to help us build the visual identity and audiovisual world of a virtual Flemish folk-rock band.

The project combines original music (delivered), five recurring fictional band members and a distinctive visual identity. Our ambition is to create a believable virtual band with consistent characters, a recognisable style and a growing collection of music videos and social content.

What we need?

1. Visual identity
- Develop five distinctive, realistic and consistent band members.
- Create individual portraits and group images.
- Establish their visual style, clothing, personalities and shared environment.
- Build a reusable character and visual identity guide.

2. Music video
- Create cinematic, engaging AI-generated music videos. We start with one
- Combine band performances, storytelling and atmospheric scenes.
- Ensure consistent characters and believable instrument performances.
- Edit videos to match the music and its rhythm.

3. Future content
- Short videos for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.
- Behind-the-scenes and character-based content.
- Visuals and promotional material for future releases.

Who we're looking for?

Someone who:
- Has proven experience with AI image and video generation.
- Is skilled at maintaining consistent characters across different scenes.
- Has a strong creative eye and understands visual storytelling.
- Can combine AI generation with professional video editing.
- Is creative, proactive and comfortable working independently.

Experience with tools such as Midjourney, Kling, Runway, OpenArt or similar is expected.

Project approach and budget

We prefer to start with a small paid assignment to establish the band's visual identity and test character consistency.

If we find the right creative partner, this can develop into an ongoing collaboration covering music videos and content for future releases.

We are an independent project with a realistic but limited budget. We value creativity, quality and good value for money rather than expensive agency production.

To apply

Please share:
- Your portfolio, especially AI-generated videos.
- Examples of consistent AI characters across multiple scenes.
- Your preferred tools and workflow.
- Your estimated price for an initial identity development project.

We will provide a detailed creative brief, moodboard, band-member descriptions and music once we start the conversation.

originalDescription.text:
We are building Club VII, an emerging golf and lifestyle clothing brand influenced by 90s sportswear, golf culture, music, streetwear, movement, nightlife and wider sporting culture.

We are looking for a talented freelance creative who can take our real photography, video, products, locations and brand references and turn them into distinctive, professional social content.

Authenticity is extremely important to us

We do NOT want AI-generated imagery.

Our photographs must show:

Real Club VII products
Real people/models
Real golfers
Real locations
Real environments
Real moments
Real clothing details and fabrics

We are happy for photography to be professionally edited, colour graded, cropped, retouched and creatively treated, but we do not want generative AI used to create fake models, environments, products, clothing details or lifestyle imagery.

The slight imperfections of genuine photography are part of what we want.

The Club VII vision

We are not trying to create another conventional golf clothing Instagram account.

We want to build a recognisable Club VII world.

Think:

Golf × 90s sportswear × streetwear × music × club culture × movement × real life

Visually, we're drawn to:

90s sports photography
Vintage sportswear campaigns
Flash photography
Film/grain
Movement and unusual cropping
Golf courses and driving ranges
Wet weather
Concrete and urban locations
Night-time imagery
Strong product details
Candid moments
Graphic design and typography
Music and club culture
Wider sporting influences
Editorial rather than overly commercial photography

The finished content should feel premium and considered, but also authentic, energetic and occasionally imperfect.

Inspiration, not imitation

One reference we admire is Malbon Golf, particularly the way Malbon has built a broader cultural world around golf rather than simply presenting clothing as products.

We do not want to copy Malbon.

Club VII needs its own visual language and point of view.

We would like someone who understands why brands like this are culturally interesting, but can use that understanding to help us push Club VII in an original direction.

The goal isn't:

"Make Club VII look like Malbon."

It's:

"Understand what we're trying to build and help us make Club VII unmistakably Club VII."

What we need from you

We will collect and provide raw assets, including:

Photography
Product shots
Short video clips
Behind-the-scenes content
Club VII logos/brand assets
Locations
Inspiration/reference images
Campaign ideas
Music/cultural references

We then want someone who can look across those assets and creatively decide:

What's the story here?

And turn that material into:

Instagram carousels
Reels
Stories
Standalone imagery
Graphic-led posts
Product/detail content
Campaign concepts
Launch content
Website/social crossover assets where appropriate

We don't want to have to specify exactly what should happen to every photograph.

We want someone who can bring a creative director's eye to what we have.

We want you to get MORE from our content

One of the biggest objectives is to maximise every shoot.

For example, one Club VII shoot might contain:

Hero images
Product images
Detail photography
Behind-the-scenes moments
Movement
Short video
Location imagery
Fabric/details
Golf imagery

We want someone who can identify how that material could become:

2 Reels + 2/3 carousels + Stories + standalone posts + campaign imagery

rather than simply selecting three photographs and posting them individually.

Initial paid test project

We would like to start with an existing Club VII jacket shoot.

We will provide genuine Club VII photography, including product, logo, fabric, movement and wet-weather detail shots, together with any suitable video and brand assets.

We would like you to develop:

Deliverables
1 Instagram Reel
1 5–7 slide carousel
3 Instagram Story assets
1 standalone campaign/hero image

We would also like you to explain briefly why you chose that creative direction and how you would develop it further.

Important

No AI-generated photography or generative replacement of our products, models or locations should be used in the test.

Who we're looking for

You might describe yourself as a:

Creative Content Designer
Social Content Creator
Junior Art Director
Fashion Content Designer
Social-first Graphic Designer
Creative Designer

Experience with fashion, streetwear, sport, lifestyle, music or culturally-led brands would be particularly relevant.

Useful skills include:

Photoshop
Lightroom
Premiere Pro / After Effects / CapCut
Graphic design
Typography
Colour grading
Image selection
Art direction
Reel editing
Social campaign development

But creative taste is more important to us than a huge list of software skills.

When applying

Please do not send a generic social-media-management proposal.

Instead, please send:

3–5 examples of your strongest relevant work
Examples involving fashion, sports, streetwear or lifestyle brands, if available
An example where you created a campaign from existing photography/video
A brief explanation of what you think makes a brand visually recognisable
The software you personally use
Confirmation that you are comfortable working without AI-generated imagery
Your availability for ongoing work
Please also answer this question:

If we gave you 30 genuine Club VII photographs and 10 short video clips from one shoot, how would you approach turning them into a week's worth of Club VII content?

We are looking for the thinking behind the work, not simply technical editing ability.

Potential ongoing relationship

If the paid test works well, we are looking for someone who can become an ongoing creative collaborator with Club VII.

We want to regularly collect our own genuine content and have someone alongside us who can:

select → edit → interpret → design → sequence → create

while helping us steadily develop a distinctive Club VII visual identity.

The ambition is to create a brand people recognise before they even see the logo.

originalDescription.text:
evco is a benefits company. We need an experienced AI-hybrid video producer to finish a 60-second brand film.

The story, script, voiceover, music, and timing are already locked. Your job is to generate the pictures, cut in existing live footage, finish the piece, and deliver a commercial-quality film. This should not require the client to direct every render. Plan on a short kickoff and two async review rounds.

What we provide after hire
We will share the creative brief, locked audio mix, existing live footage, and brand assets privately once someone is hired. Nothing further will be shared in this public posting.

What you deliver
- A finished 60-second brand film (16:9, 4K or 1440p master) plus 1:1 and 9:16 crops
- Existing live footage cut in and graded to match the generated shots
- A finishing pass: upscale, a shared grade, subtle grain, and sound design under the locked mix
- Two rounds of revisions on the test and on the full cut
- Project files and selected unused takes

Tools
Use whatever gets a photoreal, consistent result: Runway, Veo, Wan, Seedance, Higgsfield/Kling, or a similar stack, plus a proper edit/grade/sound finish (Premiere, DaVinci, After Effects, or equivalent). We care about the finished film, not a single tool.

Process
1. Paid test: one ~15-second scene from the locked brief, including a grade match to the existing live footage if that scene includes it. We pay for this test either way.
2. If the test is approved, you produce the full 60-second film, with two async review rounds. No live directing of every take.

Budget
This is a fixed-price project totaling $1,500, with all tool and render costs included:
- Milestone 1: paid ~15-second test — $300
- Milestone 2: full 60-second film — $1,200

Timeline
About one week for the test, then about two weeks for the full film after approval (about three weeks in total).

To apply
Proposals without a link to an AI-hybrid reel will not be considered. UGC ad volume alone is not a fit. We want work that combines generated shots with live footage, or a finished commercial that does not read as generic AI.

Purposeful Progress Co. is an Australian personal development brand specialising in premium guided journals and digital reflection products.

We are preparing for our first official product launch, followed closely by our Christmas marketing campaign.

We have an established brand identity, product photography, video footage and UGC content. We are looking for a talented creative professional to transform these assets into high-quality, engaging and conversion-focused advertising content.

The Role:

We are seeking an experienced graphic designer and short-form video editor who specialises in creating advertisements for e-commerce and direct-to-consumer brands.

Our primary objective is to significantly improve the quality of our advertising and social media content beyond what we can currently produce in-house.

We want someone who can take creative ownership, develop concepts, recommend effective hooks and produce polished content with minimal direction.

This is more than a basic editing role. We are looking for someone with strong creative judgement who understands how to produce content that looks premium while encouraging customers to take action.

Project Scope:

Campaign 1: Official Product Launch

4 professionally edited short-form video ads (15–30 seconds).

3 premium static advertisements.

2 additional video hook variations.

Creative concepts highlighting product benefits and lifestyle integration.

Campaign 2: Christmas Campaign

4 professionally edited short-form video ads (15–30 seconds).

Creative concepts positioning our journal as a meaningful Christmas gift.

Additional Requirements

Premium typography, graphic design and visual composition.

Consistent application of our established brand guidelines.

Optimised exports for Instagram Reels, Stories and Meta advertising.

Delivery of final assets and editable project files.

Appropriate commercial-use rights for all newly created content.

Creative Direction:

Our brand aesthetic is premium, minimalist and intentional.

We favour:

Cinematic lifestyle footage and natural lighting.

Clean, sophisticated typography.

Subtle motion graphics and smooth transitions.

Emotionally engaging storytelling.

Strong product presentation.

Visually consistent branding.

We are not looking for generic templates, basic Canva designs or overly promotional advertisements.

We want creative work that is visually distinctive, professionally executed and appropriate for a premium lifestyle brand.

No AI-Generated Content

We do not want artificial intelligence used in the creation of our advertising content.

All creative work must be produced through traditional graphic design, video editing and genuine human creativity.

This includes:

No AI-generated images, video footage or animations.

No AI-generated voiceovers or synthetic presenters.

No AI-generated product photography or lifestyle imagery.

Experience transforming UGC footage into polished advertisements.

Consistent delivery of professional, brand-aligned content.

Content designed to improve engagement, website traffic and sales.

Project Overview

We are looking for an experienced AI avatar creator and video editor to develop a highly realistic, consistent AI-generated British male presenter for an educational content brand in the trading and financial education space.

The project involves creating an original fictional AI character with a consistent appearance, synthetic voice and professional presentation style, followed by ongoing monthly video and image production.

We are looking for someone with proven experience in photorealistic AI character generation, voice synthesis, lip synchronisation and professional video editing.

Character & Creative Direction

The fictional AI presenter should have the following characteristics:

British male appearance, approximately 45 years old.
Natural salt-and-pepper hair and realistic facial features.
Sophisticated, understated and professional appearance.
Natural-sounding British English synthetic voice.
Calm, articulate and approachable communication style.
Premium professional, lifestyle and everyday environments.

The character may have a fictional creative backstory inspired by an Economics postgraduate education and former institutional trading experience. This must remain clearly fictional and must not be presented as verified personal qualifications or professional credentials.

The character must be original, with no unauthorised replication of a real person's appearance or voice.

Phase 1 – Initial Development & Production

We require the following deliverables:

1. Master AI Avatar

Creation of one consistent, photorealistic AI presenter.
Development of reusable character reference assets.
Creation of a consistent synthetic British English voice.
Establishment of a repeatable workflow for future productions.

2. AI-Generated Images

25 high-quality images featuring the character.
Variety of professional, lifestyle, personal and fictional family-oriented settings.
Consistent facial identity, appearance and styling throughout.

3. Video Production

Three videos using scripts and creative direction supplied by our team:

15-second introduction: For a Telegram bot.
2-minute introduction: Introducing the fictional AI presenter and educational brand.
5–6-minute presentation: An educational VSL-style video.

All videos should feature natural delivery, realistic facial movement, accurate lip synchronisation and professional editing.

Phase 2 – Ongoing Monthly Production

Following successful completion of the initial project, we are looking to establish a long-term monthly production arrangement.

Monthly requirements:

30 AI-generated presenter videos, approximately 30 seconds each.
30 new photorealistic AI-generated images.
Consistent character appearance, voice and visual styling.
Editing, quality control and agreed revisions.
Delivery according to an agreed production schedule.

All scripts and content direction will be provided by our team.

The freelancer should be capable of maintaining a reliable, repeatable production workflow that supports consistent output at scale.

Quality Requirements & Content Standards

Our priorities are exceptional realism, natural delivery and consistent character identity.

We expect:

Highly realistic facial features and expressions.
Consistent character appearance across different environments.
Natural British English speech and accurate lip synchronisation.
Realistic lighting, backgrounds and movement.
Professional video editing and presentation.
Consistent voice and visual quality across all productions.

All content must comply with applicable platform policies and advertising requirements.

The presenter and generated scenes must be appropriately identified as fictional and AI-generated. Fictional qualifications, personal experiences, testimonials, trading results or financial claims must never be presented as genuine or independently verified.

All third-party assets, voices and software must have appropriate commercial usage permissions.

What to Include in Your Proposal

1. Portfolio

Examples of photorealistic AI avatar videos you have created.
Examples of the same character appearing consistently across multiple environments.
Examples demonstrating realistic facial movement and lip synchronisation.

2. Recommended Workflow

3. Pricing

Initial project: Master avatar, synthetic voice, 25 images and all three videos.

Please specify whether software subscriptions and AI generation credits are included or charged separately.

4. Delivery & Licensing

Expected monthly delivery schedule.
Number of revisions included.

Any licensing restrictions relating to AI tools, synthetic voices or generated content.
Ideal Freelancer

We are looking for a reliable specialist with demonstrable experience in photorealistic AI avatars, synthetic voice production, character consistency and professional video editing.

The ideal candidate should be able to deliver high-quality work consistently and support an ongoing monthly production schedule.

This project offers an initial paid development opportunity with the potential for a long-term monthly collaboration.

We’re looking for a skilled Video Editor & AI Creative Editor to join our growing e-commerce brand in the health & wellness niche.

Your main responsibility will be creating high-converting video ads for Facebook and Instagram, combining traditional video editing with AI-generated content.

We need someone who understands that a great ad isn't just about beautiful editing. It's about capturing attention in the first 3 seconds, keeping viewers engaged, and driving conversions.

This is a long-term opportunity with consistent work for the right person.

What You'll Be Doing

Edit short-form video ads (15–90 seconds) for Facebook and Instagram.

Turn raw UGC footage, product videos, images, scripts, and voiceovers into engaging advertisements.

Create AI-generated video scenes, realistic characters, product demonstrations, and B-roll.

Use AI tools to generate or enhance footage, images, voiceovers, and other creative assets.

Add engaging captions, transitions, sound effects, music, and visual storytelling elements.

Create multiple variations of winning ads by testing different hooks, visuals, and editing styles.

Replicate successful ad structures and editing styles from references while producing original creatives.

Combine AI-generated footage with real product footage for natural, believable advertisements.

Adapt videos for different formats (9:16, 4:5, and 1:1).

Requirements

Strong experience with Adobe Premiere Pro and/or After Effects.

Experience using AI video tools such as Kling AI, Runway, Veo, Higgsfield, or similar platforms.

Experience with AI image-generation tools.

Proven experience editing e-commerce and direct-response video ads.

Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, captions, B-roll, sound design, and storytelling.

Ability to produce realistic AI-generated footage that doesn't look obviously artificial.

Ability to follow creative briefs and reference videos accurately.

Ability to create different ad variations quickly and consistently.

Good communication, attention to detail, and reliable delivery.

Bonus: Experience editing health, wellness, pain-relief, or mobility product advertisements.

What We're Looking For

We don't want someone who simply puts clips together.

We want a creative video editor who understands advertising psychology and knows how to make videos that stop people from scrolling.

You should be comfortable working with both AI and traditional editing, finding suitable footage, creating visual concepts, and improving ads based on feedback.

We'll provide scripts, creative directions, product information, and references. We expect you to bring strong editing skills, creative thinking, and attention to detail.

What We Offer

Long-term collaboration with consistent projects.

Opportunity to work on multiple e-commerce products.

Clear creative briefs and references.

Regular opportunities to create and test new ad concepts.

Potential to take on more creative responsibilities as we grow.

How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

Your portfolio: Share your 3 best e-commerce video ads, preferably for Facebook or Instagram.

AI video examples: Show at least 1–2 video ads or scenes you've created using AI tools.

Tools: Which AI video and image-generation tools do you currently use?

Experience: Have you worked on direct-response e-commerce ads before?

Pricing: What is your rate per finished video ad (30–60 seconds)?

Availability: How many video ads can you realistically deliver per week?

Important: Start your proposal with the word "CREATIVE" so we know you've read the entire job description.

We're looking for someone who can become a reliable long-term creative partner, not just complete a one-time project.

If you have strong editing skills, understand performance advertising, and know how to use AI to produce great creatives, we'd love to see your work.

We are a swimwear brand looking for an experienced professional photo retoucher/editor to work with our campaign and product photography.

We are looking for someone who has experience with fashion, swimwear, beauty, or commercial photography and can produce polished, high-end images while still keeping them natural and realistic.

What we need:

* Professional, high-resolution retouching while maintaining the original image quality
* Natural skin retouching that preserves real skin texture — no overly smooth, plastic, blurred, or AI-looking skin
* Removal or softening of temporary blemishes, uneven tones, distracting shadows, etc.
* Overall cleanup and enhancement of the image without changing the model’s natural features or body
* Accurate swimsuit colors and fabric details — the product must remain true to life
* Color grading/filters that can be matched to our previous photo shoots so images from different shoots blend together cohesively on our website, social media, and advertising
* Ability to create a slightly moody/editorial campaign look without making the images too dark or altering the true colors of the swimwear
* Consistency across an entire batch of images
* Final files delivered in high resolution and suitable for website, social media, and paid advertising

Very important: We do not want the swimsuits themselves altered or regenerated. Prints, colors, fringe, crystals, hardware, stitching, texture, and other product details need to remain accurate.

We can provide examples from previous campaigns that show the exact editing/color-grading style we would like you to match.

Ongoing Work

We regularly shoot new collections, so we are looking for someone we can continue working with if the first project goes well. We may have larger batches of images at a time, so please let us know if you offer bulk/batch pricing.

When applying, please include examples of your fashion, swimwear, beauty, or commercial retouching work, particularly before-and-after examples showing natural skin retouching and color grading.

Please also include:

* Your price per image and/or bulk pricing
* Typical turnaround time
* Approximately how many images you can complete per week
* Whether you are comfortable matching an existing editing/color-grading style from reference photos

We are looking for quality and consistency rather than heavy editing. The finished images should look professionally photographed and retouched — not obviously edited.

We’re looking for an AI image creator with strong compositing and retouching skills to create photorealistic food and product lifestyle images for a new Hot Sauce brand (its a modern hipster brand) like Oatley or Grasa

The mood is warm, sun-kissed or flash-ligth and relaxed, like a real table at home or an independent deli or street-food spot. Think gently worn sage-green Formica, earthy accents, natural window light and freshly prepared food with a few crumbs or loose herbs.

Create one overhead and one front or slightly elevated image for each setup:

- Verde with kebab
- Rojo with chicken wings and sweet potato fries

Leave space for a text overlay in the overhead shots. In the front views, focus on the table, food and bottle, with the setting softly out of focus.

originalDescription.text:
Project Overview

We're seeking an experienced creative video producer and storyteller to help refine and complete a professional, conversion-focused marketing video (2 minutes or less) for an established company in the vacation rental property management industry.

This video will be featured prominently on our website alongside a lead-generation form. Its purpose is to communicate our competitive advantages, build credibility with prospective customers, and motivate them to request additional information.

This is not a project starting from scratch. We've already completed much of the groundwork, including a finalized narration script, a preliminary video edit assembled in CapCut, existing company-branded footage from previous productions, supplemental licensed stock footage, and an established marketing strategy with a clear conversion objective.

We need a creative professional who can take these materials, evaluate what we've developed, and transform them into a polished, cohesive, persuasive video.

What We're Looking For

We need someone who brings more than technical video editing skills. We're looking for a visual storyteller with creative direction and motion graphics experience who understands how to communicate business value through video.

Responsibilities will include reviewing our existing edit, narration, and footage; providing creative recommendations to improve storytelling, pacing, and visual sequencing; selecting and arranging footage to support the narration; and developing professional motion graphics, infographics, and on-screen text to communicate business advantages that cannot be illustrated effectively through conventional footage.

The freelancer will also refine transitions, color consistency, audio, and overall production quality to create a compelling final video with a clear call to action.

The finished video should feel like a professionally produced commercial, not simply a collection of stock footage paired with narration.

Our Expectations and Deliverables

We expect an initial creative review and recommendations, followed by a proposed visual direction or storyboard before major editing begins.

The final deliverable will be one professionally edited video, no longer than two minutes, incorporating custom motion graphics and infographics where appropriate.

The project should include consistent visual treatment across existing and supplemental footage, professional audio mixing, color correction, final production finishing, and two rounds of reasonable revisions.

We will require a final high-resolution MP4 optimized for website use, along with editable project files and any custom graphics created for the project.

Working Relationship

We value collaboration and creative input. Our internal project lead has developed the marketing strategy, written the narration, and assembled the initial video. We need someone who can bring the creative and technical expertise necessary to elevate that work.

We're looking for a professional who communicates clearly, offers thoughtful recommendations, respects deadlines, and is comfortable working collaboratively through feedback and revisions.

Our team is small, decisions are made directly, and we can provide timely feedback without multiple layers of approval.

Confidentiality

This project involves an established company and proprietary marketing materials. The company name and identifying details will remain confidential during initial candidate screening.

The selected freelancer must be willing to sign a mutual nondisclosure agreement (NDA) before receiving confidential project materials.

Budget and Timeline

This is a relatively small project with a limited budget. Because the script, source footage, and preliminary edit are already complete, we're looking for a cost-effective approach that builds on the existing work.

We're currently gathering proposals to understand realistic pricing and turnaround times.

Please provide your estimated fixed project price, anticipated turnaround time, and any assumptions about the scope of work.

When Applying

Please include two or three examples of relevant commercial or marketing videos you've produced, examples of motion graphics or infographics you've created, your estimated fixed-price quote and turnaround time, and confirmation that you're comfortable signing an NDA.

We look forward to finding a creative partner who can help bring this project to a professional finish.
