Upwork Job Posting: Expert AI Rendering Artist – Photorealistic Luxury Product & Lifestyle Scenes

Project Type: Freelance / Ongoing Opportunity
Experience Level: Expert
Industry: Luxury Outdoor Living, Architectural Design, Water & Fire Features

About Valyrian Designs

Valyrian Designs is a luxury outdoor living brand specializing in architectural water and fire features, including rain curtain fountains, reflection pools, sculptural fountains, fire tables, and contemporary outdoor fireplaces.

We are looking for a highly skilled AI Rendering Artist and Architectural Visualization Specialist to transform our existing product imagery into stunning, photorealistic lifestyle scenes for our website, marketing campaigns, and online stores.

Our goal is to elevate our visual presentation to reflect the sophistication of a premium architectural design brand.

Project Description

We need an AI imaging expert who can take our existing product photographs, 3D renderings, engineering drawings, and AI-generated product images and create exceptionally realistic scenes showing our products installed in beautiful luxury environments.

These images will replace older product imagery currently displayed on www.valyariandesigns.com.

Environments may include:

Luxury Malibu oceanfront residences

Palm Springs mid-century modern homes

Scottsdale and Paradise Valley desert estates

Modern California courtyards and gardens

High-end Florida waterfront properties

Luxury hotels, spas, and resorts

Contemporary architectural residential and commercial spaces

We want images that look like they were photographed by a professional architectural photographer — not obvious AI-generated images.

Critical Requirement: Product Accuracy

This is extremely important.

Our products have unique architectural shapes, proportions, finishes, and design details. The AI artist must preserve the original product design while creating completely new environments.

The product must not be redesigned or distorted.

You must be able to:

Maintain accurate product proportions, dimensions, and geometry.

Preserve original metal finishes, colors, and structural details.

Create realistic flowing water and fire effects.

Position products at believable scale within their environments.

Produce natural shadows, reflections, lighting, and perspective.

Maintain consistency across multiple scenes using the same product.

Work from product photographs, existing renderings, and AI-generated reference images.

Produce high-resolution landscape images suitable for luxury e-commerce and advertising.

Required Experience

We are seeking someone with advanced experience using professional AI image-generation and rendering platforms, such as:

Google Gemini / Nano Banana

Krea AI

Midjourney

Adobe Firefly / Photoshop

Stable Diffusion / ComfyUI

Other professional architectural visualization and AI rendering tools

You do not need to use every platform listed, but you must demonstrate exceptional results and have a reliable workflow for maintaining product consistency.

We are not looking for someone who simply types prompts into ChatGPT. We need a creative professional with strong architectural visualization skills, an understanding of luxury design, and the technical expertise to produce commercially usable images.

Scope of Work

Review our current website and identify product images that could be improved.

Work with our existing product images and design references.

Create photorealistic architectural lifestyle scenes for each selected product.

Develop multiple environments and camera compositions while maintaining product accuracy.

Present images for review and make requested revisions.

Deliver approved high-resolution images optimized for Shopify, Etsy, social media, and advertising.

Establish a consistent visual style across the Valyrian Designs product collection.

Deliverables

High-resolution, photorealistic lifestyle images

Landscape 16:9 compositions and appropriate website formats

Multiple luxury environments per product

Consistent product finishes and architectural details

Final optimized image files for website use

Organized source files and approved final images

Ideal Candidate

You have an exceptional eye for luxury architecture, landscape design, lighting, materials, and composition.

You understand that a premium product needs to look authentic, not artificially placed into a background.

Experience creating commercial imagery for luxury furniture, outdoor living brands, architectural products, or high-end real estate is highly desirable.

How to Apply

Please include the following in your proposal:

A portfolio showing your best photorealistic AI-generated architectural or product lifestyle scenes.

Before-and-after examples demonstrating how you transformed an existing product image into a realistic environment.

The AI platforms and workflow you use.

An explanation of how you maintain accurate product geometry and consistency across different scenes.

Your pricing structure per completed image or per product collection.

Your availability for ongoing projects.

Paid Test Project

We would like to begin with a paid test using one of our actual Valyrian Designs products.

You will be asked to create a luxury outdoor architectural scene while preserving the exact design and proportions of the original product.

Successful completion could lead to a larger project involving our full product collection and an ongoing working relationship.

Our objective is simple: create imagery so realistic and visually compelling that our customers believe the products were professionally photographed at luxury architectural properties.

Website: www.valyariandesigns.com

# 🎨 HIRING: Branded DTC Product Page Designer

📍 **Location:** Remote
🕒 **Job Type:** Full-Time (Contract or Permanent)

## About Us

We’re a fast-growing **direct-to-consumer brand** focused on building high-quality, branded ecommerce experiences.

We’re looking for someone who can create **beautiful, premium-looking product pages that are also designed to convert**.

We care about both sides: **strong branding + strong performance.**

## The Role

We’re hiring a **Branded Product Page Designer** who understands ecommerce, branding, and conversion-focused design.

You’ll be responsible for designing product pages that communicate the product's value clearly, build trust, tell a compelling story, and ultimately drive purchases.

You should have a strong eye for **layout, typography, imagery, color, hierarchy, and visual storytelling** — while understanding that a beautiful page means very little if it doesn't convert.

## What You'll Do

* Design premium, branded **DTC product pages**
* Create product page layouts that are visually compelling and conversion-focused
* Turn product research and marketing angles into strong visual sections
* Create product imagery, banners, comparison sections, feature sections, FAQs, social proof, and other PDP assets
* Develop a consistent visual identity across product pages
* Improve existing product pages based on conversion data and customer behavior
* Work closely with copywriters and creative strategists to bring marketing concepts to life
* Research competitors and identify opportunities to make our product pages stand out
* Create mobile-first designs that look great across devices
* Continuously test different layouts, visuals, sections, and messaging

## You Should Have

* Proven experience designing **DTC / ecommerce product pages**
* A strong portfolio showing **branded ecommerce websites or product pages**
* Excellent understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, composition, and branding
* Strong understanding of **conversion-focused ecommerce design**
* Experience with Shopify or similar ecommerce platforms
* Strong skills in Figma, Photoshop, Canva, or similar design tools
* Ability to create premium-looking visuals without making pages feel cluttered
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to work quickly and handle multiple products/pages

### BIG PLUS:

* Experience working with successful DTC brands
* Experience designing for **beauty, fashion, wellness, kids, or lifestyle products**
* Understanding of direct-response marketing
* Experience designing advertorials, landing pages, and sales funnels
* Experience using AI tools for product imagery and creative production
* Ability to take a product from **research → positioning → copy → design → finished PDP**

## What We're Looking For

We are **NOT** looking for someone who simply knows how to make a Shopify page look pretty.

We want someone who understands:

**Why will someone buy this product?**
**What needs to be communicated above the fold?**
**What objections need to be addressed?**
**How should the page visually tell the product's story?**
**How do we make the product feel like a real brand rather than another generic ecommerce product?**

If you understand both **design and conversion**, we'd love to hear from you.

## How to Apply

Please send us:

1. **Your portfolio** with examples of DTC/ecommerce product pages you've designed.
2. **2–3 product pages you're most proud of** and briefly explain what you contributed.

Needs to hire 20 Freelancers
Summary
Tourific AI is hiring travel content creators to produce short-form video guides for our app. We need creators who know their city inside out - the spots tourists miss, the places locals actually go, the tips that make a trip go from good to unforgettable.

This job is for city-focused content. If you live in or have recently visited any of the cities listed below, we need your perspective on the places that matter most.

Only apply if you're confident you can create content that matches or exceeds our standard.

💵 The Deal

$1.25 per approved clip
$1000 total budget - once it's allocated, the program closes
All payments handled via Upwork milestones - no exceptions

🎬 What We Need You to Create

Each clip should be 20 to 25 seconds. No exceptions on the upper limit - anything over 25 seconds will not be reviewed. One place per clip. You talking about it - voiceover or on-camera. Think local knowledge, not tourist brochure.

We need clips covering restaurants, street food spots, museums, galleries, hiking trails, markets, viewpoints, neighborhoods, beaches, nightlife spots, cultural experiences, hidden gems - anything a first-time visitor would benefit from knowing.

The vibe: "Everyone goes to the Louvre but Musée de l'Orangerie across the Tuileries has Monet's Water Lilies in two oval rooms with zero crowds - same ticket price, tenth of the wait."
Or: "Bukchon Hanok Village in Seoul is packed by noon. Come at 7am, the alley cats are out, the light is perfect, and you'll have the whole street to yourself for photos."

What gets approved:

A specific, real place you've personally been to - a restaurant, museum, trail, gallery, market, beach, anything
useful details - a tip, a warning, a hack, a reason to go or skip
Voiceover or on-camera narration - this is required, not optional
Good energy and a genuine feel - polished isn't the goal, helpful is

What doesn't get approved:

Drone reels or scenic montages with no narration
Multi-location highlight reels
Music-only edits without voiceover
Clips under 20 seconds or over 25 seconds
Content you didn't create yourself
AI-generated, stock, or third-party material
Locations already well-covered on our platform

🗺️ Cities We're Hiring For

We need local-knowledge content from the following cities.

🇫🇷 France
Nice, Marseille, Lyon, Bordeaux, Mont Saint-Michel, Strasbourg, Chamonix, Avignon, Cannes, Provence (Gordes, Roussillon, Valensole)

🇺🇸 USA
Chicago, Seattle, Portland, Austin, Denver, Savannah, Charleston, San Antonio, Honolulu, Maui, Kauai, Sedona, Moab, Yellowstone, Glacier National Park

🇨🇦 Canada

originalDescription.text:
**Experience Level: Expert  
**Project Type: Fixed Price  
**Video Length: 60–90 seconds  
**Format: 16:9 Landscape

PROJECT DESCRIPTION

Seeking an experienced AI video animator and cinematic motion graphics specialist to produce a high-quality, visually compelling promotional video incorporating AI-generated footage, advanced visual effects, and sophisticated storytelling.

The production requires realistic character consistency, seamless compositing, dimensional photo animation, and cinematic transitions. The finished video must reflect the quality of a professional brand commercial or film trailer, not a traditional slideshow or template-based video.

A key animation requirement involves framed photographs transitioning realistically from an architectural background into the foreground, enlarging smoothly, holding briefly, and fading away while the underlying footage continues uninterrupted.

This effect may require 2.5D/3D animation, masking, motion tracking, and advanced compositing.

Existing visual assets will be provided. The selected freelancer must be capable of integrating and enhancing these materials while maintaining a consistent, photorealistic appearance.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Applicants must have proven experience producing cinematic AI-generated videos and professional promotional commercials, including advanced motion graphics, visual effects, compositing, 2.5D/3D animation, object movement, masking, and motion tracking.

Experience with realistic human animation, consistent facial likeness and proportions, professional video editing, color grading, audio synchronization, and cinematic transitions is essential.

Proficiency with Adobe After Effects, Blender, DaVinci Resolve, Runway, or comparable professional tools is preferred.

MANDATORY PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENT

**Applicants MUST provide at least two completed video examples demonstrating comparable cinematic animation or advanced visual effects.**

Preference will be given to applicants who can demonstrate dimensional photo animation, objects moving realistically within video scenes, and professional cinematic compositing.

Please provide direct links to completed videos and describe your specific contributions.

Applicants without relevant completed work will not be considered.

PROJECT DELIVERABLES

The selected freelancer will produce one professionally edited 90-second promotional video in high-resolution 16:9 MP4 format (minimum 1080p).

The completed production must include advanced cinematic animation and visual effects, professional audio synchronization, transitions, color grading, and two rounds of reasonable revisions.

Editable source/project files and appropriate commercial usage rights for all delivered materials are required.

SELECTION PROCESS

Qualified candidates will be evaluated based on portfolio quality, demonstrated experience, technical approach, communication, proposed budget, and production timeline.

The preferred candidate must be willing to complete a short, paid proof-of-concept animation demonstrating the primary visual effect before proceeding with the full production.

The complete creative concept, script, and confidential project details will be shared only with shortlisted candidates under appropriate confidentiality arrangements.

**Only experienced professionals with demonstrable expertise in cinematic AI video production and advanced animation should apply.**

originalDescription.text:
We're Fido, an early-stage startup building an AI device that trains your dog while you're at work. It gives a command like "Sit," uses computer vision to check whether the dog did it, and rewards it with a treat.

We're pitching to VCs on November 20 and need a polished 45–60 second AI-generated concept commercial to open the presentation. The story and shot list are written and our brand assets are ready. We need someone with a strong eye who can make it look and feel like a real product launch spot.

The story (already scripted):
1. Dog's-eye view: a dog alone at home sniffs around and chews the couch.
2. The device calls her name ("Maggie!") and her head snaps around.
3. Slow-motion run to the device, fur and ears flowing.
4. "Sit, Maggie." Suspense as she tilts her head, then sits.
5. A treat dispenses: "Good girl, Maggie!"
6. The owner at work in busy San Francisco office gets a phone notification ("Maggie is being a good girl 😄 I may have just saved you a couch cushion or two"), smiles, and goes back to work.
7. Tagline card, then the owner comes home to Biscuit waiting patiently.
8. Fido end card.

What we'll give you:
- A shot-by-shot prompt list and a timing reference cut
- Product concept renders (the device design)
- Brand fonts, colors and logo, plus the notification and end-card graphics

What we need from you:
- One finished 16:9 commercial (1080p or higher), 45–60 seconds, plus a 9:16 cut for social
- An original AI dog character that stays consistent in every shot. She must not resemble any real person's pet, and we'll approve the character design before you generate the full spot.
- A consistent device that matches our renders
- Voiceover for the device's lines (warm, friendly voice)
- Licensed music and sound design: a suspense build into an upbeat payoff
- Color grade and edit pacing that feels like an Apple or Google product spot
- Final project files and the raw generated clips

Must-have: the end card has to carry a visible "AI-generated concept film" label. We're showing it to investors and won't present AI footage as the real product.

Timeline:
- Dog character look by Nov 17
- First cut by Nov 18
- Final by Nov 19, end of day PT
- One or two rounds of revisions

To apply, please include:
1. Links to 2–3 AI videos you've made, ideally product demos or commercials with consistent characters across shots
2. Which tools you'd use (e.g. Veo, Kling, Runway, Seedance, Sora, Higgsfield) and how you keep a character consistent between shots
3. Confirmation you can hit the dates above
4. Start your reply with the word "Biscuit" so we know you read this

4. Brand Consistency

Required Qualifications

What you’ll do:

7. Deliver final files to 3 local broadcast stations and our CTV vendor, and send the social versions directly to us

What we’ll provide: B-roll footage, approved scripts, music, voiceover, brand guidelines, logo files and station spec sheets.

Timeline: First cuts by December 14, final delivery by December 28. Spots go on air in January.

Budget: Hourly, $20–50/hr. Please include your rate and estimated total hours in your proposal.

4. Can turn things around quickly and take feedback well

Please include samples of your work:

- Examples of AI footage you’ve created, ideally mixed with real footage
- Any vertical/social cutdowns you’ve made from a longer spot

Please answer these in your proposal:

originalDescription.text:
The skip button is the most honest critic in advertising. We need an editor who beats it.

EETHR is a brand cinema studio founded by Michael-Ryan Fletchall, an Emmy-nominated filmmaker with three decades behind the camera. We make films and series that audiences choose to watch, for our own channels and for our clients. Our line is Human Taste. Machine Scale. The craft stays human, and a production system we built ourselves lets us move faster than the old model allows.

We are looking for one editor who thinks like a film editor and a social editor at the same time. You know why a cut lands. You also know why someone stops scrolling in the first second, and why they stay to the last frame.

What you will cut:

• EETHR originals: Flowstate, the studio's flagship series; AI.rchives, history's documents brought to the screen; The Site Tour That Sells Itself; and the films for our new website.
• Hollywood Expat: a filmmaker's channel about craft, sets and life behind the camera.
• Client work: brand films, episodic vertical series (60 to 120 second episodes that end on a hook), and location and property films.
• From every long piece: the master, plus 15, 30 and 60 second cutdowns and vertical edits for Reels, TikTok, Shorts and LinkedIn. One shoot becomes many pieces, and none of them should feel like leftovers.

What great looks like here:

• Story first. You find the moment, build the arc and cut for emotion and rhythm, not for coverage.
• A hook and a reason to stay. You think in retention: the first second, the pattern break, the payoff, the loop back to the start.
• Platform fluency. Safe zones, caption styles, aspect ratios, first frames that work as thumbnails, and how each platform reads watch time, rewatches, shares and saves. You keep up as those rules change, and you tell us when they do.
• Sound matters to you. Music edits that breathe, sound design that sells the picture, dialogue that is clean and clear.
• Picture with taste. You can grade, or you know how to stay inside a grade someone else set.
• You work inside a brand system. Our opens, transitions, lower thirds and type rules are already built. You apply them with judgment, and you know when to leave them out.
• Smart with AI tools. You use them where they save time, never where they cost taste.
• You read the results. After a piece goes out, you look at how it performed and bring ideas to the next cut.

Tools:

DaVinci Resolve, FCP, or Premiere Pro (tell us which is home). After Effects or Fusion is a plus. Reviews happen in Frame.io with timecoded notes, and footage arrives through shared cloud storage.

How we work:

• Remote, with some working hours that overlap US Mountain Time.
• It starts with a paid test edit for a short list of editors. Then a paid trial month. Then an ongoing role for the right person, with volume growing as client work grows.
• Clear briefs, a set number of revision rounds and turnaround agreed before each job starts.
• English is required. Dutch is a plus, since the studio works from Denver and Amsterdam.

How to apply:

1.  Start your proposal with the last film or series that made you forget you were watching an edit, and one line on why.
2.  Share two or three links to work you personally cut: at least one cinematic piece (film, documentary, commercial or series) and at least one short-form vertical piece. Tell us your role on each and, where you can share them, the results.
3.  Answer the screening questions.
4.  Give your rate (hourly, or per short-form piece and per finished minute of long-form), your weekly availability and your time zone.

We read every proposal. Copy and paste proposals will not make the short list.

originalDescription.text:
Cinematic Video Editor Needed — Exclusive Alaska Wilderness Camp Buyout & Group Adventure Campaign

Project Type:** Fixed Price  
Budget:** $300–$450 (negotiable depending on experience)  
Timeline:** Approximately 10–14 days  
Potential for Ongoing Work:** Yes

About Alaska Trophy Fishing Safaris

Alaska Trophy Fishing Safaris (ATFS) is a remote wilderness fishing camp located along Alaska's Mulchatna River. Established in 1973, our camp offers authentic, guided Alaska fishing adventures in an extraordinary and secluded wilderness setting.

We provide a truly all-inclusive experience beginning in Anchorage, including regional air transportation, round-trip floatplane transfers, two hotel nights in Anchorage, wilderness accommodations, meals, guided fishing, fishing equipment, and staff gratuities.

We are developing a premium marketing campaign promoting exclusive private camp buyouts for groups of approximately 16–20 guests.

Our goal is to attract groups seeking a once-in-a-lifetime adventure together, including:

- Families planning extraordinary multigenerational vacations or reunions.
- Groups of friends looking for an unforgettable fishing adventure.
- Business owners entertaining valued clients or business partners.
- Companies rewarding employees or organizing leadership retreats.
- Private clubs, fishing groups, and organizations arranging exclusive trips.
- Groups celebrating milestone birthdays, anniversaries, retirements, or other special occasions.

These are premium experiences representing a significant financial investment, so our marketing must appeal to individuals and groups who appreciate exclusivity, adventure, personalized service, and the value of creating lasting memories.

Project Objective

We are looking for a highly creative and experienced video editor who can transform our existing collection of real photographs and video footage into a **cinematic, emotionally compelling promotional film**.

This is not intended to be a typical fishing advertisement or a corporate retreat commercial.

We want to capture the feeling of gathering your favorite people and taking them somewhere truly extraordinary—deep into the Alaska wilderness, where the entire fishing camp is reserved exclusively for your group.

The video should make viewers imagine themselves experiencing Alaska with their family, friends, colleagues, or valued clients.

The central message is:

YOUR PEOPLE. YOUR CAMP. YOUR ALASKA.

An exclusive wilderness experience, shared with the people who matter most.

Target Audience

Our ideal customers are individuals, families, groups, and organizations with the financial ability to reserve a premium private wilderness experience.

The video should appeal to affluent travelers and serious outdoor enthusiasts, while remaining welcoming, authentic, and emotionally engaging.

We do not want to focus exclusively on corporate audiences, nor should the video feel overly formal or business-oriented.

Instead, the story should emphasize the universal appeal of sharing an extraordinary adventure with a group of people who already have a meaningful connection.

Creative Direction

We want the finished video to feel like a high-end adventure travel documentary.

Overall tone:

- Cinematic, breathtaking, and visually captivating.
- Premium and exclusive without feeling pretentious.
- Authentic, warm, and emotionally engaging.
- Adventurous, inspiring, and memorable.
- Focused on the wilderness, fishing, relationships, and shared experiences.

The video should balance the excitement of fishing with the beauty of Alaska, the exclusivity of the camp, and the joy of spending time together.

We want viewers to feel that this is something far more meaningful than an ordinary vacation.

Footage & Photography

We have a collection of authentic photos and videos stored in Google Photos, including:

- Breathtaking Alaska wilderness scenery.
- Floatplane transportation and arrivals.
- Fishing adventures, large fish, and guest experiences.
- Boats traveling along the river.
- Guides assisting guests.
- Camp accommodations and common areas.
- Meals, dining, and hospitality.
- Groups spending time together.
- Wildlife and natural surroundings.

We will provide access to approved, project-specific Google Photos albums or downloadable folders.

**An essential part of this assignment is reviewing our footage, identifying the strongest moments, and selecting the clips that best tell the story.**

We are not looking for someone who simply assembles a handful of preselected clips.

The editor should be comfortable organizing a large media library, identifying compelling visuals, and developing a cohesive narrative.

The finished video should primarily use our authentic footage. AI-generated fishing scenes, fictional guest experiences, and visuals that misrepresent our camp are not permitted.

Primary Deliverable: 60–75 Second Cinematic Promotional Film

Suggested Storyline

**Scene 1 — The Invitation (0–10 seconds)**

Open with spectacular footage of Alaska's vast wilderness, rivers, and remote landscape.

Suggested voiceover:

"Some of life's greatest adventures aren't about where you go. They're about who you share them with."

Establish a sense of wonder, exclusivity, and anticipation.

**Scene 2 — The Journey (10–20 seconds)**

Show floatplanes, remote waterways, and guests traveling into the wilderness.

Suggested voiceover:

"Imagine bringing your favorite people to a place few will ever experience."

The visuals should communicate that the journey itself is part of the adventure.

**Scene 3 — Your Private Camp (20–32 seconds)**

Introduce the camp, accommodations, and private wilderness setting.

Suggested voiceover:

"At Alaska Trophy Fishing Safaris, you can reserve an entire remote Alaska fishing camp exclusively for your group."

On-screen text:

YOUR PEOPLE. YOUR CAMP. YOUR ALASKA.

**Scene 4 — The Adventure (32–47 seconds)**

Show dramatic fishing footage, large catches, guides, boats, and genuine guest reactions.

Suggested voiceover:

"Spend your days exploring incredible waters, experiencing extraordinary fishing, and creating stories you'll tell for years."

**Scene 5 — The Memories (47–57 seconds)**

Transition to footage of guests enjoying meals, laughing, sharing stories, and spending time together.

Suggested voiceover:

"And when the day is done, it's the moments together that make the experience unforgettable."

**Scene 6 — The All-Inclusive Experience (57–66 seconds)**

Show floatplane transportation, meals, camp accommodations, and guides.

Suggested voiceover:

"From Anchorage to the wilderness and back, we handle the details so you can focus on the adventure."

**Scene 7 — The Invitation to Book (66–75 seconds)**

Finish with breathtaking scenery, a memorable fishing moment, and the Alaska Trophy Fishing Safaris logo.

Suggested closing voiceover:

"Alaska Trophy Fishing Safaris. Your people. Your camp. Your Alaska."

On-screen text:

EXCLUSIVE PRIVATE CAMP BUYOUTS

GROUPS OF 16–20 GUESTS

www.alaskatrophyfishingsafaris.com

Call to Action: Plan Your Private Alaska Adventure

The script is a creative starting point. We welcome suggestions from an experienced editor who can strengthen the storytelling and emotional impact.

Video Editing Requirements

**Visual Style**

- Professional cinematic editing and color grading.
- Breathtaking wilderness footage.
- Authentic fishing action and guest interactions.
- Smooth, sophisticated transitions.
- Natural pacing that allows important moments to breathe.
- A strong emotional progression from anticipation to adventure to shared memories.

**Music & Audio**

- Professionally licensed cinematic background music.
- An emotional build that complements the visuals.
- Warm, confident, professional voiceover.
- Natural sounds from the camp and wilderness where appropriate.
- Professional sound mixing.

**Branding**

- Minimal, elegant text overlays.
- Tasteful integration of our logo.
- Consistent typography and visual presentation.
- Clear website and call to action.
- Subtitles or captions.

**Technical Requirements**

- Primary video: 16:9 horizontal, minimum 1920 × 1080.
- 4K preferred when supported by source footage.
- MP4 delivery.
- Suitable for our website, YouTube, social media, and direct marketing.
- No watermarks.
- Commercial usage rights for all licensed music, voiceovers, and other third-party assets.

Additional Deliverables After This

Please include pricing for:

1. One 60–75-second cinematic flagship promotional film.
2. One 30-second vertical advertisement for Facebook and Instagram.
3. One 15-second vertical advertisement for Reels and short-form campaigns.
4. Two alternative opening hooks for advertising tests.
5. A captioned version suitable for viewers watching without sound.
6. Editable project files and final exported videos.

I am looking for an experienced documentary editor to turn approximately three hours of preselected footage from an African off-road expedition into:

- A polished 30–35-minute main film
- A separate 90-second cinematic trailer

The footage is already organised chronologically in Adobe Premiere Pro across seven chapter sequences, with markers and background notes. It includes DJI action-camera, drone and handheld footage.

Style

The film should feel like an authentic cinematic action-adventure documentary, balancing:
- Difficult off-road driving and water crossings
- Vehicles getting stuck, towing and recoveries
- Wildlife and remote landscapes
- Drone footage showing scale and isolation
- Teamwork, humour and genuine reactions
- Quieter atmospheric moments

Action scenes should preserve the approach, challenge, peak action, outcome and reactions. I do not want excessive transitions, artificial speed effects, generic YouTube editing or manufactured drama.

The trailer should feature the strongest action, scenery, wildlife and human moments without revealing every major event.

Required work

Final story structure and pacing

- 30–35-minute main film
- 90-second trailer
- Licensed music selection
- Natural-sound editing and professional audio mix
- Colour correction and consistent cinematic grade
- Reframing of action-camera and drone footage where required
- Simple animated route map shown with each chapter title
- One substantial revision round plus final minor corrections
- High-quality master and 1080p exports
- Organised, relinkable Premiere project with all licences and graphic assets

The route map should show the overall journey, progress completed and the location of each chapter. A clean 2D animation is sufficient; I will provide the route information.

Timeline and budget

The complete project must be delivered within four weeks:

- First complete cut within 10–14 days
- Revised cut during week three
- Final film and trailer by the end of week four

Fixed-price budget: $1,200–$1,800.

The listed $1,800 is the maximum budget for the full scope. Please provide an all-inclusive price and clearly state what it covers.

Requirements

- Strong documentary, adventure, automotive or travel portfolio
- Excellent long-form storytelling and pacing
- Adobe Premiere Pro compatible with Premiere 27
- Professional sound and colour-grading skills
- Experience with action-camera and drone footage
- Ability to create clean route-map graphics
- Sufficient storage and internet capacity for a large 4K project
- Reliable four-week availability

All footage is private and may not be shared or used in a portfolio without written permission.

Shortlisted candidates may be offered a small paid test edit using 5–8 minutes of supplied footage.

To apply

Please provide:

- Two relevant complete scenes or longer-film examples and explain your role.
- An example of a route map or similar graphic, if available.
- Your proposed fixed price and included revisions.
- Your Premiere version and technical setup.
- Confirmation that you can complete everything within four weeks.

Begin your proposal with “Okavango documentary.”

Job Type: Freelance / Ongoing Opportunity
Industry: Fashion, Apparel & E-Commerce
Experience Level: Expert

Job Description

We are a professional fashion photography studio looking for a highly skilled AI Image Generation Specialist to help us create photorealistic fashion and apparel imagery.

We are looking for someone with a strong creative eye, an understanding of fashion photography, and advanced experience using AI tools to generate images that look indistinguishable from professional photography.

This is an opportunity for ongoing work as we expand our AI-generated fashion photography services.

Responsibilities

- Generate photorealistic fashion images using AI.
- Transform existing studio e-commerce photographs into high-end editorial and lifestyle imagery.
- Replace or generate backgrounds while preserving the original photographed model and clothing.
- Maintain accurate clothing details, including fabric, texture, color, fit, patterns, and construction.
- Create realistic environments with natural lighting, shadows, and perspective.
- Ensure consistency and professional commercial image quality.
- Edit and refine AI-generated imagery to achieve seamless, realistic results.

Requirements

- Proven experience in AI fashion image generation and background replacement.
- Advanced knowledge of AI tools such as ComfyUI, FLUX, Stable Diffusion, or similar platforms.
- Strong Photoshop and image-editing skills.
- Understanding of fashion photography, lighting, composition, and retouching.
- Ability to preserve the original model and garment without AI altering any details.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Ability to deliver high-resolution, commercially usable images.

Required One-Image Test

As part of the application process, we require candidates to complete one image test to demonstrate their capabilities.

We will provide an original, professionally photographed in-studio e-commerce image featuring a model wearing an outfit.

Your task is to transform the image by replacing ONLY the background with a realistic, high-end editorial or lifestyle environment.

CRITICAL REQUIREMENT:

The original model and outfit must remain 100% identical to the source photograph.

- Do not change the model's face, hair, body, skin, or pose.
- Do not alter the clothing in any way, including its color, fabric, texture, shape, fit, stitching, or details.
- Do not regenerate or reinterpret the model or garment.
- Only the background and its integration into the photograph may be modified.
- Lighting, shadows, and environmental blending must look completely natural and professionally executed.

The final result should look as though the original model was photographed in the new environment, with absolutely no visible AI alterations to the model or clothing.

Precision is essential. We are specifically looking for someone who can use AI to enhance and transform fashion photography without compromising the integrity of the original product or model.

How to Apply

Please submit:

1. A portfolio of photorealistic AI fashion or apparel imagery.
2. Examples of original photographs transformed using AI, ideally showing before-and-after results.
3. The AI tools and workflows you use.
4. Your experience preserving original models and garments during AI background generation.
5. Your availability for ongoing projects.

Please only apply if you have experience with photorealistic AI fashion imagery and precise background replacement.

We are looking for someone with exceptional attention to detail who can help us deliver high-end, commercially ready imagery for fashion brands.

originalDescription.text:
Cinematic Video Editor / Motion Graphics Artist:
52 Second Social Media Reel

Project Overview

We're a growing communications and marketing agency looking for a talented video editor to create a high-impact, cinematic 52-second social media reel.

This is an initial paid project with the potential for ongoing video editing work as we expand our production team.

We're looking for someone who understands cinematic storytelling, creative transitions, motion graphics, visual effects, and how to build emotion and energy through editing.

The Creative Concept

The video tells a story of reflection, memories, anticipation, and ultimately taking action.

Scene 1 — Anticipation

The video opens with a dramatic close-up of a man's face/eyes in a dark, cinematic environment. He's focused, almost meditating, as though waiting for the signal to take action.

The camera slowly pulls backward, revealing more of the scene.

Scene 2 — The Memories

As the camera pulls back, video clips from his previous sales offices begin appearing around him, representing memories of his journey.

We want these memories creatively integrated into the footage through layering, compositing, transitions, or other cinematic techniques.

The music and visual intensity gradually build throughout this sequence.

Scene 3 — The Finale

The sequence builds toward a powerful musical climax, with increasingly energetic visuals, impactful transitions, and a final moment that communicates: It's time to GO.

The overall feeling should be motivational, emotional, cinematic, and exciting.

Footage & Materials

- Main close-up/pullback footage will be provided.
- Additional video clips representing memories will be provided.
- Music & timing reference and creative direction will be provided.
- No filming is required.

Deliverables

- One completed cinematic video, approximately 52 seconds.
- Vertical 9:16 format, 1080 × 1920 minimum.
- Professional editing, color grading, transitions, motion graphics, and visual effects appropriate to the concept.
- Sound design and synchronization to the provided music timing reference.
- A final version without embedded copyrighted commercial music.
- One consolidated revision round.
- Final MP4 suitable for Instagram Reels and other social platforms.
- Commercial usage rights for the original editing and effects.

Budget & Timeline

Our target budget is $65 fixed price, with some flexibility depending on experience, portfolio quality, and the proposed creative approach.

Preferred turnaround: up to 5 days after receiving all footage and confirming the creative direction.

We're open to creative approaches that achieve the desired cinematic effect efficiently within budget.

Potential for Ongoing Work

We're seeking a couple reliable editors for recurring agency projects, including social media reels, promotional videos, and more advanced cinematic content.

We're especially interested in someone who communicates well, consistently meets deadlines, and can maintain professional quality across multiple projects.

To Apply

Please include:

1. A link to one or two examples of your own cinematic editing or motion graphics work, preferably involving compositing or layered visual effects.
2. A brief explanation of how you would approach the memory sequence in this video.
3. Your proposed fixed price and turnaround time.
4. Confirmation that you're comfortable with one revision round and providing a clean review draft for agency client feedback.

Please start your proposal with "CINEMATIC" so we know you've read the full description.

We're excited to find a talented editor for this project and potentially build a long-term working relationship.

originalDescription.text:
We’re seeking a video creator, AI video specialist, and editor to produce one approximately 7-minute science explainer for YouTube. It should turn scientific concepts into clear, engaging stories with the feel of a professionally produced science documentary, combining cinematic AI-generated footage, realistic visuals, 3D scientific animation, motion graphics, sound design, and human, not AI-generated, English narration.

This paid test project is intended to explore a longer-term collaboration. The engagement is a trial followed by ongoing work.

Production Scope:
* Generate cinematic scene reference images, including AI human models or cartoon animations wherever applicable, and animate them into realistic clips with consistent visuals and natural camera movement.
* Create scientifically accurate 3D visualisations, diagrams, transitions, labels, comparisons, and motion graphics to clarify complex concepts.
* Edit the footage into a cohesive video, syncing visuals to narration and maintaining engaging pacing.
* Use a human English voiceover, supported by suitable music, clear narration, realistic sound effects, ambient audio, and polished audio mixing.

I will provide the script, scene-by-scene instructions, visual consistency guidelines, research references, scientific explanations, and editing and storytelling directions.

Visual Direction:
Aim for a cinematic, photorealistic science-documentary look, combining realistic visuals and AI-generated footage with 3D scientific animation and motion graphics. Use realistic lighting, textures, depth, natural camera movement, consistent visuals, bright professional colour grading, and smooth transitions between footage and visualisations. The result should feel like a polished documentary, not a slideshow or static AI images with simple zooms.

Video Style & Deliverables
Deliver one complete, approximately 7-minute YouTube video in 16:9 format, preferably 4K (3,840 × 2,160 pixels) where practical, at 24 or 30 fps. Include the production-ready export, editable project/source files, and relevant production assets. A YouTube thumbnail may be included if agreed in scope.

originalDescription.text:
We're an e-commerce brand spending our own budget on video ads across Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. We're looking for creators who master AI video tools and can turn them into short ads that stop the scroll and sell.

• Create 15 to 60 second vertical ads (9:16) mixing AI-generated scenes, AI voice-over and our real product footage

• Produce several variations of the angles our ad tests have already proven

• A shared library of real product footage and images
• The winning angles and examples of our best-performing ads
• A dashboard where you can follow your videos' results

How you get paid (all through Upwork):
• A fixed price for each approved video
• A performance bonus of 3% of the sales your ad generates, paid as an Upwork bonus for as long as the ad runs

Requirements:
• Proven experience creating ads or short-form videos with AI tools (please share 2 to 3 examples)
• Strong editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar)
• Realistic results: natural hands, faces and product details, with no obvious AI glitches
• Good sense of pacing and hooks for TikTok and Reels

To apply, list the AI tools you use and send links to 2 to 3 videos you've made with them. Start your proposal with the word "WEAVER" so we know you read the post.

originalDescription.text:
We’re an 8-figure DTC (direct-to-consumer) brand building products that genuinely improve women’s daily comfort and quality of life.

We’re looking for a highly skilled, fast-movin Video Editor to join our team full-time and help us scale winning ads across Meta and beyond.

This isn't a typical editing role. We're looking for someone who understands direct response advertising, knows how to hook attention within the first 2–3 seconds, and can turn scripts and AI workflows into ads that drive real performance.

The Role

As our Video Editor, you'll be responsible for producing and iterating high-converting short-form ads using AI.

You'll work closely with our Creative Strategists and Scriptwriters, but we also expect you to think creatively yourself—bringing new ideas, improving concepts, and helping shape how our ads evolve over time.

What You’ll Do

- Edit high-performing short-form AI ads for Meta
- Use AI tools such as ElevenLabs, Higgsfield, Weave, HeyGen etc. to produce high quality AI concepts
- Craft strong visual hooks, pacing, and emotional flow
- Collaborate closely with strategists to bring scripts and concepts to life
- Contribute your own creative ideas
- Study what’s working in performance data and help iterate ads accordingly
- Stay on top of trends, formats, and editing styles relevant to direct response
- Help ensure consistent creative output across campaigns, avatars, and products

What We’re Looking For

- Proven experience editing short-form ads for DTC / ecommerce brands
- Strong understanding of direct response advertising (hooks, retention, emotional triggers, CTAs)
- Portfolio that demonstrates performance-driven work, not just pretty edits
- Excellent sense of pacing, storytelling, and mobile-first design
- Comfortable working fast without sacrificing quality
- Creative thinker who can contribute ideas, not just execute instructions
- Open to feedback, iteration, and continuous improvement
- Organised, reliable, and comfortable working in a fast-moving team environment
- Experience with AI workflows (or willingness to master them quickly)

Work Structure & Compensation

- $3000 per month (depending on experience)
- Attractive performance bonuses
- 35+ hours per week
- Fully remote
- You must be available to work exclusively with us (this is not a role for someone juggling multiple clients)
- Long-term opportunity with room for growth

To show you've read the entire job post, begin your application with the word "EDITOR".

originalDescription.text:
We're a growing UK-based e-commerce brand specialising in dog training products, including dog leads and dog training accessories.

We advertise heavily on Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and are looking for a talented, performance-focused Graphic Designer & AI Video Creative Specialist to join us on a long-term contract.

Our goal is to significantly increase our creative testing volume, develop more winning ads and scale our advertising profitably.

We're not looking for someone who simply makes attractive graphics. We need someone who understands direct-response advertising and creates content designed to convert.

What You'll Be Responsible For

1. Static Ad Creatives – 40 Per Week

Create high-converting static ads for Facebook and Instagram.

Develop new creative angles, hooks and concepts.

Produce variations of our existing winning ads for split testing.

Design product-focused, problem/solution, testimonial, comparison and promotional creatives.

Use AI image generation where appropriate to increase creative output.

Continuously improve designs based on advertising performance data.

2. Video Ad Creatives – 20 Per Week

Create new video advertisements using existing UGC and product footage.

Produce multiple variations of successful ads by testing different hooks, openings, messaging, captions and editing styles.

Generate entirely new video concepts using AI video tools such as Higgsfield, Runway, Kling or similar.

Develop engaging direct-response video ads designed for Meta placements.

Repurpose existing footage into fresh creative concepts.

Experiment with AI-generated UGC-style content, storytelling and problem/solution advertising.

3. Creative Testing & Development

You'll work directly with the business owner, who personally manages our Meta advertising.

We will provide:

Monthly creative direction and priorities.

Internal Meta advertising performance data.

Examples of our highest-performing creatives.

Existing UGC footage, product imagery and brand assets.

Insights into winning hooks, messaging, formats and customer pain points.

Your role will be to turn these insights into fresh advertising concepts, develop variations of proven winners and proactively suggest new creative testing opportunities.

Weekly Deliverables

40 static ad creatives

20 video ad creatives

A combination of new concepts and variations of proven winning ads.

Organised creative files ready to upload directly into Meta Ads Manager.

Consistent turnaround times and reliable communication.

Who We're Looking For

Essential Requirements:

Proven experience creating Meta advertising creatives for e-commerce or DTC brands.

Strong graphic design skills, particularly for conversion-focused static ads.

Excellent short-form video editing skills.

Experience with AI image and video generation tools.

Understanding of direct-response marketing, hooks, customer pain points and creative testing.

Ability to work independently and consistently meet weekly deadlines.

Comfortable working with performance data and using insights to improve creatives.

Bonus Skills:

Experience with Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, Midjourney or similar AI tools.

Experience creating and editing UGC-style advertising.

Understanding of Meta Ads performance metrics such as CPA, CTR, ROAS and creative fatigue.

Experience advertising pet products or other consumer e-commerce products.

Ability to develop creative strategies and suggest new angles independently.

What We Offer

We're looking to build a long-term working relationship with the right person.

You'll work directly with the owner and media buyer, with access to real advertising performance data to understand what's working and why.

We have an established brand, existing creative assets, a network of UGC creators and a clear strategy for increasing our advertising output.

We want someone who can eventually take ownership of creative production and become a key part of our growth strategy.

This is not a one-off project. We're looking for a reliable, long-term creative partner.

How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

Examples of static Meta ads you've designed for e-commerce brands.

Examples of video advertisements you've created, particularly AI-generated or UGC-style videos.

Which AI image and video generation tools you currently use.

Your experience creating and split-testing advertising creatives.

Confirmation that you can consistently deliver 40 statics and 20 videos per week.

Your proposed monthly rate for this ongoing contract.

Important: We're particularly interested in applicants who can demonstrate an understanding of what makes an ad convert, rather than simply showing visually attractive designs.

We want someone who can help us produce more winning creatives, test faster and scale our Meta advertising.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

We are particularly interested in someone who is curious about new AI technologies, constantly explores new tools, and knows how to combine creativity with AI to produce better results in less time.

We don't necessarily expect you to know every tool or have years of experience. We are more interested in your practical skills, creativity, ability to learn quickly, and willingness to experiment with new AI technologies.

We want someone who can take creative instructions, understand what makes an effective advertising video, and turn ideas into high-quality video creatives with increasing independence.

Professional Growth & Compensation

This position offers the opportunity to grow professionally within our team.

We are looking for someone ambitious, motivated, and genuinely interested in developing their skills in AI video production, performance marketing, and creative advertising.

You will have the opportunity to work on real E-commerce advertising campaigns, experiment with new AI tools, improve your editing skills, and learn how to create increasingly effective video ads.

Your initial responsibilities will mainly involve editing existing footage, creating variations of video ads, and assisting with creative production.

Over time, your responsibilities may expand depending on your performance, acquired skills, creativity, and ability to work independently.

Compensation will progressively increase over time, based on the skills you develop, the results you achieve, and the additional tasks and responsibilities assigned to you each month.

Research and experiment with new AI video tools and technologies.

Work Structure & Compensation

Project: 30 High-Resolution Fashion Campaign Images
Experience Level: Expert

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced AI Fashion Photography and Photoshop Compositing Specialist to create 30 highly realistic fashion campaign images.

We are NOT looking for someone who simply generates images using AI prompts.

We need someone who can combine real photography, AI-generated models and professional Photoshop editing to create images that look like authentic fashion photography.

What We’re Looking For

* Real photographic backgrounds: Use genuine photographs and preserve their original backgrounds rather than generating artificial-looking environments.
* AI model replacement: Replace people in real photographs with our approved AI models while maintaining realistic poses, proportions and facial consistency.
* Realistic clothing: Clothing must look completely natural, with accurate fabric textures, stitching, folds, fit, proportions and branding.
* Professional compositing: Match lighting, shadows, perspective and colour grading so the models blend seamlessly into the original photographs.
* Photorealistic results: Final images must look like professional fashion campaign photographs, without obvious AI-generated details or distortions.

We will provide model references, product images, pose references, backgrounds and creative direction.

Clothing realism is our highest priority. The final images must accurately represent our products and look like genuine photographs.

Deliverables

30 unique, professionally edited images:

* 20 Portrait Images — 3:4 (3000 × 4000 px)
* 6 Vertical Images — 9:16 (2160 × 3840 px)
* 4 Landscape Images — 16:9 (3840 × 2160 px)

Final files must include high-resolution PNGs and editable layered PSD files.

No typography, text overlays or graphic design is required. This project focuses entirely on photorealistic image production.

Required Experience

* Advanced Adobe Photoshop compositing and retouching.
* AI-assisted model replacement.
* Photorealistic fashion and apparel imagery.
* Realistic fabric and clothing reconstruction.
* Experience combining real photography with AI-generated elements.
* Strong attention to detail and visual consistency.

Budget & Selection

Fixed Budget: $450 for 30 images ($15 per image).

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid trial to demonstrate their ability before proceeding with the full project.

Successful candidates may receive ongoing work.

How to Apply

Please provide:

1. Portfolio: 3–5 examples of realistic AI-assisted fashion photography or Photoshop composites.
2. Before-and-after examples: Ideally showing real photographs and the finished AI model replacements.
3. Workflow: Briefly explain how you combine real photography, AI and Photoshop.
4. Availability: Confirm your availability and estimated completion time.

IMPORTANT: Start your proposal with the exact word “real” to confirm you’ve read the full job description.

We are looking for someone who can deliver realistic clothing, authentic backgrounds and seamless AI model integration, not generic AI-generated images.

Mellow is looking for a creator who loves jewelry and has a strong eye for making small details look beautiful on camera. We're hoping to build a long-term relationship with someone we can work with regularly.

Think close-up shots in beautiful sunlight, gentle hand movements that catch a stone's sparkle, and necklaces filmed against the skin with simple, thoughtful styling. We want someone who understands how lighting, angles and movement bring out what makes each piece special.

THE FIRST PROJECT
We'll send you approximately 5-7 pieces of jewelry, and you'll film around 50 distinct raw video clips (around 10s-20s per each) in total across those pieces.

Budget: US$500 fixed price for the first batch.
Location: Remote

The footage should include a variety of lighting, settings and compositions, such as:
- Close-ups that show the jewelry's shape, finish and small details.
- Stones catching the light and sparkling naturally.
- Rings held between fingers and worn on the hand.
- Necklaces worn, with close-ups around the neck and collarbone.
- Simple product shots using thoughtfully chosen backgrounds.

Each clip should offer a useful variation in angle, movement, lighting or setting. Please film vertically, with sharp focus and steady, gentle movement. The reference video shows the visual feel we're looking for.

NO EDITING REQUIRED
We need the original footage without added text, music, filters or effects.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- A strong eye for light, composition and jewelry styling.
- The ability to capture sharp close-ups and bring out a stone's natural sparkle.
- Access to good natural light or a lighting setup that shows the jewelry beautifully.
- Clean, neatly maintained nails for hand shots.
- Comfort filming jewelry on your hands and around your neck/collarbone.
- Reliability, attention to detail and interest in an ongoing collaboration.

Experience filming jewelry, beauty products or other small detailed objects is a plus. A phone is welcome if it produces clear, high-quality close-up footage.

TO APPLY, PLEASE SEND
- Your location.
- A few relevant examples of your work, especially jewelry close-ups or footage showing sparkle.
- Your proposal for the full batch of approximately 50 raw clips across 5-7 pieces.
- Your availability and estimated turnaround time after receiving the jewelry.

We'd love to see how you use light and movement to make jewelry look beautiful.

We are looking for an experienced AI image-to-video specialist to transform approximately 400–500 existing traffic images into short, photorealistic moving videos.

- Animate our existing images, not create completely new scenes.

- No vehicle morphing, distortion or disappearing objects.
- No unrealistic or incorrect traffic movements.

Important: The vehicles must perform the exact actions described in our instructions. Visual quality alone is not enough.

Free Test – Required
We will provide one reference image and a written description.

Before selecting a freelancer, we request one free test video of approximately 5–10 seconds.

Test Instructions
The reference image shows a white BMW learner car behind a black car on a Dutch motorway.

The animation must show:
1. Both vehicles initially driving in the left lane.
2. The white BMW activating its right turn signal.
3. The white BMW smoothly changing to the right lane.
4. The right indicator flashing during the maneuver.
5. The indicator switching off after completing the lane change.
6. The black car continuing straight in the left lane.
7. The white BMW remaining behind the black car without overtaking on the right.

The lane change must be clearly visible and realistic.

The original image should remain visually consistent throughout the video.

The free test will only be used to evaluate your capabilities and will not be used commercially without a separate agreement.

Full Project
If the test is successful, we plan to order approximately 400–500 videos.

Around 10–20 videos will require precise synchronization between the vehicle movements and the accompanying text or explanation.

We are looking for a long-term freelancer who can deliver consistent results at competitive bulk pricing.

Please Answer

2. Can you accurately control vehicle movements from a single image?
3. Are you willing to create the free sample?
4. What is your lowest price per video for 400–500 videos?
5. How many videos can you deliver per week?

We're looking for an AI video creator to produce a 30-second story-driven ad and a 15-second cutdown for Facebook and Instagram. The scenes need realistic people moving in real settings. If your portfolio is mostly talking heads or product spins, this probably isn't the right fit.

ABOUT US
SkylightSafety.Net makes a heavy-duty safety net that installs over commercial skylights to stop a worker from falling through. Our buyers are commercial roofing contractors.

THE IDEA
Roofers tell us they have never had a skylight accident, so they don't buy protection. This ad shows them what one looks like. A routine morning on a reroof job turns into the worst day of a company owner's career. Nothing graphic. The audience fills in what happened.

THE STORY
1. On the roof: A young roofer, Danny, walks across a warehouse roof during a reroof. The foreman calls out: "Danny! Grab that roll on your way back!" Danny turns, answers "Got it!" and steps backward toward a skylight. His heel catches the skylight curb and he loses his balance. Hard cut to black on a loud plastic crack.
2. The call: The company owner sits in his pickup at dawn with his coffee. His phone shows "Mike - Foreman." He answers: "Morning, Mike." Mike, shaken: "Boss... you need to get out here. It's Danny. The skylight." The owner's face falls.
3. The skylight: Slow push-in on a broken skylight with caution tape around it. The crew stands back in silence. Emergency lights flash up from the street.
4. Police: An officer questions the owner. Officer: "How long has he worked for you?" Owner: "Three years. We've done a hundred roofs. Never had a problem." Officer: "Was there anything over those skylights?" The owner has no answer.
5. Ambulance: It pulls slowly away, lights on, no siren. The owner watches from his tailgate. The foreman puts a hand on his shoulder.
6. Fact card: White text on black. We supply the statistic.
7. The next job: A week later, a different roof. The same owner watches his crew install our orange net over each skylight. The foreman scans the QR tag on a net with his phone. The owner nods. Text: "Installs in under 2 minutes, tool-free."
8. End card: Logo, price, "Shop Now." We supply the graphics.

On-screen text: "It's never happened to us." over scene 2. "Until it does." over scene 3.

THE SKYLIGHTS
Standard commercial skylights: rectangular, 4 feet by 8 feet, low-profile domed polycarbonate cover on a raised curb about a foot high. Domes yellowed and cloudy from sun. Not square, round, flat glass or small. Workers walk on the roof, never on a skylight.

OUR PRODUCT
A high-visibility orange mesh net sized for a 4x8 skylight. It installs over the dome and attaches to the skylight curb with a stainless steel ratchet strap. No tools. A QR code label is attached to each net. Product photos are attached. The net in the video must match them.

RULES
- No injury, blood or body shown.
- Show our net installed and being installed, but never catching anything. No drops or tests.
- No real people's likenesses. No logos, brand names or police or ambulance insignia.
- No music in the AI scenes. Natural sound and dialogue.

DELIVERABLES
- 30-second and 15-second versions, 9:16, 1080p or better
- 4:5 crops of each
- Burned-in captions
- All raw clips and the project file
- Full commercial rights transferred to SkylightSafety.Net

HOW WE WORK
We will pay one or two creators for a scene 1 test first, as a small separate contract. The best test gets the full job, paid in milestones: scenes 2 to 5, then the final cuts. We give feedback within one business day and keep revisions focused.

IN YOUR PROPOSAL
1. Two or three samples of realistic AI video of people moving in real settings
2. Your approach to scene 1 and the tools you would use
3. Your price for the full job, and your price for the scene 1 test
4. Your timeline
5. Revision rounds included

originalDescription.text:
Hi Denis,

I'm looking for an experienced video specialist to create a 90-second software product demo for Regenesis Materials, a deep-tech company developing AI-powered materials innovation.

The product is called GAiA ONE, an AI-powered platform that accelerates the discovery of advanced sustainable materials.

**What we need:**

We already have a detailed storyboard, creative direction, existing footage and a substantial library of assets. This is not a project where you need to create everything from scratch.

The video will combine:

- Actual screen recordings of our GAiA ONE software platform.
- Animated UI elements, zooms, transitions and motion graphics to demonstrate how the software works.
- AI prediction and material formulation visualisations.
- Laboratory, robotics and manufacturing footage.
- Material and product shots, particularly our Carbonite material.
- Data visualisation and graphs showing predicted versus actual laboratory results.

**The storyline:**

We want to demonstrate how GAiA ONE takes material requirements, uses AI to predict formulations and connects those predictions to real laboratory results.

The commercial message is particularly important: demonstrating how we can develop materials that are better in quality, cheaper in cost and more sustainable.

Carbonite will be our example, with a material cost reference of $2.95/kg.

**What we provide:**
- Detailed storyboard and creative brief.
- Existing laboratory, robotics, manufacturing and material footage.
- Access to the GAiA ONE platform for screen recordings, subject to secure access arrangements.
- Existing animatic and reference videos.
- Branding and visual assets.
- Clear feedback and creative direction from our team.

**Deliverables:**
- One polished 90-second promotional video.
- Two final versions: one including quantum technology and one without it.
- Professional editing, motion graphics, UI animation, music and sound design.
- 1080p or higher final export.
- Editable project files.

**Budget and timeline:**

Our currently allocated budget is $500, and our preferred delivery date is November 20, 2026.

We are open to discussing the scope if certain elements need to be simplified to work within the budget.

Before proceeding, could you please share:

1. Two or three examples of software/SaaS product demos you have created, particularly involving real software interfaces and animated UI.
2. Whether you can handle both screen recording and UI animation.
3. Your proposed production approach for this project.
4. Whether you could realistically deliver by November 20.
5. Your estimated fixed price for the complete scope.

We are looking for someone who can turn a relatively complex deep-tech software platform into a visually impressive, clear and commercially compelling story.

There may also be opportunities for future video projects as we continue developing GAiA ONE.

Looking forward to seeing your work!

We’re looking for an experienced professional photo retoucher to take our existing studio product photography to a premium commercial advertising standard.

We have professionally photographed inflatable boats on a white studio background. We want to achieve the same clean, sharp and polished finish seen in high-end automotive photography, similar to brands like Polestar.

What we need

* Professionally retouch existing product photography to a premium commercial standard.
* Create a clean, consistent white or very light grey background.
* Improve lighting, contrast, highlights and shadows to give the product more depth.
* Enhance materials, textures and details while maintaining a natural appearance.
* Remove imperfections, unwanted reflections and distractions.
* Create realistic, controlled ground shadows.
* Maintain accurate product proportions, colours, branding and features.
* Deliver a consistent finish across multiple images and product angles.

Important: No AI-generated retouching

We are looking for a professional retoucher, not an AI image generation service.

All work must be completed through professional photo retouching techniques in Adobe Photoshop.

AI-generated images, AI reconstruction or alterations to the product’s design, shape or features will not be accepted.

The original photography must remain the foundation of the final image. We want exceptional retouching, not an artificially generated replacement.

Quality expectations

We want our photography to look like high-end automotive product imagery. Clean, crisp, beautifully lit and almost CGI quality, while remaining completely photorealistic.

Test project and deliverables

We will start with one paid test image to assess your skills and establish the retouching style before proceeding with the full collection.

The following deliverables are mandatory:

* One fully retouched, high-resolution image.
* Original, fully editable Adobe Photoshop PSD file.
* All retouching layers, masks and adjustments preserved and clearly organised.
* No flattened PSD files.
* Final export suitable for web and commercial use.

The PSD must allow our internal creative team to review and make further adjustments if required.

EXTRA:

- Example images attached
- The Example boat raw image is from the shoot.

There will be 20 images to start and another 100 images for a second project.

1 test

100 images

originalDescription.text:
Mindful Souls (part of VGL Group) builds wellness and DTC subscription brands, including our Crystal Box and Mindful Box, and our growth is driven by performance ads on Meta. We're a remote team across 11 countries.

We're looking for an AI Creative Designer who can own static ad creatives end to end, from research to launch, and produce them at volume. This is a performance role: your work will be judged by how your ads perform, not by likes.

Full-time commitment: ~8 hours per day. We're open to an hourly or a fixed monthly arrangement for the right candidate.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Research angles, audiences and competitor ads, then turn them into static ad concepts and hooks.
- Produce 150–170 static creatives per week for Meta, using AI tools (e.g. Midjourney, Google Flow / Nano Banana, Claude) and finishing in Photoshop / Illustrator.
- Keep products looking real. Products must come from real photos, never AI-generated.
- Create multiple variations of every concept (hooks, headlines, layouts, formats) for testing.
- Review results with the marketing team (CTR, CPA, ROAS) and turn learnings into the next round.
- Deliver launch-ready files, correctly sized and named, within Meta safe zones.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- 2–4 years designing static ads for paid social, ideally Meta and DTC brands.
- A portfolio of static ads you made with AI tools, showing your role and the tools used.
- Strong copy and hook instincts, plus an eye for what converts.
- Speed and consistency: comfortable shipping high volume every week.
- Working knowledge of ad metrics (CTR, CPA, ROAS).
- Good written English and reliable availability.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (DEFINITION OF DONE)
- 150–170 launch-ready statics delivered each week, on schedule.
- Every creative at the correct specs (e.g. 1080×1920 and 1080×1080), inside Meta safe zones, with real product imagery.
- Each concept delivered with several hook and copy variations, clearly named for testing.
- Creatives improve week over week based on ad performance data shared by the team.

HOW TO APPLY
Share your portfolio of static ads (ideally AI-assisted, with results if you have them) and answer the screening questions. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short unpaid trial task.

# Hiring: AI Video Creator / AI Video Ads Specialist (Remote)

**Company:** AD.KO Marketing  
**Position:** Full-Time AI Video Creator  
**Location:** Remote  
**Salary:** $500 USD/month  
**Employment:** Long-Term, Full-Time

## About Us

AD.KO Marketing is a digital marketing agency working with businesses across the United States. We specialize in digital advertising, lead generation, website development, and marketing automation.

We are looking for a creative and skilled **AI Video Creator** to join our team full-time and produce high-quality, realistic AI-generated video advertisements for our clients.

Our goal is to create professional, cinematic, and conversion-focused advertisements using the latest AI video-generation technologies.

## Responsibilities

- Create engaging 15–30-second AI-generated video advertisements for social media platforms.
- Generate realistic, cinematic footage using AI video-generation software.
- Develop creative concepts, scripts, and storyboards based on client requirements.
- Produce AI-generated voiceovers and synchronize them with video content.
- Add captions, transitions, sound effects, music, and branding.
- Create multiple advertising variations for A/B testing.
- Edit and optimize videos for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and other platforms.
- Collaborate with our marketing team to develop effective advertising creatives.
- Complete projects within deadlines and implement feedback.

## Required Skills & Software

Experience with one or more of the following AI platforms:

- **Kling AI** – AI video generation
- **Higgsfield AI** – Cinematic AI video creation
- **Google Veo / Flow** – Realistic AI-generated footage
- **Runway** – AI video generation and editing
- **HeyGen / Arcads** – AI spokesperson and UGC-style advertisements
- **ElevenLabs** – AI voiceover generation
- **CapCut / Adobe Premiere Pro** – Video editing and post-production

You are not required to know every platform, but you must demonstrate strong proficiency with AI video-generation tools.

## Requirements

- Previous experience creating AI-generated video content.
- Portfolio demonstrating realistic, high-quality AI videos.
- Strong understanding of prompt engineering for image and video generation.
- Ability to create professional, cinematic advertisements.
- Knowledge of short-form video advertising and attention-grabbing hooks.
- Strong creative thinking and visual storytelling skills.
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.
- Good written English communication skills.
- Reliable internet connection and ability to work remotely.
- Willingness to learn new AI tools and techniques.

## Compensation & Benefits

- **Fixed salary: $500 USD per month**
- Full-time, remote position.
- Long-term employment opportunity.
- Consistent projects across multiple industries.
- Opportunity to develop skills using the latest AI technologies.
- Collaborative working environment with a growing digital marketing agency.

## How to Apply

Please submit the following:

1. **Portfolio:** Examples of AI-generated video advertisements or cinematic AI videos you have created.
2. **Software Experience:** List the AI tools you currently use and your proficiency with each.
3. **Previous Experience:** Briefly describe your experience in AI video production.
4. **Availability:** Confirm your availability for full-time remote work.
5. **Equipment:** Confirm that you have a reliable computer and internet connection.

**Important:** We are looking for someone who can create realistic, high-quality AI-generated advertisements, not just traditional video editing or slideshow-style videos.

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a short paid test assignment.

**If you are passionate about AI-generated video production and want a stable, long-term remote position, we would love to hear from you!**

Approximately 50% of videos will be in English.

3 different video ad concepts per day.

Each concept has one main video body, with 3 distinct hook variations designed for testing.

15 unique video concepts per week.

45 video ad variations per week (including the different hooks).

We value efficiency, organization, consistency, and the ability to deliver quality work at scale.

AI video generation and prompt engineering.

AI character creation and consistency across scenes.

Realistic AI voiceovers and lip synchronization.

Visual storytelling and emotional pacing.

Strong hooks that capture attention in the first 3 seconds.

Fast-paced direct-response editing.

Sound design, captions, transitions, and motion graphics.

How to turn a creative brief or reference video into a finished advertisement.

Monday–Friday production schedule.
