We're looking for a talented AI Video Creator / Creative Editor to help us produce engaging, scroll-stopping video ads for a 7 figure direct-to-consumer (DTC) brand.

We're especially interested in creators who understand the latest trends in AI-generated advertising and can turn creative concepts into compelling, high-quality video ads that capture attention, tell a story, and ultimately drive conversions.

What We're Looking For

We want someone who can create a variety of AI-powered video ad styles, including:

AI Drama / Storytelling Ads: Cinematic, emotionally engaging narratives with relatable characters, unexpected twists, conflict, and satisfying endings. Think short-form mini-movies that keep viewers watching.

Pixar-Style Animated Ads: High-quality 3D animated characters, expressive personalities, humorous situations, and entertaining storylines that creatively communicate a product's benefits.

Trending AI Ads: Ability to identify and recreate emerging AI video trends, viral ad formats, and creative concepts that perform well on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Facebook.

AI UGC / Character-Based Ads: Realistic or stylized AI-generated people, characters, and scenarios that feel native to social media.

Creative Direct Response Ads: Incorporating strong hooks, storytelling, product integration, and clear calls to action to make entertaining content that also sells.

Responsibilities

Develop and execute creative concepts for short-form video advertisements.

Generate AI characters, scenes, environments, and animations.

Produce engaging videos with strong hooks and compelling storytelling.

Incorporate products naturally into narratives without making ads feel overly promotional.

Edit videos with sound effects, music, voiceovers, captions, and transitions.

Stay up to date with emerging AI tools, video-generation techniques, and viral advertising trends.

Collaborate with our team to iterate on concepts and create multiple ad variations.

Preferred Skills & Tools

Experience with some of the following is a plus:

AI video generation: Kling, Veo, Sora, Runway, Seedance, or similar.

AI image generation: Midjourney, Nano Banana, Flux, or similar.

AI voice generation: ElevenLabs or similar.

Video editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve.

Strong understanding of TikTok, Meta, and direct-response advertising.

Ideal Candidate

Has a portfolio showcasing AI-generated video advertisements.

Has a strong creative eye and understands what makes people stop scrolling.

Can tell compelling stories through short-form video.

Understands pacing, hooks, retention, and advertising psychology.

Can create consistent characters and high-quality visuals across multiple scenes.

Is proactive about bringing new ideas and experimenting with trending formats.

Can balance creativity and entertainment with the ultimate goal of selling a product.

To Apply

Your portfolio, especially examples of AI-generated ads.

Your typical turnaround time and pricing per video.

originalDescription.text:
We're a fast-growing DTC women's beauty brand, and we're looking for an AI video creator who can make scroll-stopping AI ads: AI drama ads, AI cartoon/animated ads, and any other style of AI-generated ad that sells.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
• Create AI video ads on request: AI drama/story ads, cartoon and Pixar-style animated ads, UGC-style ads, product showcases and more
• Write and refine prompts for AI image and video tools to get consistent characters, realistic motion and on-brand results
• Edit the final cut (hook, pacing, captions, music, sound effects) so it's ready to run as a paid social ad (Meta, TikTok)

TRAINING PROVIDED
You'll get access to a complete AI video bootcamp course. You'll work through it to sharpen your prompting and AI video skills, and once you've finished it, you'll create ad content for us on request. This is a real chance to level up your skills while putting them to work on real ads.

HOW THIS WORKS
• We start with ad requests as they come up; there are no fixed weekly hours at first
• The amount of work grows with the quality of what you deliver
• Creators who prove themselves move to a long-term monthly retainer

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
• You already create AI video content and can show examples
• Strong prompting skills with tools like Kling, Veo, Sora, Runway, Higgsfield, Seedance, Hailuo, Midjourney, Nano Banana or similar
• Solid editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar)
• You understand what makes a short-form ad stop the scroll: hooks, pacing and story
• Reliable, communicates clearly, takes feedback well and improves fast
• Hungry to learn: you'll actually finish the course and apply it

TO APPLY
1. Share 2–3 links to AI videos you've made (ads are a big plus)
2. Tell us which AI tools you use the most
3. Start your proposal with the word "DRAMA" so we know you read the whole post

Proposals without work samples won't be considered.

originalDescription.text:
We make Ethos, a hardcover book of your life. People talk through their memories in our app, and we write and print the book for them. Our buyers are Americans 65 and older who want to tell their own story.

We're looking for a creative strategist who makes Meta ads that sell to this audience. You pick the idea, the hook and the reason to buy, make the static or video yourself with AI tools, and send it in. We run it and test it on our ad budget.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Come up with ad ideas: the hook, the angle, why someone buys
- Make finished statics and short videos with AI (Midjourney, Nano Banana / Gemini, Kling or similar)
- Write the words on the picture and the spoken script in plain English a 70-year-old gets on the first read
- Read how your ads did (hook rate, hold rate, cost per sale, where people dropped off) and make the next ones better

HOW YOU'LL WORK
You work from Claude or Codex, connected to our creative portal. From there you see what sells for us and why, the recipes behind our winners, live answers from our buyers, our brand kit and the house rules, and you send your ads in. A guided setup gets you running on day one. You need your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription and your own AI image and video tools.

HOW WE START: A $100 PAID TEST
We start with a paid test project: $100 for one video and 3-4 static concepts for our audience. If they're good, you join the team on the pay below.

HOW YOU'RE PAID AFTER THE TEST
- A fee for every ad of yours that goes live: €15 per static, €20 per video plus €7 per minute of length
- A winner bonus of up to €6,000 per ad
- A monthly prize of 1% of our whole ad spend for the strategist whose ads made the most sales

You start with at least 15 ads a month to test. The more of yours that sell, the more slots you get.

YOU'RE A GOOD FIT IF YOU
- Have made paid social ads that sold, and can show the numbers
- Already make pictures and video with AI tools
- Write short and plain, for older readers, without talking down to them
- Already work with Claude or Codex

Not a fit if you want hourly pay for briefs or decks, or only want to edit footage someone else hands you.

To apply, answer the screening questions below.

originalDescription.text:
IMPORTANT: MANDATORY AI VIDEO CREATION TEST. PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING.

Our number one hiring requirement is the ability to create extremely realistic, cinematic AI-generated videos that look like professionally filmed footage.

Before moving forward with any applicant, we will test their actual AI video creation capabilities.

We will provide you with an Instagram link to a hyperrealistic AI-generated cinematic short film.

Your assignment will be to recreate that film using a different AI model or character of our choosing.

We will select the model you must use. Your responsibility is to recreate the reference film's cinematic quality, photorealism, natural human movements, lighting, camera angles, visual consistency, storytelling, and professional editing while using our chosen model.

We want AI-generated videos that are extremely difficult to distinguish from real footage.

We will evaluate your ability to recreate the reference film's overall production quality, maintain consistent character identity, produce realistic movements and expressions, and deliver a polished final video.

You must be resourceful enough to determine which AI tools, techniques, and workflows are necessary to achieve the required result.

This test is mandatory and will be our first evaluation before proceeding with the rest of the hiring process.

Shortlisted applicants will receive the reference film, designated model, instructions, timeline, and test compensation details.

If you're confident in your ability to produce this level of AI content, please continue reading.

ABOUT THE POSITION

We're looking for a highly creative, resourceful, ambitious, and results-driven individual to help grow our businesses across fashion, e-commerce, streetwear, music, and entertainment.

Our brands include PrettyDynasty, an online fashion boutique, and Rich Daniel, an independent recording artist and music brand.

We're looking for someone passionate about AI hyperrealistic video production, cinematic content creation, professional video editing, paid advertising, winning product research, business growth, and AI automation.

We want someone who can take an idea, research the best way to execute it, use the right tools, coordinate the right people, and deliver an exceptional finished result.

You'll have access to our existing systems, advertising structures, analytics, product research platforms, supplier relationships, standard operating procedures, training materials, and existing team members.

We also work with external designers, freelancers, contractors, and specialized agencies whenever necessary.

Our philosophy is simple. Find products people already want, showcase them through incredible content, market them effectively, and continuously improve the systems that drive growth.

Whether the product is a boutique dress, a streetwear collection, or a music release, the objective remains the same.

1. AI HYPERREALISTIC VIDEO CREATION AND PROFESSIONAL EDITING

This is our highest creative priority.

We're looking for someone capable of producing extremely realistic AI-generated videos, models, characters, cinematic scenes, and advertising content.

We want videos that look like professionally filmed footage, featuring believable people, realistic skin textures, natural movements, consistent characters, cinematic lighting, and polished post-production.

Responsibilities include:

Creating photorealistic AI-generated people, models, characters, and environments.

Maintaining consistent facial features, body proportions, clothing, hairstyles, and character identity across multiple scenes.

Producing natural human movements, facial expressions, interactions, and realistic lip-sync when required.

Creating cinematic fashion campaigns, boutique dress advertisements, streetwear visuals, product commercials, music videos, and promotional content.

Developing reusable AI characters and models for ongoing advertising campaigns.

Creating compelling advertising hooks, visual storytelling, and multiple creative variations.

Combining real footage with AI-generated footage seamlessly.

Professionally editing videos using Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, After Effects, Photoshop, and other appropriate tools.

Handling compositing, color grading, sound design, and final production.

Researching and using effective AI generation technologies, including Kling, Google Veo, Higgsfield, Runway, and emerging alternatives.

Independently solving technical challenges and delivering completed creative projects.

We care about results. You should be capable of figuring out which tools and workflows are necessary to achieve the required quality.

2. META ADS MANAGEMENT, LAUNCHING AND OPTIMIZATION

Paid advertising is our second priority.

We already have established advertising systems, historical performance data, winning creatives, and proven campaign structures.

We need someone who can take responsibility for day-to-day execution and consistently launch more advertising creatives.

Responsibilities include:

Launching Meta advertising campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.

Creating and organizing campaigns, ad sets, and individual advertisements.

Uploading fresh creatives into our established winning campaign structures.

Following existing naming conventions, testing procedures, and advertising SOPs.

Monitoring ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, CPM, conversion rates, and other important performance indicators.

Understanding break-even ROAS, profit margins, customer acquisition costs, and advertising profitability.

Analyzing advertising performance through Meta Ads Manager and Triple Whale.

Identifying winning advertisements, creative fatigue, and underperforming campaigns.

Testing new hooks, creative angles, audiences, formats, and offers.

Researching competitor advertisements and successful marketing strategies.

Preparing performance updates and actionable optimization recommendations.

Managing campaign changes within approved budgets and operating guidelines.

AI ADVERTISING AUTOMATION

We want to develop AI-powered workflows that can prepare creative assets, organize variations, populate campaign drafts, and assist with launching approved advertisements into our established campaign structures.

We're interested in using Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, AI agents, APIs, and other automation tools to streamline these processes.

The goal is to consistently launch more high-quality advertisements while maintaining strong control over profitability and spending.

One of our current priorities is increasing the volume of new advertising creatives being produced and tested.

3. WINNING PRODUCT RESEARCH, VALIDATION AND SOURCING

Finding more winning products is one of our biggest immediate business priorities.

We want a continuous pipeline of products with strong evidence of existing consumer demand.

Our philosophy is to identify products people already want rather than guessing what might sell.

We have access to TrendTrack and other product intelligence and competitor research platforms. We're also open to adopting stronger tools when they provide better data.

PRODUCT RESEARCH RESPONSIBILITIES

Continuously identifying promising products across boutique dresses, women's fashion, streetwear, accessories, and other relevant categories.

Researching products generating significant estimated sales and revenue.

Identifying successful competitors and analyzing their product offerings.

Reviewing competitor advertising creatives and marketing strategies.

Analyzing estimated advertising spend, reach, impressions, engagement, and campaign longevity.

Identifying how long successful competitor advertisements have been running.

Researching product demand, pricing, consumer interest, and market trends.

Evaluating product costs, selling prices, potential margins, and profitability.

Identifying opportunities to improve existing products through design, positioning, or superior advertising.

Cross-referencing research data to validate product opportunities.

Maintaining an organized pipeline of researched, shortlisted, sampled, tested, and launched products.

Presenting the strongest opportunities with supporting evidence and clear recommendations.

Competitor intelligence platforms provide estimates rather than guaranteed sales or advertising spending figures. We expect thoughtful validation before inventory commitments.

SUPPLIERS, DESIGNERS AND PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

Once a promising product is identified, you'll help coordinate the process of bringing it to market.

Responsibilities include:

Researching manufacturers and suppliers.

Communicating with suppliers and negotiating pricing using our existing SOPs and training.

Requesting product specifications, materials, sizing, colors, and customization options.

Evaluating minimum order quantities and production timelines.

Coordinating product samples and arranging shipment to our team.

Tracking supplier communications, sample deliveries, revisions, and production progress.

Working with designers on original products, custom modifications, and streetwear concepts.

Hiring and coordinating specialized freelancers for individual design or production tasks.

Organizing supplier information, pricing, and product specifications.

Preparing approved products for creative production, advertising, and launch.

We already have SOPs, training materials, and access to specialized professionals. Your responsibility is to coordinate the work, maintain quality, and keep projects moving.

Our ideal product development process begins with researching proven consumer demand, validating the opportunity, sourcing or designing the product, ordering samples, creating cinematic content, launching advertising campaigns, analyzing performance, and scaling successful products.

We want this process operating continuously so new product opportunities and advertising creatives are always entering the pipeline.

4. ORGANIC GROWTH, VIRAL CONTENT DISTRIBUTION AND CLIPPING

We want to expand our content distribution beyond our primary social media accounts.

You'll coordinate with our existing team members and external partners to distribute content, develop clipping campaigns, and identify opportunities for measurable organic growth.

Responsibilities include:

Coordinating with coworkers responsible for organic social media.

Organizing and scheduling content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other relevant platforms.

Researching viral content formats and successful creative strategies.

Identifying high-performing video concepts and opportunities to create new versions featuring our music or brands, with appropriate usage rights.

Coordinating short-form clipping campaigns for Rich Daniel Music.

Researching, hiring, and managing third-party clipping companies, creator networks, editors, and distribution agencies.

Developing additional relevant content pages and distribution channels.

Coordinating creators and freelancers producing content for our brands.

Tracking content performance, reach, engagement, traffic, streaming conversions, and sales.

Identifying distribution methods that generate measurable returns.

Continuously testing new approaches to expanding awareness and reaching potential customers.

We are comfortable using external agencies and contractors when the results justify the investment.

The objective is to build repeatable distribution systems that generate genuine awareness, streams, customers, and revenue.

5. AI AGENTS, AUTOMATION AND BUSINESS OPERATIONS

We're extremely interested in using AI agents and automation to make our businesses more efficient.

We want someone excited about researching new technologies, implementing useful systems, and gradually reducing repetitive manual work.

Potential automation projects include:

Monitoring Meta Ads performance and preparing reports.

Identifying advertising campaigns that require attention.

Organizing creative assets and preparing advertising campaign drafts.

Researching competing products and identifying promising opportunities.

Maintaining structured product research databases.

Tracking supplier communications and outstanding tasks.

Organizing content calendars and distribution workflows.

Coordinating freelancers, contractors, and project deadlines.

Automating repetitive reporting and administrative tasks.

Researching and implementing additional AI-powered business workflows.

We're open to using Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, AI agent frameworks, automation platforms, APIs, and whatever technologies are most effective.

We want someone who can independently investigate solutions, test them, and implement reliable workflows.

Major financial commitments, advertising budget increases, inventory purchases, and other consequential decisions must follow approved authority and controls.

6. INDEPENDENCE, INITIATIVE AND ACCOUNTABILITY

We want someone who genuinely enjoys solving problems and taking ownership.

Someone who notices when advertising performance is declining and investigates why.

Someone who identifies a promising product and moves the research forward.

Someone who finds a better tool, researches it, tests it, and introduces an improved workflow.

Someone who knows when to complete a task personally and when to coordinate a specialist.

We value exceptional creative taste, strong technical resourcefulness, independent thinking, business awareness, analytical skills, excellent communication, organization, accountability, and consistent execution.

We're looking for someone who takes initiative rather than waiting for detailed instructions for every task.

You should be comfortable managing multiple projects, communicating progress, coordinating people, and ensuring work gets completed properly.

7. OUR LONG-TERM VISION

We're building an increasingly efficient operation where the founder can focus primarily on recording music, performing, creating content, and developing the artistic vision.

The team, external specialists, and AI systems should progressively take responsibility for everyday business execution.

Over time, this position may evolve toward greater creative direction, AI filmmaking, advertising strategy, and management of automated systems.

We want someone interested in growing with the businesses and helping develop something substantial over the long term.

90-DAY TRIAL OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship, beginning with a 90-day paid trial period.

During this period, we'll evaluate creative production, communication, initiative, reliability, advertising execution, product research, and overall contribution to business growth.

Compensation, responsibilities, and expectations will be agreed upon before starting.

IMPORTANT: REQUIRED APPLICATION RESPONSE

To confirm that you've carefully read and understood the entire job description, please include the following exact sentence at the end of your application:

"I want to do the 90-day trial. I've read everything and I'm ready."

This sentence is required so we know you've reviewed the responsibilities, expectations, and hiring process.

We're excited to see what you can create and accomplish.

originalDescription.text:
Creative Filmmaker / Cinematic Storyteller Wanted — Emotional IVF Short Film with Vintage VHS Aesthetic

Project type: Fixed price
Film length: Approximately 3–5 minutes
Style: Nostalgic 1990s VHS home movie meets cinematic documentary
Purpose: Private family screening and special announcement
Budget: Please provide your quote based on the full brief

About the Project

We are looking for an exceptionally creative filmmaker and cinematic storyteller to create a deeply personal short film about our IVF journey.

We are not simply looking for someone to edit videos together.

We want someone with the creative instincts of a film director who can take our personal footage, understand our story and transform it into a beautiful, emotional film.

The finished film will be shown to our family as part of a special announcement, once we have confirmed news we are ready to share.

Our aim is for our family to begin watching what appears to be a nostalgic home movie about our year together, before gradually discovering the journey we’ve been through behind the scenes.

We want something that feels authentic, cinematic, intimate and unforgettable.

1. Our Creative Vision — “Our Year, 2026”

We have a specific idea for the opening.

The film begins with a cinematic close-up of an old VHS cassette labelled “OUR YEAR — 2026” being inserted into a vintage VHS player.

We hear the mechanical sound of the tape being inserted, followed by a moment of static, tracking lines and the familiar sound of a video starting.

The screen flickers and displays:

OUR YEAR

2026

The year that changed everything.

The footage then begins, as though our family is watching an old home video.

We would like the filmmaker to create or source this opening using appropriately licensed footage, practical filming or visual effects.

This opening should feel realistic, nostalgic and beautifully executed.

2. The Vintage Home-Video Look

We will provide modern phone footage and photographs, but we want much of the film to look like an authentic family recording from the 1990s.

The aesthetic should include:

* Warm, slightly faded camcorder colours.
* Tasteful VHS grain and subtle tape distortion.
* Occasional tracking lines and recording indicators.
* Carefully chosen date stamps.
* Nostalgic 4:3 framing where appropriate.
* Natural, imperfect moments that feel like genuine home videos.
* Cinematic transitions between important chapters.

We do not want an exaggerated VHS filter applied to every clip.

The filmmaker should use artistic judgement to balance the vintage look with beautiful, clear footage.

Important images, especially our embryo photograph, should remain recognisable and treated sensitively.

3. The Story We Want to Tell

Chapter One — Our Life Together

The film should begin with warm, happy memories of us together.

We will provide photographs and video clips of holidays, laughter, everyday life and moments from our relationship.

We want the audience to feel that they are watching a nostalgic home movie about our year.

The opening should feel joyful, personal and natural.

Chapter Two — The Journey Nobody Saw

Gradually, the story should reveal that behind our happy memories, we were going through fertility treatment.

Our IVF journey began in April 2026, following fertility challenges and endometriosis.

Over the following months, we experienced medication, injections, hospital appointments, procedures, uncertainty and emotional ups and downs.

We will provide footage of injections, medication, hospital visits and other personal moments.

We want this part of the film to feel honest and moving, without being overly dramatic or upsetting.

The music, pacing and imagery should gradually build the emotion.

Chapter Three — The Numbers

We have a very specific vision for a minimalist, cinematic sequence.

We imagine a black screen with beautiful white typography.

Each statement appears separately, with carefully timed pauses and subtle sound design.

7 months.

Over 150 injections.

27 eggs collected.

20 embryos created.

One little 5AA embryo transferred.

Then a longer pause:

All for the chance to meet you.

This should be one of the most impactful moments in the film.

We want the audience to absorb each number rather than seeing everything at once.

The injection figure is currently an estimate and may be confirmed or adjusted before the final edit.

Chapter Four — Our Little Embryo

On 27 October 2026, we transferred one frozen embryo graded 5AA.

We would like to include our embryo photograph and any personal footage from transfer day.

Possible on-screen text:

27 October 2026

One tiny embryo.

One enormous hope.

We imagine the vintage aesthetic becoming softer and more cinematic here, giving this moment a sense of significance.

Chapter Five — The Waiting

After the transfer came the uncertainty of waiting.

We want this section to feel intimate, quiet and reflective.

Possible on-screen text:

And then we waited…

We would love the filmmaker to use music, silence and visual storytelling to convey the mixture of hope and fear.

Chapter Six — The Final Reveal

The final reveal will be confirmed later, once we know the outcome of our treatment and are ready to share our news.

We do not want the filmmaker to assume or create a pregnancy announcement before we confirm it.

If we are announcing a pregnancy, we imagine the film building gently towards an emotional, understated reveal.

Possible wording:

After everything…

Our greatest adventure is just beginning.

Baby [Surname] — Coming 2027

The final screen would return to the nostalgic VHS style:

TO BE CONTINUED… 2027

The exact wording and ending will be agreed with the filmmaker at a later stage.

4. Music and Sound Design

Music and sound design will be essential to the success of this film.

We would love:

* Beautiful, emotional instrumental music, possibly piano or cinematic orchestral arrangements.
* A gradual musical build as the story unfolds.
* Realistic VHS player sounds at the beginning.
* Natural audio from our original footage where meaningful.
* Thoughtful pauses and moments of silence.
* Music that supports the emotion without overpowering it.

All music and third-party footage must be appropriately licensed for the intended private screening and sharing.

5. Who SHOULD Apply

We are looking for someone who is more than technically skilled at editing.

We want a creative storyteller with a filmmaker’s mindset.

Please apply if you:

* Have experience creating emotional, cinematic short films or personal documentaries.
* Understand how to build a narrative with a beginning, middle and powerful ending.
* Can think like a director and contribute original creative ideas.
* Know how to make audiences feel something through pacing, imagery, music and silence.
* Have experience with beautiful, authentic VHS or vintage home-video aesthetics.
* Can develop a storyboard or creative treatment from a written brief.
* Are comfortable making thoughtful recommendations about footage, structure and storytelling.
* Have strong skills in typography, sound design and visual effects.
* Can work sensitively and confidentially with personal medical footage.
* Take genuine pride in creating something meaningful rather than simply completing an edit.

We would particularly welcome applicants with experience in short films, documentary filmmaking, cinematic wedding films or emotionally driven personal storytelling.

We want someone who can bring their own artistic vision to the project while respecting ours.

6. Who Should NOT Apply

Please do not apply if:

* You only offer basic video editing or clip assembly.
* Your portfolio consists entirely of generic social media reels, TikToks or promotional videos without storytelling.
* You primarily use ready-made templates or automatic slideshow generators.
* Your approach is simply adding transitions, text and background music to supplied footage.
* You cannot demonstrate experience creating emotional, narrative-driven work.
* You expect us to direct every cut, transition and creative decision.
* You are unwilling to develop a concept or storyboard before editing.
* You cannot create or convincingly source the vintage VHS opening.
* You are uncomfortable handling sensitive, private family or medical footage.
* You plan to outsource the work without our prior agreement.
* You are looking for a quick turnaround project with minimal creative involvement.

Please do not send a generic application.

We are willing to invest in genuine creative talent, but we are not looking to pay for a standard video montage.

7. Our Expected Creative Process

We would like the successful filmmaker to:

1. Review our footage and discuss the story with us.
2. Propose a creative concept, visual direction and storyboard.
3. Identify the strongest footage and suggest anything additional we could provide.
4. Obtain our approval of the concept before beginning the full edit.
5. Create the VHS opening and establish the film’s visual identity.
6. Develop the narrative, pacing, music and sound design.
7. Produce a complete first cut for review.
8. Collaborate with us through the agreed revision rounds.
9. Deliver the final film and complete the announcement ending when confirmed.

We welcome creative suggestions and would love to be pleasantly surprised by thoughtful ideas we haven’t considered.

8. Revisions and Creative Approval

Because this is a deeply personal and emotionally important film, we require three rounds of creative revisions included in the agreed fixed price.

These revisions may include changes to:

* Storytelling and narrative structure.
* Footage selection.
* Music and sound design.
* Pacing and emotional impact.
* Typography and text.
* Transitions, visual effects and colour grading.

We also require:

Creative concept approval: We must approve the proposed concept or storyboard before the main edit begins.

Separate final announcement update: One later update to complete the final reveal must be included separately and must not count towards the three creative revision rounds. The timing and scope of this update will be agreed in advance.

Technical corrections: Fixing technical errors or elements that do not meet the agreed brief should not count towards the three creative revision rounds.

Please confirm that you agree to these terms and clearly explain any additional charges that could apply outside the agreed scope.

9. Payment Milestones

We propose a fixed-price agreement with three milestones:

Milestone 1 — 20%
Creative concept, visual treatment and storyboard delivered and approved.

Milestone 2 — 40%
Complete first edit delivered for review.

Milestone 3 — 40%
Final film delivered and approved following the agreed revisions.

The separate future announcement update must also be included in the overall agreed scope, with its delivery arrangements documented before the contract begins.

Payment and milestone releases will be managed through Upwork.

10. Deliverables

We require:

* One main film, approximately 3–5 minutes.
* High-resolution MP4 suitable for television playback, preferably 4K if the source footage allows.
* A mobile-friendly version for private sharing.
* A custom VHS opening sequence.
* Cinematic typography and the numbers sequence.
* Music and third-party assets appropriately licensed for our intended use.
* Three included creative revision rounds.
* One separately included final announcement update.
* A clearly agreed delivery timeline and revision process.

Please confirm whether editable project files can also be supplied and whether these are included in your quote.

11. Privacy and Confidentiality

This film will contain deeply personal family memories, medical information, fertility treatment footage and an embryo photograph.

We require complete confidentiality.

Our footage and personal information must not be shared, published, used in portfolios, posted on social media or supplied to third parties without our prior written permission.

Please explain how you securely store and handle client footage, and disclose whether you intend to use AI tools or external collaborators.

We expect all supplied materials to be handled respectfully and confidentially.

12. How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

1. Two or three examples of your best cinematic, emotionally driven storytelling work.
2. An example of vintage VHS, camcorder or nostalgic film styling, if available.
3. Your creative approach to our project.
4. Your fixed-price quote for the full scope.
5. Your estimated timeline for the first cut and final delivery.
6. Confirmation that you can create the VHS tape opening.
7. Confirmation that you accept the revision and later-announcement terms.
8. Confirmation that you will personally carry out the creative work, or clearly identify any collaborators.

Required Creative Question

If you were directing a 3–5 minute short film about a couple’s seven-month IVF journey, beginning with a VHS tape being inserted into a player, how would you make the audience feel the emotion of the story without simply creating a chronological montage?

Please give us a thoughtful answer.

We would love to understand your ideas for storytelling, pacing, music, visual symbolism and the final reveal.

Also tell us about one project you’re particularly proud of and the creative decisions you made to bring that story to life.

Applications that do not address these questions or provide relevant work samples are unlikely to be shortlisted.

⸻

What This Film Means to Us

We want our family to sit down expecting to watch a nostalgic home movie called “Our Year — 2026.”

As the film unfolds, we want them to discover the journey we have been on, the challenges we have faced and the hope that has carried us through.

We want them to feel the significance of every appointment, every injection, every milestone and that one precious embryo.

We want the ending to be emotional because the story has earned it.

We don’t want a montage of memories. We want a film that becomes a memory in itself.

We’re looking for the right creative person to help us make that happen.

originalDescription.text:
IMPORTANT: MANDATORY AI VIDEO CREATION TEST. PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING.

Our number one hiring requirement is the ability to create extremely realistic, cinematic AI-generated videos that look like professionally filmed footage.

Before moving forward with any applicant, we will test their actual AI video creation capabilities.

We will provide you with an Instagram link to a hyperrealistic AI-generated cinematic short film.

Your assignment will be to recreate that film using a different AI model or character of our choosing.

We will select the model you must use. Your responsibility is to recreate the reference film's cinematic quality, photorealism, natural human movements, lighting, camera angles, visual consistency, storytelling, and professional editing while using our chosen model.

We want AI-generated videos that are extremely difficult to distinguish from real footage.

We will evaluate your ability to recreate the reference film's overall production quality, maintain consistent character identity, produce realistic movements and expressions, and deliver a polished final video.

You must be resourceful enough to determine which AI tools, techniques, and workflows are necessary to achieve the required result.

This test is mandatory and will be our first evaluation before proceeding with the rest of the hiring process.

Shortlisted applicants will receive the reference film, designated model, instructions, timeline, and test compensation details.

If you're confident in your ability to produce this level of AI content, please continue reading.

ABOUT THE POSITION

We're looking for a highly creative, resourceful, ambitious, and results-driven individual to help grow our businesses across fashion, e-commerce, streetwear, music, and entertainment.

Our brands include PrettyDynasty, an online fashion boutique, and Rich Daniel, an independent recording artist and music brand.

We're looking for someone passionate about AI hyperrealistic video production, cinematic content creation, professional video editing, paid advertising, winning product research, business growth, and AI automation.

We want someone who can take an idea, research the best way to execute it, use the right tools, coordinate the right people, and deliver an exceptional finished result.

You'll have access to our existing systems, advertising structures, analytics, product research platforms, supplier relationships, standard operating procedures, training materials, and existing team members.

We also work with external designers, freelancers, contractors, and specialized agencies whenever necessary.

Our philosophy is simple. Find products people already want, showcase them through incredible content, market them effectively, and continuously improve the systems that drive growth.

Whether the product is a boutique dress, a streetwear collection, or a music release, the objective remains the same.

1. AI HYPERREALISTIC VIDEO CREATION AND PROFESSIONAL EDITING

This is our highest creative priority.

We're looking for someone capable of producing extremely realistic AI-generated videos, models, characters, cinematic scenes, and advertising content.

We want videos that look like professionally filmed footage, featuring believable people, realistic skin textures, natural movements, consistent characters, cinematic lighting, and polished post-production.

Responsibilities include:

Creating photorealistic AI-generated people, models, characters, and environments.

Maintaining consistent facial features, body proportions, clothing, hairstyles, and character identity across multiple scenes.

Producing natural human movements, facial expressions, interactions, and realistic lip-sync when required.

Creating cinematic fashion campaigns, boutique dress advertisements, streetwear visuals, product commercials, music videos, and promotional content.

Developing reusable AI characters and models for ongoing advertising campaigns.

Creating compelling advertising hooks, visual storytelling, and multiple creative variations.

Combining real footage with AI-generated footage seamlessly.

Professionally editing videos using Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, After Effects, Photoshop, and other appropriate tools.

Handling compositing, color grading, sound design, and final production.

Researching and using effective AI generation technologies, including Kling, Google Veo, Higgsfield, Runway, and emerging alternatives.

Independently solving technical challenges and delivering completed creative projects.

We care about results. You should be capable of figuring out which tools and workflows are necessary to achieve the required quality.

2. META ADS MANAGEMENT, LAUNCHING AND OPTIMIZATION

Paid advertising is our second priority.

We already have established advertising systems, historical performance data, winning creatives, and proven campaign structures.

We need someone who can take responsibility for day-to-day execution and consistently launch more advertising creatives.

Responsibilities include:

Launching Meta advertising campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.

Creating and organizing campaigns, ad sets, and individual advertisements.

Uploading fresh creatives into our established winning campaign structures.

Following existing naming conventions, testing procedures, and advertising SOPs.

Monitoring ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, CPM, conversion rates, and other important performance indicators.

Understanding break-even ROAS, profit margins, customer acquisition costs, and advertising profitability.

Analyzing advertising performance through Meta Ads Manager and Triple Whale.

Identifying winning advertisements, creative fatigue, and underperforming campaigns.

Testing new hooks, creative angles, audiences, formats, and offers.

Researching competitor advertisements and successful marketing strategies.

Preparing performance updates and actionable optimization recommendations.

Managing campaign changes within approved budgets and operating guidelines.

AI ADVERTISING AUTOMATION

We want to develop AI-powered workflows that can prepare creative assets, organize variations, populate campaign drafts, and assist with launching approved advertisements into our established campaign structures.

We're interested in using Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, AI agents, APIs, and other automation tools to streamline these processes.

The goal is to consistently launch more high-quality advertisements while maintaining strong control over profitability and spending.

One of our current priorities is increasing the volume of new advertising creatives being produced and tested.

3. WINNING PRODUCT RESEARCH, VALIDATION AND SOURCING

Finding more winning products is one of our biggest immediate business priorities.

We want a continuous pipeline of products with strong evidence of existing consumer demand.

Our philosophy is to identify products people already want rather than guessing what might sell.

We have access to TrendTrack and other product intelligence and competitor research platforms. We're also open to adopting stronger tools when they provide better data.

PRODUCT RESEARCH RESPONSIBILITIES

Continuously identifying promising products across boutique dresses, women's fashion, streetwear, accessories, and other relevant categories.

Researching products generating significant estimated sales and revenue.

Identifying successful competitors and analyzing their product offerings.

Reviewing competitor advertising creatives and marketing strategies.

Analyzing estimated advertising spend, reach, impressions, engagement, and campaign longevity.

Identifying how long successful competitor advertisements have been running.

Researching product demand, pricing, consumer interest, and market trends.

Evaluating product costs, selling prices, potential margins, and profitability.

Identifying opportunities to improve existing products through design, positioning, or superior advertising.

Cross-referencing research data to validate product opportunities.

Maintaining an organized pipeline of researched, shortlisted, sampled, tested, and launched products.

Presenting the strongest opportunities with supporting evidence and clear recommendations.

Competitor intelligence platforms provide estimates rather than guaranteed sales or advertising spending figures. We expect thoughtful validation before inventory commitments.

SUPPLIERS, DESIGNERS AND PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

Once a promising product is identified, you'll help coordinate the process of bringing it to market.

Responsibilities include:

Researching manufacturers and suppliers.

Communicating with suppliers and negotiating pricing using our existing SOPs and training.

Requesting product specifications, materials, sizing, colors, and customization options.

Evaluating minimum order quantities and production timelines.

Coordinating product samples and arranging shipment to our team.

Tracking supplier communications, sample deliveries, revisions, and production progress.

Working with designers on original products, custom modifications, and streetwear concepts.

Hiring and coordinating specialized freelancers for individual design or production tasks.

Organizing supplier information, pricing, and product specifications.

Preparing approved products for creative production, advertising, and launch.

We already have SOPs, training materials, and access to specialized professionals. Your responsibility is to coordinate the work, maintain quality, and keep projects moving.

Our ideal product development process begins with researching proven consumer demand, validating the opportunity, sourcing or designing the product, ordering samples, creating cinematic content, launching advertising campaigns, analyzing performance, and scaling successful products.

We want this process operating continuously so new product opportunities and advertising creatives are always entering the pipeline.

4. ORGANIC GROWTH, VIRAL CONTENT DISTRIBUTION AND CLIPPING

We want to expand our content distribution beyond our primary social media accounts.

You'll coordinate with our existing team members and external partners to distribute content, develop clipping campaigns, and identify opportunities for measurable organic growth.

Responsibilities include:

Coordinating with coworkers responsible for organic social media.

Organizing and scheduling content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other relevant platforms.

Researching viral content formats and successful creative strategies.

Identifying high-performing video concepts and opportunities to create new versions featuring our music or brands, with appropriate usage rights.

Coordinating short-form clipping campaigns for Rich Daniel Music.

Researching, hiring, and managing third-party clipping companies, creator networks, editors, and distribution agencies.

Developing additional relevant content pages and distribution channels.

Coordinating creators and freelancers producing content for our brands.

Tracking content performance, reach, engagement, traffic, streaming conversions, and sales.

Identifying distribution methods that generate measurable returns.

Continuously testing new approaches to expanding awareness and reaching potential customers.

We are comfortable using external agencies and contractors when the results justify the investment.

The objective is to build repeatable distribution systems that generate genuine awareness, streams, customers, and revenue.

5. AI AGENTS, AUTOMATION AND BUSINESS OPERATIONS

We're extremely interested in using AI agents and automation to make our businesses more efficient.

We want someone excited about researching new technologies, implementing useful systems, and gradually reducing repetitive manual work.

Potential automation projects include:

Monitoring Meta Ads performance and preparing reports.

Identifying advertising campaigns that require attention.

Organizing creative assets and preparing advertising campaign drafts.

Researching competing products and identifying promising opportunities.

Maintaining structured product research databases.

Tracking supplier communications and outstanding tasks.

Organizing content calendars and distribution workflows.

Coordinating freelancers, contractors, and project deadlines.

Automating repetitive reporting and administrative tasks.

Researching and implementing additional AI-powered business workflows.

We're open to using Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, AI agent frameworks, automation platforms, APIs, and whatever technologies are most effective.

We want someone who can independently investigate solutions, test them, and implement reliable workflows.

Major financial commitments, advertising budget increases, inventory purchases, and other consequential decisions must follow approved authority and controls.

6. INDEPENDENCE, INITIATIVE AND ACCOUNTABILITY

We want someone who genuinely enjoys solving problems and taking ownership.

Someone who notices when advertising performance is declining and investigates why.

Someone who identifies a promising product and moves the research forward.

Someone who finds a better tool, researches it, tests it, and introduces an improved workflow.

Someone who knows when to complete a task personally and when to coordinate a specialist.

We value exceptional creative taste, strong technical resourcefulness, independent thinking, business awareness, analytical skills, excellent communication, organization, accountability, and consistent execution.

We're looking for someone who takes initiative rather than waiting for detailed instructions for every task.

You should be comfortable managing multiple projects, communicating progress, coordinating people, and ensuring work gets completed properly.

7. OUR LONG-TERM VISION

We're building an increasingly efficient operation where the founder can focus primarily on recording music, performing, creating content, and developing the artistic vision.

The team, external specialists, and AI systems should progressively take responsibility for everyday business execution.

Over time, this position may evolve toward greater creative direction, AI filmmaking, advertising strategy, and management of automated systems.

We want someone interested in growing with the businesses and helping develop something substantial over the long term.

90-DAY TRIAL OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship, beginning with a 90-day paid trial period.

During this period, we'll evaluate creative production, communication, initiative, reliability, advertising execution, product research, and overall contribution to business growth.

Compensation, responsibilities, and expectations will be agreed upon before starting.

IMPORTANT: REQUIRED APPLICATION RESPONSE

To confirm that you've carefully read and understood the entire job description, please include the following exact sentence at the end of your application:

"I want to do the 90-day trial. I've read everything and I'm ready."

This sentence is required so we know you've reviewed the responsibilities, expectations, and hiring process.

We're excited to see what you can create and accomplish.

I am developing an original AI-generated sitcom series and seeking a talented AI video developer or animation specialist to bring my creative vision to life. I have already completed the script and character treatment, including the storyline, character descriptions, and creative direction. I am looking for a developer who can transform these materials into a professionally produced episodic series using AI video generation, animation, voice synthesis, and video editing technologies.

The ideal candidate will have experience creating consistent characters, developing engaging scenes, synchronizing dialogue, and maintaining visual continuity throughout an episode. The project requires someone who understands storytelling, comedic timing, character interactions, and the technical aspects of AI video production.

My goal is to produce a cohesive sitcom with recognizable characters, engaging dialogue, entertaining storylines, and a consistent visual style. I am not simply looking for someone to generate individual AI clips. I want a creative production partner who can help translate my script into a complete, polished viewing experience.

The initial project will focus on developing a proof of concept, establishing character consistency, and producing a sample scene. Depending on the quality of the initial production, I would like to establish a long-term working relationship to develop additional episodes.

Applicants should provide examples of previous AI video or animation projects, recommended production tools, estimated costs, and their approach to developing a sitcom from an existing script and character treatment. Ownership of my original script, characters, and intellectual property must remain clearly established throughout the project.

LONG-TERM COLLABORATION
We are looking for an ongoing production partner, starting with one paid pilot. If we are a good fit, we plan to produce at least 2 videos per week over the coming months.

We are looking for an AI video creator who can turn our supplied scripts and finished English voice-overs into engaging 8-9 minute fitness explainer videos. We want someone with a practical, efficient AI workflow and strong visual storytelling skills.

STYLE
Consistent 2D comic/illustrated visuals with one recurring male character and our brand accent color. Use clear visual examples, well-timed text, simple diagrams, comparisons, and selective animation to explain what is being said. The character does not need to move constantly. Each scene should serve the narration and keep viewers interested. Avoid generic stock-footage montages, random image swaps, repetitive slideshows, and distracting effects.

WHAT WE PROVIDE
- Final English script and finished voice-over
- Character and visual style references
- Brand colors, example videos, and direction for important scenes
- Existing visual assets where available

You should be able to create or adapt the remaining visuals yourself using AI and your editing tools. We are not providing a finished image for every scene.

YOUR ROLE
- Plan clear scenes from the script and voice-over
- Create consistent character poses, props, backgrounds, and explanatory visuals
- Edit the full video with purposeful motion, readable typography, and text reveals timed to the spoken words
- Add suitable licensed music/sound effects where useful and keep the narration clear
- Check the final export for visual glitches, distorted anatomy, flickering, spelling, and audio sync

DELIVERABLES
One complete 1920x1080, 16:9 MP4, at least 8 minutes and no longer than 9 minutes, with no watermarks. Use the complete supplied voice-over at its original speed. Include the editable project/source assets and one consolidated revision round. Scriptwriting, voice generation, thumbnails, and YouTube uploading are outside this assignment.

BUDGET AND WORKFLOW
$30 fixed price for one paid pilot video, including your normal AI generation/tool costs and the revision round. We are looking for a sustainable workflow at around $30 per finished video. Further paid videos will follow if the quality and collaboration are a good fit; at least 2 videos per week.

Efficient production matters, but the finished video must still be coherent and engaging.

originalDescription.text:
# EXPERT Facebook Ads Manager & AI Creative Strategist | $40K Monthly Ad Spend | SOLO FREELANCERS ONLY

## IMPORTANT: EXPERIENCED INDIVIDUAL FREELANCERS ONLY — NO AGENCIES, NO BEGINNERS!

We are looking for **ONE highly experienced, independent Facebook Ads Manager & AI Creative Specialist** to take full ownership of our e-commerce advertising operations.

**PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:**
- You are an agency, marketing company, or agency owner.
- You work with a team or plan to outsource any responsibilities.
- You are a beginner, junior media buyer, or still learning Facebook Ads.
- You have never personally managed significant e-commerce advertising budgets.
- You cannot demonstrate proven campaign results.
- You cannot personally produce professional advertising images and AI-generated videos.
- You are looking for a project to build your first portfolio.

**We are NOT hiring someone to learn on our advertising account. We need a proven expert who can deliver results from day one.**

## 1. About Our Business

**Company:** BAW Shop  
**Website:** https://www.baw.co.il  
**Target Country:** Israel ONLY  
**Current Advertising Platform:** Facebook (Meta Ads Manager)  
**Average Monthly Advertising Spend:** $40,000 USD  
**Annual Advertising Spend:** Approximately $480,000 USD  
**Business Model:** E-commerce / Direct-to-Consumer  
**Payment Methods:** Cash on Delivery (COD), Credit Cards & Bit  
**Position:** Long-Term / Remote / Individual Freelancer

BAW Shop is an Israeli e-commerce store selling a variety of consumer products exclusively to customers in Israel.

We currently invest approximately **$40,000 USD every month in Facebook advertising**.

Our goal is to find an experienced professional who can independently manage our advertising campaigns, improve profitability, develop winning creative strategies, and help us scale our business.

**Cash on Delivery (COD) is an important part of our business model.** Customers can order products online and pay upon delivery.

Our current advertising focus is Facebook. Experience with Instagram, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads, or other platforms is a significant advantage for potential future expansion, but not mandatory.

## 2. Full Facebook Ads Manager Responsibility

You will be responsible for our complete Facebook advertising operations.

Your responsibilities include:

- Independently manage and optimize all Facebook advertising campaigns.
- Monitor campaign performance daily.
- Manage our existing $40,000 monthly advertising budget.
- Develop effective advertising strategies for the Israeli market.
- Improve ROAS, reduce CPA, and increase profitable sales.
- Identify and scale winning campaigns and products.
- Pause, improve, or restructure underperforming campaigns.
- Create new campaigns, ad sets, and advertisements.
- Manage prospecting, retargeting, and scaling strategies.
- Perform A/B testing of audiences, creatives, hooks, copy, and offers.
- Analyze advertising frequency and creative fatigue.
- Research competitors and identify new advertising opportunities.
- Monitor Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and conversion tracking.
- Analyze attribution and campaign performance.
- Recommend advertising budget adjustments.
- Continuously improve advertising efficiency and profitability.

We expect a proactive expert who independently identifies problems, implements improvements, and develops new strategies.

## 3. AI Video Advertising Production — VERY IMPORTANT

You must be capable of independently creating professional, high-converting video advertisements using AI tools.

We are particularly interested in experience with **Google Flow / Google Veo**.

Your responsibilities include:

- Create realistic AI-generated UGC-style video advertisements.
- Produce professional 15–40-second advertising videos.
- Develop powerful hooks that capture attention in the first 1–3 seconds.
- Write persuasive advertising scripts.
- Create realistic AI spokesperson and product demonstration videos.
- Develop product-focused storytelling and problem-solution advertising concepts.
- Create multiple variations of winning video advertisements.
- Add accurate subtitles, motion graphics, zoom effects, transitions, and clear calls to action.
- Produce videos optimized for Facebook Feed, Reels, and Stories.
- Ensure products shown in AI-generated videos accurately match our real products.
- Create content suitable for Israeli consumers and Hebrew-speaking audiences.
- Deliver complete, edited, ready-to-launch video advertisements.

We are not interested in someone who only writes prompts or produces low-quality AI content.

**You must personally produce professional advertising videos and demonstrate previous work.**

## 4. Static Image Advertising Production

You will also be responsible for creating high-converting static advertising creatives.

Responsibilities include:

- Design professional Facebook advertising images.
- Create promotional, lifestyle, product-focused, and comparison advertisements.
- Develop new creative concepts based on customer pain points.
- Create different visual hooks and advertising angles.
- Produce multiple variations for A/B testing.
- Design advertisements in 1:1, 4:5, and 9:16 formats.
- Use Photoshop, Canva, AI image generation tools, or equivalent professional software.
- Maintain consistent product appearance and accurate advertising claims.
- Deliver finished, ready-to-publish advertising creatives.

All creative content must be appropriate for the Israeli market.

## 5. Advertising Copywriting & Creative Strategy

You will be responsible for developing persuasive advertising messages and creative concepts.

This includes:

- Researching Israeli customer behavior and competitors.
- Identifying customer pain points and purchase motivations.
- Writing compelling advertising headlines and primary texts.
- Developing strong hooks for image and video advertisements.
- Creating persuasive calls to action.
- Testing different advertising angles and messages.
- Developing new concepts for existing products.
- Creating Hebrew advertising copy or arranging reliable native-level quality control.
- Continuously improving advertising creatives based on performance data.

**Hebrew-language proficiency is a major advantage.**

If you do not speak Hebrew, you must explain how you will ensure accurate, natural, high-quality Hebrew advertising content while personally handling the work.

## 6. Cash on Delivery (COD) Marketing Experience

Our store supports Cash on Delivery, allowing customers to place orders online and pay upon delivery.

Experience with COD e-commerce is highly preferred.

You should understand how to:

- Promote Cash on Delivery as a trust-building selling point.
- Develop advertisements that attract genuine buyers.
- Improve customer acquisition quality.
- Reduce low-quality orders.
- Understand order confirmation, cancellation, and delivery-related challenges.
- Analyze actual sales performance rather than relying only on Meta-reported purchases.
- Optimize campaigns for profitability and successfully completed orders.
- Recommend strategies that improve order quality and customer trust.

## 7. KPI Monitoring, Analytics & Reporting

We require professional, transparent, and detailed performance reporting.

### Daily Monitoring

You must monitor:

- Total advertising spend
- ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)
- CPA / Cost per Purchase
- CPC (Cost per Click)
- CTR (Click-Through Rate)
- CPM (Cost per 1,000 Impressions)
- Conversion rate
- Purchase volume
- Attributed advertising revenue
- Campaign, ad set, and individual advertisement performance
- Creative fatigue and advertising frequency
- Cost efficiency and profitability

### Weekly Reports

You must provide a detailed weekly report containing:

1. Total advertising spend, revenue, and ROAS.
2. Best-performing and worst-performing campaigns.
3. CPA, conversion rate, and purchase performance.
4. Performance comparison with previous periods.
5. Creative testing results and key findings.
6. New advertisements produced and launched.
7. Changes and optimizations completed.
8. Problems identified and solutions implemented.
9. Budget allocation and scaling recommendations.
10. Clear action plan for the following week.

### Monthly Reports

Provide a comprehensive monthly performance review including:

- Overall advertising performance.
- Month-over-month KPI comparisons.
- Profitability and acquisition efficiency.
- Winning products, campaigns, and advertising creatives.
- Underperforming areas and recommended improvements.
- New creative strategies and growth opportunities.
- Budget allocation recommendations.
- Strategy for the upcoming month.

We expect meaningful analysis and actionable recommendations, not just spreadsheets filled with numbers.

## 8. Conversion Rate Optimization & E-commerce Strategy

We need someone who understands the complete customer journey.

Your responsibilities include:

- Analyze performance from advertisement to product page to checkout.
- Identify opportunities to improve product page conversion rates.
- Recommend improvements to landing pages and checkout.
- Evaluate promotional offers and product positioning.
- Test new advertising angles, offers, and bundles.
- Identify opportunities to increase average order value.
- Analyze customer acquisition efficiency.
- Recommend improvements that increase actual business profitability.

## 9. Expected Weekly Deliverables

We expect consistent, measurable work every week.

Initial expectations:

- Daily Facebook campaign monitoring and optimization.
- One detailed weekly KPI report.
- One weekly advertising strategy and optimization plan.
- Approximately 3–5 new static image advertisements.
- Approximately 2–3 AI-generated video advertisements.
- Multiple new hooks, headlines, and advertising copy variations.
- Continuous A/B testing.
- Ongoing campaign optimization and scaling.
- Proactive communication regarding results and opportunities.

Final deliverables will be agreed upon based on workload, campaign needs, and creative complexity.

## 10. Minimum Experience Requirements — STRICT

**Only experienced professionals should apply.**

You must have:

- **At least 5 years of hands-on Facebook / Meta Ads management experience.**
- **At least 3 years of e-commerce performance marketing experience.**
- Proven experience personally managing at least **$40,000 USD per month in advertising spend**.
- Preferably experience managing $50,000–$100,000+ monthly advertising budgets.
- A strong track record of improving ROAS, CPA, and campaign profitability.
- Proven experience with creative testing and advertising strategy.
- The ability to independently produce both static image advertisements and AI-generated videos.
- Practical experience with Google Flow / Veo or comparable AI video tools.
- Strong KPI reporting and analytical skills.
- Excellent communication and organizational skills.
- The ability to work independently without an agency, team, or subcontractors.

### Additional Advantages — Not Mandatory

- Experience advertising to Israeli customers.
- Hebrew-language proficiency.
- Cash on Delivery e-commerce experience.
- Experience with Instagram advertising.
- Experience with Google Ads, TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads, or other advertising platforms.
- Experience scaling e-commerce advertising accounts beyond $100K per month.

Our immediate focus is Facebook advertising. Other platform experience is valuable for possible future expansion.

## 11. What Success Looks Like

We will evaluate your performance based on:

- Improved advertising profitability.
- Sustainable ROAS.
- Reduced customer acquisition costs.
- Increased quality of customer orders.
- Consistent development of winning advertising creatives.
- Effective management of our $40,000 monthly advertising budget.
- Transparent and accurate reporting.
- Proactive problem-solving.
- Consistent optimization and testing.
- Sustainable business growth.

**Our priority is profitable sales, not simply spending more money on advertising.**

## 12. Application Questions — ALL ANSWERS REQUIRED

Please review our website before applying:

**https://www.baw.co.il**

Answer ALL the following questions:

**1. Independent Freelancer Verification**

Are you an individual freelancer working completely independently? Confirm that you are not an agency, agency owner, team, or middleman, and that you will personally perform all the work without outsourcing.

**2. Years of Experience**

How many years have you personally managed Facebook / Meta Ads campaigns? How many years have you worked specifically with e-commerce businesses?

**3. Advertising Budget Experience**

What is the largest monthly advertising budget you have personally managed? Have you managed accounts spending $40,000–$100,000+ per month?

**4. Proven Campaign Results**

Share at least two e-commerce case studies showing advertising spend, ROAS, CPA, and measurable improvements. Explain what you personally did to achieve those results.

**5. AI Video Production**

Have you personally created AI-generated UGC video advertisements using Google Flow, Veo, or similar tools? Share examples of videos you personally created.

**6. Static Image Production**

Can you independently design professional, high-converting Facebook image advertisements? Share examples of your previous work.

**7. Israeli Market Experience**

Have you previously managed advertising campaigns targeting Israeli customers? Do you speak Hebrew? If not, how will you ensure accurate Hebrew advertising content?

**8. Cash on Delivery Experience**

Have you managed advertising campaigns for COD e-commerce businesses? How do you measure campaign profitability when some orders are cancelled or never delivered?

**9. First 30-Day Strategy**

If you take over our existing Facebook advertising account with a $40,000 monthly budget, what would your first 30 days look like? Explain your audit, optimization, testing, and creative production strategy.

**10. Additional Advertising Platforms**

Besides Facebook, which advertising platforms have you personally managed? Please describe your experience with Google Ads, TikTok Ads, Instagram Ads, or other platforms.

**11. Reporting & Analytics**

What tools do you use for KPI tracking, campaign analysis, attribution, and performance reporting? Can you provide an example of a weekly report?

**12. Availability & Pricing**

How many hours per week can you personally dedicate to BAW Shop? What is your expected monthly management fee? Does your fee include image and AI video creative production?

**13. Communication**

originalDescription.text:
# AI Lifestyle Photography & Creative Imaging Partner
**Ongoing Freelance Collaboration**

### About the Brand

We are a British homewares and interiors brand specialising in beautifully designed textiles and accessories for the home, including table linens, cushions, bedding and children's interiors.

Our aesthetic is fresh, elegant and timeless, with a love of colour, original patterns and thoughtful styling. We believe in creating beautiful pieces that can be mixed and layered to bring personality to a home.

As we develop the next chapter of our brand, we're looking for a talented AI imaging specialist to work closely with us in creating a distinctive and consistent visual identity.

### The Opportunity

We're not simply looking for someone to generate a handful of AI images. We're looking for **a long-term creative partner** who can help us develop beautiful, realistic lifestyle photography featuring our actual products.

We want to create images that feel as though they've come from a professional interiors photoshoot, with the quality, styling and attention to detail you would expect to see in a leading interiors magazine.

**The most important requirement is that our images must never look obviously AI-generated.** They need to feel natural, fresh, sophisticated and completely believable.

We'll work closely with you to develop a shared understanding of our brand, our creative direction and the style of photography we want to become known for.

### What We'll Need

We want to build a comprehensive library of imagery for our own website, retailer websites, marketing campaigns and social media.

This will include:

- **Hero images:** Beautifully styled interiors featuring our products, suitable for homepage banners, collection pages and marketing campaigns.
- **Lifestyle product images:** Our tablecloths, cushions, bedding and other products photographed within realistic, thoughtfully styled interiors.
- **Close-up photography:** Detailed images showing fabric texture, patterns, ruffles, stitching and product finishes.
- **Products in use:** Natural, believable scenes showing how our products are used in everyday life, from a beautifully dressed table to cushions on a sofa or bedding in a bedroom.
- **Product cut-outs:** Clean, professionally finished images of individual products, isolated from their backgrounds, with accurate colours, proportions, patterns and construction details. Transparent and white-background versions where required.
- **Alternative compositions:** Different angles, crops and styling arrangements of the same products, suitable for different website and retailer requirements.

### Our Creative Direction

We love interiors that feel fresh, colourful and elegant without being overdone.

We're drawn to beautifully considered combinations of colour and pattern, natural light, interesting furniture and interiors that feel individual rather than overly coordinated.

We want our imagery to have personality, but also restraint. Nothing too staged, overly perfect, old-fashioned or artificial.

An important part of our brand is that our designs are created to complement one another, so we'd love to develop imagery that demonstrates how different patterns and products can be styled together.

We'll share reference imagery, our brand direction, product photographs, original artwork and fabric specifications to help guide the process.

### Product Accuracy Is Essential

One of our biggest challenges with AI imagery has been maintaining the accuracy of our actual products.

For example, a tablecloth may have a specific stripe width, colour, stripe direction and ruffle construction. These details must be reproduced faithfully.

We're therefore looking for someone who can combine AI image generation with strong Photoshop or image-editing skills to ensure that the final results accurately represent the products we're selling.

This is particularly important because the images will be used not only on our own website but also by our retail partners.

### How We'd Like to Work Together

We see this as an ongoing collaboration rather than a one-off project.

Initially, we'd like to work together on a small selection of images to establish the creative direction, develop a consistent visual style and understand the best process for producing accurate, high-quality results.

From there, we'd like to build an ongoing relationship as we introduce new collections and expand our imagery library.

We'll provide creative direction and product references, but we'd also welcome someone who brings their own ideas, styling instincts and technical expertise to the process.

Ideally, we'd like to find someone who becomes familiar with our brand and can help us maintain a consistent look and feel across everything we create.

### Who We're Looking For

Someone with:

- Proven experience creating photorealistic AI lifestyle and product imagery.
- A strong eye for interiors, styling, composition and colour.
- Excellent Photoshop and image-retouching skills.
- Experience incorporating real products into AI-generated environments.
- The ability to maintain accurate product details and consistent visual quality.
- A collaborative approach and an interest in building a long-term working relationship.

### To Apply

We'd love to see examples of your work, particularly realistic interiors or lifestyle images featuring actual products.

Please also share a little about your process, the AI and editing tools you use, and how you ensure products remain accurate within generated images.

If possible, we'd be particularly interested in seeing examples of original product photographs alongside the final AI lifestyle images.

We're excited to find someone who can help us bring our brand's visual world to life and become a valued creative partner as the business grows.
