About Us

We are an established European e-commerce company specializing in swords, fantasy weapons, movie and gaming replicas, collectibles and premium handcrafted products.

We are looking for a talented AI video creator and video editor who can transform our existing product images into high-quality, cinematic product videos suitable for our online shop, social media, marketing campaigns and advertising.

We will provide professional product images. Your job is to turn these images into visually impressive, premium-looking product videos using AI video tools and professional editing techniques.

What We Are Looking For

We want videos that make our products look premium, exciting and visually appealing.

The videos should be approximately 30–45 seconds long and combine cinematic visuals, subtle motion, dynamic transitions, lighting effects, text overlays, music and other creative elements where appropriate.

You may use tools such as CapCut, Kling, Runway, Veo, Seedance or other AI video generation and editing tools, depending on what works best for the project.

We are open to your creative approach and recommendations.

Extremely Important: Product Accuracy

The actual product must remain accurate and unchanged throughout the video.

We will provide product images from different angles, which should serve as the reference for the video creation process.

AI-generated videos often distort products during animation. This is something we specifically want to avoid.

The sword or product must retain its original appearance, including:

Blade shape, length, proportions and curvature

Guard, handle, pommel and other components

Colors, materials and surface details

Engravings, patterns and distinctive features

Overall proportions and design

The AI must not invent, alter, distort or add product details.

We expect you to use appropriate techniques to minimize AI hallucinations, for example, keeping the product relatively stable while animating the camera, background, lighting, atmosphere and surrounding elements.

If necessary, you should combine AI-generated scenes with conventional editing techniques to ensure that the product itself remains visually accurate.

Product accuracy is more important to us than excessive AI effects or unrealistic animation.

Your Responsibilities

Create professional 30–45 second product videos using our supplied product images.

Use AI video generation tools to create cinematic motion, environments and visual effects.

Edit the videos professionally, including transitions, music, sound effects, text overlays and pacing.

Ensure the product remains accurate and consistent throughout the video.

Create videos that communicate the quality, craftsmanship and unique features of our products.

Deliver finished videos ready for use in e-commerce, social media and advertising.

Be able to adapt your editing style to different product categories and marketing concepts.

The Style We Are Looking For

We envision high-quality, cinematic product videos.

Depending on the product, the visual style could include:

Dark, cinematic backgrounds

Dramatic lighting and reflections

Fantasy or medieval environments

Atmospheric smoke, sparks or particles

Subtle camera movements and cinematic zooms

Macro shots highlighting product details

Premium product presentation

Modern typography and professional text overlays

Carefully selected music and sound effects

The result should feel like a professionally produced product commercial rather than a basic slideshow or generic AI video.

Requirements

Proven experience creating AI-generated videos.

Strong video editing skills.

Experience with AI video tools such as CapCut, Kling, Runway, Veo, Seedance or similar.

Strong understanding of how to maintain visual consistency in AI-generated videos.

Ability to work with product images and turn them into compelling video content.

Attention to detail, particularly regarding product accuracy.

Creative thinking and the ability to suggest interesting video concepts.

Please include examples of AI-generated product videos or similar work in your application.

Project Scope & Payment

We are looking for freelancers who are willing to work on a fixed-price basis per video/project, not hourly.

Each video will be treated as a separate project, and we will agree on the price and scope of work before the project begins.

We are initially looking for a freelancer to create a few test videos.

If the quality meets our expectations, we are interested in establishing a long-term collaboration with regular video production.

We have a large range of products and would potentially require videos for multiple products over time.

How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

Examples of product videos you have created using AI.

Which AI tools and editing software you primarily use.

How you prevent AI from distorting or changing products during video generation.

Your proposed fixed price per 30–45 second video.

Your estimated turnaround time per video.

We are not looking for hourly contracts. We will pay a fixed price for each individual video/project.

We are particularly interested in freelancers who understand that creating a visually impressive video is only half the job – the actual product must remain accurate.

We look forward to seeing your work!

originalDescription.text:
Experienced Photorealistic AI Video Creator / Cinematic AI Filmmaker – Three-Season BL Drama Production

Project Overview

I am looking for an experienced photorealistic AI video creator, cinematic AI filmmaker or production team to produce an original vertical-format Boys' Love (BL) romantic drama titled:

MAFIA KING × MAFIA KING

Two Dons. One Love.

This is an original fictional drama about two powerful adult mafia men whose lives were intertwined during their teenage years. Circumstances beyond their control separated them before they had the opportunity to understand what they meant to one another. Years later, they find each other again, only to discover that their reunion is connected to a much larger story involving a hidden protagonist and events that unfold across three seasons.

The project has three planned seasons:

- Season One – Head & Heart
- Season Two – Power & Desire
- Season Three – Blood & Loyalty

My immediate priority is Season One, with the potential to continue into Seasons Two and Three.

The story, scripts, characters and creative direction have already been developed. I am looking for an experienced creator who can bring this material to life through exceptionally realistic, cinematic AI video production.

The Type of Creator I Am Looking For

I am looking for someone who specialises in photorealistic AI-generated human characters and cinematic drama production.

I am not looking for someone to generate individual character pictures, add basic movement and edit them together.

I need genuine flowing video production, with natural performances, believable physical interactions, consistent characters and properly constructed scenes.

The finished videos should feel like scenes from a professionally produced drama.

Viewers will understand that the production is AI-generated. However, the characters should look and move so convincingly that the audience can become immersed in the story rather than being distracted by obvious AI limitations.

Visual quality references

Please research the following productions before applying:

- Royal Blood
- Mafia Knight
- Pucked by My Hockey Rival
- Rival to Lovers

These are references for the visual realism, character presentation, movement, facial expressions and overall production quality I am looking for.

They are not references for copying stories, characters, costumes, dialogue or creative concepts. My story and characters are original.

Examples can be found through TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and other social platforms.

Please do not apply unless you have reviewed these references and understand the visual standard being requested.

Production Requirements

The most important requirements are:

- Photorealistic human characters.
- Consistent facial identity throughout every scene and episode.
- Consistent hairstyles, physiques, clothing and overall appearance.
- Consistent voices and convincing dialogue delivery.
- Accurate lip-sync.
- Natural facial expressions and emotional performances.
- Realistic body movement, gestures and physical interactions.
- Natural walking, sitting, standing and movement between characters.
- Convincing romantic interactions and affectionate gestures.
- Realistic camera movement, angles and cinematic framing.
- Smooth transitions between shots, locations and scenes.
- Consistent backgrounds, lighting and environmental details.
- Professional sound design, music placement and editing.

The characters must not suddenly look like different people from one shot to the next. Their clothing, facial features, voices and physical proportions must remain consistent.

I do not want robotic movement, unnatural expressions, frozen faces, awkward transitions or scenes that look like a collection of unrelated AI-generated clips.

The finished production must flow like a continuous drama, not a slideshow of generated images.

Episode Production – Three Seasons

The principal episodes are approximately two minutes long.

The scripts and timings have already been prepared.

The current episode structure includes:

- Most videos are approximately two minutes.
- Three episodes are shorter than two minutes.
- Approximately four to five episodes run between two minutes and two minutes thirty seconds.

Season One contains 30 story episodes, structured into approximately 53–55 individual video parts. The scripts have been divided and timed, so the exact running time and structure are already established.

Seasons Two and Three are also written and developed, with their own scripts, scenes, character requirements and production directions.

I would be happy to discuss production of all three seasons with one creator or production team, provided the quality and pricing are right.

I am equally open to splitting the work between multiple creators if that makes more financial and practical sense.

Promotional Shorts and Additional Content

There is a substantial amount of additional content beyond the main episodes.

Each season has its own collection of promotional and character-based shorts.

- Season One: More than 60 shorts.
- Season Two: Approximately 60–70 shorts.
- Season Three: A smaller collection, although still a substantial amount of additional content.

The shorts vary in length:

- Under one minute.
- Approximately one minute.
- Around one minute thirty seconds.

The standard shorts are no longer than one minute thirty seconds.

Some shorts have complete scripts and detailed directions. Others have an outline or concept rather than a full script. Some are music-led, with no dialogue, using original music and visual storytelling.

The shorts have different purposes and tones, including:

- Romantic moments.
- Flirtatious interactions.
- Funny and playful situations.
- Cheeky and mischievous moments.
- Affectionate character interactions.
- Relationship development.
- Music-led visual sequences.
- Alternative-universe scenarios.

There is also a considerable collection of shorts covering the characters' younger years and earlier relationship. These have their own visual and storytelling requirements and are separate from the adult storyline.

I am happy to consider a separate creator for the shorts if someone does not wish to undertake the full episodes.

Genre and Story Content

This is an adult Boys' Love (BL) romantic drama featuring two adult male protagonists.

Romance and the relationship between the two lead characters are central to the story. The production includes emotional relationship development, affection, romantic interactions, flirtation and dramatic relationship scenes appropriate to the genre.

The story also includes mafia-related drama, family relationships, loyalty, conflict, suspense and action.

The promotional shorts are generally lighter in tone and include romantic, funny, playful and cheeky character moments.

Please review the genre and subject matter before applying to ensure that this is a project you are comfortable working on.

Any work commissioned through this platform must remain within Upwork's content policies.

What I Already Have Prepared

I have already completed the substantial creative development work. I am not approaching a creator with just an idea and asking them to build everything from scratch.

I have:

- All three seasons written.
- All principal episode scripts.
- Scripts divided and timed for individual videos.
- Character sheets for the two main protagonists.
- Fully developed character designs, including reference views from multiple angles.
- Character designs for the additional supporting cast.
- Visual references for the characters and their appearances.
- Backgrounds and location references.
- Scene descriptions and production prompts.
- Camera angles and shot directions.
- Wardrobe and styling references.
- Dialogue and character directions.
- Original music written specifically for the production and its scenes.
- Music selections and directions for particular moments.
- Scripts, concepts and directions for the promotional shorts.

There are two main protagonists in this particular drama, but there are additional characters who are also developed and visually designed.

I will provide the relevant materials to the selected creator.

The creative direction, story, characters and music are already established. The production requirement is to turn this material into high-quality, realistic video.

One Creator or Multiple Creators

I am open to either arrangement.

I would be happy to work with one experienced creator or production company that can handle the complete production of all three seasons and the associated shorts.

However, I am equally happy to consider several specialists if that offers better value and quality.

For example:

- One creator for the main episodes.
- A separate creator for promotional shorts.
- A small team that can divide production between different workstreams.

I am interested in the quality of the finished work, the experience of the people involved and the overall cost.

Please explain which parts of the project you can realistically undertake.

Budget and Working Arrangement

I want to be upfront about the financial side of this project.

I am an independent creator funding this production personally from my own savings.

There is no production house, studio or external production team behind me. I am the person developing, writing, planning and financing the entire project.

I fully appreciate that professional creators have their own costs, software subscriptions, generation credits, time and expertise. I am not looking to undervalue anyone's work or expect professional production for unrealistic prices.

However, I also have to be financially responsible.

I do not want to compromise the quality of the production, but I must find a sustainable arrangement that I can personally afford.

I am open to discussing:

- Fixed prices per episode.
- Packages for a complete season.
- Separate pricing for promotional shorts.
- A staged production arrangement.
- One creator or multiple creators working on different parts of the project.

Please provide realistic pricing based on the work involved. If your pricing depends on complexity, please explain how you calculate it.

I am particularly interested in creators who can offer consistent quality across a substantial volume of content.

Paid Test – Required Before Any Long-Term Commitment

I am happy to pay for a test production.

However, I will only commission a test from someone who can already demonstrate relevant experience and a genuine understanding of the quality I am looking for.

I have a limited personal budget, and I cannot afford to repeatedly pay for tests that do not meet the required standard.

Before proposing a paid test, please:

1. Review the reference dramas listed above.
2. Watch the examples and assess the realism, movement, facial expressions and character consistency.
3. Review the project requirements.
4. Provide examples of your own comparable AI drama or cinematic human-character video work.

I would then be happy to discuss a paid test using one of my actual scripts.

The purpose of the test will be to assess whether you can achieve the required realism, character consistency, natural movement, dialogue, lip-sync, camera work and seamless scene transitions.

I am not looking for a collection of attractive individual shots. I need to see that you can create a convincing, flowing drama scene.

I will not commit to a complete season or long-term production until I am satisfied with the test.

Confidentiality and Ownership

The project contains original scripts, characters, music, storylines and creative material.

An NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement) will be required before confidential project materials are shared.

The ownership, permitted use and confidentiality of the supplied creative material will need to be agreed as part of the working arrangement.

I am looking for a professional working relationship built on clear communication, reliability and respect for the original work.

Potential for Future Work

Although my immediate focus is MAFIA KING × MAFIA KING, this is part of a much larger original creative universe.

There are six principal characters within the wider universe. This particular drama focuses on two of them.

The other characters have their own individual storylines, with some planned to run for two to four seasons.

The story of Alex and Matteo also continues beyond this drama. Eventually, their family dynasty develops into further stories involving their four children, who will have their own storylines and multiple planned seasons.

I am mentioning this because there is potential for substantial future work with the right creator or production team.

However, this is future potential, not a guaranteed contract or commitment at this stage. Any additional work will depend on production quality, pricing, availability and the success of the initial collaboration.

For now, the priority is Season One, with the possibility of continuing into Seasons Two and Three.

Who Should Apply?

I am looking for someone who:

- Has previous experience producing realistic AI-generated human video.
- Understands cinematic storytelling and drama production.
- Can demonstrate consistent character identity across multiple scenes.
- Can create realistic movement, expressions and interactions.
- Has experience with dialogue, lip-sync and voice consistency.
- Understands scene continuity and cinematic editing.
- Is comfortable with the BL romantic-drama genre.
- Can work from detailed scripts, character sheets and production directions.
- Is reliable, communicative and realistic about delivery times.
- Can provide transparent and sustainable pricing.

Please do not apply if you have never produced this type of realistic AI video before.

I am not looking for beginners who want to experiment using my project as their first attempt at cinematic AI drama production.

I am also not looking for someone whose portfolio consists primarily of still character images with basic animation or transitions.

When Applying, Please Include:

1. Examples of realistic AI-generated human drama or cinematic video you have personally produced.
2. Examples demonstrating natural movement, facial expressions, dialogue and lip-sync.
3. Examples showing the same characters maintaining consistent appearances across different scenes.
4. Which AI video tools and production workflow you use.
5. Whether you can undertake the main episodes, promotional shorts or both.
6. Your estimated price per two-minute episode.
7. Your estimated pricing for a complete season of approximately 53–55 video parts.
8. Your pricing for promotional shorts, preferably with rates for different lengths.
9. Your realistic production capacity and estimated delivery schedule.
10. Whether you are an individual creator or a team.

Please also confirm that you have reviewed the reference dramas and understand the visual standard being requested.

---

My aim is to find the right creative partner, not simply the cheapest provider.

I have invested a great deal of time, effort and personal money into developing this project. The scripts, characters, music and creative direction are already there.

What I need now is an experienced AI filmmaker who can bring them to life with the realism, consistency and cinematic quality they deserve.

Please research the realisim of the following drama and drama shorts for refrence. I can also provide the link (on TT, X, IG& YT)

Royal blood, mafia Knight
Pucked by my hockey rival
Rival to Lovers
Under his current

Hi! I'm launching a gamified learning app. Our mascot is a sarcastic cartoon fox who judges your study habits.

I want the mascot "invading" real student life. Real filmed footage (eg desk, library, phone, revising), with the mascot popping into the shot to roast you. Think cartoon meets real life. I have 15 illustrated poses of her ready to use.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Come up with funny ideas and write the jokes
- Film real footage yourself or anything you believe can work (no stock footage)
- Edit the mascot into the footage: movement, timing, captions, sound
- 2-3 short videos a week for TikTok / Instagram Reels
- 2-3 static posts a week for TikTok / Instagram
- Grow the account: follow trends, sounds and formats, and use what works to get more views, followers and shares
- Check what performs each week and adjust

MUST HAVE
- You film AND edit.
- No AI. The only possible exception is the mascot's voice or movement, and only if we agree on it first.
- Confident with editing tools, for example CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or something similar
- You can put a graphic or cartoon into real footage and make it look natural
- A genuine sense of humour
- You live online: you know current trends, memes, TikTok humour and brain rot, and can spot a trend early
- You can make content that fits both the trend and the app (studying, learning, procrastinating)
- Fluent English

HOW IT WORKS
- Paid test ($30): I send 3 mascot poses. You film a 10-15 second clip and put her in it so it's funny.
- If it works: weekly milestones for the first month, then monthly with a bonus for strong results.
- Budget: around $400 a month to start.

Please answer the screening questions in your own words. Short answers are fine.

originalDescription.text:
# AI Animation Specialist & YouTube Producer Needed for Children's Japanese Anime Series — Long-Term Opportunity

**Project:** Kaya & Bead-Z Adventures  
**Job Type:** Freelance / Potential Long-Term Partnership  
**Starting Budget:** $100 Paid Animation Trial  
**Future Work:** 5–8-Minute Animated Episodes, Music Videos, YouTube Shorts & Channel Management  
**Experience Level:** Intermediate to Expert  
**Location:** Worldwide / Remote

## About the Project

Hello!

I am launching a brand-new children's YouTube animated series called **Kaya & Bead-Z Adventures**, and I am searching for a talented, creative, and dependable animation specialist who can help bring my vision to life.

My goal is to find **one freelancer who can handle the entire creative and technical production process**, from developing animated scenes to editing, creating thumbnails, and publishing completed videos on YouTube.

This is not a one-time project. I am looking to establish a long-term working relationship with someone who can help build this series into a recognizable children's entertainment brand.

### About Kaya & Bead-Z Adventures

The series follows Kaya, a fun, curious, adventurous 9-year-old African American girl, and her magical best friend, Bead-Z.

Bead-Z is a talking, magical hair accessory with extraordinary powers.

Together, they travel through imaginative worlds, explore different hairstyles and hair textures, solve everyday childhood problems, and learn valuable lessons about confidence, friendship, kindness, self-love, and individuality.

The series will feature exciting adventures, humor, catchy original music, colorful fantasy environments, and meaningful educational messages.

**Our mission is to help every little girl feel beautiful, confident, and special, regardless of her hair type or texture.**

The intended audience is children approximately 5–10 years old.

I already have approved character concepts, product reference images, story ideas, scripts, theme song lyrics, and creative direction.

I need someone who can transform these materials into professional, engaging, fully animated YouTube content.

---

## 1. Animation Style — NON-NEGOTIABLE

The entire series must maintain a consistent **traditional Japanese 2D anime appearance**.

I do not want Pixar-style animation, 3D characters, or changes in the characters' appearances between scenes or episodes.

The animator must maintain:

- Consistent character faces, eyes, skin tones, hairstyles, and proportions.
- Accurate character outfits and accessories.
- Traditional Japanese anime-style illustrations and cel shading.
- Natural facial expressions, blinking, smiling, talking, and lip-sync.
- Smooth character movements and transitions.
- Beautiful, colorful, imaginative backgrounds.
- Professional camera movements, zooms, pans, and scene transitions.
- Consistent animation quality across every episode.

**Character consistency is one of my highest priorities.**

### Kaya — Main Character

Kaya is a 9-year-old African American girl with a funny, feisty, loving, curious, and adventurous personality.

Her traditional Japanese anime character appearance has already been approved.

The animator must use the approved reference design and maintain her recognizable appearance throughout the series.

### Bead-Z — Magical Best Friend

Bead-Z is a glossy purple hair accessory made of **exactly three rounded beads fused together into one clip-on bead**.

Its design is based on an actual product, and its structure must remain recognizable and accurate.

**Bead-Z's official design rules:**

- Bead-Z normally has expressive eyes and a talking mouth.
- No visible arms, hands, legs, or feet in its everyday appearance.
- Arms and hands magically appear only when needed.
- Legs and feet appear when Bead-Z dances, sings, runs, or goes on adventures.
- All limbs retract when they are no longer needed.
- When Bead-Z is preparing to clip onto hair or is being worn, all limbs must be hidden.
- The three fused beads and built-in clip mechanism must remain consistent.
- Bead-Z clips onto suitable hairstyles without rubber bands or a bead feeder.

The animator must understand these transformation rules and apply them consistently.

---

## 2. Character Design and Animation Production

I need a freelancer capable of producing complete animated episodes approximately **5–8 minutes long**.

Responsibilities include:

- Reviewing scripts, character designs, and creative instructions.
- Creating storyboards and planning individual scenes.
- Generating or illustrating consistent anime-style character images.
- Developing reusable character reference sheets and animation assets.
- Creating background environments for each adventure.
- Animating characters using AI-assisted or traditional 2D techniques.
- Creating natural facial expressions and dialogue lip-sync.
- Animating character interactions, movement, and magical transformations.
- Adding appropriate camera movements and visual effects.
- Combining scenes into complete, engaging episodes.
- Maintaining consistent characters throughout the entire production.

Experience with Kling AI, Runway, Toon Boom, Adobe After Effects, Moho, or similar software is preferred.

AI-assisted animation is welcome, provided the final videos are polished, consistent, and commercially usable.

---

## 3. Voiceovers, Music, and Sound Production

The series will feature character dialogue, original theme songs, background music, and magical sound effects.

I need help with:

- Creating distinct, consistent voices for Kaya, Bead-Z, and supporting characters.
- Synchronizing character dialogue with mouth movements.
- Incorporating original theme songs and musical performances.
- Creating magical sound effects and transitions.
- Adding appropriate background music.
- Producing clean, balanced audio.
- Maintaining consistent character voices across episodes.

The series will have two versions of its theme song:

**Version 1:** Approximately 25 seconds for regular YouTube episode introductions.

**Version 2:** Approximately 60–90 seconds for a standalone animated music video.

I will provide original lyrics and creative direction.

Experience with ElevenLabs, Suno, or similar tools is beneficial.

All music, voices, and sound effects must be properly licensed for commercial use.

---

## 4. Video Editing and Final Production

The freelancer must be capable of editing complete episodes and preparing them for publication.

Responsibilities include:

- Combining all animated scenes.
- Adding dialogue, music, and sound effects.
- Synchronizing audio and animation.
- Creating smooth transitions.
- Incorporating the official intro and outro.
- Correcting visual or audio inconsistencies.
- Reviewing the finished video for errors.
- Exporting videos in high-quality MP4 format.

**Final video requirements:**

- Resolution: 1920 × 1080 or higher.
- Aspect ratio: 16:9 for regular episodes.
- Clear, professional audio.
- No watermarks.
- Appropriate for children's entertainment.
- Ready for publication on YouTube.

---

## 5. YouTube Channel Setup, SEO, and Publishing

I am starting this YouTube channel from scratch and would like the freelancer to assist with the technical setup and ongoing content management.

Responsibilities include:

- Helping configure and customize YouTube Studio.
- Uploading completed videos.
- Creating professional, colorful, anime-style YouTube thumbnails.
- Writing engaging, searchable video titles.
- Creating SEO-friendly descriptions.
- Researching relevant keywords and hashtags.
- Organizing episodes into playlists.
- Scheduling and publishing videos.
- Creating YouTube Shorts from longer episodes.
- Monitoring basic channel analytics.
- Recommending improvements based on audience retention and video performance.
- Helping establish a consistent publishing schedule.

The freelancer must understand YouTube's **Made for Kids** content requirements, including the limitations on certain advertising and engagement features.

The goal is to build an engaging channel that can eventually qualify for the YouTube Partner Program.

**Important:** No freelancer should promise guaranteed views, subscribers, rankings, or monetization approval.

### YouTube Account Security

I will maintain full ownership and administrative control of the YouTube channel.

The freelancer will receive appropriate access through YouTube Studio permissions.

I will not share my Google account password or transfer ownership of the channel.

All videos, titles, thumbnails, and descriptions must receive my approval before publication.

---

## 6. YouTube Thumbnails and Branding

The freelancer must create engaging, professional thumbnails that are visually consistent with the anime series.

Thumbnail requirements include:

- Traditional Japanese 2D anime style.
- Accurate Kaya and Bead-Z character designs.
- Bright, playful rainbow colors.
- Exciting facial expressions.
- Bold, easy-to-read text.
- Eye-catching adventure backgrounds.
- Consistent branding across episodes.
- Standard 16:9 YouTube thumbnail dimensions.

I will provide existing channel branding and character references.

The freelancer must not redesign the characters or change their animation style without approval.

---

## 7. Initial Paid Trial — $100 Budget

Before committing to ongoing work, I want to begin with a **$100 paid animation test**.

The trial will involve creating a **10–15-second animated scene** featuring Kaya and Bead-Z.

The test should demonstrate:

- Accurate traditional Japanese anime character designs.
- Consistent character appearance across multiple shots.
- Natural facial expressions.
- Basic character movement.
- Bead-Z's correct three-bead structure.
- Dialogue with synchronized mouth movement.
- Appropriate camera movement.
- Clean animation and professional presentation.

The test must include at least three distinct shots showing the same characters from different angles or positions.

**This trial is extremely important because I need to verify that the freelancer can maintain character consistency before commissioning full episodes.**

The trial budget is $100. Please confirm what you can realistically deliver within this amount.

The test is paid, and all deliverables and rights must follow our agreed project terms.

---

## 8. Project Milestones

I prefer to work through Upwork's fixed-price milestone system.

### Milestone 1 — Paid Animation Test

Create a 10–15-second sample featuring Kaya and Bead-Z.

**Budget: $100**

### Milestone 2 — Official YouTube Intro

Create a complete 25-second animated opening featuring the characters, theme song, magical effects, and series branding.

The budget will be agreed upon after the trial.

### Milestone 3 — Extended Theme Song Video

Create a 60–90-second animated music video featuring Kaya, Bead-Z, singing, dancing, and magical adventures.

### Milestone 4 — Pilot Episode

Produce the first complete 5–8-minute animated episode, including voiceovers, music, sound effects, animation, and editing.

### Milestone 5 — YouTube Launch

Prepare and upload approved videos, create thumbnails, optimize titles and descriptions, organize playlists, and schedule content.

### Milestone 6 — Ongoing Episodes

If the pilot meets expectations, establish a recurring production schedule, initially targeting approximately two full episodes per month, subject to agreed pricing and production capacity.

Each milestone will have an agreed scope, price, deadline, and revision allowance before work begins.

---

## 9. Ownership, Copyright, and Commercial Rights

This project involves original characters and a children's entertainment brand that I intend to develop long-term.

Ownership and licensing are extremely important.

The freelancer must agree to written terms ensuring that, upon payment, I receive the agreed ownership or commercial-use rights to all original project-specific deliverables.

This includes, as applicable:

- Final animated videos.
- Character artwork created for the project.
- Background illustrations.
- Original graphics and thumbnails.
- Editable animation project files.
- Reusable character rigs and animation assets.
- Original audio and music files, where transferable.
- Other project-specific creative assets.

Any third-party assets, AI-generated materials, music, fonts, or software components must have appropriate commercial licenses.

The freelancer must disclose any licensing limitations before using those materials.

My existing Kaya and Bead-Z characters, designs, brand materials, and product references remain my intellectual property.

They may not be reused, sold, licensed, or incorporated into unrelated projects without my written permission.

Any portfolio use or public sharing of unreleased work must receive my prior approval.

---

## 10. Portfolio Verification — REQUIRED

**I will not select a freelancer based only on attractive still images or unrelated AI artwork.**

Applicants must provide examples of completed animated videos.

I especially want to see:

- Traditional Japanese anime-style animation.
- Children's animated stories.
- Consistent characters appearing across multiple scenes.
- Talking characters with accurate lip-sync.
- Character movements and camera transitions.
- Finished videos with music, dialogue, and sound effects.

**Please provide at least one example showing the same animated character in three or more different scenes.**

This will help me evaluate your ability to maintain character consistency.

Please also identify which parts of your samples you personally created.

---

## 11. Communication and Workflow

I am looking for someone dependable, organized, creative, and easy to communicate with.

The ideal freelancer should:

- Provide clear production timelines.
- Communicate regularly.
- Share work-in-progress previews.
- Ask questions when creative direction is unclear.
- Follow approved character references.
- Accept feedback professionally.
- Correct errors before final delivery.
- Meet agreed deadlines.
- Be interested in helping develop the series over time.

I would like to approve the storyboard and character references before full animation begins.

I also expect a reasonable number of revisions to be included in each agreed milestone.

---

## 12. What I Will Provide

I will provide:

- The overall concept and creative direction.
- Approved character designs.
- The original Bead-Z product photograph.
- Character personality descriptions.
- Episode ideas and story concepts.
- Scripts and dialogue, when available.
- Original theme song lyrics.
- YouTube branding materials.
- Creative feedback and approvals.

The freelancer should be comfortable organizing these materials into a professional production workflow.

---

## 13. Questions Every Applicant Must Answer

Please answer all questions when submitting your proposal.

1. Have you created traditional Japanese 2D anime-style animation? Please provide links.
2. Can you maintain the exact same character designs throughout multiple scenes and episodes?
3. Can you show a completed animation featuring the same character in at least three different scenes?
4. What AI animation and video editing tools do you use?
5. Can you create character dialogue with accurate lip-sync?
6. Can you animate original songs and musical performances?
7. Can you create the full video from script and character references to final export?
8. Can you assist with YouTube thumbnails, SEO, uploads, and publishing?
9. What can you deliver for the $100 paid trial?
10. What would you charge for a 25-second animated intro?
11. What would you charge for a 60–90-second music video?
12. What would you charge for a complete 5–8-minute animated episode?
13. How long would each deliverable take?
14. How many revisions are included in your pricing?
15. Will you provide editable project files and commercially licensed deliverables?
16. Are you interested in a long-term working relationship?

**Please begin your proposal with the words "Kaya's Magical Adventure" so I know you have read the entire job description.**

## Final Note

I am passionate about creating a fun, uplifting, entertaining series that helps children celebrate their individuality and feel confident about who they are.

I want to build something special, and I am looking for a creative partner who is excited about helping turn this vision into a successful children's YouTube series.

If you have the experience, creativity, and technical skills to bring Kaya & Bead-Z to life, I would love to hear from you!

Thank you, and I look forward to reviewing your portfolio.

We're hiring a creative with a strange sense of humour and strong taste to make one 15 to 20 second absurdist AI-generated video for Anchor Compliance, a Canadian software company for confined space safety.

Health and safety marketing is boring, and every company in the industry sounds the same. We want to be the exception. Two milestones: 3 to 4 still frames for approval, then the final video.

Rules: original characters and objects only, with no copyrighted characters, real people or other brands; nothing showing unsafe work, injury or death; full commercial rights and the music licence transfer on payment.

To apply, send links to your funniest or strangest AI video work, the most absurd idea you can think of for a video about paperwork (one or two sentences), the tools you use, your fixed price and your timeline.

AI Video Ad Creator – Recreate Existing Ads Using AI Tools

Job Title: AI Video Ad Creator / AI Ad Recreation Specialist

Job Description

We are looking for a skilled AI Video Ad Creator who can help us recreate existing advertisements using AI tools and technologies.

The ideal candidate should have experience analyzing existing video ads, identifying their creative elements, and recreating them using AI-powered video generation and editing tools. We want someone who can take inspiration from existing ads and produce high-quality AI-generated versions that closely replicate their style, structure, messaging, and overall presentation.


Key Responsibilities

- Analyze existing video advertisements and recreate them using AI tools.
- Convert traditional video ads into AI-generated versions while maintaining their original creative direction.
- Use AI tools to replicate scenes, transitions, animations, voiceovers, characters, and other visual elements.
- Create new ad variations based on existing successful advertisements.
- Ensure the final videos are professional, engaging, and suitable for digital marketing campaigns.
- Recommend the best AI tools and workflows for efficient ad production.


Required Skills & Experience

- Proven experience in AI-generated video production and ad creation.
- Proficiency with tools such as Higgsfield AI, Runway, Kling AI, Sora, Veo, HeyGen, or similar platforms.
- Experience recreating or cloning existing video advertisements using AI.
- Strong understanding of video editing, storytelling, visual effects, and commercial advertising.
- Ability to produce realistic AI-generated scenes, characters, and product visuals.
- Attention to detail and ability to match the style and quality of reference advertisements.


What We Expect

We will provide examples of existing advertisements that we want recreated or adapted using AI.

The freelancer should be able to:
1. Review and analyze the reference advertisements.
2. Recommend the best AI tools and approach for recreating them.
3. Produce AI-generated versions that closely match the original creative direction.
4. Deliver polished, high-quality video ads ready for marketing use.


To Apply

Please include the following in your proposal:

1. Examples of AI-generated video advertisements you have created.
2. Examples of existing ads you have successfully recreated using AI, if available.
3. The AI tools you typically use for this type of work.
4. Your estimated turnaround time and pricing per video ad.
5. A brief explanation of how you would approach recreating an existing advertisement using AI.

Bonus: Experience recreating commercial ads for brands, real estate, hospitality, technology, or service-based businesses.

We are interested in finding someone for ongoing collaboration if the quality of work meets our expectations.

originalDescription.text:
We are a growing eCommerce company operating in the pet travel space. Our brand focuses on creating innovative cat carriers that make traveling with cats safer, more convenient, and comfortable.

With our advertising content reaching millions of cat owners every month, we're looking to bring an experienced Video Editor into our creative team. This is a full-time opportunity intended for someone interested in building a stable, long-term professional relationship with our brand.

Your Role and Responsibilities
You will be responsible for developing advertising creatives from initial concepts to finished videos, including:

- Editing Meta (Facebook and Instagram) video advertisements and Video Sales Letters (VSLs).
- Combining voiceovers, AI-created visuals, original product recordings, stock footage, transitions, effects, and subtitles into polished advertising content.
- Generating realistic AI images and video sequences suitable for commercial advertising.
- Finding and incorporating relevant B-roll footage from different online sources. We will also provide access to our stock media library.
- Building compelling, emotionally engaging, documentary-inspired stories that maintain audience interest and lead naturally to the final offer.
- Producing a weekly creative output of at least 5 distinct advertising hooks, with 4 creative variations for each hook (20 videos in total).

Skills and Experience
The ideal candidate will have:

- Practical experience using AI tools to generate images and videos for commercial advertising.
- Strong knowledge of professional editing applications, including Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro. CapCut alone is not sufficient for this position.
- A good understanding of visual storytelling, pacing, and how individual shots contribute to the overall message.
- Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. You should be comfortable interpreting scripts, discussing creative concepts, and participating in regular team calls and written discussions.
- A structured and independent working approach, with good time management, attention to detail, and consistent communication.

Working Arrangements
The position offers flexibility in terms of working hours, as long as agreed production volumes and quality standards are consistently maintained.

For the first week, you will be expected to work according to CET time to allow our Europe-based team to provide onboarding, guidance, and feedback throughout the training process.

Materials and Tools Provided
You will have access to the resources needed to create and edit the advertising content, including:

- Ready-to-use advertising scripts.
- Original footage of our products.
- UGC (user-generated content) materials.
- Paid AI subscriptions and software required for image and video generation, voiceover production, and AI talking-head videos.
- Additional Qualifications We Value

These skills are not mandatory, but would be considered a plus:
- Previous experience working with pet brands or animal-related products.
- A background in producing VSLs and AI-assisted advertising creatives.
- A portfolio demonstrating successful advertising hooks and high-performing video concepts.
- Familiarity with graphic design, animation, and motion graphics.

What You Can Expect From Us
- A full-time collaboration with the intention of working together over the long term.
- Competitive payment, supplemented by weekly and quarterly performance-based bonuses.
- Ongoing projects and a reliable volume of work.
- A collaborative, fast-paced creative team.
- Opportunities to improve your skills, take on creative challenges, and grow professionally alongside an expanding brand.

How to Apply
We would like to make sure applicants have reviewed the full description before submitting their proposals.

Please start your application with the word "PURRFECT".

Your proposal should contain:

Wie is STIL T
STIL T maakt Douglas overkappingen, buitenkeukens en bars als compleet bouwpakket op maat. Klanten

Video brief
Short advertising videos for patio covers and outdoor kitchens · 23 November 2026

The request in brief. STIL T is looking for an AI content creator to make short advertisements for Instagram and Facebook. Each video shows one benefit of one product, in 15 to 25 seconds, and must look as though it was actually filmed. The product on screen must be an exact match for the real product.
Below, we explain who we are, what we expect for each video, where AI video goes wrong and five ideas written out to get started.

Who is STIL T?
STIL T makes made-to-measure Douglas fir patio covers, outdoor kitchens and bars as complete assembly kits. Customers put their design together themselves in a 3D configurator on stilt.nl and then build it themselves using a 3D assembly guide. Our slogan is “You make your own outdoor happiness.” The two outdoor kitchens covered in this brief are called Close (with a flap that serves as a canopy when open) and Fold (with folding doors).

What we expect for each video
Format: vertical 9:16 as the main version, plus square 1:1.
Length: 15 to 25 seconds.
One promise per video. No list of benefits.
The first two seconds should make the viewer stop scrolling.
Easy to follow without sound: short on-screen text, five words per line at most.
Sound: natural ambient sound, possibly quiet music. No voice unless agreed.
End card: product name, slogan and STIL T logo.
Two or three opening variations per idea so we can test.

Where AI video goes wrong
We did our own trials and drew these rules from them. They are firm requirements for us.
The product is an exact match for the real product. Every shot starts with an image built from our own product photos. Construction, proportions, number of doors, hinges and walls must be right. For example, the side walls of the Close are closed along their full depth. We will reject an image with a half-length side wall.
The product does not move on its own. Only the camera moves, and slowly. Things that move in real life may move: rain, smoke, fire, leaves, people. A barbecue rolling toward the camera looks fake.
No lettering or logos from the AI model. Add text and logo in the edit, in our own typeface.
Keep people small in the frame and ordinary-looking. Prefer a view from behind or the side to a facial close-up. Use an ordinary Dutch backyard, no villa.
Do not show any price, delivery time, build time or other claim in the picture or text without confirmation from us.
Do not use a real customer’s garden or face without permission. Customer photos are only examples of shape and angle.

Five ideas
The on-screen lines are suggestions. The order reflects our preference: the patio cover is our biggest product, and a trial of the first idea already exists.

1. Close outdoor kitchen · “It’s raining. You’re staying dry.”
Promise: the flap of the Close is your canopy, so you can barbecue even when it rains.
Time / image / on-screen text
0–4 s: Backyard in a downpour. The Close stands with its flap open and wall lights on, the only warm spot in the frame. Static camera. No text.
4–8 s: Someone stands calmly under the flap turning a steak. Water runs off the flap in a curtain. “It’s raining.”
8–12 s: The camera glides toward the open kamado: glowing coals, steam, a dry countertop. “You’re staying dry.”
12–18 s: Wide shot at an oblique side angle, then the end card. “Close outdoor kitchen · You make your own outdoor happiness.”
Images from our trial version. We will send these as an example of tone and pace.

2. Patio cover · “Design it yourself”
Promise: you configure the cover to your own dimensions and can see immediately how it will look.
Why: customers choose us primarily for sizing and price. Competitors’ videos showing the configurator are the ads that stay in circulation longest.
Time / image / on-screen text
0–3 s: Empty corner of a terrace. Someone holds up a phone as though measuring the space. “Would a patio cover fit here?”
3–10 s: Screen recording of the 3D configurator on the phone: adjust width and depth, choose the roof, add the back wall. “Your dimensions. Your design.”
10–16 s: The 3D design transitions to the same cover, actually built on the same terrace in the evening light, with people underneath. No text.
16–20 s: End card. “Configure your patio cover · stilt.nl”
How: we supply the actual screen recording. The garden images may be AI, provided the cover exactly matches the design in the recording.

3. Patio cover · “Outdoors every season”
Promise: a patio cover lets you use your garden all year.
Why: the same principle as the Close in the rain, but for our biggest product. It works well with AI because only the weather changes while the cover stays still.
Time / image / on-screen text
0–4 s: Fixed camera on one cover in one garden. Downpour, someone sitting dry underneath with a coffee. “Rain.”
4–8 s: Same viewpoint, autumn: wind, falling leaves, light on. “Autumn.”
8–12 s: Same viewpoint, winter evening with snow and lights, people with a blanket. “Winter.”
12–16 s: Same viewpoint, long summer evening with a set table. “Summer.”
16–20 s: End card. “Outdoors every season · You make your own outdoor happiness.”
Important: the cover, garden and camera position must be identical in all four shots. That is the whole point of the video.

4. Patio cover · “You build this yourself”
Promise: it’s a kit, and you really can build it yourself.
Why: customers doubt they can do it themselves and worry they will still have to hire expensive help. Competitors use self-assembly in advertising, and it attracts many viewers on YouTube.
Time / image / on-screen text
0–3 s: The cover is finished and furnished. “Can you believe this is a kit?”
3–7 s: Kit on the driveway: Douglas fir beams and boards cut to size. “Everything cut to size.”
7–14 s: Two people building, with the tablet showing the 3D assembly guide beside them. Screen recording of the guide: each part falls into place. “Step by step in 3D.”
14–20 s: The same two people at the table under the cover, then the end card. “Built it ourselves. · stilt.nl”
How: this idea works best with actual construction footage, supplemented with AI for the transitions. We supply the screen recording of the assembly guide. Do not mention a build time.

5. Fold outdoor kitchen · “I built that myself”
Promise: the pride you feel when friends ask where you got that outdoor kitchen.
Why: for outdoor kitchens, no competitor advertises a wooden assembly kit. That is an opportunity for us.
Time / image / on-screen text
0–3 s: The folding doors of the Fold open, revealing the kamado. “You build this yourself.”
3–10 s: Assembly in the garden with the 3D assembly guide on a tablet. “Can I do that? Yes.”
10–15 s: Close-up of the kamado in the countertop, lid open, smoke. “Will your kamado fit?”
15–20 s: Friends arrive. The owner points at the Fold with the barbecue tongs and laughs. End card. “Built it myself. · stilt.nl”

What we supply
Product photos of each product from the front, the side and in detail.
Customer photos in real gardens, only as examples of shape and angle.
Screen recordings of the 3D configurator and the 3D assembly guide.
Logo, fonts and brand colours.
A list of facts you may mention.
Our own Close trial video as an example.

How we work together
We work in four steps for each video and approve each step, so time and money are not wasted on images that are wrong.
Step / What we receive / What we look for
1. Script: shots, on-screen text, sound. One promise, strong first two seconds.
2. Still starting images, one for each shot. Does the product match when placed beside our photos?
3. Low-quality draft version. Does only what should move actually move? Is the pace right?
4. Final version. Sharpness, text, sound, end card.
Delivery per video: 1080p MP4 in 9:16 and 1:1, a version without text, the individual shots and the starting images used. All usage rights belong to STIL T.
Please include in your proposal: price per video and per extra opening variation, turnaround time, number of revision rounds, tools you use and two or three examples of earlier work in which you reproduced an existing product exactly.
STIL T · stilt.nl · You make your own outdoor happiness.

originalDescription.text:
We’re looking for someone skilled at prompting AI video models and producing realistic, high-quality clips.

You don’t need an e-commerce advertising background. What matters is whether you can take a reference image or shot description and turn it into believable footage.

This is an ongoing hourly position, starting with a paid trial.

What you’ll do
Generate short clips from reference images, example videos, and shot instructions.
Create realistic people, natural movement, convincing object interactions, and interesting camera angles.
Refine prompts and regenerate until the shot looks right—not just accept the first output.
Keep the appearance of people and objects consistent with the references.
Check your clips for distorted hands, changing objects, unnatural motion, and other AI artifacts.
Organize finished clips into a categorized clip library.
This role focuses on generating individual clips—not editing complete ads, writing scripts, or adding captions and music.

What we’re looking for
Strong examples of realistic AI-generated video.
Experience with tools such as Kling, Veo, Seedance, Higgsfield, Runway, Sora, or similar.
Strong text-to-video and image-to-video prompting skills.
Good visual judgment and the patience to improve a shot through multiple attempts.
Reliable communication and the ability to follow a specific brief.
To apply
Please send:

2–3 of your strongest relevant AI-generated clips.
Which tools you used and what you personally did.
Your hourly rate and weekly availability.
We’ll invite suitable applicants to a $30 paid trial to generate 6 short clips, with references and instructions supplied.

Message 1 — Send to applicants
Thanks for applying! We hire based on whether someone can produce useful content for our specific products—not just a strong general portfolio.

Would you be interested in a $30 paid trial to generate 6 short AI video clips? We’ll provide the product references and shot instructions.

If it’s a good fit, this will be an ongoing hourly position creating clips and organizing them into our clip bank for use in ads.

Let me know if you’re interested and I’ll send over the trial details!

originalDescription.text:
We are a boutique digital marketing agency working with luxury hotels, restaurants, travel and premium lifestyle brands. We are looking for an AI content creator whose work does not look like AI.

The quality bar is high. Our clients pay for premium content, so what you deliver has to pass as real, professionally shot footage. That means natural skin and faces, believable movement, correct hands, realistic lighting, and nothing plastic or uncanny. If your work looks typically "AI", this role is not for you.

What you will do

Create short-form AI video and image content for social media and ads (Reels, TikTok, Meta and Google ad creatives)
Generate realistic people, food, interiors and hospitality scenes
Keep characters and visual style consistent across a series
Edit, upscale and finish content so it is ready to publish

Requirements

Proven experience creating photorealistic AI video featuring people
Able to work during Central European Time (CET) business hours
Minimum 20 hours per week, typically up to 30
You work with your own tools and subscriptions. We do not provide any software, accounts, credits or tokens.
The tools you use must allow commercial use of the output for client work
Good written English

Rate
Long-term, hourly engagement. Please quote one all-inclusive hourly rate that covers your time, tools, tokens, generation credits and prompting. We will not pay any extra costs on top.

How to apply
Do not send your full portfolio. Send ONE video: the single most lifelike AI video featuring people that you have made. In your application, also tell us:

Which tools you used for that video
How long it took to produce
Your all-inclusive hourly rate
How many hours per week you can commit within CET hours

Start your application with the word REALISTIC so we know you have read the full post. Generic or copy-paste applications will not be considered.

Important: all communication stays on Upwork. If you try to contact us outside the platform or ask to move the conversation elsewhere, your application will be declined and reported to Upwork.

originalDescription.text:
Experienced Clothing Resale Lister for eBay, Poshmark & Depop

Pretty Habit is hiring a lister with experience listing clothing on eBay, Poshmark, and Depop. I’ll share garment photos in Google Drive. You’ll complete 5 items per day or work ahead and keep enough finished drafts in Nifty for me to publish 5 items daily. I’ll review and publish everything.

What you’ll do

- Write exactly 80-character titles. Put the recognizable brand first, Women’s or Men’s next, and size at the end.
- Put the title, 10 comma-separated keywords, and 5 hashtags in the description box.
- Add Depop hashtags, choose Poshmark style tags, and select matching Theme options when available. Fill in Depop’s Style, Age, and Source fields.
- Complete the eBay category and item specifics. Use the garment tags to verify details and flag anything unclear.
- Enter the SKU, shipping weight, package dimensions, and the price I provide. Use the same price across all three platforms.

You must be able to recognize common aesthetics like classic, preppy, boho, and streetwear. Do all listing work without AI. You may use Nifty’s background remover on the main photo.

To apply

Send two clothing listings you created, briefly describe your marketplace and Nifty experience, and include your rate per completed item and whether you prefer daily or batch work.

originalDescription.text:
Description:
I'm a romance author looking for an AI video creator to turn scenes from my dark mafia romance novels into short, cinematic Facebook and Instagram ads and reels. The first project is two videos for The Mafia Marriage Contract. If the results perform well, more books and series will follow.
What I'm looking for
Photorealistic, movie-quality scenes with consistent characters, real lip-synced dialogue and emotional close-ups. The goal is a clip that feels like a moment from a film adaptation and stops people scrolling. I'll share a reference video with shortlisted applicants showing exactly the style, pacing and length I want.
Deliverables (per video)
•	1 finished video, about 55–60 seconds long
•	1:1 square, 1080×1080, 30fps, MP4 (H.264)
•	Photorealistic AI-generated footage, with the same characters looking consistent in every shot (faces, hair, wardrobe)
•	Lip-synced dialogue with distinct character voices, including an Irish accent for the heroine
•	Background music or ambient sound with no silent gaps, mixed so the dialogue is clear
•	A new shot every 2–4 seconds, mixing wide shots with close-up reactions
•	Two exports: a clean version with no text, and a version with burned-in subtitles
What I provide
•	A shot-by-shot script with the dialogue already written
•	Detailed character descriptions
•	The book cover, if needed
Content requirements
•	The videos must pass Meta's ad review: no nudity, no profanity, no sexual content, no gore, no weapons pointed at people
•	The themes are mature (mafia, danger, romantic tension), but the footage itself should stay suggestive rather than explicit
Rights
You must use tools whose licenses allow commercial use. I receive full commercial rights to all final videos and any assets created for them.
Revisions: 2 rounds per video.
Timeline: December 15, 2026
Budget: $200 per video
To apply, please include:
1.	Links to 2–3 AI videos you've made with lip-synced dialogue and consistent characters across several shots. Applications without examples won't be considered.
2.	The tools you use for video generation, lip sync and voices.
3.	Your turnaround time for one 60-second video.
4.	Your price per video, and for a bundle of 2.
5.	Start your reply with the word "Altar" so I know you read this posting.

**Who We Are**

We operate multiple DTC e-commerce brands targeting the US and French markets, primarily through Meta Ads.

We're looking for a data-driven, performance-focused Creative Strategist to build and continuously improve our system for finding winning ads.

Our philosophy: It's not about producing more ads. It's about producing more winners.

**🎯 Your Mission & Responsibilities**

Creative Research: Analyze competitors, winning ads, consumer trends, and marketing angles to identify new opportunities.

Performance Analysis: Analyze Meta Ads data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CVR) to understand why creatives win or fail.

Copywriting & Scripting: Turn insights into high-converting scripts and detailed briefs for video and static ads.

Creative Winning Rate: more than 2% (benchmark: 1 winning ad per 50 creatives tested).

Meta Ads ROAS: ≥2.0 (shared business objective).

Creative Output: 25–50 video and static ads per week, together with our AI Video Editor.

Responsiveness: Available with a response time of under 30 minutes for urgent requests.

Creative quality and winning rate always take priority over production volume.

**🧠 Required Skills**

Strong direct-response copywriting, consumer psychology, and creative analysis skills.

Experience with DTC e-commerce, Meta Ads, and AI creative tools (statics/video).

Ability to identify winning angles and turn them into actionable scripts.

Fluent English required; Mandarin Chinese is a major plus

Autonomous, analytical, proactive, and results-oriented.

**💰 Compensation & Benefits**

$1,500 USD/month 

12-month minimum collaboration, with long-term potential.

Working directly with our AI Video Editor.

Access to advanced e-commerce marketing frameworks and knowledge backed by $50,000+ invested in professional digital marketing resources.

**📩 How to Apply**

Please send:

Your CV, LinkedIn profile, or professional introduction.

2–3 examples of ads you've developed, ideally with performance results.

A list of AI tools you use for creative research and production.

Ravule is a group of DTC e-commerce footwear brands selling mainly to women 40-60+ in English-speaking markets (mainly the US). We produce a high volume of AI-generated video ads: AI UGC and avatars, Pixar-style 3D animation, songs and jingles, and voiceover-led ads.

HOW TO APPLY

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
- A high volume of launch-ready creatives with strong hooks and retention
- No brand or technical errors reaching ads
- Creative standards that keep improving based on results

originalDescription.text:
Senior Meta Ads Marketer — $100K+/Month Spend & AI Creative Systems

Remote, long-term, dedicated individual role | USD1,000–4,000/month depending on qualifications and agreed scope

TalentSeeds is recruiting a hands-on performance marketer for an English-language consumer digital-product business. We want one person to build and operate the full process: customer and competitor research → angles, hooks and scripts → AI-assisted video production → Meta campaign launches → purchase/CPA analysis → creative iterations and profitable scaling.

Essential experience:
- You personally managed at least USD100,000 in monthly Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad spend for one business; USD300,000+/month is strongly preferred. Please distinguish Meta from other channels, monthly spend from lifetime spend/revenue, and your own responsibility from a team account total.
- You owned campaign and budget decisions and can explain purchase economics, CPA, ROAS, contribution margin, CAC/LTV and subscription payback where relevant.
- You built a repeatable creative production and testing process and can show how campaign results changed the next scripts, hooks and videos.
- Strong English direct-response writing and clear communication.

What you will own:
- Research customers, competitors, offers and objections; turn findings into original concepts and production-ready briefs.
- Write English hooks and scripts, coordinate editors/creators, and use AI tools for suitable video, voice, visuals and workflow automation, using own or licensed assets.
- Build a practical weekly production/testing cadence with clear hypotheses, naming, reporting and documented learnings.
- Launch and manage Meta campaigns, make disciplined budget decisions and investigate the full funnel through paid purchases.
- Document the system, templates and workflows so the team can operate and improve it.

Digital products, online education, consumer subscriptions, parenting, health/wellness or other direct-response consumer experience are relevant. Explain which parts of production you personally execute and which require editors or creators.

Please include:
1. One case with product/category, dates, monthly Meta spend, purchases, CPA/ROAS, your exact role and evidence you can walk through with confidential details redacted.

AI Cinematic Video Creator – Long-Term Collaboration (EdTech)

**About the Project**

Jangflix is an EdTech platform based in Senegal, transforming traditional school lessons into engaging, immersive educational experiences.

We are looking for creative production partners for a long-term collaboration, starting with an initial project of approximately 100 educational videos, each lasting between 5 and 10 minutes, across subjects such as Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, History, Geography, French, English, and Philosophy.

**Our creative vision**

We want to emphasize that we are not necessarily looking for 100% AI-generated videos.
We are completely open to hybrid production approaches combining:
* Cinematic AI-generated scenes and storytelling
* 2D or 3D animation and cartoon-style visuals
* Motion graphics, animated illustrations, and educational diagrams

* A combination of these approaches, depending on the subject and lesson

Our main requirement is that every video must be immersive, engaging, visually appealing, and, above all, effective in helping students understand and remember the lesson.

- Create **5–10 minute educational videos in French**.
- Combine realistic AI-generated cinematic scenes with motion graphics, diagrams, illustrations, and animated explanations.
- Deliver visually immersive, engaging content inspired by cinematic storytelling platforms like Ayatique.
- Ensure consistent characters, visual quality, and smooth transitions.
- Include professional editing, sound design, and French voice-over.
- Deliver videos in 16:9 Full HD (1080p).

**What We Provide**

- All educational lessons and subject matter, fully prepared by Jangflix.
- Pedagogical guidance and content validation.
- Brand guidelines and creative direction.

**Ideal Candidate**

- Experienced with AI video generation tools (Kling, Veo, Runway, Midjourney, etc.).
- Skilled in After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or equivalent.
- Able to produce complete videos of 5–10 minutes, not just short AI clips.
- Strong cinematic storytelling and educational animation skills.

**Collaboration**

We are looking for a **long-term production partner** to develop a growing library of educational videos across multiple subjects.

We will begin with a paid pilot project before discussing ongoing production.

**To Apply**

Please share your portfolio, examples of long-form AI videos, your production workflow, and /or create a sample based on the attached script

**Important: All final videos must be produced in French.**

Other successful creators in AI, business growth, and entrepreneurship

Understand the video, its audience, and the central hook.

Research successful and outperforming videos in the niche.

Develop three genuinely different thumbnail concepts based on that research.

What matters most

Your thinking is more important than your design software.

"Here's who will watch this, here's what they're curious about, here's what competing videos are doing, and here's a concept that could outperform them."

Research into relevant successful videos and thumbnail concepts.

Three distinct thumbnail directions with explanations.

Three finished thumbnail options.

One revision round on the selected concept.

Final YouTube-ready files.

Long-term opportunity

We're building a high-volume YouTube channel helping established business owners make more money using AI.

Our goal is to publish frequently, so we're looking for someone who can eventually own thumbnail research, ideation, and production on an ongoing basis.

Three thumbnails you've created, ideally in the AI/business/entrepreneurship niche.

We are an active e-commerce brand selling vintage and curated apparel, accessories, and home goods across multiple platforms (eBay, Poshmark, Etsy, etc.). We are seeking a skilled photo editor and AI image specialist to handle ongoing batch processing, cleanup, and realistic product rendering.

This is a recurring, contract-based role with regular batches of inventory.

---

**Scope of Work**

1. **AI Model Generation:**
* Generate realistic, high-quality images of diverse models naturally wearing our flat-lay or hanger-shot clothing items.
* Maintain the exact garment integrity: pattern, texture, drape, color accuracy, and fit without AI warping or hallucinating details.


2. **Ghost / Invisible Mannequin Rendering:**
* Transform flat-lay or standard mannequin shots into 3D, hollow-neck "ghost mannequin" product photos using AI or traditional compositing techniques.


3. **Standard Retouching & Cleanup:**
* Clean background removal to clean, solid neutral/pure white backdrops.
* Spot correction, wrinkle softening, lint removal, color correction, and shadow generation (natural ground/drop shadows).
* Cropping and formatting according to platform-specific aspect ratios (1:1 square for Poshmark/eBay, etc.).


4. **Home Goods & Decor:**
* Clean background isolation and perspective correction for vintage decor, case goods, and small home furnishings.
* Occasional contextual staging (placing products into tasteful, realistic interior mockups).



---

**Requirements & Skills**

* Proven portfolio demonstrating realistic AI garment synthesis (e.g., Midjourney, Stable Diffusion/ControlNet, Flux, or specialized tools like VModel/Botika) alongside standard Photoshop retouching.
* Expert mastery of Adobe Photoshop (pen tool, masking, frequency separation, lighting/shadow matching).
* Sharp eye for garment construction, natural proportions, fabric drape, and accurate color grading.
* Reliable turnaround times and clear communication.

---

**How to Apply**

Please submit:

1. A brief note detailing the AI tools and software you use for virtual try-on and garment generation.
2. Direct links or attachments showing **before/after examples** of your work:
* AI model try-ons generated from flat-lay/hanger shots.

Our objective is to achieve a professional, premium-quality, fully functional, and customer-ready Shopify website that accurately represents our product, communicates its unique benefits, and provides a seamless shopping experience.
We are looking for an experienced Shopify professional who takes ownership of their work, demonstrates integrity, communicates effectively, and consistently delivers high-quality results.
