originalDescription.text:
The opportunity: run Meta ads like an owner, with AI as your edge.
Most ad jobs want someone to push buttons. This one wants a strategist who uses AI to out-think competitors, create winning ads fast, and own lead generation from first click to the CRM.
If you have 3+ years running Meta ads, real insurance experience, and you already use AI every day to research, write and design, keep reading. If not, this role is not for you, and that is okay.
About Open House Insurance Group
Open House Insurance Group is a growing U.S. Life Insurance Agency. We help high-end clients build protection and long-term wealth with Indexed Universal Life (IUL) insurance, so lead quality matters far more to us than lead volume.
We are looking for a long-term partner, not a task-taker: someone who sees our vision and wants to become part of the team.
We are also launching a second marketing arm that helps other business owners grow with AI. The right person can grow into that work too, based on the quality of what they deliver.
What you'll be responsible for
• Meta ads, end to end. Plan, launch, test and scale lead-generation campaigns on Facebook and Instagram, starting from our existing ad account and Business Manager.
• Compliance on every ad. Run campaigns correctly under Meta's Financial Products & Services Special Ad Category, and keep every ad within Meta's policies and insurance advertising rules. No exaggerated returns, no misleading claims.
• AI competitor research agent. Build and run an AI agent that tracks what other IUL and life insurance advertisers are running in the Meta Ad Library, and turn it into weekly insights.
• AI ad creative. Use AI tools to write copy and produce images and short videos, then test them to find winners quickly.
• Landing pages and lead forms. Build a two-step lead flow for high-end clients: a short, Meta-compliant instant form on the ad, then a more detailed qualifying form (business, income and health questions) connected to our CRM. You will build and integrate the second form, and make sure sensitive answers stay private and are never shared with Meta.
• CRM connection. Connect every lead into our CRM so our existing text and email follow-up starts right away.
• Weekly reporting. Send a short weekly report (cost per lead, lead quality, what you are testing next), and walk through it on Zoom.
• Next platforms. LinkedIn and other channels come next as lead quality proves out.
Your first 90 days
1.  Days 1–30: Audit and launch. Review the ad account, Business Manager and any past ads. Confirm or install the Meta pixel and tracking. Build the two-step lead flow and connect both forms to the CRM. Build the competitor research agent. Launch the first compliant test campaigns.
2.  Days 31–60: Test and improve. Run steady creative and audience tests. Cut what does not work and lower cost per lead while raising lead quality.
3.  Days 61–90: Scale. Put more budget behind proven winners, deliver a steady flow of booked appointments, and propose a plan for LinkedIn or the next platform.
Must-haves
• 3+ years running Meta (Facebook and Instagram) lead-generation campaigns yourself
• Proven insurance ad experience, ideally life insurance or IUL or Annuity or Mortgage Protection leads.
• Working knowledge of Meta's Financial Products & Services Special Ad Category and insurance advertising compliance
• Daily use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar) for research, copy and creative, and the ability to build a simple AI agent or automation
• Experience with the Meta pixel, Conversions API, multi-step lead forms, and integrating forms with a CRM (webhooks, Zapier or Make), plus care in handling sensitive client data
• Fluent English, written and spoken, and comfortable on live Zoom calls
• At least 3–4 hours a day overlapping U.S. Central time
• Results you can show: screenshots or numbers from campaigns you ran
Bonus points: LinkedIn Ads experience, short-form video editing, landing page builders, Zapier or Make, and experience with financial-services audiences.
Pay and schedule
• Pay: $8–$15 per hour, based on experience
• Performance bonus: paid monthly, based on booked appointments from your campaigns
• Raises: tied to results as lead quality and volume grow
• Hours: starts at 20–30 hours a week, with a clear path to full-time as results come in
• Schedule: remote, open to any country, with at least 3–4 hours a day overlapping U.S. Central time
• Ad budget: a growing monthly budget that increases as you prove results
Why work with us
• A long-term home. This is a real seat on a growing team. You can take over LinkedIn and other platforms.
• A second path to grow. Our new AI marketing arm serves other business owners, and great work here opens a long-term partnership there.
• No micromanagement. Quick decisions, clear feedback, and room to run your own strategy.
• Pay that follows results. Monthly bonuses for booked appointments, and raises as your campaigns grow.
How to apply
We read every application, but only complete ones get a reply. Send:
1.  Start your application with the words "Open House IUL". This shows you read the whole post. Applications without it are skipped.
2.  One insurance campaign you ran: the goal, what you changed, and the result (cost per lead, lead volume, booked calls). Screenshots welcome.
3.  Your AI toolkit: the tools you use for research, copy, images and video, and one way you used AI to beat a competitor's ads.
4.  Your country, time zone, and the hours you can overlap with U.S. Central time.
Next step: shortlisted candidates complete a short paid test (about 2–3 hours). You will break down 3 competitor IUL ads from the Meta Ad Library and use AI to create 3 new, compliant ad versions. Then we meet on Zoom.

originalDescription.text:
We're an ecommerce brand running a growing creator program and Meta ads every day. We need one reliable person to own our creative, from finding creators to planning ads to the final sign off.

The role
You'll be the bridge between our creators, our creative team and our ad account. You find what's working, turn it into concepts for both video and static ads, bring in and coach creators, and you're the final human sign off before anything goes live.

What you'll do
• Research winning ads daily using Meta Ads Library, Foreplay and similar tools
• Turn that research into concepts and briefs for video ads AND static ads. You plan the statics (angle, hook, layout, copy) and a designer builds them
• Find new creators on Instagram, TikTok and through Meta, and DM them to bring them into the program
• Run our creator program in TRYBE and our in-house creator platform: onboarding, approving videos, giving feedback and asking for revisions
• Coach creators, including on a quick call when needed, so their next video is better than their last
• Be the final creative approval before any ad, video or static, goes into our ad account. AI helps us move fast, but a human always signs off

AI is a big part of this role
We want someone who uses AI to the best of their ability, every day: for ad research, concepts, briefs, creator feedback, copy and outreach. You'll work alongside the AI systems we've built, so the more you can get out of tools like ChatGPT (and Codex), Claude or Grok, the better you'll do here.

Hours
• Part time to start: around 10 to 20 hours a week
• Your hours must be during Australian business hours (e.g. 9am to 5pm Sydney time), Monday to Friday. Non-negotiable. We need someone we can rely on in our hours

Must haves
• Online during Australian business hours (e.g. 9am to 5pm Sydney time) on weekdays
• Hands-on, daily use of AI tools like ChatGPT (and Codex), Claude or Grok
• A strong eye for what makes a scroll-stopping ad, video or static, especially the first 3 seconds
• Comfortable learning new internal systems quickly
• Clear, warm written English. Creators should enjoy hearing from you

Nice to haves

originalDescription.text:
ABOUT TLF APPAREL
TLF Apparel created the Gym-To-Street Wear® category back in 2012. We're a premium activewear brand based in Fort Lauderdale, FL, and we sell globally. Every product line falls under one of three pillars:
• GYM – high-tech performance training gear
• TO – premium everyday essentials that go from the gym to the rest of your day
• STREET – fashion-forward streetwear with custom graphics and designs
Our brand lines are Redefine Impossible® and Take Life Further®. We innovate. We never duplicate.

THE OPPORTUNITY
We want a full-time video editor who uses AI heavily, both to work faster and to create content. This is not a one-off gig. Hiring starts with a paid trial project: one 15-second vertical ad plus a general edit. If you hit our turnaround times and deliver next-level production quality and storytelling, we'll move you into a full-time role. You'll own TLF's video output across organic social, paid ads on every platform, and brand campaigns.

STEP 1 – PAID TRIAL PROJECT
A) General edit: turn raw footage into a clean, engaging finished video
B) One 15-second vertical ad (1080x1920, 9:16) for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Stories:
   • A strong hook in the first 2 seconds
   • Captions and on-screen text
   • Licensed or royalty-free music and sound effects
   • Color correction and grading
   • TLF logo and a call-to-action end screen
   • Exported as MP4, 1080x1920
   • At least one AI-generated or AI-enhanced element (scene, environment, shot extension, motion, or upscale) that is impossible to tell apart from real footage
We provide the raw footage, product photos, any stock footage, the logo, brand colors, fonts, and a script or key message.
We judge the trial on hook strength, pacing, storytelling, brand fit, AI realism, product accuracy, polish and on-time delivery.

STEP 2 – THE FULL-TIME ROLE (FOR THE RIGHT EDITOR)
1) Organic social content
   • Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, Pinterest
   • Product drops, try-ons, training clips, behind-the-scenes, creator and athlete features
   • Trend-aware edits that stay on-brand and never look generic or cheap
2) Paid ads for every platform
   • Meta (FB/IG), TikTok, YouTube, Google (PMax/Demand Gen), Pinterest, Snapchat
   • Hooks in the first 1–3 seconds, built to stop the scroll
   • Many versions per concept: different hooks, lengths (6s/15s/30s), CTAs, captions
   • Correct aspect ratios and safe zones: 9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9
   • UGC-style and polished brand-style ads
3) Brand campaign videos
   • Hero films, collection launches, seasonal campaigns and Gym/To/Street storytelling
   • Cinematic pacing, color grading, sound design and music sync
   • Cut-downs from each hero film for social and paid placements

AI FOR CONTENT CREATION (HYPER-REALISTIC IS MANDATORY)
We sell apparel, so the product on screen must look exactly like the product the customer receives. AI content must be hyper-realistic and true to the product:
   • AI-generated scenes, environments, locations and b-roll built around real TLF product footage and photography
   • AI shot extensions, camera moves, slow motion, upscaling, cleanup and object removal
   • AI model, scene and background variations for testing ads at scale
   • AI voiceover and sound design where it fits
Non-negotiable product fidelity:
   • Fabric texture, sheen, drape and stretch look real and correct
   • Colorways match the real product exactly
   • Logos, graphics, prints, seams, stitching, zippers and trims stay sharp. Nothing warps, morphs or shifts between frames.
   • Fit and silhouette are true to the real garment
   • Zero AI artifacts: no distorted hands or faces, flicker, melting edges or uncanny motion
   • Real product footage is always the source of truth. AI enhances the product but never invents or misrepresents it.
   • Follows each platform's rules for labeling AI-generated content

AI FOR OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY
We expect AI throughout your workflow so you can produce more, faster, without losing quality:
   • AI rough cuts, transcription, auto-captioning and translation
   • Batch resizing and reframing across 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9
   • Fast ad versioning: hooks, lengths, CTAs and text overlays, produced at volume
   • Templates, presets and automations that cut repeat work
   • Organized asset management and file naming so the team can find anything fast
We'll ask you to show us your AI stack and the time it saves you.

VOICE & TONE
Every edit should feel like TLF:
• Bold and confident. We don't hedge on quality.
• Premium and elevated, never cheap, never "athleisure"
• Empowering. The viewer is the hero.
• High energy and punchy. One idea per video.
• Technical where it counts: show the fabric, the fit, the construction
Brands whose feel we admire: Nike (declarative power), Apple (technical made aspirational), Reformation (premium without the pretension).
Each pillar has its own edit style:
• GYM = intensity, performance, sweat, precision
• TO = clean, minimal, versatile, elevated everyday
• STREET = visual impact, culture, drop energy

REQUIREMENTS
• A portfolio of short-form vertical videos and social ads. Fitness, apparel, fashion or DTC e-commerce work is strongly preferred.
• Expert in Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut (CapCut is a plus)
• Hands-on, current experience with AI video and image tools such as Runway, Kling, Veo, Sora, Higgsfield, Adobe Firefly / Premiere Generative Extend, Midjourney, Topaz, ElevenLabs, Descript or CapCut AI
• A proven ability to produce hyper-realistic AI footage where the apparel stays accurate
• Strong color grading, motion text, captions and sound design
• Understands what makes ads perform: hooks, retention, CTA placement
• Uses only licensed or royalty-free music and assets
• Turns work around in 24–72 hours depending on scope, with consistent deadlines
• Communicates clearly and handles feedback and revisions well
• Has full-time availability, or a clear plan to move to it

NICE TO HAVE
• Motion graphics and animated product callouts
• Experience editing creator/UGC ads at volume
• AI virtual try-on or AI model/scene generation for fashion
• Thumbnail and cover frame design

WORKFLOW
• Footage and briefs come through a shared drive or our DAM
• Files are named with our naming convention (we'll provide it)
• Deliver MP4 (H.264) at platform-native specs, plus project files and AI prompts when we ask for them

TO APPLY, PLEASE INCLUDE:
1. Links to 2–3 vertical ads or short-form videos you edited (fitness/apparel if you have them)
2. 1–2 examples of hyper-realistic AI video work, especially work with apparel or other physical products
3. Your AI tool stack and how it speeds up your workflow
4. Results from any ads you can share (hook rate, CTR, ROAS)
5. Your turnaround time for the trial project
6. Your rate for the trial, plus your expected full-time rate (hourly or monthly)
7. Your weekly availability and time zone
Start your proposal with the word "VERTICAL" so we know you read the full post.

Redefine Impossible®. Take Life Further®.

Updated screening questions (top 5)

Send your best hyper-realistic AI video, ideally with apparel or a physical product. Which tools did you use, and how did you keep the product accurate (fabric, logos, color, fit)?
What's your AI tool stack, and how much time does it save you per project?
Send your single best vertical ad. What was the hook, and why did it work?
What turnaround can you commit to for a 15s ad, and for a pack of 3 hooks × 3 lengths?
Are you available full-time? What's your time zone, and what hours do you overlap with US Eastern Time?

Extra interview questions on AI

Show us an AI shot that failed, such as a warped logo or morphing fabric. How did you fix it, or did you switch to real footage?
How do you decide when to use AI and when to use real product footage?
How do you keep the same model, scene and look consistent across a batch of AI ad variations?
How do you handle the AI-content labeling rules on Meta, TikTok and YouTube?

We are SAB TECH (Saudi Basic Technology Company Ltd.), a Saudi Arabian manufacturer and supplier of hydraulic equipment, industrial machinery, loading dock systems, lifting equipment, security barriers and waste management solutions.
We are looking for a skilled and experienced AI video generation specialist who can transform our existing product photographs into high-quality, photorealistic and technically accurate product videos for marketing, product demonstrations, our website and social media platforms.

Scope of Work:
•	Generate professional videos using existing industrial product photographs as reference images.
•	Demonstrate actual machine operations, including the movement of hydraulic cylinders, platforms, doors, lifting mechanisms and other mechanical components.
•	Create realistic industrial environments and product application scenarios.
•	Maintain product geometry, dimensions, proportions, colors, branding, logos, nameplates and other technical details.
•	Ensure realistic mechanical movements, physics and visual consistency throughout each video.
•	Incorporate English and Arabic captions, subtitles, product descriptions and technical information where required.
•	Incorporate professional English and Arabic voiceovers, synchronized with the video content and machine operations, where required.
•	Ensure accurate Arabic text rendering, right-to-left formatting and correct pronunciation of technical terminology.
•	Incorporate suitable background music and realistic sound effects where appropriate.
•	Deliver high-resolution, commercially usable videos with professional lighting, camera movements and smooth transitions.
•	Produce different video formats and aspect ratios suitable for websites, social media and digital marketing campaigns.

Required Skills:
•	Proven experience with AI image-to-video generation tools.
•	Experience in industrial, mechanical, engineering or technical product visualization.
•	Strong understanding of prompt engineering, image referencing and visual consistency.
•	Ability to understand machinery operations and accurately translate technical instructions into videos.
•	Proficiency in video editing and post-production.
•	Ability to incorporate bilingual captions, subtitles and professional voiceovers.
•	Strong attention to technical details and brand consistency.

Important Expectations:
We are not simply looking for cinematic videos with camera movements around static products. The primary objective is to demonstrate how our machines actually operate in real-world applications.
Technical accuracy is equally important as visual quality. Unnecessary alterations to product design, unrealistic mechanical movements, distorted components, changing logos or disappearing parts are unacceptable.
Applicants are encouraged to visit our website, https://sabtech.com.sa, to understand our product range, machinery types and the nature of the videos we require.

When Applying, Please Include:
•	Relevant portfolio or previous video samples, preferably involving industrial or mechanical products.
•	AI tools and software you use.
•	Your approach to maintaining product integrity and achieving accurate mechanical movements.
•	Examples of videos incorporating captions and voiceovers, if available.

originalDescription.text:
Who we are
The Scaling Crew is a performance creative and media buying agency for e-commerce brands. We test angles, find winners, and scale them on Meta. Every ad we make gets judged by one thing: the numbers in the ad account. We are working with the worlds largest brands so you'll be making real money on the commission generated from your videos.

The role
You turn briefs into finished AI video ads for DTC brands. We hand you the angle, the script and the product assets. You generate, edit and deliver an ad that is ready to run.

What you'll make

AI product ads for DTC brands, 1-2 minutes
Animated ads (2D and 3D styles)
Claymation-style ads
Hyperrealistic product and lifestyle ads
3 to 5 hook variations per winning concept

What we provide

Creative brief: angle, persona, hook, script
Product photos, brand kit, reference ads
Tool subscriptions: [list, or "you bring your own"]
Feedback within [24] hours
Performance data on your ads, so you see what won and why

What you need

A portfolio of AI video ads, not AI art. We want to see products, not dragons.
Product consistency. The product looks the same in every shot: label, shape, color.
Strong with image-to-video and video generation tools (e.g. Kling, Veo, Runway, Higgsfield), plus image generation and AI voice
Real editing skills: pacing, sound design, captions, color (CapCut, Premiere or After Effects)
You understand hooks. The first 3 seconds decide the ad.
You hit deadlines without being chased

How we expect you to work

Image first, video second. You lock the look in a still (product, character, lighting), then animate it. You don't prompt text-to-video and hope.

You use start and end frames, reference images and seeds to control a shot instead of rerolling 30 times.

You write prompts in camera language: lens, shot size, movement, lighting, speed.

You track credits. You know roughly what a finished 20-second ad costs you in generations.

AI glitches you catch and fix before we ever see them

Product drift: label text warping, logo changing, bottle shape or cap color shifting between shots

Garbled text: any on-pack or on-screen text the model invented

Hands and fingers: extra fingers, fingers melting into the product, impossible grips

Morphing: objects or faces changing mid-shot, things appearing or vanishing

Flicker and texture crawl: skin, hair or backgrounds shimmering frame to frame

Broken physics: liquids, creams, pours and fabric moving wrong

Identity drift: the same character looking like a different person in shot 3

Plastic skin and dead eyes: the uncanny look that makes people scroll past

Lip sync drift: mouth not matching the voiceover

Wrong reflections and shadows, especially on glass, metal and glossy packaging

How you fix them

Composite the real product photo or label over the generated shot when the model can't hold it. Tracking and masking in After Effects, or equivalent.
Inpaint or regenerate only the broken region, not the whole shot.
Cut around the glitch. Most shots have 1.5 clean seconds, and that is often enough.
Upscale and add grain to finish so shots from different models match.
Know when to stop fixing and regenerate. If the fix takes longer than [20] minutes, reroll.

Style knowledge

Claymation: real stop motion runs around 12 frames per second with visible fingerprints and slight wobble. AI makes it too smooth. You know how to drop the frame rate and keep the handmade texture.
Hyperrealistic: real skin texture, consistent light direction across shots, correct product scale in hand, believable liquid and cream.
Animation: one consistent art style and character across the full ad, not five styles in five shots.

- Start your proposal with the word REVIEW so we know you read this
- Tell us how many video ads you have reviewed or edited, and for which platforms

We have one of the most epic and exciting new entries to the party game category: fast-paced, chaotic, colorful and huge. We need some production wizardry to bring that to life through an epic hero promo video.

How we'd like to work

We'll introduce you to the product first. Then we'll come up with the concept, look and feel together.

What we need

- A hero promo video for the product, plus shorter versions for ads (lengths and formats agreed together)
- Mainly a real-life, in-person shoot with camera work
- The ability to add animation, AI or CGI where necessary
- Full production, from concept through to final edit

About you

- A strong portfolio of commercial or product video work
- In-house capability, or trusted partners, for animation, AI and CGI

Where you're based

Our founders are based in the UK, so being UK-based is a bonus because we'd be able to attend the shoot. If you're US-based, there's a chance we could attend too. But we're looking for partners who can make this happen wherever they are in the world, so please apply wherever you're based.

To apply, please answer these questions
1. Share 2 or 3 product videos you're proudest of, and tell us your role on each.
2. Show us an example where you combined live action with animation, AI or CGI.
3. How do you like to develop a concept with a client?
4. Where are you based, and where are you able to shoot?
5. What's your ballpark cost for a hero promo video plus shorter ad versions, and what does that include?
6. How long from kick-off to final delivery, and what's your earliest availability?

originalDescription.text:
Waiver360 Academy (Phier Point LLC) creates online professional-development training for caregivers and direct support professionals. We need a video editor / motion designer with Higgsfield experience to produce the lesson videos for a 6-lesson course on recognizing and responding to allergies, asthma and anaphylaxis.

THE FORMAT
Each lesson video is 1.5–3.5 minutes (about 18 finished minutes in total):
- Open (10–15 s): our AI presenter on camera, on green screen
- Middle: animated slides and visuals timed to the presenter's narration
- Close (10–15 s): the presenter on camera

HIGGSFIELD REQUIRED
You'll generate our AI presenter's narration and her green-screen open/close clips in your own Higgsfield account, following our step-by-step tutorial (our licensed presenter voice, our start poses, Wan 2.7 and ElevenLabs v4 settings). Our presenter is based on a real person, so strict likeness rules apply: approved scripts only, no other use, and everything deleted at the end of the contract.

WE PROVIDE
Approved scripts, the presenter voice sample and start poses (after hire), our tutorial with exact settings, our brand palette, typography and style guide, a reference lesson from a finished course, and a scene-by-scene visual plan.

YOU DELIVER, PER LESSON
- Presenter narration (open, middle, close) plus the open/close clips as green-screen MP4 and transparent ProRes 4444
- A clean 1080p30 edit with tasteful motion graphics: callouts, simple diagrams (e.g. "reliever vs. controller inhaler"), icon sequences, lower thirds
- Realistic supporting visuals (licensed stock or disclosed AI imagery) that follow our image rules: adults only, no identifiable real people, no brand names or logos, no needles shown in skin
- Audio at -16 LUFS, a WebVTT caption file, a poster frame and your project files

DEFINITION OF DONE (each lesson)
1. Narration matches the approved script word for word, with correct pronunciation
2. Presenter clips: lips in sync, face consistent with the start pose, clean key (no green fringe)
3. MP4 is 1920x1080, 30 fps, H.264, AAC 48 kHz, -16 LUFS ±1, length within ±2 s of the narration
4. On-screen text comes only from the script, with no typos; captions match the narration
5. All files delivered and named per our standards, with a list of the tools, AI services and asset licenses used
6. Passes our automated file check and our clinical reviewer's content check, and the owner accepts it in writing

Accuracy matters. This is health-related training: don't change narration or instructional wording.

BUDGET AND PAYMENT
Fixed price of $185 for all six lessons, including your Higgsfield credits (in our experience about 50–95 credits per lesson). Paid in six milestones, one per lesson, starting with Lesson 1. Each milestone is funded and released as that lesson is approved, with two revision rounds per lesson. If this budget doesn't work for you, tell us what scope or price would. We have more courses in the pipeline for the right partner.

REQUIREMENTS
- A portfolio of e-learning, training or explainer videos (healthcare is a plus)
- After Effects (or equivalent) motion graphics and green-screen compositing
- Hands-on Higgsfield experience (AI presenter / lip-sync video and voice), on a plan that allows commercial use
- You disclose any AI tools you use and confirm their commercial-use terms
- Confidentiality: our footage, voice and scripts are used only for this project and never uploaded to other AI tools

TO APPLY, INCLUDE
1. 2–3 links to similar training or explainer work, and your role
2. Your total fixed price for all six lessons, including credits
3. Your turnaround per lesson
4. The tools you'd use (including AI tools)
5. The word "CALM" at the top of your proposal

originalDescription.text:
# AI Native Animator and Editor for a 90 Second Felt Style Film

We’re looking for an animator/editor with strong visual taste, character performance, and comic timing who uses AI as a practical part of a finished production workflow.

I’m developing a standalone 90-second animated comedy explainer as a paid proof of concept. The film explores a proposed 10% credit-card interest-rate cap through an entertaining journey into price controls and their unexpected consequences. The goal is a polished finished film that demonstrates the creative approach.

The current visual direction is a tactile felt world with expressive characters, cinematic lighting, and smooth movement. Performance and continuity matter: characters should look consistent across shots, act with intention, and give visual jokes time to land.

# What you will do

- Join early story discussions with the comedy writer and audio producer, contributing visual ideas and practical ways to execute the comedy.

- Translate the writer’s audiovisual script—including the on-screen action and comic beats—into a shot plan, drawn storyboard, and timed animatic. Develop the staging, camera choices, character performance, and edit that make the jokes land.

- Develop or refine the supplied character and world references into production assets.

- Produce animation, compositing, exact text and graphics, and the final edit.

- Integrate the audio producer’s work and finish the film for delivery.

# Deliverables

- Storyboard and full animatic with temporary audio.

- A representative motion test to establish the production approach.

- One finished 90-second film in an agreed primary aspect ratio, with a clean master, captioned version, and subtitle file.

- Organized editable project files, reusable commissioned assets, and a brief workflow and asset handoff.

Additional aspect ratios or cutdowns can be quoted separately. Identify any tools or subscriptions needed to reopen and revise your project files.

# Collaboration and timing

You’ll work directly with me as creative director, alongside a dedicated writer and audio producer. I’ll provide the creative brief, background material, and visual studies as they develop. You’re welcome to improve any part of the creative; I’ll make the final decisions.

The production target is two weeks after the full team is hired and kickoff materials are ready. We expect you to participate from day one while the script is developed.


# To apply

Send two or three finished examples and identify exactly what you created. Include at least one example showing character consistency or performance across multiple shots. Explain your AI and editing workflow, how you handle revisions, your availability, and your proposed fee.

originalDescription.text:
Expert AI Video Creator & Editor – Seedance 2.5 | 6–7 Minute Cinematic Film

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced AI Video Generation Specialist with proven expertise in Seedance 2.5 to produce a professionally generated and edited cinematic video of approximately 6–7 minutes.

This project requires more than basic AI video generation. The most critical requirement is maintaining consistent character identities, facial features, appearances, and visual continuity throughout the entire film.

We will provide the script, character reference images, scene breakdowns, and creative direction. Your responsibility will be to transform these materials into a polished, cinematic production using Seedance 2.5 and professional video editing techniques.

Project Requirements

The final video must meet the following specifications:

- AI Video Generation: Primarily using Seedance 2.5.
- Final Duration: Approximately 6–7 minutes.
- Resolution: Full HD 1080p.
- Aspect Ratio: 16:9 widescreen.
- Language: English.
- Subtitles: Accurate, synchronized English subtitles throughout.
- Editing: Professional cinematic editing, scene transitions, pacing, and continuity.
- Visual Quality: Realistic, cinematic, and professionally polished.

Essential Technical Expertise

The selected freelancer must demonstrate expertise in:

1. Character Face Consistency: Maintaining the same facial identity, facial geometry, hairstyle, and recognizable appearance across multiple scenes and camera angles.

2. Character Continuity: Ensuring consistent wardrobe, physical appearance, expressions, and positioning across connected scenes.

3. Seedance 2.5 Mastery: Strong understanding of advanced prompting, reference-image workflows, camera movements, shot composition, and scene generation.

4. Cinematic Storytelling: Generating visually coherent shots with professional lighting, realistic movements, appropriate framing, and cinematic atmosphere.

5. Professional Post-Production: Editing multiple AI-generated clips into a seamless film, including audio synchronization, sound design, dialogue integration, and transitions.

6. English Subtitling: Providing accurately timed and synchronized English subtitles.

Deliverables

- One completed cinematic film of approximately 6–7 minutes.
- Full HD 1080p MP4 export.
- 16:9 aspect ratio.
- Consistent character faces and appearances throughout.
- Professionally edited scenes with coherent transitions.
- Synchronized English subtitles.
- Final audio mix and sound design.
- Original generated video clips and final project files, where available.

Application Requirements

To be considered, please provide:

1. Your portfolio featuring AI-generated cinematic videos.
2. Examples of projects created specifically with Seedance 2.5.
3. Examples demonstrating consistent character faces across multiple scenes.
4. A brief explanation of your workflow for maintaining character identity and scene continuity.
5. Your estimated budget and delivery timeline for this 6–7 minute production.

Important: We are specifically looking for an expert in AI filmmaking, not someone who only generates individual AI clips or performs basic video editing.

Please apply only if you have the technical expertise and portfolio to demonstrate your ability to deliver professional, consistent, cinematic results.

We are interested in working with someone who can potentially collaborate on future AI filmmaking projects as well.

originalDescription.text:
Are you a filmmaker, designer or storyteller who now creates with AI? We want you on our core team.

We are an established video production studio with a steady, long-term pipeline of cinematic AI series, dramatic stories and children's music videos. We are building a small team of AI film directors who bring real visual craft to every shot. No slop, no lucky generations, no random clips.

Who we are looking for:

The best people on our team came to AI from somewhere else. A TV and commercials VFX artist. A luxury brand designer. A documentary storyteller. They already knew how to frame a shot, light a face and pace a story. AI became their camera.

If that sounds like you, read on.

What you will direct:

You turn approved storyboards and character sheets into finished cinematic sequences, using Seedance as your main tool and Kling as a secondary tool. You decide how each shot is framed, how a character moves and feels, and how one clip flows into the next.

The work includes:

Children's music videos set in magical, cinematic worlds
Dramatic narrative episodes and children's story episodes with recurring characters
Story-driven scenes where emotion and continuity matter

What we care about:

Thinking before generating. You plan camera, light, blocking and performance first, then prompt
Character consistency. The same face, outfit and feel from the first shot to the last
Emotional continuity. Every clip carries the mood of the one before it
Efficiency. You get strong results in a few generations because you know what you want
Taste. You can tell a cinematic shot from a generic one and you will not settle for the second

This role rewards people who think like directors. If you only type prompts and hope, this is not the right fit.

What you get:

Approved storyboards, character sheets and scene descriptions for every video
Seedance and Kling access once hired, with a set credit budget for each video covered by us
A directing-focused role with no editing, no admin and no hunting for tools
Payment through funded Upwork milestones, per approved video
A real long-term place on a creative team, with a clear path to longer, higher-paid episodes

Pay:

Everyone starts on music videos of 2 to 3 minutes at USD 100 per approved video. As your work meets our standard, you move up to longer episodes at higher rates, confirmed in writing.

You will stand out if you have:

A background in filmmaking, VFX, photography, design, animation or documentary work
AI work with recurring characters or multi-scene stories, not just single clips
A clear, reliable working rhythm and good communication
The availability to grow with a team for the long term

A real production or filming background combined with AI drama work is a big plus.

How we select:

We review proposals fast and hold a short video call on Upwork with shortlisted directors. Strong candidates then complete a short paid trial through an Upwork contract. For the trial you use your own tool account, and the trial fee covers your credits. We never ask for free work.

All work is confidential under an NDA and cannot be used in a portfolio or shared publicly.

To apply:

Share 1 to 2 cinematic AI pieces you directed yourself and answer the questions below. Thoughtful answers stand out. Fast replies get fast interviews.

originalDescription.text:
I'm the founder of Cliffra, a vertical short-drama app like ReelShort and DramaBox. The app is already built. I'm looking for an engineer to build the AI video system that turns our scripts into finished, cinematic episodes.

WHAT YOU'LL BUILD
A render service that plugs into our existing app through a defined contract (VIDEO_PIPELINE_CONTRACT.md, shared after NDA). For each episode, the app sends a job with:
- the script, shot list, voice casting, music cues, captions and cliffhanger sting;
- format 9:16, about 85 seconds (75-90 allowed).
Your service returns:
- the finished MP4 or a Mux asset, a captions file (VTT) and the duration;
- automatic quality checks and a cost breakdown per vendor call;
- signed status updates as it works: queued, rendering, QA, ready for review.
The app is a NestJS and TypeScript monorepo on Postgres and Redis.

QUALITY BAR (NON-NEGOTIABLE)
Episodes must equal or beat ReelShort in visuals and story flow:
- cinematic shot variety and camera motion, film-grade lighting and color;
- characters who look the same in every shot and episode, and no AI artifacts;
- acted voices with accurate lip-sync, and mood music ducked under dialogue;
- a hook in the first 3 seconds, a new beat every 15-20 seconds, an emotional climax and a hard cliffhanger with a sting;
- seamless cuts and clean captions.
One series is adapted from my novel and must follow the book exactly.

PHASE 1: PAID TEST (FIXED PRICE)
One sample episode from a script I provide, rendered through your pipeline and scored against a ReelShort benchmark episode. Please quote a fixed price and turnaround.

PHASE 2: FULL BUILD (MILESTONES, IF THE TEST PASSES)
1. A working render service matching the contract, with status updates, cancel, re-render of named shots and a health check.
2. Character consistency across a full series, plus automatic QA.
3. Two or three finished test episodes, with the real cost per episode at each quality tier.
4. Documentation, a handover and 30 days of bug fixes.

TERMS
- All work goes through Upwork milestones.
- All code, models, prompts and videos belong to Cliffra LLC.
- Code is pushed to our repository.
- Vendor and GPU costs are billed to Cliffra's own accounts, with no keys stored in the code.
- An NDA is required before I share the scripts.

PLEASE REPLY WITH
- 2-3 examples of videos you've made with lip-sync and consistent characters;
- which video, voice and lip-sync tools you'd use, and why;
- your price and timeline for the test, plus an estimate for Phase 2;
- your expected cost per episode.

Thank you,
Seyali, Founder, Cliffra

Create product infographics, lifestyle images, feature highlights, and comparison charts.

Conduct competitor research to identify visual improvement opportunities.

Create mobile-optimized Amazon graphics and A+ Content layouts.

Maintain brand consistency across multiple products, SKUs, and variations.

AI Video Production Developer – Build an Automated Video Maker for Classic Cars

Project Overview
We are an established classic-car dealership looking for an experienced AI developer to build an automated video production system for our vehicle inventory.
We typically acquire 4–5 cars per week. Each car has its own organized Google Drive folder containing photographs, video clips, and a written description.
We want to develop an AI-powered video production agent that can automatically process these folders and produce professional promotional videos and graphics for each vehicle.

What We Provide
Each vehicle folder contains:
120+ landscape photographs.
At least 4 landscape video clips.
At least 4 vertical video clips.
A written vehicle description and relevant details.

We will provide examples of our existing YouTube videos and other promotional material to demonstrate the style and quality we expect.

What We Want the System to Produce
For each vehicle, the agent should automatically:
Analyze the photographs and video clips and select the most suitable material.
Create one professionally edited landscape promotional video for YouTube.
Create at least 2 vertical promotional videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.
Generate an attractive YouTube thumbnail.
Create suitable promotional graphics for social media.
Apply consistent branding, including our logo, fonts, titles, and preferred video style.

We prefer clean, professional presentations with good pacing and transitions rather than excessive visual effects.

Google Drive Integration
The system should:
Monitor a designated Google Drive folder for new vehicle folders.
Automatically retrieve and process the photographs and videos.
Save all completed videos, thumbnails, and graphics into the appropriate vehicle folder or its designated output subfolder.

Use consistent file naming and folder organization.

Notify us when processing is complete.

Quality and Accuracy
The finished videos must be professionally edited and visually appealing.
The system should avoid repetitive photographs, poor-quality selections, awkward transitions, and unnecessary effects.
It must not invent vehicle specifications, mechanical condition, restoration history, or features that have not been provided.

originalDescription.text:
We are building a tool that generates a realistic fashion runway video from a model’s photo and a selected runway scene. The finished video should look like an edited fashion show, with a natural walking pace, a visible audience, and camera cuts that follow the model down the runway.

We are looking for an engineer who can build a repeatable workflow. Our team should be able to upload a different model’s photo, select a runway scene, and generate a new video without hiring an editor for each model.
The main quality challenge is preserving the model’s likeness in motion.

In our previous tests, the face looked similar in a still frame, but the facial features shifted while walking, and the jaw appeared to move separately from the neck. We will evaluate the result at normal playback speed, especially as the model approaches the camera or turns slightly.

Milestone 1 — Paid proof of quality
* Use an authorized model photo and a real runway clip cleared for this use. For the first test, replace only the central model’s face. Preserve the original outfit, hairstyle, body movement, walking speed, camera motion, and audience.
* Deliver a 7–10 second continuous walking shot in which the face becomes clearly visible. Choose a shot with some natural head movement so we can judge likeness, facial stability, lighting, and the transition from jaw to neck.
* Provide the original clip and the result side by side, plus a clean MP4. Disclose any manual work, processing time, and generation cost, including retries.
* A single portrait is our preferred input. If your method needs additional views or a short recording, explain exactly what you need and what improvement it provides before we start.

Milestone 2 — Working automation
* Build a simple interface or API where our team uploads a model photo, selects a runway template, and generates the finished MP4.
* Support a short edited sequence combining a clear walking shot with a wider runway or audience angle. The model and outfit should remain consistent across cuts, and audience members should retain their original faces.
* Acceptance test: Our team will use a second authorized model photo and generate a new runway video without the developer manually tracking, masking, or retouching that model.
* Deliver the project-specific source code, setup instructions, and a breakdown of one-time template preparation, per-video costs, processing time, and third-party commercial licensing.

Contract: Fixed price by milestone. Please quote the pilot and the automation separately. We are open to commercial APIs, open-source models, or a hybrid approach. Explain why your approach fits this particular runway task.

originalDescription.text:
AI Virtual Influencer & Entertainment Production Specialist

Pvt.Space (https://pvt.space) is a next-generation, privacy-first social and monetisation platform. We are establishing a dedicated AI Creator and Entertainment division and are seeking an experienced AI specialist to help us develop hyper-realistic AI personalities and a scalable content production operation.

Our objective is to create engaging, lifelike AI personalities that produce regular entertainment content, build global audiences and demonstrate the monetisation opportunities available on Pvt.Space.

AI Personalities Required

We initially intend to develop eight distinct AI personalities:

- Sienna Lane: Travel and lifestyle influencer.
- Maya: Technology and business presenter.
- Isabella Rossi: Fashion, glamour and luxury lifestyle model.
- Alex Stone: Fitness and lifestyle influencer.
- Luna Chen: Digital fashion and culture influencer.
- Scarlett James: Singer and songwriter producing original music and music videos.
- JAX NOVA:DJ and electronic music producer.
- Jack Murphy: Stand-up comedian producing original comedy routines and entertainment videos.

We have already commenced development of Sienna Lane and Maya using HeyGen.

Key Requirements

- Hyper-realistic, true-to-life human appearance.
- Consistent facial features and body proportions across all images and videos.
- Natural facial expressions, gestures, movement and body language.
- Distinct personalities, realistic voices and appropriate accents.
- High-quality lip synchronisation.
- Realistic singing, musical performances and stand-up comedy.
- Cinematic-quality video production.
- Multiple outfits, hairstyles, environments and locations.
- Realistic travel, restaurant, nightclub, beach, gym, recording studio and stage environments.
- High-resolution photographic content.
- Vertical 9:16 and landscape 16:9 video production.
- Cost-effective, scalable and repeatable content generation.

Technical Experience

We are interested in applicants experienced with some or all of the following technologies:

- HeyGen
- ComfyUI
- FLUX
- Stable Diffusion
- Custom LoRA training
- ElevenLabs
- Suno
- Udio
- Kling AI
- OpenArt
- Runway
- AI workflow automation

We are open to alternative technologies and welcome recommendations on the most effective combination of AI tools to achieve exceptional realism, character consistency and manageable ongoing production costs.

Project Deliverables

- Development of eight consistent AI personalities.
- Comprehensive character profiles and reference image libraries.
- Unique voice configurations and personality guidelines.
- Reusable image, audio and video generation workflows.
- Original music, singing and comedy demonstration videos.
- Social media-ready photographic and video content.
- Production templates and reusable prompts.
- Recommendations for software, infrastructure and subscriptions.
- Complete workflow documentation.
- Training and knowledge transfer to our internal production team.
- Transfer of all transferable project assets and appropriate commercial usage rights.

All personalities must be original fictional adults, transparently identified as AI-generated, without unauthorised use of real individuals' likenesses or voices.

Long-Term Objective

We are not simply looking for someone to produce individual AI-generated videos. Our objective is to establish Pvt.Space AI Studios, a scalable internal AI entertainment and content production operation.

Our initial production target is approximately 36 content releases per week across eight personalities, subject to establishing a viable production workflow.

We also see opportunities to offer AI personality development and content production services to external creators and businesses in the future.

Application Requirements

Please provide the following with your application:

- Examples of hyper-realistic AI personalities you have created.
- Examples demonstrating consistent character appearance across multiple images and videos.
- Examples of AI-generated singing, music videos or comedy performances, where available.
- Your recommended AI software and production workflow.
- Estimated initial character development costs.
- Estimated ongoing content production costs.
- Proposed delivery timeframe.
- Experience with automation and scalable content production.
- Ability to provide training, documentation and ongoing technical support.

We intend to commence with a paid three-character pilot covering lifestyle content, singing and stand-up comedy before expanding to the complete eight-character portfolio.

We are looking for an innovative, experienced and commercially minded individual who can help us establish this exciting new division, with the potential for a long-term working relationship.

Please visit https://pvt.space to learn more about our platform.

Artificial Intelligence. Real Earnings.

Create Anywhere. Earn Everywhere.

originalDescription.text:
StartEngine is an equity crowdfunding platform where everyday investors can invest in private companies raising capital through Reg CF and Reg A+ offerings. Our paid media team needs a fast and efficient freelancer to make AI-generated short-form video ads promoting our top-tier issuers on Meta/Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok-style placements.

We're starting with a paid test project. If it goes well, ongoing work follows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Turn issuer materials and our creative briefs into scroll-stopping 15-30 second video ads using AI video, voice, and avatar tools plus traditional editing.
- Write and test several hooks for each concept, built to improve hook rate, CTR, and cost per lead.
- Follow securities advertising rules (details below). Every ad goes through StartEngine principal/compliance review before it runs, so expect compliance notes and quick edits.

PAID TEST PROJECT ($1,000 FIXED)
- One issuer, 1 video, 15-30 seconds.
- Include 2-3 alternate hooks (first 1-3 seconds) we can test.
- 3 aspect ratios: 9:16 (Reels/Stories/TikTok/Shorts), 1:1 (feed), and 16:9 (YouTube).
- First drafts within 24-48 hours of receiving the brief and assets.
- Up to 2 revision rounds, including any changes required by compliance review.

ONGOING WORK (IF THE TEST IS SUCCESSFUL)
- $1,000 per video (one concept delivered in 9:16, 1:1, and 16:9, with 2 revision rounds including compliance edits).
- Steady flow of new concepts and hook variations across multiple issuers.
- Same 24-48 hour first-draft turnaround.

DELIVERABLES AND SPECS
- Final MP4 files (H.264), 1080p minimum: 1080x1920 (9:16), 1080x1080 (1:1), 1920x1080 (16:9).
- Burned-in captions (most viewers watch with sound off), plus a clean version without captions on request.
- On-screen text and safe zones that work on each platform's UI.
- Required risk disclosures and legends included exactly as provided by our compliance team, readable and on screen long enough to read.
- Editable project files and source assets (voiceover audio, generated clips, music license info) delivered with the finals.
- A short note listing every AI tool, model, voice, avatar, music, and stock source used, with proof of commercial-use rights / license tier (e.g., paid plans that allow commercial use).

OWNERSHIP AND USAGE RIGHTS
- StartEngine gets full ownership and unrestricted commercial usage rights to all deliverables, for paid and organic use on any platform, with no time limit.
- No content may use real people's likenesses or voices, copyrighted music, or trademarks without proper rights. AI avatars and voices must be licensed for commercial advertising.

COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS (IMPORTANT)
These are securities offerings, so ads are regulated. You must be willing to work within:
- FINRA Rule 2210: content must be fair and balanced. No promissory, exaggerated, or misleading claims; no guarantees or projections of returns; benefits shown with related risks.
- Required risk disclosures and legends, provided by StartEngine, included as instructed.
- Reg CF Rule 204: limits on advertising offering terms outside the funding portal; ads point viewers to the offering page on StartEngine.
- Reg A+ testing-the-waters rules, including required legends where applicable.
- StartEngine principal/compliance review and approval of every ad before it runs. Only approved scripts and claims may be used. Don't add numbers, testimonials, or claims that aren't in the brief.

Experience in fintech, investing, crypto, insurance, healthcare, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.

MUST-HAVES
- Proven experience with AI video generation and editing tools (e.g., Runway, Kling, Veo, Sora, HeyGen, Synthesia, Pika, ElevenLabs, CapCut, Premiere/After Effects/DaVinci).
- A portfolio of short-form paid social ads with measurable results (CTR, CPA/CPL, ROAS, hook rate / thumb-stop rate).
- Comfortable with $1,000 per video ongoing pricing and the $1,000 fixed test project.
- Reliable 24-48 hour first-draft turnaround and responsive communication.
- Careful with compliance: follows briefs and disclosure requirements exactly.

CONFIDENTIALITY
You'll see non-public issuer and campaign information. You must keep all materials confidential, and not post the work in your portfolio or elsewhere without written permission.

HOW TO APPLY
1. Answer the screening questions below.
2. Include links to 2-3 AI-generated video ads you made, with results.

Generic or copy-paste proposals will be skipped. We review applications twice a day and move quickly.

originalDescription.text:
WinIt (appwinit.com) is a New York City app that helps drivers dispute parking tickets. We're scaling paid user acquisition on TikTok, Instagram Reels and Meta, and need a performance-minded AI video creator to produce scroll-stopping 15-30s ads.

WHAT YOU'LL MAKE
- UGC-style and hook-driven app ads: talking-head "I got a $65 ticket..." stories, problem/solution, POV, street-interview style, and app UI demos.
- Use Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Seedance or similar. Our app screens must stay clean and readable.
- For each concept: one main video plus 3 hook variations. Formats 9:16 and 4:5 (1:1 optional), with captions, voiceover, music and an end card.
- Improve each round based on the CTR and CPI data we share.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Paid test: 1 video of 15-30s plus 3 hooks, fixed price $50-80, delivered within 72h.
2. If it works: packs of 5-10 concepts a month on an ongoing basis.

REQUIREMENTS
- A portfolio of AI ads you made, with at least one app or SaaS ad if possible.
- Results you can share: CTR, CPA or CPI, spend, views, or Meta Ad Library links.
- Consistent characters (no face or wardrobe drift) and natural lip-sync.
- Full commercial usage rights. You cover generation credits, or say how you price them.
- Time zone: availability overlapping US Eastern Time (NYC), ideally 9am-1pm ET on weekdays, for quick feedback.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (DEFINITION OF DONE)
- Delivered on time.
- Matches the approved script and storyboard.
- No visible AI artifacts in hands, faces or text.
- App UI shown correctly.
- All formats and 3 hooks included.
- Captions are correct.
- Project files are available on request.

originalDescription.text:
I build websites for local businesses, including restaurants, barbershops, and retail stores. I’m looking for a reliable freelancer to create polished cinematic videos for the opening section of these websites.

Projects will typically be 15–30 seconds. There is potential for ongoing work across different clients. 

I will provide original video footage, photos, logos, creative direction, and reference examples. You will handle the editing, visual effects, quality control, and final exports.

What you’ll create

* Smooth cinematic sequences approaching a storefront, entering the business, and revealing the interior.
* Natural lighting and color improvements, including golden-hour or sunset treatments when requested.
* Removal of specified cars, people, clutter, and their associated reflections or shadows.
* Consistent transitions between supplied photo keyframes when a project requires image-to-video generation.
* Tasteful logo animations and brand reveals, with a short final hold when requested.

The most important requirement: visual continuity

The actual business must remain recognizable and physically consistent throughout the video. Buildings, signs, doors, furniture, appliances, shelves, and decorations must retain their correct shapes, proportions, and locations.

There should be no visible object morphing, flickering, sliding furniture, distorted lettering, changing door geometry, or unnatural camera transitions. Objects must overlap correctly according to perspective.

Preserve existing details unless a change is specifically requested. Review the entire video for errors and resolve them before delivery.

Experience needed

* Strong video editing, compositing, tracking, object removal, and color grading skills..
* Familiarity with AI video tools such as Kling or Runway, alongside professional editing/compositing tools where needed.
* Ability to choose an effective workflow and identify when additional source footage is necessary.
* Clear communication and reliable delivery.

Deliverables per project

* High-quality final master, with resolution agreed based on the source material.
* Compressed, muted MP4 suitable for use as a website hero video.
* A matching poster/thumbnail image.
* Organized editable project files and supporting assets where applicable.
* Two rounds of revisions included in the agreed scope.

If work is good and have good communication I will raise the hourly pay

originalDescription.text:
Job Description:

We build, launch and scale our own consumer brands in the US market. What began with two founders three years ago is now a team of 50+ people, with 5+ brands scaled into 7- and 8-figure businesses across health and wellness, consumer safety and telehealth.

What You Will Do

- Create premium static visuals, short-form videos and social-first content for a new beauty, skincare and wellness brand.
- Develop original creative concepts inspired by fashion editorials, luxury beauty campaigns and contemporary social media aesthetics.
- Use AI tools to produce sophisticated imagery, videos, product visuals and innovative creative concepts.
Help shape a distinctive, cohesive visual identity across paid advertising, organic social content and influencer collaborations.
- Create engaging, trend-aware content that resonates with younger audiences while maintaining a premium brand aesthetic.
- Collaborate with creative strategists, designers and editors to bring ideas from concept to execution.
- Experiment with new visual styles, creative formats and AI techniques to continuously elevate the brand's creative output.

What We Are Looking For

- Proven experience creating content for beauty, skincare, fashion or premium lifestyle brands.
- An exceptional portfolio demonstrating strong aesthetics, originality, visual storytelling and creative direction.
- Advanced graphic design skills and the ability to create or direct high-quality short-form video content.
Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, influencer content and emerging visual trends.
- Hands-on experience with AI image and video generation tools such as Midjourney, Nano Banana, Higgsfield, Kling or similar.
- Excellent eye for composition, typography, colour, art direction and premium branding.
- Ability to independently develop creative concepts and execute them to a high standard.
- Strong creative instincts, attention to detail and a proactive approach.
- Good English communication skills and ability to work independently.
- Nice to have: Experience with premium brands, beauty eCommerce website design, editorial photography or motion design.

Why Join Us?

🎨 Freedom to Create: Remote work, flexible hours and creative ownership. (CET overlap needed, 4h at least)
🤖 Powerful AI Toolkit: We provide the AI tools, prompts and production resources you need.
🚀 Real Creative Ownership: Work on established US brands, with creative testing budgets that allow your ideas to be launched, tested and scaled.
🧠 Learn from Strong Creatives: Collaborate with experienced strategists, editors and performance marketers, with access to real campaign data.

Compensation: $1500-$2500 / month


Our Mission and Your Goal

Our mission is to become one of the best companies in the world at what we do, working alongside people who are equally exceptional at what they do.

Your goal here is the same thing at a different scale: become the best at what you do. As you grow, the company grows, and as the company grows, so do your opportunities.

How We Work

Our values come from how our founders actually work, and we hire against them. If these read like a description of you, keep going.

🎯 Act with Intent. Every action has a reason you can say in one sentence. A creative made without a strategy is the most expensive thing we make.
🌟 Be World-Class. The bar is the best person in the world at your job, not the best person in the room.
🏆 Own the Outcome. If it's yours, you own the work, the result and the lesson. When it fails, you say so first. When it wins, you share why.
🔧 See It, Solve It. Don't walk past a problem. Name it and bring a proposed fix with it.
💬 Say the Hard Thing. Say what everyone is thinking, with respect, about the work and not the person. Take it the same way.
💡 Ask How, Not If. "Here's what it would take" beats "that's not possible."
⚡ Move Fast. Decide, ship, learn, repeat. When a test can settle a disagreement, we run the test.
📈 1% Every Day. Motivation comes and goes. Discipline compounds. Show up the same on a flat Tuesday as on launch day.

Our Hiring Process

Apply: Share your portfolio and a short application.
Paid Creative Task: Selected candidates complete a $50 paid assignment.
HR Interview: Discuss your experience, working style and availability.

Offer & Onboarding.

*This is strictly an individual contributor role. We work directly with independent professionals, not agencies or studios.

Because generation credits are covered on my end, I’m looking for finished, post-ready edits rather than silent raw clips:

Full Audio & Beat-Sync Editing: Every clip should be edited cleanly to the beat using my master mixes and instrumental stems (not silent raw generations).

Baked-In Lyric Animations: For the Lyric Video style pieces, animate bold, rhythmic lyric text synced to the beat directly inside the video.

Up to 2 Focused Revision Rounds: Since you can freely iterate with the provided credits, up to two focused revision rounds are included across the milestones to make sure character consistency and world atmosphere are spot-on.

Content Breakdown (How the 66 Pieces Are Structured):

Primary Focus — Individual Character Visuals (Odi, Sillow & Mill): The bulk of the batch focuses on the 3 main characters, kept strictly separate in their own distinct art style and Äkinoya environment. Each character has their own dedicated video reference subfolder (Ref_Odi, Ref_Sillow, Ref_Mill) showing the exact vibe, pacing, and transitions to aim for.

Signature Odi Concept (Ref_Odi): Includes adapting the multi-platform flip/jump transition concept where 3D Odi flips across different Äkinoya platforms/environments while the audio seamlessly switches across the 3 tracks (Could Forget, Memories, and Bingäa).

Primary Focus — Atmospheric Lyric Video Style (Ref_LyricVideo): Clean, hypnotic Äkinoya environment visuals featuring bold, rhythmic lyric text synced to the beat.

Supporting Filler — Environment Style (Environment style): Pure atmospheric Äkinoya world shots (without characters) to round out the batch and help comfortably reach the full 66 pieces while keeping the feed visually rich and cohesive.

Creative Freedom — Planet Äkinoya & Music Stems:

Expanding Planet Äkinoya: While reference environments anchor the look, I want you to invent new, jaw-dropping environments across planet Äkinoya. As long as you stay 100% faithful to the same visual style and planetary DNA (signature mushrooms, cold crystals, lighting, and atmosphere), feel free to create new concept-art locations—such as a glowing crystal beach, endless surreal fields, or uncharted corners of the planet.

Full Tracks & Personal Stems (Shared Upon Collaboration): To protect unreleased copyright and prevent leaks prior to release, the audio files are not included in the public briefing ZIP. The full master mixes and personal instrumental trackouts (guitar, kick, percussion, synths, etc.) for Could Forget, Memories, and Bingäa—along with the Higgsfield account credentials—will be shared privately as soon as we agree to collaborate (my 4th track Don't Need is a live-action music video I’m handling myself). Many Reels go viral purely on an emotional guitar riff or a punchy drum groove without vocals—so you’ll have full creative freedom to decide when to use the full vocal mix versus isolating instrumental stems for maximum atmosphere and beat sync.

Reference Pack (SillowMill_Akinoya_Briefing_Pack.zip):

Inside you’ll find 00_README_BRIEF.txt, separate folders for Odi, Sillow, and Mill (character sheets + style & environment references), and 04_Content_Ref_Videos_And_LyricsVideo (with dedicated subfolders for each character, the lyric video style, and environment-only shots).

Deliverables & Format:

66 finished, post-ready vertical Reels (9:16 / 1080x1920 preferred) with music/stems and lyric animations included, delivered in two batches of 33 (December 6 & December 10).

Clean files with no watermarks on the final paid deliveries.

Delivered as one organized ZIP file per milestone, sorted into clear character/scene subfolders (no shared cloud workspace needed).

originalDescription.text:
We run a restaurant in Singapore and we are building a weekly line of AI-made short videos for Instagram and TikTok. We need one senior person who can take an idea and turn it into a finished ad: the concept, the storyboard, the generated shots and the edit. We approve every video before it goes out.

PAY
- $15 per finished 9:16 video, 10 to 20 seconds, with captions.
- $0.50 for every extra hook variant (a new first 1-3 seconds) on a video we have approved.
- Volume: 5 to 7 videos a week, about 25 to 30 a month, so roughly $375 to $450 a month plus hooks. Paid per approved video, every week.
- Generation credits are on us. You generate on our own KIE.ai account, so you never spend your own money on tokens for our work.

PAID TEST FIRST (not free)
Before the weekly work starts you make two test videos, each paid at the same $15 rate as a fixed-price contract:
1. You get a finished storyline and send back the edit.
2. You get only an idea and send back your own storyline, storyboard and edit.
Both are paid whether or not we hire you. Generation for the test also runs on our KIE.ai account.

TOOLS
- All generation happens on KIE.ai with low-cost models: Wan 3.0 first, or another cheap video model on KIE.
- We do not use Higgsfield because its credits cost too much for this volume. If Higgsfield is the only tool you know, this job is not a fit.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Two kinds of brief. Some come with a finished storyline and need the edit. Others are only an idea, and you decide the angle, the hook options, the storyboard and the shots.
- Generate the shots on KIE and cut the credit cost per video wherever you can.
- Deliver 10 to 20 second vertical videos with captions, sound and 3 to 5 hook variants, ready to post.
- Real product photos are the reference for anything food-related. We never let a model invent what the food looks like.

WHO WE WANT
- 10 or more years of video editing, and at least a year of AI video generation in your recent work.
- You can explain your shot-by-shot credit cost, your model choice and where you would cut cost.
- You can find the angle yourself. We tell you the product and the goal, and you bring the idea.

HOW TO APPLY
Start your proposal with the word STORYBOARD. Then walk us through one AI video ad from idea to finish: the hook, the storyboard and the model you used for each shot. Link 3 finished AI videos. Proposals without sample links will not be read.

originalDescription.text:
I run a UK DTC ergonomic wellness brand and need 8 photorealistic lifestyle images of one specific product: a contoured memory foam cervical pillow. They'll go on our Shopify product page and in ads, so they must look like real photographs taken on a high-spec camera and edited by a photographer. They must not look rendered or AI-generated.

The hard part is accuracy. The pillow is a wide, chunky butterfly shape with two pointed wing tips and a deep scoop in the front edge. It has a diamond-quilted top with a button dimple and 3D spacer-mesh side walls with open holes. Our current images get this wrong, which is why we're replacing them. I'll supply customer photos, exact dimensions and a written spec, and you'll need to follow them.

Deliverables:
– 8 images, mostly 1:1 with a few 4:5 and 9:16, the pillow central with margin so they crop safely
– Mostly the grey variant, plus one white and one dark grey
– A mix of product and lifestyle shots: top-down, a side view showing both pillow heights, a person out of shot lifting or placing the pillow, and two or three shots of a person sleeping (I'll supply the character)
– Natural-light bedroom settings with linen and soft daylight, no studio look
– 3 samples first, then the other 5 once I approve them
– 2 revision rounds, high-resolution files and commercial usage rights

Definition of done:
1. 8 images delivered at 2000px or larger on the long edge, with no watermarks.
2. In every shot the pillow matches the spec: pointed wing tips, deep front scoop, diamond quilting and dimple, open-hole mesh, a fine flat seam with no raised piping, and the correct colours.
3. No visible AI artefacts: no warped hands or faces, no melted textures, no glossy or CGI sheen.
4. Both pillow heights are visible in the side-view shot.
5. Sizes are as listed, and the shots stay usable when cropped to square.

To apply, link 3 photorealistic product images you've made, ideally textured items like pillows or bedding, and say which tools you use. Ongoing creative work available if the images perform.
